`native/src/player.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common.h"
#include <ksmedia.h>

namespace hr {

struct AudioPlayback {
    ComPtr<IAudioClient> client;
    ComPtr<IAudioRenderClient> render;
    WAVEFORMATEX* mix_format = nullptr;
    SwrContext* resampler = nullptr;
    AVChannelLayout in_layout{};
    AVSampleFormat in_fmt = AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NONE;
    int in_rate = 0;
    UINT32 buffer_frames = 0;
    bool ready = false;

    bool configure_resampler(const AVChannelLayout* src_layout, AVSampleFormat src_fmt, int src_rate) {
        if (!src_layout || src_rate <= 0 || src_fmt < 0) return false;
        if (src_layout->nb_channels <= 0 || !av_channel_layout_check(src_layout)) return false;
        if (!mix_format || mix_format->nSamplesPerSec == 0 || mix_format->nChannels == 0) return false;

        AVChannelLayout out_layout{};
        if (mix_format->wFormatTag == WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE) {
            auto* ext = reinterpret_cast<WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE*>(mix_format);
            if (ext->dwChannelMask) av_channel_layout_from_mask(&out_layout, ext->dwChannelMask);
            else av_channel_layout_default(&out_layout, mix_format->nChannels);
        } else {
            av_channel_layout_default(&out_layout, mix_format->nChannels);
        }

        if (!av_channel_layout_check(&out_layout) || out_layout.nb_channels <= 0) {
            av_channel_layout_uninit(&out_layout);
            av_channel_layout_default(&out_layout, mix_format->nChannels);
        }

        AVSampleFormat out_fmt = (mix_format->wBitsPerSample == 32) ? AV_SAMPLE_FMT_FLT : AV_SAMPLE_FMT_S16;

        SwrContext* new_resampler = nullptr;
        int res = swr_alloc_set_opts2(&new_resampler, &out_layout, out_fmt, mix_format->nSamplesPerSec,
                                      src_layout, src_fmt, src_rate, 0, nullptr);
        av_channel_layout_uninit(&out_layout);
        if (res < 0 || !new_resampler) return false;
        if (swr_init(new_resampler) < 0) {
            swr_free(&new_resampler);
            return false;
        }

        if (resampler) swr_free(&resampler);
        resampler = new_resampler;

        av_channel_layout_uninit(&in_layout);
        if (av_channel_layout_copy(&in_layout, src_layout) < 0) {
            swr_free(&resampler);
            in_fmt = AV_SAMPLE_FMT_NONE;
            in_rate = 0;
            return false;
        }
        in_fmt = src_fmt;
        in_rate = src_rate;
        return true;
    }

    explicit AudioPlayback(AVCodecContext* codec) {
        if (!codec) return;
        try {
            ComPtr<IMMDeviceEnumerator> enumerator;
            if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(__uuidof(MMDeviceEnumerator), nullptr, CLSCTX_ALL, IID_PPV_ARGS(&enumerator)))) return;
            ComPtr<IMMDevice> device;
            if (FAILED(enumerator->GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(eRender, eConsole, &device))) return;
            if (FAILED(device->Activate(__uuidof(IAudioClient), CLSCTX_ALL, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(client.GetAddressOf())))) return;
            if (FAILED(client->GetMixFormat(&mix_format)) || !mix_format) return;
            if (FAILED(client->Initialize(AUDCLNT_SHAREMODE_SHARED, 0, 5'000'000, 0, mix_format, nullptr))) return;
            if (FAILED(client->GetBufferSize(&buffer_frames))) return;
            if (FAILED(client->GetService(IID_PPV_ARGS(&render)))) return;
            ready = true;

            if (codec->sample_rate > 0 && codec->sample_fmt >= 0 &&
                codec->ch_layout.nb_channels > 0 && av_channel_layout_check(&codec->ch_layout)) {
                configure_resampler(&codec->ch_layout, codec->sample_fmt, codec->sample_rate);
            }
        } catch (...) {
            ready = false;
        }
    }

    ~AudioPlayback() {
        if (client) client->Stop();
        if (resampler) swr_free(&resampler);
        av_channel_layout_uninit(&in_layout);
        if (mix_format) CoTaskMemFree(mix_format);
    }

    std::atomic<float> volume{1.0f};

    void set_volume(float v) {
        volume.store(std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f));
    }

    void reset() {
        if (client) client->Reset();
        if (resampler && swr_is_initialized(resampler)) {
            swr_close(resampler);
            swr_init(resampler);
        }
    }

    void write(AVFrame* frame) {
        if (!ready || !render || !frame) return;
        if (frame->nb_samples <= 0 || frame->sample_rate <= 0 || frame->format < 0) return;
        if (!frame->extended_data || !frame->extended_data[0]) return;
        if (frame->ch_layout.nb_channels <= 0 || !av_channel_layout_check(&frame->ch_layout)) return;

        if (!resampler ||
            av_channel_layout_compare(&in_layout, &frame->ch_layout) != 0 ||
            in_fmt != static_cast<AVSampleFormat>(frame->format) ||
            in_rate != frame->sample_rate) {
            if (!configure_resampler(&frame->ch_layout, static_cast<AVSampleFormat>(frame->format), frame->sample_rate)) {
                return;
            }
        }

        int out_samples = static_cast<int>(av_rescale_rnd(swr_get_delay(resampler, frame->sample_rate) + frame->nb_samples,
                                                          mix_format->nSamplesPerSec, frame->sample_rate, AV_ROUND_UP));
        if (out_samples <= 0) return;
        UINT32 padding = 0;
        if (FAILED(client->GetCurrentPadding(&padding))) return;
        if (padding >= buffer_frames) return;
        UINT32 available = buffer_frames - padding;
        UINT32 to_write = std::min(static_cast<UINT32>(out_samples), available);
        if (to_write == 0) return;

        BYTE* dest = nullptr;
        if (FAILED(render->GetBuffer(to_write, &dest))) return;
        uint8_t* out_ptrs[1]{dest};
        const uint8_t** in_ptrs = const_cast<const uint8_t**>(frame->extended_data);
        int converted = swr_convert(resampler, out_ptrs, to_write, in_ptrs, frame->nb_samples);
        if (converted > 0) {
            float vol = volume.load();
            if (vol <= 0.0001f) {
                memset(dest, 0, static_cast<size_t>(converted) * mix_format->nBlockAlign);
            } else if (vol < 0.999f || vol > 1.001f) {
                if (mix_format->wBitsPerSample == 32) {
                    float* s = reinterpret_cast<float*>(dest);
                    int total = converted * mix_format->nChannels;
                    for (int i = 0; i < total; ++i) {
                        s[i] *= vol;
                    }
                } else if (mix_format->wBitsPerSample == 16) {
                    int16_t* s = reinterpret_cast<int16_t*>(dest);
                    int total = converted * mix_format->nChannels;
                    for (int i = 0; i < total; ++i) {
                        s[i] = static_cast<int16_t>(std::clamp<int>(static_cast<int>(s[i] * vol), -32768, 32767));
                    }
                }
            }
            render->ReleaseBuffer(converted, 0);
        } else {
            render->ReleaseBuffer(0, 0);
        }
    }
};

struct PlayerImpl {
    AVFormatContext* format = nullptr;
    int video_stream_idx = -1;
    int audio_stream_idx = -1;
    Codec video_codec;
    Codec audio_codec;
    SwsContext* sws = nullptr;

    int out_width = 0;
    int out_height = 0;
    int out_stride = 0;
    double duration_sec = 0.0;
    double fps = 60.0;

    std::unique_ptr<AudioPlayback> audio_playback;
    std::atomic<float> volume{1.0f};

    std::atomic<bool> playing{false};
    std::atomic<bool> ended{false};
    std::atomic<bool> stop_worker{false};
    std::atomic<bool> seek_requested{false};
    std::atomic<double> seek_target_sec{0.0};
    std::atomic<double> current_pts_sec{0.0};

    std::mutex frame_mutex;
    std::vector<uint8_t> frame_bgra;
    std::vector<uint8_t> back_bgra; // Decode-thread scratch, swapped into frame_bgra under frame_mutex.
    double frame_pts = 0.0;
    bool has_new_frame = false;

    Frame downloaded = make_frame(); // System-memory copy of a GPU-decoded frame, reused per frame.

    // Scales outside the lock so the UI thread's read_frame never waits for a conversion. A D3D11 (GPU-decoded)
    // frame is first copied to system memory; the scaler follows the actual frame format and size, so a stream
    // that changes either mid-way is converted correctly instead of being read with stale parameters.
    void publish_frame(AVFrame* frame, double pts) {
        AVFrame* source = frame;
        if (frame->format == AV_PIX_FMT_D3D11) {
            av_frame_unref(downloaded.get());
            if (av_hwframe_transfer_data(downloaded.get(), frame, 0) < 0) return;
            source = downloaded.get();
        }
        sws = sws_getCachedContext(sws, source->width, source->height, static_cast<AVPixelFormat>(source->format),
                                   out_width, out_height, AV_PIX_FMT_BGRA, SWS_BILINEAR, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
        if (!sws) return;
        if (back_bgra.size() != frame_bgra.size()) back_bgra.resize(frame_bgra.size());
        uint8_t* dst_planes[1]{back_bgra.data()};
        int dst_strides[1]{out_stride};
        sws_scale(sws, source->data, source->linesize, 0, source->height, dst_planes, dst_strides);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(frame_mutex);
        frame_bgra.swap(back_bgra);
        frame_pts = pts;
        has_new_frame = true;
    }

    std::thread worker;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    std::mutex cv_mutex;

    std::mutex seek_mutex;
    std::condition_variable seek_done_cv;
    std::atomic<bool> seek_done{true}; // No seek is pending until player_seek requests one.

    std::mutex preview_mutex;
    AVFormatContext* preview_format = nullptr;
    Codec preview_codec;

    int64_t clock_start_qpc = 0;
    double clock_start_pts = 0.0;

    ~PlayerImpl() {
        stop_worker = true;
        playing = false;
        seek_done = true;
        cv.notify_all();
        seek_done_cv.notify_all();
        if (worker.joinable()) worker.join();

        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(preview_mutex);
            if (preview_format) avformat_close_input(&preview_format);
            preview_codec.reset();
        }

        if (sws) sws_freeContext(sws);
        if (format) avformat_close_input(&format);
    }

    void start_worker() {
        worker = std::thread([this] { worker_loop(); });
    }

    void perform_seek(double target) {
        if (target < 0.0) target = 0.0;
        if (duration_sec > 0.0 && target > duration_sec) target = duration_sec;

        AVRational tb = format->streams[video_stream_idx]->time_base;
        int64_t ts = static_cast<int64_t>(target / av_q2d(tb));
        int seek_flags = (target <= 0.05) ? (AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD | AVSEEK_FLAG_ANY) : AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD;
        av_seek_frame(format, video_stream_idx, (target <= 0.05 ? 0 : ts), seek_flags);

        avcodec_flush_buffers(video_codec.get());
        if (audio_codec) {
            avcodec_flush_buffers(audio_codec.get());
            if (audio_playback) audio_playback->reset();
        }

        auto packet = make_packet();
        auto frame = make_frame();
        // Frames between the keyframe and the target are decoded but not shown: publishing them made the picture
        // and the reported position run through the seconds before the target while a seek was still in progress.
        // If the target is never reached (end of file, decode budget), the last decoded frame is shown instead.
        auto last = make_frame();
        double last_pts = target;
        bool reached = false;
        for (int attempts = 0; attempts < 300 && av_read_frame(format, packet.get()) >= 0; ++attempts) {
            if (packet->stream_index == video_stream_idx) {
                if (avcodec_send_packet(video_codec.get(), packet.get()) >= 0) {
                    if (avcodec_receive_frame(video_codec.get(), frame.get()) >= 0) {
                        double pts = target;
                        if (frame->best_effort_timestamp != AV_NOPTS_VALUE) {
                            pts = frame->best_effort_timestamp * av_q2d(tb);
                        } else if (frame->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE) {
                            pts = frame->pts * av_q2d(tb);
                        }
                        if (target <= 0.05 || pts >= target - 0.05) {
                            publish_frame(frame.get(), pts);
                            current_pts_sec = pts;
                            reached = true;
                            av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                            break;
                        }
                        av_frame_unref(last.get());
                        av_frame_move_ref(last.get(), frame.get());
                        last_pts = pts;
                    }
                }
            }
            av_packet_unref(packet.get());
        }
        if (!reached && last->buf[0]) {
            publish_frame(last.get(), last_pts);
            current_pts_sec = last_pts;
        }

        clock_start_qpc = qpc_100ns();
        clock_start_pts = current_pts_sec.load();
        ended = false;
    }

    void worker_loop() {
        Apartment apartment;
        PreciseTimer pacer; // Video pacing at the frame rate needs sub-millisecond wakeups.
        // Reused for every packet; avcodec_receive_frame unreferences the frame before filling it.
        auto packet = make_packet();
        auto frame = make_frame();
        while (!stop_worker) {
            if (!playing && !seek_requested) {
                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(cv_mutex);
                cv.wait(lock, [&] { return playing.load() || stop_worker.load() || seek_requested.load(); });
            }
            if (stop_worker) break;

            if (seek_requested) {
                double target = seek_target_sec.load();
                seek_requested = false;
                perform_seek(target);
                seek_done = true;
                seek_done_cv.notify_all();
                continue;
            }

            int ret = av_read_frame(format, packet.get());
            if (ret < 0) {
                if (ret == AVERROR_EOF) {
                    playing = false;
                    ended = true;
                    if (audio_playback && audio_playback->client) audio_playback->client->Stop();
                }
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
                continue;
            }

            if (packet->stream_index == video_stream_idx) {
                if (avcodec_send_packet(video_codec.get(), packet.get()) >= 0) {
                    while (avcodec_receive_frame(video_codec.get(), frame.get()) >= 0) {
                        AVRational tb = format->streams[video_stream_idx]->time_base;
                        double pts = 0.0;
                        if (frame->best_effort_timestamp != AV_NOPTS_VALUE) {
                            pts = frame->best_effort_timestamp * av_q2d(tb);
                        } else if (frame->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE) {
                            pts = frame->pts * av_q2d(tb);
                        }

                        if (playing) {
                            double master_time = clock_start_pts + (qpc_100ns() - clock_start_qpc) / 10'000'000.0;
                            double diff = pts - master_time;
                            if (diff > 0.002 && diff < 0.5) {
                                pacer.sleep_for(std::chrono::duration<double>(diff));
                            }
                        }

                        publish_frame(frame.get(), pts);
                        current_pts_sec = pts;

                        if (seek_requested || !playing || stop_worker) break;
                    }
                }
            } else if (packet->stream_index == audio_stream_idx && audio_codec && audio_playback && audio_playback->ready) {
                if (avcodec_send_packet(audio_codec.get(), packet.get()) >= 0) {
                    while (avcodec_receive_frame(audio_codec.get(), frame.get()) >= 0) {
                        if (playing) {
                            audio_playback->write(frame.get());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            av_packet_unref(packet.get());
        }
    }
};

static AVPixelFormat prefer_d3d11(AVCodecContext* codec, const AVPixelFormat* formats) {
    for (const AVPixelFormat* format = formats; *format != AV_PIX_FMT_NONE; ++format)
        if (*format == AV_PIX_FMT_D3D11) return *format;
    return avcodec_default_get_format(codec, formats);
}

hr_player* player_open(const wchar_t* path, int32_t* width, int32_t* height, double* duration) {
    if (!path || !width || !height || !duration) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid player arguments.");
    auto player = std::make_unique<PlayerImpl>();
    std::string filename = utf8(path);

    avcheck(avformat_open_input(&player->format, filename.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr), "Open player media");
    avcheck(avformat_find_stream_info(player->format, nullptr), "Read stream info");

    const AVCodec* v_decoder = nullptr;
    player->video_stream_idx = av_find_best_stream(player->format, AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, -1, -1, &v_decoder, 0);
    avcheck(player->video_stream_idx, "Find video stream");

    player->video_codec = Codec(avcodec_alloc_context3(v_decoder));
    if (!player->video_codec) throw std::bad_alloc();
    avcheck(avcodec_parameters_to_context(player->video_codec.get(), player->format->streams[player->video_stream_idx]->codecpar), "Configure video decoder");
    // Decode on the GPU through D3D11VA when the device and driver support the stream; FFmpeg falls back to the
    // software decoder by itself when get_format is not offered D3D11 or the hardware setup fails.
    AVBufferRef* gpu = nullptr;
    if (av_hwdevice_ctx_create(&gpu, AV_HWDEVICE_TYPE_D3D11VA, nullptr, nullptr, 0) >= 0) {
        player->video_codec->hw_device_ctx = gpu; // The codec context takes this reference.
        player->video_codec->get_format = prefer_d3d11;
        player->video_codec->thread_count = 1;     // Hardware decoding does not benefit from frame threads.
    } else {
        player->video_codec->thread_count = 0;     // Software decoding: let FFmpeg pick the thread count.
    }
    avcheck(avcodec_open2(player->video_codec.get(), v_decoder, nullptr), "Open video decoder");

    if (avformat_open_input(&player->preview_format, filename.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr) >= 0) {
        if (avformat_find_stream_info(player->preview_format, nullptr) >= 0) {
            player->preview_codec = Codec(avcodec_alloc_context3(v_decoder));
            if (player->preview_codec) {
                avcodec_parameters_to_context(player->preview_codec.get(), player->preview_format->streams[player->video_stream_idx]->codecpar);
                player->preview_codec->thread_count = 2;
                avcodec_open2(player->preview_codec.get(), v_decoder, nullptr);
            }
        }
    }

    const AVCodec* a_decoder = nullptr;
    player->audio_stream_idx = av_find_best_stream(player->format, AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO, -1, -1, &a_decoder, 0);
    if (player->audio_stream_idx >= 0 && a_decoder) {
        player->audio_codec = Codec(avcodec_alloc_context3(a_decoder));
        if (player->audio_codec) {
            if (avcodec_parameters_to_context(player->audio_codec.get(), player->format->streams[player->audio_stream_idx]->codecpar) >= 0) {
                if (avcodec_open2(player->audio_codec.get(), a_decoder, nullptr) >= 0) {
                    player->audio_playback = std::make_unique<AudioPlayback>(player->audio_codec.get());
                    if (player->audio_playback) player->audio_playback->set_volume(player->volume.load());
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int raw_w = player->video_codec->width;
    int raw_h = player->video_codec->height;
    if (raw_w < 2 || raw_h < 2) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid video dimensions.");

    player->out_width = raw_w;
    player->out_height = raw_h;
    if (player->out_width > 1920) {
        player->out_height = std::max(2, static_cast<int>(av_rescale(player->out_height, 1920, player->out_width)));
        player->out_width = 1920;
        player->out_height = (player->out_height / 2) * 2;
    }
    player->out_stride = player->out_width * 4;
    player->frame_bgra.resize(static_cast<size_t>(player->out_stride) * player->out_height, 0);


    if (player->format->duration > 0) {
        player->duration_sec = static_cast<double>(player->format->duration) / AV_TIME_BASE;
    } else {
        auto* stream = player->format->streams[player->video_stream_idx];
        if (stream->duration > 0) player->duration_sec = stream->duration * av_q2d(stream->time_base);
    }

    AVRational r_fps = player->format->streams[player->video_stream_idx]->r_frame_rate;
    player->fps = (r_fps.den > 0 && r_fps.num > 0) ? av_q2d(r_fps) : 60.0;

    *width = player->out_width;
    *height = player->out_height;
    *duration = player->duration_sec;

    // Decode initial frame
    player->perform_seek(0.0);
    player->start_worker();

    return reinterpret_cast<hr_player*>(player.release());
}

void player_close(hr_player* ptr) {
    delete reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
}

void player_seek(hr_player* ptr, double seconds);

void player_play(hr_player* ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    auto* player = reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
    // perform_seek shares the demuxer and decoders with the decode loop, so only the worker may run it.
    if (player->ended) player_seek(ptr, 0.0);
    // A seek still running on the worker (player_seek waits at most 300 ms) restarts the clock itself when it
    // lands; starting it here from the pre-seek position would pace playback from the wrong point.
    if (player->seek_done && !player->seek_requested) {
        player->clock_start_qpc = qpc_100ns();
        player->clock_start_pts = player->current_pts_sec.load();
    }
    player->playing = true;
    if (player->audio_playback && player->audio_playback->client) player->audio_playback->client->Start();
    player->cv.notify_one();
}

void player_pause(hr_player* ptr) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    auto* player = reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
    player->playing = false;
    if (player->audio_playback && player->audio_playback->client) player->audio_playback->client->Stop();
}

void player_seek(hr_player* ptr, double seconds) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    auto* player = reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(player->seek_mutex);
    player->seek_done = false;
    player->seek_target_sec = seconds;
    player->seek_requested = true;
    player->cv.notify_one();
    player->seek_done_cv.wait_for(lock, std::chrono::milliseconds(300), [&] { return player->seek_done.load(); });
}

void player_get_state(hr_player* ptr, int32_t* is_playing, int32_t* is_ended, double* current_pts) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    auto* player = reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
    if (is_playing) *is_playing = player->playing.load() ? 1 : 0;
    if (is_ended) *is_ended = player->ended.load() ? 1 : 0;
    if (current_pts) *current_pts = player->current_pts_sec.load();
}

void player_read_frame(hr_player* ptr, uint8_t* buffer, int32_t stride, int32_t width, int32_t height, int32_t* updated, double* pts) {
    if (!ptr || !buffer || !updated || !pts) return;
    auto* player = reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
    *updated = 0;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(player->frame_mutex);
    *pts = player->frame_pts;
    if (player->has_new_frame && width == player->out_width && height == player->out_height && stride == player->out_stride) {
        memcpy(buffer, player->frame_bgra.data(), player->frame_bgra.size());
        *updated = 1;
        player->has_new_frame = false;
    }
}

void player_preview(hr_player* ptr, double seconds, int32_t max_width,
                    uint8_t** pixels, int32_t* width, int32_t* height, int32_t* stride) {
    if (!ptr || !pixels || !width || !height || !stride || max_width < 32 || max_width > 1920)
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid preview arguments.");
    *pixels = nullptr;
    auto* player = reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
    if (!player) throw std::runtime_error("Null player.");
    if (player->stop_worker.load()) throw std::runtime_error("Player closing.");

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(player->preview_mutex);
    if (player->stop_worker.load() || !player->preview_format || !player->preview_codec)
        throw std::runtime_error("Preview decoder not available.");

    AVRational tb = player->preview_format->streams[player->video_stream_idx]->time_base;
    int64_t ts = static_cast<int64_t>(seconds / av_q2d(tb));
    int seek_flags = (seconds <= 0.05) ? (AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD | AVSEEK_FLAG_ANY) : AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD;
    av_seek_frame(player->preview_format, player->video_stream_idx, (seconds <= 0.05 ? 0 : ts), seek_flags);
    avcodec_flush_buffers(player->preview_codec.get());

    auto packet = make_packet();
    auto frame = make_frame();
    auto best_frame = make_frame();
    double best_diff = 1e9;
    bool decoded = false;

    for (int attempts = 0; attempts < 250 && !player->stop_worker.load() && av_read_frame(player->preview_format, packet.get()) >= 0; ++attempts) {
        if (packet->stream_index == player->video_stream_idx) {
            if (avcodec_send_packet(player->preview_codec.get(), packet.get()) >= 0) {
                while (avcodec_receive_frame(player->preview_codec.get(), frame.get()) >= 0) {
                    double pts = frame->best_effort_timestamp != AV_NOPTS_VALUE
                        ? frame->best_effort_timestamp * av_q2d(tb)
                        : (frame->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? frame->pts * av_q2d(tb) : seconds);

                    double diff = std::abs(pts - seconds);
                    if (diff < best_diff) {
                        best_diff = diff;
                        av_frame_unref(best_frame.get());
                        av_frame_ref(best_frame.get(), frame.get());
                        decoded = true;
                    }

                    if (diff < 0.08 || pts > seconds + 0.1) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (decoded && (best_diff < 0.08 || attempts > 80)) {
                    av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        av_packet_unref(packet.get());
    }

    if (!decoded || best_frame->width < 1 || best_frame->height < 1) throw std::runtime_error("No decodable preview frame.");

    *width = std::min(max_width, best_frame->width);
    *height = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(av_rescale(best_frame->height, *width, best_frame->width)));
    *stride = *width * 4;

    SwsContext* scaler = sws_getContext(best_frame->width, best_frame->height, static_cast<AVPixelFormat>(best_frame->format),
                                        *width, *height, AV_PIX_FMT_BGRA, SWS_FAST_BILINEAR, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (!scaler) throw std::runtime_error("Preview scaler unavailable.");

    auto* output = static_cast<uint8_t*>(av_malloc(static_cast<size_t>(*stride) * *height));
    if (!output) { sws_freeContext(scaler); throw std::bad_alloc(); }
    uint8_t* planes[]{output, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
    int lines[]{*stride, 0, 0, 0};
    int res = sws_scale(scaler, best_frame->data, best_frame->linesize, 0, best_frame->height, planes, lines);
    sws_freeContext(scaler);
    if (res <= 0) { av_free(output); throw std::runtime_error("Preview conversion failed."); }
    *pixels = output;
}

void player_set_volume(hr_player* ptr, float volume) {
    if (!ptr) return;
    auto* player = reinterpret_cast<PlayerImpl*>(ptr);
    float clamped = std::clamp(volume, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    player->volume.store(clamped);
    if (player->audio_playback) {
        player->audio_playback->set_volume(clamped);
    }
}

} // namespace hr

```

`native/src/trim.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common.h"

namespace hr {

struct SwsDelete {
    void operator()(SwsContext* p) const {
        if (p) sws_freeContext(p);
    }
};
using Sws = std::unique_ptr<SwsContext, SwsDelete>;

// The H.264 encoder for a frame-accurate cut: the first GPU encoder that opens on this machine, so a trim does
// not load the CPU, else libx264. Every candidate takes system-memory frames; no D3D11 device is needed.
// Quality targets the source: about its bitrate, capped at 1.5x, with an IDR on the first frame.
static Codec open_trim_encoder(const AVCodecContext* dec, const AVStream* source, int64_t container_bitrate) {
    struct Candidate { const char* name; AVPixelFormat format; std::vector<std::pair<const char*, const char*>> options; };
    const Candidate candidates[] = {
        {"h264_nvenc", AV_PIX_FMT_NV12, {{"preset", "p5"}, {"tune", "hq"}, {"rc", "vbr"}, {"forced-idr", "1"}}},
        {"h264_amf", AV_PIX_FMT_NV12, {{"usage", "transcoding"}, {"quality", "quality"}, {"rc", "vbr_peak"}, {"forced_idr", "1"}}},
        {"h264_qsv", AV_PIX_FMT_NV12, {{"preset", "medium"}, {"forced_idr", "1"}}},
        {"libx264", AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P, {{"preset", "veryfast"}, {"crf", "20"}}},
    };
    int64_t bitrate = source->codecpar->bit_rate > 0 ? source->codecpar->bit_rate
        : container_bitrate > 0 ? container_bitrate : 6'000'000;
    AVRational fps = source->avg_frame_rate.num > 0 ? source->avg_frame_rate : source->r_frame_rate;
    if (fps.num <= 0 || fps.den <= 0) fps = AVRational{30, 1};
    std::string tried;
    for (const auto& candidate : candidates) {
        const AVCodec* encoder = avcodec_find_encoder_by_name(candidate.name);
        if (!encoder) continue;
        Codec enc(avcodec_alloc_context3(encoder));
        if (!enc) throw std::bad_alloc();
        enc->width = dec->width;
        enc->height = dec->height;
        enc->pix_fmt = candidate.format;
        enc->framerate = fps;
        // Source time base keeps variable-frame-rate capture timing intact.
        enc->time_base = source->time_base;
        enc->max_b_frames = 0;
        enc->gop_size = (fps.num / fps.den > 0) ? (fps.num / fps.den) : 30;
        enc->flags |= AV_CODEC_FLAG_GLOBAL_HEADER | AV_CODEC_FLAG_CLOSED_GOP;
        // libx264 is driven by CRF with a VBV cap; the GPU encoders by an average bitrate with the same cap.
        if (candidate.format != AV_PIX_FMT_YUV420P) enc->bit_rate = bitrate;
        enc->rc_max_rate = bitrate * 3 / 2;
        enc->rc_buffer_size = static_cast<int>(std::min<int64_t>(bitrate * 3, INT32_MAX));
        enc->color_range = dec->color_range;
        enc->colorspace = dec->colorspace;
        enc->color_primaries = dec->color_primaries;
        enc->color_trc = dec->color_trc;
        enc->sample_aspect_ratio = dec->sample_aspect_ratio;
        AVDictionary* options = nullptr;
        for (const auto& [key, value] : candidate.options) av_dict_set(&options, key, value, 0);
        int result = avcodec_open2(enc.get(), encoder, &options);
        av_dict_free(&options);
        if (result >= 0) {
            ffmpeg_detail.clear(); // A skipped candidate's message ("Cannot load nvcuda.dll") must not tag later errors.
            return enc;
        }
        tried += std::string(tried.empty() ? "" : ", ") + candidate.name;
    }
    throw std::runtime_error("No H.264 encoder could be opened for frame-accurate trimming (tried: " + tried + ").");
}

// Keeps DTS strictly increasing per output stream and PTS >= DTS, then interleaves the packet.
static void write_monotonic(AVFormatContext* output, AVPacket* packet, std::vector<int64_t>& last_dts, const char* operation) {
    auto& last = last_dts[packet->stream_index];
    if (last != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && packet->dts <= last) packet->dts = last + 1;
    if (packet->pts < packet->dts) packet->pts = packet->dts;
    last = packet->dts;
    avcheck(av_interleaved_write_frame(output, packet), operation);
}

struct TrimOutputGuard {
    AVFormatContext* format = nullptr;
    std::wstring path;
    bool committed = false;

    explicit TrimOutputGuard(std::wstring p) : path(std::move(p)) {}
    ~TrimOutputGuard() {
        if (format) {
            if (format->pb) avio_closep(&format->pb);
            avformat_free_context(format);
            format = nullptr;
        }
        if (!committed && !path.empty()) {
            _wremove(path.c_str());
        }
    }
};

void trim(const wchar_t* source_path, const wchar_t* target_path,
          double start_seconds, double end_seconds, bool accurate,
          hr_trim_progress_callback progress_cb, void* user) {
    if (!source_path || !target_path || source_path[0] == L'\0' || target_path[0] == L'\0') {
        throw std::runtime_error("Missing source or target path.");
    }
    if (_wcsicmp(source_path, target_path) == 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Destination path cannot be identical to source path.");
    }
    if (!std::isfinite(start_seconds) || !std::isfinite(end_seconds)) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Trim boundaries must be finite.");
    }
    if (start_seconds < 0.0) start_seconds = 0.0;
    if (end_seconds <= start_seconds) {
        throw std::runtime_error("End time must strictly exceed start time.");
    }
    if (end_seconds - start_seconds < 0.1) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Clip duration is too short (minimum 0.1s).");
    }

    struct InputContext {
        AVFormatContext* format = nullptr;
        ~InputContext() {
            if (format) avformat_close_input(&format);
        }
    } input;

    std::string in_file = utf8(source_path);
    avcheck(avformat_open_input(&input.format, in_file.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr), "Open source media for trim");
    avcheck(avformat_find_stream_info(input.format, nullptr), "Read stream info for trim");

    int video_idx = av_find_best_stream(input.format, AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, -1, -1, nullptr, 0);
    if (video_idx < 0) {
        throw std::runtime_error("No video stream found in source media.");
    }

    AVStream* in_vst = input.format->streams[video_idx];
    int64_t start_us = static_cast<int64_t>(start_seconds * 1'000'000.0);
    int64_t end_us = static_cast<int64_t>(end_seconds * 1'000'000.0);
    int64_t target_pts = static_cast<int64_t>(start_seconds / av_q2d(in_vst->time_base));

    // Estimate single frame duration in microseconds
    int64_t frame_dur_us = 33333; // Fallback ~30fps
    if (in_vst->avg_frame_rate.num > 0 && in_vst->avg_frame_rate.den > 0) {
        frame_dur_us = av_rescale_q(1, av_inv_q(in_vst->avg_frame_rate), microseconds);
    } else if (in_vst->r_frame_rate.num > 0 && in_vst->r_frame_rate.den > 0) {
        frame_dur_us = av_rescale_q(1, av_inv_q(in_vst->r_frame_rate), microseconds);
    }
    if (frame_dur_us <= 0) frame_dur_us = 33333;

    // Determine whether frame-accurate re-encoding is required.
    // When accurate == true or cutting at a non-keyframe, frame-accurate re-encoding is performed.
    bool need_reencode = accurate;
    if (!need_reencode) {
        if (start_seconds <= 0.05) {
            need_reencode = false; // Starts at origin 0.0s
        } else {
            bool is_keyframe_aligned = false;
            int entries_count = avformat_index_get_entries_count(in_vst);
            if (entries_count > 0) {
                const AVIndexEntry* entry_bw = avformat_index_get_entry_from_timestamp(in_vst, target_pts, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD);
                if (entry_bw && (entry_bw->flags & AVINDEX_KEYFRAME)) {
                    int64_t entry_pts_us = av_rescale_q(entry_bw->timestamp, in_vst->time_base, microseconds);
                    if (std::abs(entry_pts_us - start_us) <= frame_dur_us / 2) {
                        is_keyframe_aligned = true;
                    }
                }
                if (!is_keyframe_aligned) {
                    const AVIndexEntry* entry_fw = avformat_index_get_entry_from_timestamp(in_vst, target_pts, 0);
                    if (entry_fw && (entry_fw->flags & AVINDEX_KEYFRAME)) {
                        int64_t entry_pts_us = av_rescale_q(entry_fw->timestamp, in_vst->time_base, microseconds);
                        if (std::abs(entry_pts_us - start_us) <= frame_dur_us / 2) {
                            is_keyframe_aligned = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Probe nearest preceding keyframe via demuxer seek
                if (av_seek_frame(input.format, video_idx, target_pts, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD) >= 0) {
                    auto probe_pkt = make_packet();
                    while (av_read_frame(input.format, probe_pkt.get()) >= 0) {
                        if (probe_pkt->stream_index == video_idx && (probe_pkt->flags & AV_PKT_FLAG_KEY)) {
                            int64_t pts = probe_pkt->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? probe_pkt->pts : probe_pkt->dts;
                            int64_t pkt_pts_us = av_rescale_q(pts, in_vst->time_base, microseconds);
                            if (std::abs(pkt_pts_us - start_us) <= frame_dur_us / 2) {
                                is_keyframe_aligned = true;
                            }
                            break;
                        }
                        av_packet_unref(probe_pkt.get());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!is_keyframe_aligned) {
                need_reencode = true;
            }
        }
    }

    Codec dec_ctx;
    Codec enc_ctx;
    if (need_reencode) {
        const AVCodec* decoder = avcodec_find_decoder(in_vst->codecpar->codec_id);
        if (!decoder) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported video codec for decode in trim.");
        }
        dec_ctx = Codec(avcodec_alloc_context3(decoder));
        if (!dec_ctx) throw std::bad_alloc();
        avcheck(avcodec_parameters_to_context(dec_ctx.get(), in_vst->codecpar), "Configure video decoder parameters");
        dec_ctx->thread_count = 0; // Let FFmpeg pick the thread count for this machine.
        avcheck(avcodec_open2(dec_ctx.get(), decoder, nullptr), "Open video decoder for trim");
        enc_ctx = open_trim_encoder(dec_ctx.get(), in_vst, input.format->bit_rate);
    }

    TrimOutputGuard output(target_path);
    std::string out_file = utf8(target_path);
    avcheck(avformat_alloc_output_context2(&output.format, nullptr, "mp4", out_file.c_str()), "Allocate trim output context");
    if (!output.format) throw std::bad_alloc();

    std::vector<int> stream_map(input.format->nb_streams, -1);
    int active_audio_streams = 0;

    for (unsigned int i = 0; i < input.format->nb_streams; ++i) {
        AVStream* in_st = input.format->streams[i];
        if (in_st->codecpar->codec_type != AVMEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO &&
            in_st->codecpar->codec_type != AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO) {
            continue;
        }

        AVStream* out_st = avformat_new_stream(output.format, nullptr);
        if (!out_st) throw std::bad_alloc();

        if (i == static_cast<unsigned int>(video_idx) && need_reencode) {
            avcheck(avcodec_parameters_from_context(out_st->codecpar, enc_ctx.get()), "Copy trim encoder parameters to output stream");
            out_st->codecpar->codec_tag = 0;
            out_st->time_base = enc_ctx->time_base;
            out_st->avg_frame_rate = enc_ctx->framerate;
            out_st->r_frame_rate = enc_ctx->framerate;
        } else {
            avcheck(avcodec_parameters_copy(out_st->codecpar, in_st->codecpar), "Copy stream codec parameters");
            out_st->codecpar->codec_tag = 0;
            if (out_st->codecpar->codec_id == AV_CODEC_ID_HEVC) {
                out_st->codecpar->codec_tag = MKTAG('h', 'v', 'c', '1');
            }
            out_st->time_base = in_st->time_base;
            out_st->avg_frame_rate = in_st->avg_frame_rate;
            out_st->r_frame_rate = in_st->r_frame_rate;
        }

        out_st->disposition = in_st->disposition;
        av_dict_copy(&out_st->metadata, in_st->metadata, 0);

        if (in_st->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO) {
            active_audio_streams++;
        }

        stream_map[i] = out_st->index;
    }

    avcheck(avio_open(&output.format->pb, out_file.c_str(), AVIO_FLAG_WRITE), "Open trim output file");
    AVDictionary* options = nullptr;
    av_dict_set(&options, "movflags", "+faststart", 0);
    int res = avformat_write_header(output.format, &options);
    av_dict_free(&options);
    avcheck(res, "Write trim MP4 header");

    // Seek backward to preceding keyframe
    if (start_seconds > 0.05) {
        int seek_res = av_seek_frame(input.format, video_idx, target_pts, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD);
        if (seek_res < 0) {
            av_seek_frame(input.format, video_idx, 0, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD);
        }
    } else {
        av_seek_frame(input.format, video_idx, 0, AVSEEK_FLAG_BACKWARD);
    }

    int64_t origin_us = AV_NOPTS_VALUE;
    std::vector<int64_t> last_dts(output.format->nb_streams, AV_NOPTS_VALUE);
    std::vector<bool> audio_done(input.format->nb_streams, false);
    int completed_audio_streams = 0;
    bool video_started = false;
    bool video_done = false;
    bool video_flushed = false;
    int64_t last_encoded_pts = AV_NOPTS_VALUE;

    struct QueuedAudioPacket {
        Packet pkt;
        int in_idx;
        int64_t pts_us;
        int64_t dts_us;
    };
    std::deque<QueuedAudioPacket> audio_queue;
    Sws sws_ctx;
    Frame converted_frame; // Pixel-format conversion target, allocated once per output size.

    auto packet = make_packet();
    auto dec_frame = make_frame();
    auto enc_pkt = make_packet();

    double trim_duration = end_seconds - start_seconds;
    if (trim_duration < 0.1) trim_duration = 0.1;
    int packet_counter = 0;

    auto write_audio_packet = [&](AVPacket* pkt, int in_stream_idx, int64_t pts_us, int64_t dts_us) {
        if (pts_us < origin_us) {
            return; // Discard audio packet preceding origin_us (privacy leak prevention)
        }
        if (pts_us > end_us) {
            if (!audio_done[in_stream_idx]) {
                audio_done[in_stream_idx] = true;
                completed_audio_streams++;
            }
            return;
        }

        int out_stream_idx = stream_map[in_stream_idx];
        AVStream* in_stream = input.format->streams[in_stream_idx];
        AVStream* out_stream = output.format->streams[out_stream_idx];

        int64_t rel_pts_us = pts_us - origin_us;
        int64_t rel_dts_us = dts_us >= origin_us ? (dts_us - origin_us) : rel_pts_us;

        pkt->pts = av_rescale_q(rel_pts_us, microseconds, out_stream->time_base);
        pkt->dts = av_rescale_q(rel_dts_us, microseconds, out_stream->time_base);
        if (pkt->duration > 0) {
            pkt->duration = av_rescale_q(pkt->duration, in_stream->time_base, out_stream->time_base);
        }
        pkt->pos = -1;
        pkt->stream_index = out_stream_idx;
        write_monotonic(output.format, pkt, last_dts, "Write remuxed audio packet");
    };

    auto report_progress = [&](int64_t rel_pts_us) {
        if (!progress_cb || ++packet_counter % 10 != 0) return;
        double prog = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(rel_pts_us) / 1'000'000.0 / trim_duration, 0.0, 0.99);
        if (progress_cb(user, prog) != 0) throw std::runtime_error("Trim cancelled by the user.");
    };

    // Moves every packet the encoder has ready into the output. av_packet_rescale_ts converts duration too.
    auto drain_encoder = [&](const char* operation, int64_t rel_pts_us) {
        int out_v_idx = stream_map[video_idx];
        AVStream* out_v_st = output.format->streams[out_v_idx];
        while (avcodec_receive_packet(enc_ctx.get(), enc_pkt.get()) == 0) {
            enc_pkt->stream_index = out_v_idx;
            av_packet_rescale_ts(enc_pkt.get(), enc_ctx->time_base, out_v_st->time_base);
            enc_pkt->pos = -1;
            write_monotonic(output.format, enc_pkt.get(), last_dts, operation);
            av_packet_unref(enc_pkt.get());
            if (rel_pts_us >= 0) report_progress(rel_pts_us);
        }
    };

    auto flush_audio_queue = [&]() {
        while (!audio_queue.empty()) {
            auto& q = audio_queue.front();
            write_audio_packet(q.pkt.get(), q.in_idx, q.pts_us, q.dts_us);
            audio_queue.pop_front();
        }
    };

    auto flush_encoder = [&]() {
        if (!video_flushed && need_reencode && enc_ctx) {
            video_flushed = true;
            avcodec_send_frame(enc_ctx.get(), nullptr);
            drain_encoder("Write flushed trim video packet", -1);
        }
    };

    auto encode_video_frame = [&](AVFrame* frame) {
        int64_t frame_pts = frame->best_effort_timestamp != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? frame->best_effort_timestamp : frame->pts;
        if (frame_pts == AV_NOPTS_VALUE) return;
        int64_t frame_pts_us = av_rescale_q(frame_pts, in_vst->time_base, microseconds);

        if (!video_started) {
            if (frame_pts_us < start_us) {
                return; // Discard pre-roll video frame
            }
            video_started = true;
            origin_us = frame_pts_us;
            flush_audio_queue();
        }

        if (frame_pts_us > end_us) {
            video_done = true;
            return;
        }

        AVFrame* frame_to_send = frame;
        if (frame->format != enc_ctx->pix_fmt ||
            frame->width != enc_ctx->width ||
            frame->height != enc_ctx->height) {
            sws_ctx.reset(sws_getCachedContext(
                sws_ctx.release(),
                frame->width, frame->height, static_cast<AVPixelFormat>(frame->format),
                enc_ctx->width, enc_ctx->height, enc_ctx->pix_fmt,
                SWS_BILINEAR, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr));
            if (!sws_ctx) throw std::bad_alloc();

            if (!converted_frame) {
                converted_frame = make_frame();
                converted_frame->format = enc_ctx->pix_fmt;
                converted_frame->width = enc_ctx->width;
                converted_frame->height = enc_ctx->height;
                avcheck(av_frame_get_buffer(converted_frame.get(), 32), "Allocate converted frame buffer");
            } else {
                // The encoder may still reference the previous picture; this copies only in that case.
                avcheck(av_frame_make_writable(converted_frame.get()), "Reuse converted frame buffer");
            }
            sws_scale(sws_ctx.get(), frame->data, frame->linesize, 0, frame->height,
                      converted_frame->data, converted_frame->linesize);
            frame_to_send = converted_frame.get();
        }

        int64_t rel_pts_us = frame_pts_us - origin_us;
        int64_t enc_pts = av_rescale_q(rel_pts_us, microseconds, enc_ctx->time_base);
        if (last_encoded_pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE && enc_pts <= last_encoded_pts) {
            enc_pts = last_encoded_pts + 1;
        }
        last_encoded_pts = enc_pts;
        frame_to_send->pts = enc_pts;

        if (enc_pts == 0) {
            frame_to_send->pict_type = AV_PICTURE_TYPE_I;
            frame_to_send->flags |= AV_FRAME_FLAG_KEY;
        } else {
            frame_to_send->pict_type = AV_PICTURE_TYPE_NONE;
            frame_to_send->flags &= ~AV_FRAME_FLAG_KEY;
        }

        avcheck(avcodec_send_frame(enc_ctx.get(), frame_to_send), "Send frame to trim video encoder");
        drain_encoder("Write encoded trim video packet", rel_pts_us);
    };

    while (av_read_frame(input.format, packet.get()) >= 0) {
        int in_idx = packet->stream_index;
        if (in_idx < 0 || in_idx >= static_cast<int>(stream_map.size()) || stream_map[in_idx] < 0) {
            av_packet_unref(packet.get());
            continue;
        }

        AVStream* in_st = input.format->streams[in_idx];
        int out_idx = stream_map[in_idx];
        AVStream* out_st = output.format->streams[out_idx];

        int64_t pkt_pts = packet->pts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? packet->pts : packet->dts;
        int64_t pkt_dts = packet->dts != AV_NOPTS_VALUE ? packet->dts : packet->pts;
        if (pkt_pts == AV_NOPTS_VALUE && pkt_dts == AV_NOPTS_VALUE) {
            av_packet_unref(packet.get());
            continue;
        }

        int64_t pkt_pts_us = av_rescale_q(pkt_pts, in_st->time_base, microseconds);
        int64_t pkt_dts_us = av_rescale_q(pkt_dts, in_st->time_base, microseconds);

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Audio stream handling
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        if (in_st->codecpar->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO) {
            if (audio_done[in_idx]) {
                av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                continue;
            }

            if (pkt_pts_us > end_us) {
                if (!audio_done[in_idx]) {
                    audio_done[in_idx] = true;
                    completed_audio_streams++;
                }
                av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                if (video_done && completed_audio_streams >= active_audio_streams) {
                    break;
                }
                continue;
            }

            // Privacy: discard audio prior to requested start
            if (pkt_pts_us < start_us || pkt_dts_us < start_us) {
                av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                continue;
            }

            if (!video_started) {
                QueuedAudioPacket q;
                q.pkt = make_packet();
                av_packet_move_ref(q.pkt.get(), packet.get());
                q.in_idx = in_idx;
                q.pts_us = pkt_pts_us;
                q.dts_us = pkt_dts_us;
                audio_queue.push_back(std::move(q));
                continue;
            }

            write_audio_packet(packet.get(), in_idx, pkt_pts_us, pkt_dts_us);
            av_packet_unref(packet.get());

            if (video_done && completed_audio_streams >= active_audio_streams) {
                break;
            }
            continue;
        }

        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        // Video stream handling
        // -------------------------------------------------------------
        if (in_idx == video_idx) {
            if (need_reencode) {
                if (video_done) {
                    av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                    if (pkt_pts_us > end_us + 1'500'000) {
                        break;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                int ret = avcodec_send_packet(dec_ctx.get(), packet.get());
                av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                if (ret < 0) continue;

                while (avcodec_receive_frame(dec_ctx.get(), dec_frame.get()) == 0) {
                    encode_video_frame(dec_frame.get());
                    av_frame_unref(dec_frame.get());
                    if (video_done) {
                        flush_encoder();
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (video_done && completed_audio_streams >= active_audio_streams) {
                    break;
                }
                continue;
            } else {
                // Fast Stream Copy Path
                if (video_done) {
                    av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                    if (pkt_pts_us > end_us + 1'500'000) {
                        break;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                if (!video_started) {
                    if ((packet->flags & AV_PKT_FLAG_KEY) &&
                        (start_seconds <= 0.05 || pkt_pts_us >= start_us - frame_dur_us / 2)) {
                        video_started = true;
                        origin_us = std::min(pkt_pts_us, pkt_dts_us);
                        flush_audio_queue();
                    } else {
                        av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                if (pkt_dts_us < origin_us || pkt_pts_us < origin_us) {
                    av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                    continue;
                }

                if (pkt_pts_us > end_us) {
                    video_done = true;
                    av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                    if (completed_audio_streams >= active_audio_streams) {
                        break;
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                int64_t rel_pts_us = pkt_pts_us - origin_us;
                int64_t rel_dts_us = pkt_dts_us - origin_us;

                packet->pts = av_rescale_q(rel_pts_us, microseconds, out_st->time_base);
                packet->dts = av_rescale_q(rel_dts_us, microseconds, out_st->time_base);
                if (packet->duration > 0) {
                    packet->duration = av_rescale_q(packet->duration, in_st->time_base, out_st->time_base);
                }
                packet->pos = -1;
                packet->stream_index = out_idx;
                write_monotonic(output.format, packet.get(), last_dts, "Write remuxed trim packet");
                av_packet_unref(packet.get());
                report_progress(rel_pts_us);
                continue;
            }
        }

        av_packet_unref(packet.get());
    }

    // Flush decoder and encoder if EOF was reached
    if (need_reencode && dec_ctx && !video_done) {
        avcodec_send_packet(dec_ctx.get(), nullptr);
        while (avcodec_receive_frame(dec_ctx.get(), dec_frame.get()) == 0) {
            encode_video_frame(dec_frame.get());
            av_frame_unref(dec_frame.get());
            if (video_done) break;
        }
    }
    flush_encoder();

    if (!video_started) {
        throw std::runtime_error("Failed to find video frame in specified range.");
    }

    avcheck(av_write_trailer(output.format), "Finalize trim MP4 trailer");
    avcheck(avio_closep(&output.format->pb), "Flush trim output file");
    output.committed = true;

    if (progress_cb) progress_cb(user, 1.0);
}

} // namespace hr

```

`native/src/video.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "common.h"

namespace hr {
D3D::D3D(HMONITOR monitor, const wchar_t* gpu_device) {
    ComPtr<IDXGIFactory1> factory;
    check(CreateDXGIFactory1(IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory)));
    ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> fallback;
    ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> monitor_adapter;
    ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> explicit_adapter;

    std::wstring requested_str;
    if (gpu_device) {
        const wchar_t* p = gpu_device;
        while (*p && iswspace(*p)) p++;
        const wchar_t* end_p = p + wcslen(p);
        while (end_p > p && iswspace(*(end_p - 1))) end_p--;
        requested_str.assign(p, end_p - p);
    }

    int requested_index = -1;
    bool has_requested_index = false;
    if (!requested_str.empty()) {
        wchar_t* end = nullptr;
        long val = wcstol(requested_str.c_str(), &end, 10);
        if (end != requested_str.c_str() && *end == L'\0') {
            has_requested_index = true;
            if (val >= 0) {
                requested_index = static_cast<int>(val);
            }
        }
    }

    ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> exact_adapter;
    ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> substring_adapter;

    for (UINT i = 0; ; ++i) {
        ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> candidate;
        HRESULT enumerated = factory->EnumAdapters1(i, &candidate);
        if (enumerated == DXGI_ERROR_NOT_FOUND) break;
        check(enumerated);
        DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 desc{};
        check(candidate->GetDesc1(&desc));
        if (desc.Flags & DXGI_ADAPTER_FLAG_SOFTWARE) continue;
        if (!fallback) fallback = candidate;

        if (!requested_str.empty()) {
            if (has_requested_index) {
                if (static_cast<int>(i) == requested_index) {
                    explicit_adapter = candidate;
                }
            } else {
                if (_wcsicmp(desc.Description, requested_str.c_str()) == 0) {
                    exact_adapter = candidate;
                } else if (!substring_adapter) {
                    std::wstring desc_lower(desc.Description);
                    std::wstring req_lower(requested_str);
                    for (auto& c : desc_lower) c = towlower(c);
                    for (auto& c : req_lower) c = towlower(c);
                    if (desc_lower.find(req_lower) != std::wstring::npos) {
                        substring_adapter = candidate;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (UINT j = 0; ; ++j) {
            ComPtr<IDXGIOutput> output;
            HRESULT enumerated_output = candidate->EnumOutputs(j, &output);
            if (enumerated_output == DXGI_ERROR_NOT_FOUND || FAILED(enumerated_output)) break;
            DXGI_OUTPUT_DESC info{};
            if (SUCCEEDED(output->GetDesc(&info))) {
                if (info.Monitor == monitor) monitor_adapter = candidate;
            }
        }
    }

    if (!has_requested_index) {
        if (exact_adapter) {
            explicit_adapter = exact_adapter;
        } else if (substring_adapter) {
            explicit_adapter = substring_adapter;
        }
    }

    ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> default_adapter = monitor_adapter ? monitor_adapter : fallback;
    if (!default_adapter) throw std::runtime_error("No hardware DXGI adapter available (RDP/headless is not supported).");

    D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL levels[]{D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_1, D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0};
    UINT flags = D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_BGRA_SUPPORT | D3D11_CREATE_DEVICE_VIDEO_SUPPORT;

    auto try_init = [&](IDXGIAdapter1* target_adapter) -> bool {
        if (!target_adapter) return false;
        ComPtr<ID3D11Device> dev;
        ComPtr<ID3D11DeviceContext> ctx;
        HRESULT hr = D3D11CreateDevice(target_adapter, D3D_DRIVER_TYPE_UNKNOWN, nullptr,
            flags, levels, ARRAYSIZE(levels), D3D11_SDK_VERSION, &dev, nullptr, &ctx);
        if (FAILED(hr)) return false;
        ComPtr<ID3D10Multithread> mt;
        if (FAILED(ctx.As(&mt))) return false;
        ComPtr<ID3D11VideoDevice> vd;
        if (FAILED(dev.As(&vd))) return false;
        ComPtr<ID3D11VideoContext> vc;
        if (FAILED(ctx.As(&vc))) return false;
        mt->SetMultithreadProtected(TRUE);
        device = dev;
        context = ctx;
        video_device = vd;
        video_context = vc;
        adapter = target_adapter;
        return true;
    };

    requested_fallback = !requested_str.empty();
    if (explicit_adapter && try_init(explicit_adapter.Get())) {
        requested_fallback = false;
    } else if (try_init(default_adapter.Get())) {
        // Default adapter initialized.
    } else if (fallback && fallback.Get() != default_adapter.Get() && try_init(fallback.Get())) {
        // Generic fallback adapter initialized.
    } else {
        throw std::runtime_error("No hardware DXGI adapter could initialize Direct3D 11 video context.");
    }

    DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 desc{}; check(adapter->GetDesc1(&desc));
    vendor = desc.VendorId; name = desc.Description;
}

VideoEncoder::VideoEncoder(D3D& device, hr_config config, Emit callback) : d3d(device), emit(std::move(callback)) {
    encoder = config.encoder;
    if (encoder == 0) {
        switch (d3d.vendor) {
            case 0x1002: encoder = 1; break;
            case 0x10de: encoder = 2; break;
            case 0x8086: encoder = 3; break;
            default: throw std::runtime_error("Unknown GPU. Select an encoder explicitly; there is no silent CPU fallback.");
        }
    }
    const char* names[5][3] = {
        {nullptr, nullptr, nullptr}, {"h264_amf", "hevc_amf", "av1_amf"},
        {"h264_nvenc", "hevc_nvenc", "av1_nvenc"}, {"h264_qsv", "hevc_qsv", "av1_qsv"},
        {"libx264", nullptr, nullptr}
    };
    const char* name = names[encoder][config.codec];
    const AVCodec* implementation = name ? avcodec_find_encoder_by_name(name) : nullptr;
    if (!implementation) throw std::runtime_error("Selected encoder/codec is not included in the native runtime.");

    d3d_device.reset(av_hwdevice_ctx_alloc(AV_HWDEVICE_TYPE_D3D11VA));
    if (!d3d_device) throw std::bad_alloc();
    auto* hw = reinterpret_cast<AVD3D11VADeviceContext*>(reinterpret_cast<AVHWDeviceContext*>(d3d_device->data)->hwctx);
    hw->device = d3d.device.Get(); hw->device->AddRef();
    avcheck(av_hwdevice_ctx_init(d3d_device.get()), "D3D11 FFmpeg device");
    frames.reset(av_hwframe_ctx_alloc(d3d_device.get()));
    if (!frames) throw std::bad_alloc();
    auto* fc = reinterpret_cast<AVHWFramesContext*>(frames->data);
    fc->format = AV_PIX_FMT_D3D11; fc->sw_format = AV_PIX_FMT_NV12;
    fc->width = encoder == 3 ? (config.width + 31) & ~31 : config.width;
    fc->height = encoder == 3 ? (config.height + 31) & ~31 : config.height;
    // FFmpeg 8.1 uses initial_pool_size > 0 as one Texture2D array, even with
    // RENDER_TARGET. NV12 render-target arrays can fail CreateTexture2D(E_INVALIDARG).
    // A dynamic pool reuses independent ArraySize=1 GPU textures; QSV derivation
    // supports this too. This is NOT a CPU/readback fallback.
    fc->initial_pool_size = 0;
    auto* dxframes = reinterpret_cast<AVD3D11VAFramesContext*>(fc->hwctx);
    dxframes->BindFlags = D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET;
    const std::string surface_info = std::to_string(fc->width) + "x" + std::to_string(fc->height)
        + ", NV12, ArraySize=1, RENDER_TARGET, adapter=" + utf8(d3d.name) + ", encoder=" + name;
    ffmpeg_detail.clear();
    avcheck(av_hwframe_ctx_init(frames.get()), ("GPU dynamic frame pool (" + surface_info + ")").c_str());
    {
        // A dynamic pool allocates lazily. Probe it now so allocation failures are
        // reported at startup with dimensions/adapter/FFmpeg's underlying HRESULT,
        // not asynchronously after the UI has announced that capture is running.
        auto probe = make_frame();
        avcheck(av_hwframe_get_buffer(frames.get(), probe.get(), 0),
            ("GPU NV12 texture allocation (" + surface_info + ")").c_str());
        D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC actual{};
        reinterpret_cast<ID3D11Texture2D*>(probe->data[0])->GetDesc(&actual);
        if (actual.ArraySize != 1 || actual.Format != DXGI_FORMAT_NV12)
            throw std::runtime_error("Unexpected FFmpeg GPU surface layout (" + surface_info + ").");
    }

    codec.reset(avcodec_alloc_context3(implementation));
    if (!codec) throw std::bad_alloc();
    codec->width = config.width; codec->height = config.height;
    codec->time_base = AVRational{1, config.fps}; codec->framerate = AVRational{config.fps, 1};
    codec->bit_rate = config.bitrate; codec->rc_max_rate = config.bitrate;
    codec->rc_buffer_size = config.bitrate * 2;
    codec->gop_size = config.fps * config.gop_seconds;
    codec->max_b_frames = 0; codec->flags |= AV_CODEC_FLAG_GLOBAL_HEADER | AV_CODEC_FLAG_CLOSED_GOP;
    codec->color_range = AVCOL_RANGE_MPEG; codec->colorspace = AVCOL_SPC_BT709;
    codec->color_primaries = AVCOL_PRI_BT709; codec->color_trc = AVCOL_TRC_BT709;
    codec->sample_aspect_ratio = AVRational{1, 1};
    if (encoder == 3) {
        AVBufferRef* qdev = nullptr;
        avcheck(av_hwdevice_ctx_create_derived(&qdev, AV_HWDEVICE_TYPE_QSV, d3d_device.get(), 0), "QSV device");
        qsv_device.reset(qdev);
        AVBufferRef* qframes = nullptr;
        avcheck(av_hwframe_ctx_create_derived(&qframes, AV_PIX_FMT_QSV, qsv_device.get(), frames.get(),
            AV_HWFRAME_MAP_READ), "QSV shared GPU frames");
        qsv_frames.reset(qframes);
        codec->pix_fmt = AV_PIX_FMT_QSV;
        codec->hw_frames_ctx = av_buffer_ref(qsv_frames.get());
    } else if (encoder == 4) {
        codec->pix_fmt = AV_PIX_FMT_NV12; // Explicit CPU x264 fallback with GPU readback.
    } else {
        codec->pix_fmt = AV_PIX_FMT_D3D11;
        codec->hw_frames_ctx = av_buffer_ref(frames.get());
    }
    AVDictionary* options = nullptr;
    // A replay buffer is saved seconds after the fact: encoder latency is irrelevant, quality per bit is not.
    // So the presets favour quality over latency. CBR stays, keeping RAM use per second predictable.
    if (encoder == 1) {
        av_dict_set(&options, "usage", "transcoding", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "quality", "balanced", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "rc", "cbr", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "forced_idr", "1", 0);
        if (config.codec == 0) {
            av_dict_set(&options, "header_spacing", std::to_string(config.fps * config.gop_seconds).c_str(), 0);
        }
    } else if (encoder == 2) {
        av_dict_set(&options, "preset", "p4", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "tune", "hq", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "rc", "cbr", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "forced-idr", "1", 0);
    } else if (encoder == 3) {
        av_dict_set(&options, "preset", "veryfast", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "async_depth", "4", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "forced_idr", "1", 0);
    } else {
        av_dict_set(&options, "preset", "veryfast", 0);
        av_dict_set(&options, "tune", "zerolatency", 0);
    }
    int result = avcodec_open2(codec.get(), implementation, &options);
    av_dict_free(&options);
    avcheck(result, "Open hardware encoder (check GPU codec support and installed driver)");
    description = d3d.name + L" / " + wide(name) + (encoder == 4 ? L" / CPU" : L" / GPU");
}

void VideoEncoder::rebuild_processor(int width, int height) {
    input_view.Reset(); input_texture = nullptr;
    processor.Reset(); enumerator.Reset();
    D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_CONTENT_DESC desc{};
    desc.InputFrameFormat = D3D11_VIDEO_FRAME_FORMAT_PROGRESSIVE;
    desc.InputWidth = width; desc.InputHeight = height;
    desc.OutputWidth = codec->width; desc.OutputHeight = codec->height;
    desc.InputFrameRate = {static_cast<UINT>(codec->framerate.num), 1}; desc.OutputFrameRate = desc.InputFrameRate;
    desc.Usage = D3D11_VIDEO_USAGE_PLAYBACK_NORMAL;
    check(d3d.video_device->CreateVideoProcessorEnumerator(&desc, &enumerator));
    UINT support = 0; check(enumerator->CheckVideoProcessorFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_NV12, &support));
    if (!(support & D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_FORMAT_SUPPORT_OUTPUT))
        throw std::runtime_error("The selected GPU does not support NV12 video processor output.");
    check(d3d.video_device->CreateVideoProcessor(enumerator.Get(), 0, &processor));
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetStreamFrameFormat(processor.Get(), 0, D3D11_VIDEO_FRAME_FORMAT_PROGRESSIVE);
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetStreamAutoProcessingMode(processor.Get(), 0, FALSE);
    D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_COLOR_SPACE rgb{}; rgb.Usage = 0; rgb.RGB_Range = 0;
    D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_COLOR_SPACE yuv{}; yuv.YCbCr_Matrix = 1; yuv.Nominal_Range = D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_NOMINAL_RANGE_16_235;
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetStreamColorSpace(processor.Get(), 0, &rgb);
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetOutputColorSpace(processor.Get(), &yuv);
    D3D11_VIDEO_COLOR black{}; black.YCbCr.Y = 16.f / 255.f; black.YCbCr.Cb = .5f; black.YCbCr.Cr = .5f; black.YCbCr.A = 1.f;
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetOutputBackgroundColor(processor.Get(), TRUE, &black);
    // Scale to fill and crop the overhang evenly instead of letterboxing: some drivers ignore the YCbCr background
    // color or leave unwritten NV12 texels, which shows up as teal or green bars around the picture.
    double scale = std::max(double(codec->width) / width, double(codec->height) / height);
    int srcw = std::clamp(int(std::lround(codec->width / scale)), 1, width);
    int srch = std::clamp(int(std::lround(codec->height / scale)), 1, height);
    int x = (width - srcw) / 2, y = (height - srch) / 2;
    RECT source{x, y, x + srcw, y + srch};
    RECT output{0, 0, codec->width, codec->height};
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetStreamSourceRect(processor.Get(), 0, TRUE, &source);
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetStreamDestRect(processor.Get(), 0, TRUE, &output);
    d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorSetOutputTargetRect(processor.Get(), TRUE, &output);
    input_width = width; input_height = height;
}

void VideoEncoder::encode(ID3D11Texture2D* bgra, int width, int height, int64_t pts) {
    if (!processor || width != input_width || height != input_height) rebuild_processor(width, height);
    auto hardware = make_frame();
    avcheck(av_hwframe_get_buffer(frames.get(), hardware.get(), 0), "Acquire NV12 texture");
    if (!input_view || input_texture != bgra) {
        D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_INPUT_VIEW_DESC iv{};
        iv.ViewDimension = D3D11_VPIV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        input_view.Reset();
        check(d3d.video_device->CreateVideoProcessorInputView(bgra, enumerator.Get(), &iv, &input_view));
        input_texture = bgra;
    }
    D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_OUTPUT_VIEW_DESC ov{};
    auto* nv12 = reinterpret_cast<ID3D11Texture2D*>(hardware->data[0]);
    D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC target_desc{}; nv12->GetDesc(&target_desc);
    if (target_desc.ArraySize == 1) {
        ov.ViewDimension = D3D11_VPOV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        ov.Texture2D.MipSlice = 0;
    } else {
        ov.ViewDimension = D3D11_VPOV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2DARRAY;
        ov.Texture2DArray.MipSlice = 0;
        ov.Texture2DArray.FirstArraySlice = static_cast<UINT>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(hardware->data[1]));
        ov.Texture2DArray.ArraySize = 1;
    }
    ComPtr<ID3D11VideoProcessorOutputView> output;
    check(d3d.video_device->CreateVideoProcessorOutputView(
        reinterpret_cast<ID3D11Texture2D*>(hardware->data[0]), enumerator.Get(), &ov, &output));
    D3D11_VIDEO_PROCESSOR_STREAM stream{}; stream.Enable = TRUE; stream.pInputSurface = input_view.Get();
    check(d3d.video_context->VideoProcessorBlt(processor.Get(), output.Get(), 0, 1, &stream));
    d3d.context->Flush();
    Frame mapped;
    AVFrame* frame = hardware.get();
    if (encoder == 3) {
        mapped = make_frame();
        mapped->format = AV_PIX_FMT_QSV; mapped->hw_frames_ctx = av_buffer_ref(qsv_frames.get());
        avcheck(av_hwframe_map(mapped.get(), hardware.get(), AV_HWFRAME_MAP_READ), "Map D3D11 to QSV");
        frame = mapped.get();
    } else if (encoder == 4) {
        mapped = make_frame();
        avcheck(av_hwframe_transfer_data(mapped.get(), hardware.get(), 0), "Explicit x264 GPU readback");
        frame = mapped.get();
    }
    frame->width = codec->width; frame->height = codec->height;
    frame->pts = pts;
    frame->color_range = codec->color_range; frame->colorspace = codec->colorspace;
    frame->color_primaries = codec->color_primaries; frame->color_trc = codec->color_trc;
    // Force closed IDRs on the configured wall-clock GOP grid, even after frame drops.
    if (pts / codec->gop_size > last_forced_gop) {
        frame->pict_type = AV_PICTURE_TYPE_I;
        last_forced_gop = pts / codec->gop_size;
    }
    int result = avcodec_send_frame(codec.get(), frame);
    if (result == AVERROR(EAGAIN)) { drain(); result = avcodec_send_frame(codec.get(), frame); }
    avcheck(result, "Encode video frame"); drain();
}

void VideoEncoder::drain(bool flush) {
    if (flush) avcheck(avcodec_send_frame(codec.get(), nullptr), "Flush video encoder");
    for (;;) {
        int result = avcodec_receive_packet(codec.get(), drained.get());
        if (result == AVERROR(EAGAIN) || result == AVERROR_EOF) break;
        avcheck(result, "Receive encoded video");
        if (drained->duration <= 0) drained->duration = 1;
        emit(0, drained.get(), codec->time_base);
        av_packet_unref(drained.get());
    }
}
}
```

```proto
        DestroySDKInstanceRequest destroySDKInstanceRequest = 20;
        IsClientAliveRequest isClientAliveRequest = 21;
        GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupRequest getNumberOfHighlightsInGroupRequest = 22;
        GetUserConfigRequest getUserConfigRequest = 23;
        RequestPermissionRequest requestPermissionRequest = 24;
        OpsOptimizeRequest opsOptimizeRequest = 25;
    }
}

message SDKIPCResponse {
    required int32 retval = 1;
    optional string retstatus = 2;

    oneof response {
        GetUILanguageResponse getUILanguageResponse = 10;
        CreateSDKInstanceResponse createSDKInstanceResponse = 11;
        IsClientAliveResponse isClientAliveResponse = 12;
        GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupResponse getNumberOfHighlightsInGroupResponse = 13;
        GetUserConfigResponse getUserConfigResponse = 14;
    }
}

message SDKIPCNotification {
    required SDKComponent component = 1;

    oneof notification {
        PermissionsChangedNotification permissionsChangedNotification = 10;
        OverlayStateNotification overlayStateNotification = 11;
    }
}

message SDKIPCMessage {
    oneof message {
        SDKIPCRequest request = 1;
        SDKIPCResponse response = 2;
        SDKIPCNotification notification = 3;
    }
}
```
