`src/HuntReplay.App/App.xaml.cs`:

```cs
using System.Reflection;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Windows;
using HuntReplay.App.Services;
using HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;
using HuntReplay.App.Views;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using Forms = System.Windows.Forms;

namespace HuntReplay.App;
public partial class App : Application
{
    static App()
    {
        FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(FrameworkElement), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(
            System.Windows.Markup.XmlLanguage.GetLanguage(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.IetfLanguageTag)));
    }
    private Mutex? instance;
    private EventWaitHandle? activate;
    private RegisteredWaitHandle? activationWait;
    private Forms.NotifyIcon? tray;
    private StudioLog? log;
    private RecorderService? recorder;
    private HighlightsPipeServer? pipe;
    private MainViewModel? model;
    private MainWindow? window;
    private bool exiting;

    protected override async void OnStartup(StartupEventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnStartup(e);
        if (e.Args.Length >= 2 && e.Args[0] == "--nvidia-service-keeper" && int.TryParse(e.Args[1], out int mainPid))
        {
            var extraServices = e.Args.Skip(2).ToArray();
            NvidiaServiceManager.RunKeeper(mainPid, extraServices);
            Shutdown(0);
            return;
        }
        if (e.Args.Contains("--install-shim") || e.Args.Contains("--uninstall-shim"))
        {
            try
            {
                using var mutex = new Mutex(false, @"Global\HuntReplayStudio.ShimSetup");
                bool acquired;
                try { acquired = mutex.WaitOne(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); } catch (AbandonedMutexException) { acquired = true; }
                if (!acquired) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Install.AnotherRunning"));
                try
                {
                    if (e.Args.Contains("--uninstall-shim")) SelfInstaller.Uninstall();
                    else SelfInstaller.Install(e.Args.Contains("--replace-nvidia"));
                }
                finally { mutex.ReleaseMutex(); }
                Shutdown(0);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, Text.Get("Install.Title"), MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error); Shutdown(1); }
            return;
        }
        try
        {
            if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindowsVersionAtLeast(10, 0, 19041))
                throw new PlatformNotSupportedException(Text.Get("Startup.UnsupportedWindows"));
            // After a self-update the previous process still holds the single-instance mutex until it exits.
            await UpdateInstallerService.FinishAsync(e.Args);
            using var identity = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
            var sid = identity.User?.Value ?? Environment.UserName;
            var name = @"Local\HuntReplayStudio." + sid;
            instance = new Mutex(true, name, out bool first);
            if (!first)
            {
                try { using var signal = EventWaitHandle.OpenExisting(name + ".Activate"); signal.Set(); }
                catch (WaitHandleCannotBeOpenedException) { MessageBox.Show(Text.Get("Startup.AlreadyRunning")); }
                Shutdown(); return;
            }
            activate = new EventWaitHandle(false, EventResetMode.AutoReset, name + ".Activate");
            activationWait = ThreadPool.RegisterWaitForSingleObject(activate, (_, _) => Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() => window?.ShowStudio()), null, Timeout.Infinite, false);
            bool portable = e.Args.Contains("--portable");
            var root = portable ? AppContext.BaseDirectory : Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "HuntReplayStudio");
            // Clip metadata and thumbnails live here, never in the clips folder (which holds only MP4 files).
            var libraryRoot = Path.Combine(root, "library");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(root);
            log = new StudioLog(root);
            DispatcherUnhandledException += (_, args) =>
            {
                log.Write(args.Exception.ToString(), "ERROR");
                MessageBox.Show(args.Exception.Message, "HuntReplay Studio", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
                args.Handled = true;
                _ = ExitAsync(1);
            };
            var store = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(root, "config.json"));
            var settings = store.Load();
            // The saved language applies before any window or message box exists.
            Text.SetLanguage(settings.System.Language);
            ThemeService.Apply(string.Equals(settings.System.Theme, "light", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? AppTheme.Light : AppTheme.Dark);
            if (store.LoadWarning is { } warning) log.Write(warning, "WARN");
            string? storageWarning = null;
            try { Directory.CreateDirectory(settings.Storage.Directory); }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
            { storageWarning = Text.Format("Startup.StorageUnavailable", ex.Message); }
            if (!settings.System.FirstRunCompleted)
            {
                var status = await Task.Run(SelfInstaller.Check);
                var wizard = new SetupWizard(status);
                wizard.ShowDialog();
                settings.System.FirstRunCompleted = true;
                settings.System.Language = Text.Language; // The wizard can switch it.
                store.Save(settings);
            }
            recorder = new RecorderService(settings, log, libraryRoot);
            pipe = new HighlightsPipeServer(recorder, log);
            model = new MainViewModel(store, recorder, pipe, log, portable, libraryRoot);
            window = new MainWindow { DataContext = model }; MainWindow = window;
            CreateTray();
            bool startInTray = e.Args.Contains("--tray");
            if (startInTray) { window.ShowInTaskbar = false; window.WindowState = WindowState.Minimized; }
            window.Show();
            if (startInTray) window.Hide();
            // NVIDIA's container is paused only when it actually holds the Highlights pipe: no UAC prompt,
            // stopped service or killed process on systems where the pipe is free.
            if (!pipe.TryStart(logFailure: false))
            {
                if (SelfInstaller.IsNvidiaActive())
                {
                    await Task.Run(() => NvidiaServiceManager.EnsureServicePausedAsync(log));
                    // A stopped container can take a moment to release its pipe instances.
                    for (int attempt = 1; attempt < 5 && !pipe.TryStart(logFailure: false); attempt++)
                        await Task.Delay(400);
                }
                if (!pipe.IsListening) pipe.TryStart(logFailure: true);
            }
            await model.InitializeAsync(window);
            if (storageWarning is not null) model.Error(new IOException(storageWarning));
            if (store.LoadWarning is { } loadWarning) model.Error(new InvalidDataException(loadWarning));
            if (e.Args.Contains(UpdateInstallerService.UpdatedFromArgument)) model.ReportUpdated();
            log.Write(Text.Get("Log.Ready"));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show(ex.Message, Text.Get("Startup.FailedTitle"), MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
            await ExitAsync(1);
        }
    }

    private void CreateTray()
    {
        using var iconStream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream("HuntReplay.Studio.ico")!;
        using var icon = new System.Drawing.Icon(iconStream);
        var loc = LocalizationService.Instance;
        tray = new Forms.NotifyIcon { Icon = (System.Drawing.Icon)icon.Clone(), Text = loc["Tray.Tooltip"], Visible = true };
        tray.DoubleClick += (_, _) => Dispatcher.Invoke(() => window?.ShowStudio());
        var menu = new Forms.ContextMenuStrip();
        menu.Items.Add(loc["Tray.Open"], null, (_, _) => Dispatcher.Invoke(() => window?.ShowStudio()));
        menu.Items.Add(loc["Tray.Save"], null, (_, _) => Dispatcher.Invoke(() => model?.SaveCommand.Execute(null)));
        menu.Items.Add(loc["Tray.Toggle"], null, (_, _) => Dispatcher.Invoke(() => model?.ToggleBufferCommand.Execute(null)));
        menu.Items.Add(new Forms.ToolStripSeparator());
        menu.Items.Add(loc["Tray.Exit"], null, async (_, _) => await ExitAsync());
        tray.ContextMenuStrip = menu;
    }

    internal async Task ExitAsync(int code = 0)
    {
        if (exiting) return; exiting = true;
        if (window is not null) { window.IsEnabled = false; window.ClosePlayer(); }
        try
        {
            try { if (model is not null) await model.DisposeAsync(); }
            finally
            {
                try { if (pipe is not null) await pipe.DisposeAsync(); }
                finally { if (recorder is not null) await recorder.DisposeAsync(); }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { log?.Write(Text.Format("Log.ExitError", ex.Message), "ERROR"); code = 1; }
        finally
        {
            if (tray is not null) { tray.Visible = false; tray.ContextMenuStrip?.Dispose(); tray.Icon?.Dispose(); tray.Dispose(); }
            activationWait?.Unregister(null); activate?.Dispose(); instance?.Dispose();
            NvidiaServiceManager.RestoreServices(log);
            if (log is not null) await log.DisposeAsync();
            if (window is not null) { window.CanClose = true; window.Close(); }
            Shutdown(code);
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
{
    None,
    Start,
    End,
    Range,
    Playhead
}

public sealed class RangeSeekEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
{
    public double Timestamp { get; }
    public RangeSliderHandle Handle { get; }

    public RangeSeekEventArgs(RoutedEvent routedEvent, double timestamp, RangeSliderHandle handle)
        : base(routedEvent)
    {
        Timestamp = timestamp;
        Handle = handle;
    }
}

    private Point rangeBarStartPoint;
    private double rangeBarStartRangeStart;
    private double rangeBarStartRangeEnd;
    private bool isDraggingRangeBar;

    public RangeSlider()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) => UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    #region Layout & Usable Width

    public double GetUsableWidth()
    {
        double actualWidth = TrackCanvas?.ActualWidth ?? ActualWidth;
        if (actualWidth <= 0.0) actualWidth = ActualWidth;
        return Math.Max(1.0, actualWidth - 14.0);
    }

    private void OnControlSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    public void SetRange(double start, double end)
    {
        if (start > RangeStart || end > RangeEnd)
        {
            RangeEnd = end;
            RangeStart = start;
        }
        else
        {
            RangeStart = start;
            RangeEnd = end;
        }
    }

    public void UpdateLayoutPositions()
    {
        if (TrackCanvas is null || StartThumb is null || EndThumb is null ||
            SelectedRangeBar is null || UnselectedLeftTrack is null ||
            UnselectedRightTrack is null || PlayheadThumb is null) return;

        double actualWidth = TrackCanvas.ActualWidth;
        if (actualWidth <= 0.0) actualWidth = ActualWidth;
        if (actualWidth <= 0.0) return;

        const double thumbWidth = 14.0;
        const double playheadWidth = 10.0;
        double usableWidth = Math.Max(1.0, actualWidth - thumbWidth);
        double min = Math.Min(Minimum, Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(Minimum, Maximum);
        double range = Math.Max(0.001, max - min);

        double startRatio = Math.Clamp((RangeStart - min) / range, 0.0, 1.0);
        double endRatio = Math.Clamp((RangeEnd - min) / range, 0.0, 1.0);
        double playheadRatio = Math.Clamp((Playhead - min) / range, 0.0, 1.0);

        double startX = startRatio * usableWidth;
        double endX = endRatio * usableWidth;

        Canvas.SetLeft(StartThumb, startX);
        Canvas.SetLeft(EndThumb, endX);

        double barX = startX + (thumbWidth / 2.0);
        double barWidth = Math.Max(0.0, endX - startX);
        Canvas.SetLeft(SelectedRangeBar, barX);
        SelectedRangeBar.Width = barWidth;

        Canvas.SetLeft(UnselectedLeftTrack, 0.0);
        UnselectedLeftTrack.Width = Math.Max(0.0, barX);

        double rightX = barX + barWidth;
        Canvas.SetLeft(UnselectedRightTrack, rightX);
        UnselectedRightTrack.Width = Math.Max(0.0, actualWidth - rightX);

        double playheadCenter = (thumbWidth / 2.0) + (playheadRatio * usableWidth);
        double playheadLeft = Math.Clamp(playheadCenter - (playheadWidth / 2.0), 0.0, Math.Max(0.0, actualWidth - playheadWidth));
        Canvas.SetLeft(PlayheadThumb, playheadLeft);

        // Hide playhead if explicitly invisible, or when coinciding with the boundary handles so it does not obscure them
        bool coincidesWithHandles = Math.Abs(playheadCenter - (startX + thumbWidth / 2.0)) < 6.0 ||
                                    Math.Abs(playheadCenter - (endX + thumbWidth / 2.0)) < 6.0;

        PlayheadThumb.Visibility = (IsPlayheadVisible && !coincidesWithHandles) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    }

    #endregion

    #region Coercion & Property Changed Handlers

    private static object CoerceRangeStart(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double val = (double)baseValue;
        double min = Math.Min(slider.Minimum, slider.Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(slider.Minimum, slider.Maximum);
        if (double.IsNaN(val) || double.IsInfinity(val)) return min;
        double maxStart = Math.Min(max - slider.EffectiveMinRange, slider.RangeEnd - slider.EffectiveMinRange);
        maxStart = Math.Clamp(maxStart, min, max);
        return Math.Clamp(val, min, maxStart);
    }

    private static object CoerceRangeEnd(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double val = (double)baseValue;
        double min = Math.Min(slider.Minimum, slider.Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(slider.Minimum, slider.Maximum);
        if (double.IsNaN(val) || double.IsInfinity(val)) return max;
        double minEnd = Math.Max(min + slider.EffectiveMinRange, slider.RangeStart + slider.EffectiveMinRange);
        minEnd = Math.Clamp(minEnd, min, max);
        return Math.Clamp(val, minEnd, max);
    }

    private static object CoercePlayhead(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double val = (double)baseValue;
        double min = Math.Min(slider.Minimum, slider.Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(slider.Minimum, slider.Maximum);
        if (double.IsNaN(val) || double.IsInfinity(val)) return min;
        return Math.Clamp(val, min, max);
    }

    private static void OnMinimumChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeStartProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeEndProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeStartProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(SelectionStartProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(SelectionEndProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(PlayheadProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(ValueProperty);
        slider.UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    private static void OnMaximumChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeEndProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeStartProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeEndProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(SelectionEndProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(SelectionStartProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(PlayheadProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(ValueProperty);
        slider.UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    private static void OnMinRangeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeEndProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(RangeStartProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(SelectionEndProperty);
        slider.CoerceValue(SelectionStartProperty);
        slider.UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    private static void OnRangeStartChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double oldVal = (double)e.OldValue;
        double newVal = (double)e.NewValue;

        if (Math.Abs(slider.SelectionStart - newVal) > 1e-6)
        {
            slider.SelectionStart = newVal;
        }

        slider.RaiseEvent(new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double>(oldVal, newVal, SelectionStartChangedEvent));
        slider.UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    private static void OnSelectionStartChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double newVal = (double)e.NewValue;
        if (Math.Abs(slider.RangeStart - newVal) > 1e-6)
        {
            slider.RangeStart = newVal;
        }
    }

    private static void OnRangeEndChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double oldVal = (double)e.OldValue;
        double newVal = (double)e.NewValue;

        if (Math.Abs(slider.SelectionEnd - newVal) > 1e-6)
        {
            slider.SelectionEnd = newVal;
        }

        slider.RaiseEvent(new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double>(oldVal, newVal, SelectionEndChangedEvent));
        slider.UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    private static void OnSelectionEndChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double newVal = (double)e.NewValue;
        if (Math.Abs(slider.RangeEnd - newVal) > 1e-6)
        {
            slider.RangeEnd = newVal;
        }
    }

    private static void OnPlayheadChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double oldVal = (double)e.OldValue;
        double newVal = (double)e.NewValue;

        if (Math.Abs(slider.Value - newVal) > 1e-6)
        {
            slider.Value = newVal;
        }

        slider.RaiseEvent(new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double>(oldVal, newVal, PlayheadChangedEvent));
        slider.UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        double newVal = (double)e.NewValue;
        if (Math.Abs(slider.Playhead - newVal) > 1e-6)
        {
            slider.Playhead = newVal;
        }
    }

    private static void OnIsPlayheadVisibleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        var slider = (RangeSlider)d;
        slider.UpdateLayoutPositions();
    }

    #endregion

    #region Mouse & Drag Interaction

    private void OnStartThumbDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)
    {
        IsDragging = true;
        RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragStartedEvent));
    }

    private void OnStartThumbDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
    {
        double usableWidth = GetUsableWidth();
        double min = Math.Min(Minimum, Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(Minimum, Maximum);
        double range = Math.Max(0.001, max - min);
        double deltaSeconds = (e.HorizontalChange / usableWidth) * range;
        double effectiveMin = EffectiveMinRange;
        double maxStart = Math.Clamp(RangeEnd - effectiveMin, min, max);
        double newStart = Math.Clamp(RangeStart + deltaSeconds, min, maxStart);

        RangeStart = newStart;
        RaiseEvent(new RangeSeekEventArgs(LiveSeekEvent, newStart, RangeSliderHandle.Start));
    }

    private void OnStartThumbDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
    {
        IsDragging = false;
        RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragCompletedEvent));
    }

    private void OnEndThumbDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)
    {
        IsDragging = true;
        RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragStartedEvent));
    }

    private void OnEndThumbDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
    {
        double usableWidth = GetUsableWidth();
        double min = Math.Min(Minimum, Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(Minimum, Maximum);
        double range = Math.Max(0.001, max - min);
        double deltaSeconds = (e.HorizontalChange / usableWidth) * range;
        double effectiveMin = EffectiveMinRange;
        double minEnd = Math.Clamp(RangeStart + effectiveMin, min, max);
        double newEnd = Math.Clamp(RangeEnd + deltaSeconds, minEnd, max);

        RangeEnd = newEnd;
        RaiseEvent(new RangeSeekEventArgs(LiveSeekEvent, newEnd, RangeSliderHandle.End));
    }

    private void OnEndThumbDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
    {
        IsDragging = false;
        RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragCompletedEvent));
    }

    private void OnPlayheadDragStarted(object sender, DragStartedEventArgs e)
    {
        IsDragging = true;
        RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragStartedEvent));
    }

    private void OnPlayheadDragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
    {
        double usableWidth = GetUsableWidth();
        double min = Math.Min(Minimum, Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(Minimum, Maximum);
        double range = Math.Max(0.001, max - min);
        double deltaSeconds = (e.HorizontalChange / usableWidth) * range;
        double newPlayhead = Math.Clamp(Playhead + deltaSeconds, min, max);

        Playhead = newPlayhead;
        RaiseEvent(new RangeSeekEventArgs(LiveSeekEvent, newPlayhead, RangeSliderHandle.Playhead));
    }

    private void OnPlayheadDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e)
    {
        IsDragging = false;
        RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragCompletedEvent));
    }

    private void OnRangeBarMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
        {
            isDraggingRangeBar = true;
            IsDragging = true;
            rangeBarStartPoint = e.GetPosition(RootGrid);
            rangeBarStartRangeStart = RangeStart;
            rangeBarStartRangeEnd = RangeEnd;
            SelectedRangeBar.CaptureMouse();
            RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragStartedEvent));
            e.Handled = true;
        }
    }

    private void OnRangeBarMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (isDraggingRangeBar && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
        {
            Point current = e.GetPosition(RootGrid);
            double deltaX = current.X - rangeBarStartPoint.X;
            double usableWidth = GetUsableWidth();
            double min = Math.Min(Minimum, Maximum);
            double max = Math.Max(Minimum, Maximum);
            double range = Math.Max(0.001, max - min);
            double deltaSec = (deltaX / usableWidth) * range;
            double duration = Math.Max(0.0, rangeBarStartRangeEnd - rangeBarStartRangeStart);

            double candStart = rangeBarStartRangeStart + deltaSec;
            double candEnd = rangeBarStartRangeEnd + deltaSec;

            if (candEnd > max)
            {
                candEnd = max;
                candStart = Math.Max(min, max - duration);
            }
            if (candStart < min)
            {
                candStart = min;
                candEnd = Math.Min(max, min + duration);
            }

            if (deltaSec >= 0)
            {
                RangeEnd = candEnd;
                RangeStart = candStart;
            }
            else
            {
                RangeStart = candStart;
                RangeEnd = candEnd;
            }

            RaiseEvent(new RangeSeekEventArgs(LiveSeekEvent, candStart, RangeSliderHandle.Range));
            e.Handled = true;
        }
    }

    private void OnRangeBarMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (isDraggingRangeBar)
        {
            isDraggingRangeBar = false;
            IsDragging = false;
            SelectedRangeBar.ReleaseMouseCapture();
            RaiseEvent(new RoutedEventArgs(RangeDragCompletedEvent));
            e.Handled = true;
        }
    }

    private void OnTrackMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.OriginalSource == StartThumb || e.OriginalSource == EndThumb ||
            e.OriginalSource == PlayheadThumb || e.OriginalSource == SelectedRangeBar ||
            isDraggingRangeBar) return;

        Point pos = e.GetPosition(TrackCanvas);
        double usableWidth = GetUsableWidth();
        double min = Math.Min(Minimum, Maximum);
        double max = Math.Max(Minimum, Maximum);
        double ratio = Math.Clamp((pos.X - 7.0) / usableWidth, 0.0, 1.0);
        double target = min + ratio * (max - min);
        Playhead = target;
        RaiseEvent(new RangeSeekEventArgs(LiveSeekEvent, target, RangeSliderHandle.Playhead));
    }

    #endregion
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Interop/DeviceOption.cs`:

```cs
namespace HuntReplay.App.Interop;

// Width and Height are the physical pixel size of a monitor (Kind 0); 0 when unknown or for other kinds.
internal sealed record DeviceOption(int Kind, string Id, string Name, ulong Handle = 0, bool IsDefault = false, int Vendor = 0, int Width = 0, int Height = 0)
{
    public override string ToString() => Name;

    /// <summary>
    /// Finds the adapter a saved GPU value refers to. The native layer reports the adapter description as the ID
    /// (a DXGI index only when two adapters share a description). Builds before v0.1.8 saved the DXGI index for
    /// every adapter, and such a value never equals a description, so it is read as a position in the
    /// enumeration, which is what the native layer would pick for it. Returns null when nothing matches.
    /// </summary>
    public static DeviceOption? ResolveGpu(string saved, IEnumerable<DeviceOption> devices)
    {
        string value = saved.Trim();
        if (value.Length == 0) return null;
        var gpus = devices.Where(d => d.Kind == 3 && d.Id.Length > 0).ToList();
        return gpus.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Id == value)
            ?? gpus.FirstOrDefault(d => string.Equals(d.Id, value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || string.Equals(d.Name, value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            ?? (int.TryParse(value, System.Globalization.NumberStyles.None, System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int index)
                && index < gpus.Count && !gpus.Any(d => d.Id.All(char.IsAsciiDigit)) ? gpus[index] : null);
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Interop/GameWindow.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Interop;

/// <summary>
/// One system-wide process enumeration. Process.GetProcessesByName enumerates every process on each call,
/// so a probe that asks several questions takes a single snapshot and queries it.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class ProcessSnapshot
{
    private readonly ILookup<string, int> idsByName;
    private readonly HashSet<int> ids;

    private ProcessSnapshot(ILookup<string, int> idsByName)
    {
        this.idsByName = idsByName;
        ids = idsByName.SelectMany(group => group).ToHashSet();
    }

    public static ProcessSnapshot Take()
    {
        var processes = Process.GetProcesses();
        try { return new(processes.ToLookup(p => p.ProcessName, p => p.Id, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)); }
        finally { foreach (var process in processes) process.Dispose(); }
    }

    public bool Has(string name) => idsByName.Contains(name);
    public IEnumerable<int> Ids(string name) => idsByName[name];
    public bool IsAlive(int pid) => ids.Contains(pid);
}

internal static partial class GameWindow
{
    private static readonly string[] PrimaryGameProcessNames = ["HuntGame", "HuntGameSteam"];
    private static readonly string[] LauncherProcessNames = ["Hunt"];

    public static bool HasGameProcess(ProcessSnapshot processes, int additionalPid = 0) =>
        (additionalPid > 0 && processes.IsAlive(additionalPid)) ||
        PrimaryGameProcessNames.Concat(LauncherProcessNames).Any(processes.Has);

    public static IntPtr Find(int additionalPid = 0) => Find(ProcessSnapshot.Take(), additionalPid);

    public static IntPtr Find(ProcessSnapshot processes, int additionalPid = 0)
    {
        var candidatePids = PrimaryGameProcessNames.SelectMany(processes.Ids).ToHashSet();
        if (additionalPid > 0) candidatePids.Add(additionalPid);
        if (candidatePids.Count == 0) return IntPtr.Zero;

        IntPtr bestWindow = IntPtr.Zero;
        int bestScore = 0;

        EnumWindows((window, _) =>
        {
            GetWindowThreadProcessId(window, out var pid);
            int windowPid = (int)pid;
            if (!candidatePids.Contains(windowPid)) return true;

            // Reject child or owned windows
            if (GetWindow(window, GW_OWNER) != IntPtr.Zero) return true;

            bool isIconic = IsIconic(window);
            bool isVisible = IsWindowVisible(window) || isIconic;
            if (!isVisible) return true;

            string title = GetWindowTitle(window);
            string className = GetWindowClassName(window);

            // Strictly filter out Easy Anti-Cheat splash, launcher, and loading dialogs
            if (IsSplashOrEac(title, className)) return true;

            Rect bounds = default;
            if (!isIconic)
            {
                if (!GetClientRect(window, out bounds) || bounds.Right < 640 || bounds.Bottom < 480)
                    return true;
            }

            int score = 100;
            if (additionalPid > 0 && windowPid == additionalPid) score += 10000;
            if (string.Equals(className, "CryENGINE", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) score += 3000;
            if (title.Contains("Hunt", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) score += 1000;
            if (!isIconic)
            {
                score += 500;
                score += (bounds.Right * bounds.Bottom) / 1000;
            }

            if (score > bestScore)
            {
                bestScore = score;
                bestWindow = window;
            }

            return true;
        }, IntPtr.Zero);

        return bestWindow;
    }

    private static readonly string[] SplashTitles = ["Easy Anti-Cheat", "EasyAntiCheat", "Waiting for game", "Splash"];
    private static readonly string[] SplashClasses = ["EasyAntiCheat", "Splash"];

    private static bool IsSplashOrEac(string title, string className) =>
        SplashTitles.Any(s => title.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
        SplashClasses.Any(s => className.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    private static unsafe string GetWindowTitle(IntPtr hWnd)
    {
        char* buffer = stackalloc char[256];
        int length = GetWindowTextNative(hWnd, buffer, 256);
        return length > 0 ? new string(buffer, 0, length) : string.Empty;
    }

    private static unsafe string GetWindowClassName(IntPtr hWnd)
    {
        char* buffer = stackalloc char[256];
        int length = GetClassNameNative(hWnd, buffer, 256);
        return length > 0 ? new string(buffer, 0, length) : string.Empty;
    }

    private const uint GW_OWNER = 4;
    private delegate bool EnumWindowsCallback(IntPtr window, IntPtr parameter);
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] private struct Rect { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }
    // Delegate callbacks are not supported by source-generated LibraryImport; EnumWindows keeps DllImport.
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern bool EnumWindows(EnumWindowsCallback callback, IntPtr parameter);
    [LibraryImport("user32")] private static partial uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr window, out uint pid);
    [LibraryImport("user32")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static partial bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr window);
    [LibraryImport("user32")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static partial bool IsIconic(IntPtr window);
    [LibraryImport("user32")] private static partial IntPtr GetWindow(IntPtr window, uint command);
    [LibraryImport("user32")] [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] private static partial bool GetClientRect(IntPtr window, out Rect rect);
    [LibraryImport("user32", EntryPoint = "GetWindowTextW")] private static unsafe partial int GetWindowTextNative(IntPtr hWnd, char* text, int maxCount);
    [LibraryImport("user32", EntryPoint = "GetClassNameW")] private static unsafe partial int GetClassNameNative(IntPtr hWnd, char* className, int maxCount);
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Interop/NativeCaptureEngine.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using HuntReplay.Core.Media;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Interop;

internal sealed class NativeCaptureEngine : IDisposable
{
    private IntPtr session;
    // Packet payloads of this session; chunks are reused instead of one large-object array per frame.
    private readonly PayloadArena payloads = new();
    private readonly NativeMethods.PacketCallback packetCallback;
    private readonly NativeMethods.LogCallback logCallback;
    private Exception? callbackError;
    public string Description { get; private set; } = Text.Get("Capture.NotRunning");
    public event Action<EncodedPacket>? Packet;
    public event Action<int, string>? Log;

    public NativeCaptureEngine()
    {
        packetCallback = OnPacket;
        logCallback = (_, level, text) => { try { Log?.Invoke(level, Marshal.PtrToStringUTF8(text) ?? "Native event"); } catch { } };
    }

    public void Start(StudioSettings settings, IntPtr window, IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> devices)
    {
        if (session != IntPtr.Zero) throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Capture.AlreadyRunning"));
        RuntimeAssets.EnsureLoaded();
        var config = BuildConfig(settings, window, devices);
        NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_start(in config, packetCallback, logCallback, IntPtr.Zero, out session));
        Description = Marshal.PtrToStringUni(NativeMethods.hr_description(session)) ?? "GPU encoder";
    }

    public NativeStats Stats
    {
        get
        {
            if (session == IntPtr.Zero) return default;
            NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_get_stats(session, out var stats));
            if (callbackError is not null) stats.Running = 0;
            return stats;
        }
    }

    public void Stop() { if (session != IntPtr.Zero) NativeMethods.hr_stop(session); }

    // Caller must retain this session until all exports have finished (RecorderService enforces it).
    public unsafe void Export(ReplaySnapshot snapshot, string path)
    {
        NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_mux_open(session, path, out var mux));
        try
        {
            foreach (var packet in snapshot.Packets)
            {
                fixed (byte* data = packet.Payload.Span)
                {
                    var native = new NativePacket
                    {
                        Stream = packet.StreamIndex, Keyframe = packet.IsKeyFrame ? 1 : 0,
                        PtsUs = packet.PtsUs, DtsUs = packet.DtsUs, DurationUs = packet.DurationUs,
                        Data = (IntPtr)data, Size = packet.Payload.Length
                    };
                    NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_mux_write(mux, in native, snapshot.StartUs));
                }
            }
            var owned = mux;
            mux = IntPtr.Zero; // Close consumes its handle even when trailer/flush fails.
            NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_mux_close(owned));
        }
        finally { if (mux != IntPtr.Zero) NativeMethods.hr_mux_abort(mux); }
    }

    public static IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> EnumerateDevices()
    {
        RuntimeAssets.EnsureLoaded();
        var devices = new List<DeviceOption>();
        Exception? error = null;
        NativeMethods.DeviceCallback callback = (IntPtr _, in NativeDevice device) =>
        {
            try
            {
                devices.Add(new(device.Kind, Marshal.PtrToStringUni(device.Id) ?? "", Marshal.PtrToStringUni(device.Name) ?? "",
                    device.Handle, device.IsDefault != 0, device.Vendor));
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { error = ex; }
        };
        NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_devices(callback, IntPtr.Zero));
        GC.KeepAlive(callback);
        if (error is not null) throw error;
        return LocalizeMonitorNames(devices);
    }

    // The native layer reports monitors with a language-neutral fallback label; captions shown to people are built here.
    private static List<DeviceOption> LocalizeMonitorNames(List<DeviceOption> devices)
    {
        int ordinal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < devices.Count; ++i)
        {
            var device = devices[i];
            if (device.Kind != 0) continue;
            ++ordinal;
            var info = new MonitorInfo { Size = Marshal.SizeOf<MonitorInfo>() };
            if (!GetMonitorInfo((IntPtr)(long)device.Handle, ref info)) continue;
            var key = device.IsDefault ? "Device.MonitorPrimary" : "Device.Monitor";
            int width = info.Monitor.Right - info.Monitor.Left, height = info.Monitor.Bottom - info.Monitor.Top;
            devices[i] = device with { Name = Text.Format(key, ordinal, width, height), Width = width, Height = height };
        }
        return devices;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] private struct Rect { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] private struct MonitorInfo { public int Size; public Rect Monitor, Work; public uint Flags; }
    [DllImport("user32", EntryPoint = "GetMonitorInfoW")] private static extern bool GetMonitorInfo(IntPtr monitor, ref MonitorInfo info);

    public static void Probe(StudioSettings settings, IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> devices)
    {
        RuntimeAssets.EnsureLoaded();
        var config = BuildConfig(settings, settings.Video.Source == CaptureSource.HuntWindow ? GameWindow.Find() : IntPtr.Zero, devices);
        NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_probe(in config));
    }

    public static void SaveThumbnail(string video, string target)
    {
        RuntimeAssets.EnsureLoaded();
        NativeMethods.Check(NativeMethods.hr_thumbnail(video, 640, out var pixels, out var width, out var height, out var stride));
        try
        {
            // Reads straight from the native buffer: one copy instead of native -> byte[] -> bitmap.
            var bitmap = BitmapSource.Create(width, height, 96, 96, PixelFormats.Bgra32, null, pixels, checked(stride * height), stride);
            bitmap.Freeze();
            var encoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
            encoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(bitmap));
            using var file = new FileStream(target, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.Read);
            encoder.Save(file);
        }
        finally { NativeMethods.hr_free(pixels); }
    }

    private static NativeConfig BuildConfig(StudioSettings settings, IntPtr window, IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> devices)
    {
        settings.Validate();
        bool explicitMonitor = settings.Video.Source == CaptureSource.Monitor && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(settings.Video.MonitorDevice);
        var selected = explicitMonitor
            ? devices.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Kind == 0 && d.Id == settings.Video.MonitorDevice)
            : devices.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Kind == 0 && d.IsDefault);
        if (selected is null) throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Capture.MonitorDisconnected"));
        return new NativeConfig
        {
            Size = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<NativeConfig>(), Encoder = (int)settings.Video.Encoder, Codec = (int)settings.Video.Codec,
            // Only the height is sent: the native layer derives the width from the captured window or monitor (hr::fit_output).
            Fps = settings.Video.Fps, Width = 0, Height = settings.Video.Resolution.Height(), Bitrate = settings.Video.BitrateMbps * 1_000_000,
            GopSeconds = settings.Video.GopSeconds, Window = (ulong)window.ToInt64(), Monitor = selected.Handle,
            OutputDevice = settings.Audio.OutputDeviceId, MicrophoneDevice = settings.Audio.MicrophoneDeviceId,
            MicrophoneEnabled = settings.Audio.MicrophoneEnabled ? 1 : 0, MicrophoneGain = settings.Audio.MicrophoneVolume / 100f,
            SeparateMicrophone = settings.Audio.Mode == AudioMode.SeparateTracks ? 1 : 0,
            // Send the adapter the Settings page shows, also for a value saved by an older build.
            GpuDevice = DeviceOption.ResolveGpu(settings.Video.GpuDevice, devices)?.Id ?? settings.Video.GpuDevice
        };
    }

    private void OnPacket(IntPtr user, in NativePacket packet)
    {
        try
        {
            if (callbackError is not null) return;
            if (packet.Size <= 0 || packet.Size > 64 * 1024 * 1024) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Capture.InvalidPacketSize"));
            var (chunk, segment) = payloads.Rent(packet.Size);
            Marshal.Copy(packet.Data, segment.Array!, segment.Offset, segment.Count);
            // The buffer takes over the chunk reference, also when it rejects the packet.
            Packet?.Invoke(new(packet.Stream, segment, packet.PtsUs, packet.DtsUs, packet.DurationUs, packet.Keyframe != 0) { Chunk = chunk });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref callbackError, ex, null) is null)
            {
                try { Log?.Invoke(2, Text.Format("Capture.PacketBufferStopped", ex.Message)); } catch { }
            }
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (session == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        NativeMethods.hr_destroy(session); // Joins callbacks before delegates may be collected.
        session = IntPtr.Zero;
        GC.KeepAlive(packetCallback); GC.KeepAlive(logCallback);
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Interop/NativeMethods.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Interop;

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
internal struct NativeConfig
{
    public uint Size;
    public int Encoder, Codec, Fps, Width, Height, Bitrate, GopSeconds;
    public ulong Window, Monitor;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string OutputDevice;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string MicrophoneDevice;
    public int MicrophoneEnabled;
    public float MicrophoneGain;
    public int SeparateMicrophone;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string GpuDevice;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
internal struct NativePacket
{
    public int Stream, Keyframe;
    public long PtsUs, DtsUs, DurationUs;
    public IntPtr Data;
    public int Size;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
internal struct NativeStats
{
    public long Frames, DroppedFrames, EncodedBytes, ElapsedUs;
    public int Width, Height, Encoder, Codec, Running, SourceStale;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
internal struct NativeDevice
{
    public int Kind, IsDefault, Vendor;
    public ulong Handle;
    public IntPtr Id, Name;
}

internal static class NativeMethods
{
    private const string Library = "HuntReplay.Media.dll";
    [UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal delegate void PacketCallback(IntPtr user, in NativePacket packet);
    [UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal delegate void LogCallback(IntPtr user, int level, IntPtr message);
    [UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal delegate void DeviceCallback(IntPtr user, in NativeDevice device);
    [UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal delegate int hr_trim_progress_callback(IntPtr user, double progress);

    [DllImport(Library, CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal static extern int hr_abi_version();
    [DllImport(Library, CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal static extern IntPtr hr_last_error();
    internal static string? GetLastError() => Marshal.PtrToStringUni(hr_last_error());
    [DllImport(Library, CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal static extern int hr_devices(DeviceCallback callback, IntPtr user);
    [DllImport(Library, CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal static extern int hr_probe(in NativeConfig config);
    [DllImport(Library, CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal static extern int hr_start(in NativeConfig config,
        PacketCallback packets, LogCallback logs, IntPtr user, out IntPtr session);
    [DllImport(Library, CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal static extern void hr_stop(IntPtr session);
    [DllImport(Library, CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)] internal static extern void hr_destroy(IntPtr session);
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Interop/RuntimeAssets.cs`:

```cs
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Interop;

internal static class RuntimeAssets
{
    private static readonly object Gate = new();
    private static bool loaded;
    private static IntPtr nativeLibrary;

    public static void EnsureLoaded()
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            if (loaded) return;
            var assembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
            using var manifest = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("HuntReplay.Native.manifest")
                ?? throw new FileNotFoundException(Text.Get("Runtime.NotEmbedded"));
            using var reader = new StreamReader(manifest, Encoding.UTF8);
            var text = reader.ReadToEnd();
            var version = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text)))[..20];
            var root = Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),
                "HuntReplayStudio", "runtime", version);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(root);
            if ((File.GetAttributes(root) & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0)
                throw new IOException(Text.Get("Runtime.DirectoryIsLink"));
            foreach (var line in text.Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries))
            {
                var entry = line.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
                if (entry.Length != 2 || entry[0].Length != 64 || Path.GetFileName(entry[1]) != entry[1] ||
                    !entry[1].EndsWith(".dll", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Runtime.BadManifest"));
                var path = Path.Combine(root, entry[1]);
                if (File.Exists(path))
                {
                    if ((File.GetAttributes(path) & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Runtime.DllIsLink"));
                    using var existing = File.OpenRead(path);
                    if (Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(existing)).Equals(entry[0], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                }
                using var source = assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("HuntReplay.Native." + entry[1])
                    ?? throw new FileNotFoundException(Text.Format("Runtime.MissingLibrary", entry[1]));
                var temp = path + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
                try
                {
                    using (var output = new FileStream(temp, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None)) source.CopyTo(output);
                    using (var check = File.OpenRead(temp))
                        if (!Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(check)).Equals(entry[0], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                            throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Format("Runtime.ChecksumMismatch", entry[1]));
                    File.Move(temp, path, true);
                }
                finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
            }
            nativeLibrary = LoadLibraryEx(Path.Combine(root, "HuntReplay.Media.dll"), IntPtr.Zero, 0x100 | 0x1000);
            if (nativeLibrary == IntPtr.Zero) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), Text.Get("Runtime.LoadFailed"));
            NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver(assembly, (name, _, _) => name == "HuntReplay.Media.dll" ? nativeLibrary : IntPtr.Zero);
            if (NativeMethods.hr_abi_version() != 1) throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Runtime.AbiMismatch"));
            loaded = true;
            DeleteStaleRuntimes(root);
        }
    }

    // Every build with a new manifest extracts ~190 MB into a fresh folder; drop the old ones.
    private static void DeleteStaleRuntimes(string current)
    {
        foreach (var dir in new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetDirectoryName(current)!).EnumerateDirectories())
        {
            if (string.Equals(dir.FullName, current, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                (dir.Attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0) continue;
            try { dir.Delete(true); }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { } // still loaded by another running instance
        }
    }

    [DllImport("kernel32", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern IntPtr LoadLibraryEx(string fileName, IntPtr reserved, uint flags);
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs`:

```cs
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Windows;
using HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;

namespace HuntReplay.App;
public partial class MainWindow : Window
{
    internal bool CanClose { get; set; }
    public MainWindow()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        MinWidth = Math.Min(980, SystemParameters.WorkArea.Width);
        MinHeight = Math.Min(680, SystemParameters.WorkArea.Height);
        Width = Math.Min(1380, SystemParameters.WorkArea.Width - 24);
        Height = Math.Min(920, SystemParameters.WorkArea.Height - 24);
        SourceInitialized += (_, _) => Interop.WindowAppearance.DarkCaption(this);
    }
    private async void OnClosing(object? sender, CancelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (CanClose) return;
        e.Cancel = true;
        if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm)
        {
            if (!await vm.ConfirmLeaveSettingsAsync()) return;
            if (vm.CloseToTray) { Hide(); return; }
        }
        await ((App)Application.Current).ExitAsync();
    }
    internal void ShowStudio()
    {
        ShowInTaskbar = true; Show(); WindowState = WindowState.Normal; Activate();
    }
    internal void ClosePlayer() => Gallery.Close();
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/Authenticode.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal static class Authenticode
{
    public static void VerifyNvidia(string path)
    {
        var file = new TrustFile { Size = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<TrustFile>(), Path = path };
        var pointer = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf<TrustFile>());
        Marshal.StructureToPtr(file, pointer, false);
        var data = new TrustData
        {
            Size = (uint)Marshal.SizeOf<TrustData>(), UiChoice = 2, UnionChoice = 1,
            File = pointer, StateAction = 1, ProviderFlags = 0x1000 // Cache-only trust; first run never downloads a DLL.
        };
        var action = new Guid("00AAC56B-CD44-11D0-8CC2-00C04FC295EE");
        try
        {
            var result = WinVerifyTrust(new IntPtr(-1), in action, ref data);
            if (result != 0) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Format("Install.SignatureInvalid", $"0x{result:X8}"));
#pragma warning disable SYSLIB0057 // .NET 8 Authenticode certificate API; not a PFX import.
            using var signed = X509Certificate.CreateFromSignedFile(path);
            using var certificate = new X509Certificate2(signed);
#pragma warning restore SYSLIB0057
            if (!certificate.GetNameInfo(X509NameType.SimpleName, false).Equals("NVIDIA Corporation", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Install.PublisherNotNvidia"));
        }
        finally
        {
            data.StateAction = 2;
            WinVerifyTrust(new IntPtr(-1), in action, ref data);
            Marshal.DestroyStructure<TrustFile>(pointer);
            Marshal.FreeHGlobal(pointer);
        }
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private struct TrustFile
    {
        public uint Size;
        [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string Path;
        public IntPtr File, KnownSubject;
    }
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
    private struct TrustData
    {
        public uint Size;
        public IntPtr PolicyCallback, SipClient;
        public uint UiChoice, RevocationChecks, UnionChoice;
        public IntPtr File;
        public uint StateAction;
        public IntPtr StateData, UrlReference;
        public uint ProviderFlags, UiContext;
    }
    [DllImport("wintrust", ExactSpelling = true, PreserveSig = true)]
    private static extern int WinVerifyTrust(IntPtr window, in Guid action, ref TrustData data);
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/DesktopIntegration.cs`:

```cs
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Media;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using HuntReplay.Core.Storage;
using HuntReplay.Core.Support;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal sealed class HotkeyService : IDisposable
{
    private readonly HwndSource source;
    private readonly Action save;
    private int activeId;
    public int CurrentKey { get; private set; }
    public HotkeyService(Window window, Action save)
    {
        this.save = save;
        source = HwndSource.FromHwnd(new WindowInteropHelper(window).EnsureHandle())!;
        source.AddHook(WndProc);
    }
    public void Register(int virtualKey)
    {
        if (virtualKey == CurrentKey) return;
        int id = activeId == 0x4811 ? 0x4812 : 0x4811;
        if (!RegisterHotKey(source.Handle, id, 0x4000 /* MOD_NOREPEAT */, (uint)virtualKey))
            throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), Text.Get("Hotkey.Busy"));
        if (activeId != 0) UnregisterHotKey(source.Handle, activeId);
        activeId = id; CurrentKey = virtualKey;
    }
    private IntPtr WndProc(IntPtr hwnd, int message, IntPtr wparam, IntPtr lparam, ref bool handled)
    {
        if (message == 0x0312 && wparam.ToInt32() == activeId) { handled = true; save(); }
        return IntPtr.Zero;
    }
    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (activeId != 0) UnregisterHotKey(source.Handle, activeId);
        source.RemoveHook(WndProc);
    }
    [DllImport("user32", SetLastError = true)] private static extern bool RegisterHotKey(IntPtr window, int id, uint modifiers, uint key);
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern bool UnregisterHotKey(IntPtr window, int id);
}

internal static class DesktopIntegration
{
    public static void ConfigureStartup(bool enabled, bool portable)
    {
        using var key = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(@"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run", true);
        if (enabled)
        {
            var executable = Environment.ProcessPath ?? throw new IOException(Text.Get("Startup.ExePathUnknown"));
            key.SetValue("HuntReplayStudio", $"\"{executable}\" --tray" + (portable ? " --portable" : ""));
        }
        else key.DeleteValue("HuntReplayStudio", false);
    }
    public static void NotifySaved(StudioSettings settings)
    {
        if (settings.System.SoundOnSave) SystemSounds.Asterisk.Play();
    }
    public static void OpenFolder(string folder)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
        Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo("explorer.exe") { ArgumentList = { Path.GetFullPath(folder) }, UseShellExecute = true });
    }
    public static void OpenUrl(string url)
    {
        if (!SupportChannels.IsSafeLink(url)) throw new ArgumentException(Text.Get("Support.BadLink"), nameof(url));
        Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(url) { UseShellExecute = true });
    }
    public static void RevealFile(string file)
    {
        Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo("explorer.exe") { Arguments = "/select,\"" + Path.GetFullPath(file) + "\"", UseShellExecute = true });
    }
    // Opens the already saved MP4 with whatever Windows associates with .mp4. Nothing is re-encoded or copied.
    public static void OpenWithDefaultPlayer(string file)
    {
        var full = Path.GetFullPath(file);
        if (!File.Exists(full)) throw new FileNotFoundException(Text.Get("Clip.NotFound"), full);
        Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(full) { UseShellExecute = true });
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/DiagnosticsService.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text;
using HuntReplay.App.Interop;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal static class DiagnosticsService
{
    public static string Run(StudioSettings settings, RecorderService recorder, HighlightsPipeServer pipe)
    {
        var report = new StringBuilder();
        report.AppendLine("HUNTREPLAY STUDIO / SYSTEM READINESS");
        report.AppendLine(DateTimeOffset.Now.ToString("u"));
        report.AppendLine("─────────────────────────────────────────────────");
        Check("Windows 10 2004+ x64", () =>
        {
            if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindowsVersionAtLeast(10, 0, 19041) || !Environment.Is64BitProcess)
                throw new PlatformNotSupportedException(Text.Get("Diag.WindowsRequired"));
            return Environment.OSVersion.VersionString;
        });
        Check("MessageBus.dll / Authenticode", () => { SelfInstaller.CheckDll(SelfInstaller.DllPath); return "NVIDIA Corporation / SHA-256 OK"; });
        Check(Text.Get("Diag.RegistryCheck"), () =>
        {
            var status = SelfInstaller.Check();
            if (!status.Registry64 || !status.Registry32) throw new IOException($"Registry64={status.Registry64}; Registry32={status.Registry32}");
            return Text.Get("Diag.RegistryOk");
        });
        Check("Named pipe", () => pipe.IsListening ? @"\\.\pipe\NvMessageBusBroadcast / CurrentUserOnly"
            : throw new IOException(pipe.Failure ?? Text.Get("Diag.PipeNotListening")));
        Check(Text.Get("Diag.StorageCheck"), () =>
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(settings.Storage.Directory);
            var temp = Path.Combine(settings.Storage.Directory, "hrs-diagnostic-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp");
            using (new FileStream(temp, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 1, FileOptions.DeleteOnClose)) { }
            var drive = new DriveInfo(Path.GetPathRoot(settings.Storage.Directory)!);
            return drive.IsReady ? Text.Format("Diag.FreeSpace", drive.AvailableFreeSpace / 1_000_000_000d) : Text.Get("Diag.Writable");
        });
        IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> devices = [];
        Check(Text.Get("Diag.RuntimeCheck"), () =>
        {
            devices = NativeCaptureEngine.EnumerateDevices();
            return string.Join("; ", devices.Where(d => d.Kind == 3).Select(d => d.Name));
        });
        foreach (var device in devices.Where(d => d.Kind is 0 or 1 or 2))
            report.AppendLine($"      {(device.Kind == 0 ? "DISPLAY" : device.Kind == 1 ? "OUTPUT" : "MIC")} · {device.Name}{(device.IsDefault ? " [default]" : "")}");
        Check(Text.Get("Diag.EncoderCheck"), () =>
        {
            var status = recorder.Status;
            if (status.Running && status.Buffer.Seconds > 0) return Text.Format("Diag.PacketsFlowing", status.Encoder);
            if (devices.Count == 0) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Diag.NoDevices"));
            NativeCaptureEngine.Probe(settings, devices);
            return Text.Format("Diag.ProbeOk", settings.Video.Encoder, settings.Video.Codec);
        });
        report.AppendLine();
        report.AppendLine(Text.Get("Diag.FooterPerformance"));
        report.AppendLine(Text.Get("Diag.FooterHdr"));
        report.AppendLine(Text.Get("Diag.FooterCodecs"));
        report.AppendLine(Text.Get("Diag.FooterPrivacy"));
        return report.ToString();

        void Check(string name, Func<string> operation)
        {
            try { report.AppendLine($"[ OK ] {name}\n       {operation()}"); }
            catch (Exception ex) { report.AppendLine($"[FAIL] {name}\n       {ex.Message}"); }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/GpuInfo.cs`:

```cs
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

/// <summary>Driver version and dedicated video memory of a display adapter, as Windows records them for its driver.</summary>
internal sealed record GpuInfo(string? Driver, long? MemoryBytes)
{
    // Display adapter class; each adapter's driver has a numbered subkey with its description, version and memory size.
    private const string DisplayClass = @"SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}";
    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, GpuInfo> Cache = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public static GpuInfo For(string adapterName) => Cache.GetOrAdd(adapterName, Read);

    private static GpuInfo Read(string adapterName)
    {
        try
        {
            using var display = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(DisplayClass);
            foreach (var name in display?.GetSubKeyNames() ?? [])
            {
                using var key = TryOpen(display!, name);
                if (key?.GetValue("DriverDesc") is not string description || !string.Equals(description.Trim(), adapterName.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                var version = key.GetValue("DriverVersion") as string;
                return new(DriverLabel(description, version, key.GetValue("RadeonSoftwareVersion") as string), Memory(key));
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is System.Security.SecurityException or UnauthorizedAccessException or IOException) { }
        return new(null, null);
    }

    private static RegistryKey? TryOpen(RegistryKey parent, string name)
    {
        try { return parent.OpenSubKey(name); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is System.Security.SecurityException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { return null; } // "Properties" is locked.
    }

    // The vendor's own version reads better than the Windows driver version: Adrenalin for AMD, the 5-digit release for NVIDIA.
    internal static string? DriverLabel(string description, string? version, string? radeonVersion)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(radeonVersion)) return radeonVersion.Trim();
        if (version is null) return null;
        var digits = new string(version.Where(char.IsAsciiDigit).ToArray());
        if (description.Contains("NVIDIA", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && digits.Length >= 5)
            return $"{digits[^5..^2]}.{digits[^2..]}"; // 32.0.15.6094 -> 560.94
        return version;
    }

    private static long? Memory(RegistryKey key) => key.GetValue("HardwareInformation.qwMemorySize") switch
    {
        long bytes when bytes > 0 => bytes,
        byte[] raw when raw.Length >= 8 => BitConverter.ToInt64(raw, 0),
        int bytes when bytes != 0 => (uint)bytes,
        _ => key.GetValue("HardwareInformation.MemorySize") switch { int bytes when bytes != 0 => (uint)bytes, byte[] raw when raw.Length >= 4 => BitConverter.ToUInt32(raw, 0), _ => null }
    };
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/HighlightsPipeServer.cs`:

```cs
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.IO.Pipes;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Google.Protobuf;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using HuntReplay.Protocol;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal sealed class HighlightsPipeServer(RecorderService recorder, StudioLog log, string pipeName = HighlightsPipeServer.PipeName) : IAsyncDisposable
{
    public const string PipeName = "NvMessageBusBroadcast";
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource stop = new();
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<int, Task> clients = new();
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<int, (uint Pid, string Game)> games = new();
    // Null whenever no listen loop runs, so TryStart can claim the pipe again after a failure.
    private volatile Task? listener;
    private int nextClient;
    private volatile bool listening;
    public bool IsListening => listening;
    public string? Failure { get; private set; }
    public event Action? StateChanged;
    public IReadOnlyCollection<(uint Pid, string Game)> Games => games.Values.ToArray();

    /// <summary>
    /// Claims the Highlights pipe. Returns false when another server holds it; with logFailure false the caller
    /// can react first (for example pause NVIDIA's container) and retry without an error in the log.
    /// </summary>
    public bool TryStart(bool logFailure)
    {
        if (stop.IsCancellationRequested) return false;
        if (listener is not null) return true;
        try
        {
            // FirstPipeInstance detects NVIDIA/Python/another user's server instead of hijacking it.
            var first = NewPipe(first: true);
            listening = true;
            Failure = null;
            listener = Task.Run(() => ListenAsync(first));
            log.Write(Text.Format("Ipc.Listening", @"\\.\pipe\" + pipeName));
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            Failure = SelfInstaller.IsNvidiaActive() ? Text.Get("Ipc.BusyNvidia") : Text.Format("Ipc.BusyOther", ex.Message);
            if (logFailure) log.Write(Failure, "ERROR");
            return false;
        }
    }

    private NamedPipeServerStream NewPipe(bool first) => new(pipeName, PipeDirection.InOut, 16,
        PipeTransmissionMode.Byte, PipeOptions.Asynchronous | PipeOptions.CurrentUserOnly |
        (first ? PipeOptions.FirstPipeInstance : PipeOptions.None), 65536, 65536);

    private async Task ListenAsync(NamedPipeServerStream initial)
    {
        var next = initial;
        try
        {
            while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                try { await next.WaitForConnectionAsync(stop.Token).ConfigureAwait(false); }
                catch (IOException ex)
                {
                    // A client that connects and drops immediately fails only this instance.
                    log.Write(Text.Format("Ipc.ConnectFailed", ex.Message), "WARN");
                    next.Dispose();
                    next = NewPipe(first: false);
                    await Task.Delay(100, stop.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    continue;
                }
                var connected = next;
                // Keep a listening instance alive for the entire lifetime of the server.
                next = NewPipe(first: false);
                if (clients.Count >= 14) { connected.Dispose(); log.Write(Text.Get("Ipc.TooManyClients"), "WARN"); continue; }
                int id = Interlocked.Increment(ref nextClient);
                var task = HandleAsync(connected, id);
                clients[id] = task;
                _ = RemoveWhenDoneAsync(task, id);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stop.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            Failure = ex.Message;
            log.Write(Text.Format("Ipc.ServerStopped", ex.Message), "ERROR");
        }
        // listening drops first: a TryStart that sees the null listener then starts a fresh loop that stays marked.
        finally { next.Dispose(); listening = false; listener = null; StateChanged?.Invoke(); }
    }

    private async Task RemoveWhenDoneAsync(Task task, int id)
    {
        try { await task.ConfigureAwait(false); }
        finally { clients.TryRemove(id, out _); }
    }

    private async Task HandleAsync(NamedPipeServerStream pipe, int id)
    {
        using (pipe)
        {
            try
            {
                if (!GetNamedPipeClientProcessId(pipe.SafePipeHandle, out var pid)) throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error());
                var session = new HighlightsSession(pid, () => recorder.NowUs,
                    eventId => recorder.Settings.Replay.IsEnabled(eventId), recorder.TryHighlight, message => log.Write(message));
                session.GameChanged += game =>
                {
                    if (game is null) games.TryRemove(id, out _); else games[id] = (pid, game);
                    StateChanged?.Invoke();
                };
                while (!stop.IsCancellationRequested && await BusFraming.ReadAsync(pipe, stop.Token).ConfigureAwait(false) is { } frame)
                    foreach (var reply in session.Process(frame))
                        await BusFraming.WriteAsync(pipe, reply, stop.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or InvalidProtocolBufferException or InvalidDataException or Win32Exception or InvalidOperationException)
            { log.Write(Text.Format("Ipc.ClientError", id, ex.Message), "WARN"); }
            finally
            {
                games.TryRemove(id, out _);
                StateChanged?.Invoke();
                log.Write(Text.Format("Ipc.ClientDisconnected", id));
            }
        }
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        stop.Cancel();
        if (listener is not null) await listener.ConfigureAwait(false);
        await Task.WhenAll(clients.Values.ToArray()).ConfigureAwait(false);
        stop.Dispose();
    }
    [DllImport("kernel32", SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern bool GetNamedPipeClientProcessId(SafePipeHandle pipe, out uint pid);
}
```

```cs
using System.ComponentModel;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

/// <summary>
/// WPF face of <see cref="Text"/>: XAML binds <c>{Binding Loc[Key]}</c> and code uses <c>Loc["Key"]</c> or

public sealed class LocalizationService : INotifyPropertyChanged

    public string this[string key] => Text.Get(key);
```
