`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/NvidiaServiceManager.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Security.AccessControl;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.ServiceProcess;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal static class NvidiaServiceManager
{
    private static readonly string[] CandidateServices =
    [
        "NVDisplay.ContainerLocalSystem",
        "NvContainerLocalSystem"
    ];

    private static readonly List<string> StoppedServices = [];

    public static bool IsServiceRunning(string name) =>
        WithService(name, service => service.Status is ServiceControllerStatus.Running or ServiceControllerStatus.StartPending);

    public static bool StopServiceInternal(string name) => WithService(name, service =>
    {
        if (service.Status == ServiceControllerStatus.Stopped) return true;
        if (service.Status != ServiceControllerStatus.StopPending)
        {
            try { service.Stop(); }
            catch (InvalidOperationException)
            {
                // The service may have stopped on its own in the meantime; anything else is a refusal.
                service.Refresh();
                if (service.Status is not (ServiceControllerStatus.Stopped or ServiceControllerStatus.StopPending)) return false;
            }
        }
        // Wait up to 3 seconds for the service to finish stopping cleanly.
        try { service.WaitForStatus(ServiceControllerStatus.Stopped, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3)); }
        catch (System.ServiceProcess.TimeoutException) { }
        service.Refresh();
        return service.Status is ServiceControllerStatus.Stopped or ServiceControllerStatus.StopPending;
    });

    public static bool StartServiceInternal(string name) => WithService(name, service =>
    {
        if (service.Status == ServiceControllerStatus.StopPending)
        {
            try { service.WaitForStatus(ServiceControllerStatus.Stopped, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)); }
            catch (System.ServiceProcess.TimeoutException) { }
            service.Refresh();
        }
        if (service.Status is ServiceControllerStatus.Running or ServiceControllerStatus.StartPending) return true;
        service.Start();
        return true;
    });

    // A missing service, denied access or a refused start/stop reads as "no", as the raw SCM calls did.
    private static bool WithService(string name, Func<ServiceController, bool> action)
    {
        try
        {
            using var service = new ServiceController(name);
            return action(service);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is InvalidOperationException or System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception) { return false; }
    }

    public static void StopResidualProcesses(StudioLog? log = null)
    {
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++)
        {
            try
            {
                var processes = Process.GetProcessesByName("nvcontainer");
                if (processes.Length == 0) break;
                foreach (var p in processes)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        if (!p.HasExited)
                        {
                            p.Kill(true);
                            p.WaitForExit(1000);
                            log?.Write(Text.Format("Nvidia.ProcessStopped", p.Id));
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        log?.Write(Text.Format("Nvidia.ProcessStopFailed", p.Id, ex.Message), "WARN");
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        p.Dispose();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                log?.Write(Text.Format("Nvidia.ProcessesStopError", ex.Message), "WARN");
                break;
            }
            if (attempt == 0) Thread.Sleep(100);
        }
    }

    public static async Task EnsureServicePausedAsync(StudioLog? log)
    {
        var runningServices = CandidateServices.Where(IsServiceRunning).ToList();
        var runningProcesses = Process.GetProcessesByName("nvcontainer");
        bool hasProcesses = runningProcesses.Length > 0;
        foreach (var p in runningProcesses) p.Dispose();

        if (runningServices.Count == 0 && !hasProcesses) return;

        bool isAdmin = false;
        try
        {
            using var identity = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
            isAdmin = new WindowsPrincipal(identity).IsInRole(WindowsBuiltInRole.Administrator);
        }
        catch { }

        bool directSuccess = false;
        if (isAdmin)
        {
            directSuccess = true;
            foreach (var svc in runningServices)
            {
                if (StopServiceInternal(svc))
                {
                    StoppedServices.Add(svc);
                }
                else
                {
                    directSuccess = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

            StopResidualProcesses(log);

            if (directSuccess)
            {
                if (StoppedServices.Count > 0)
                {
                    log?.Write(Text.Get("Nvidia.ServicePaused"));
                    bool keeperReady = await StartKeeperProcessAsync(StoppedServices, elevated: false, log);
                    if (keeperReady)
                    {
                        log?.Write(Text.Get("Nvidia.KeeperActive"));
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
        }

        try
        {
            var servicesToPass = runningServices;
            bool signalled = await StartKeeperProcessAsync(servicesToPass, elevated: true, log);
            if (signalled)
            {
                log?.Write(Text.Get("Nvidia.PausedByKeeper"));
                await Task.Delay(300);
                StopResidualProcesses(log);
            }
            else
            {
                log?.Write(Text.Get("Nvidia.KeeperTimeout"), "WARN");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            log?.Write(Text.Format("Nvidia.PauseFailed", ex.Message), "WARN");
        }
    }

    private static EventWaitHandle CreateKeeperReadyEvent(string name, out bool createdNew)
    {
        try
        {
            var security = new EventWaitHandleSecurity();
            security.AddAccessRule(new EventWaitHandleAccessRule(
                new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.AuthenticatedUserSid, null),
                EventWaitHandleRights.FullControl,
                AccessControlType.Allow));
            var handle = EventWaitHandleAcl.Create(false, EventResetMode.ManualReset, name, out createdNew, security);
            if (!createdNew) handle.Reset();
            return handle;
        }
        catch
        {
            var handle = new EventWaitHandle(false, EventResetMode.ManualReset, name, out createdNew);
            if (!createdNew) handle.Reset();
            return handle;
        }
    }

    private static async Task<bool> StartKeeperProcessAsync(IEnumerable<string> services, bool elevated, StudioLog? log)
    {
        int myPid = Environment.ProcessId;
        string readyEventName = @"Local\HuntReplay.NvidiaKeeperReady." + myPid;
        using var readyEvent = CreateKeeperReadyEvent(readyEventName, out _);

        var serviceArgs = string.Join(" ", services);
        var startInfo = new ProcessStartInfo(Environment.ProcessPath ?? throw new IOException(Text.Get("Startup.ExePathUnknown")))
        {
            UseShellExecute = true,
            Verb = elevated ? "runas" : "",
            Arguments = $"--nvidia-service-keeper {myPid} {serviceArgs}".Trim(),
            WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Hidden
        };

        using var keeperProcess = Process.Start(startInfo);
        if (keeperProcess is not null)
        {
            if (elevated)
                log?.Write(Text.Get("Nvidia.ElevationRequested"));
            var timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(elevated ? 30 : 10);
            return await Task.Run(() => readyEvent.WaitOne(timeout));
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void RestoreServices(StudioLog? log)
    {
        foreach (var svc in StoppedServices)
        {
            try
            {
                if (StartServiceInternal(svc))
                {
                    log?.Write(Text.Format("Nvidia.ServiceRestored", svc));
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                log?.Write(Text.Format("Nvidia.ServiceRestoreFailed", svc, ex.Message), "WARN");
            }
        }
        StoppedServices.Clear();
    }

    public static void RunKeeper(int mainPid, string[]? servicesToKeep = null)
    {
        var servicesToRestore = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (servicesToKeep != null)
        {
            foreach (var s in servicesToKeep)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) &&
                    CandidateServices.Contains(s.Trim(), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    servicesToRestore.Add(s.Trim());
            }
        }

        foreach (var svc in CandidateServices)
        {
            if (IsServiceRunning(svc))
            {
                servicesToRestore.Add(svc);
                StopServiceInternal(svc);
            }
        }

        StopResidualProcesses();

        try
        {
            if (EventWaitHandle.TryOpenExisting(@"Local\HuntReplay.NvidiaKeeperReady." + mainPid, out var readyEvent))
            {
                readyEvent.Set();
                readyEvent.Dispose();
            }
        }
        catch { }

        if (servicesToRestore.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            using var mainProc = Process.GetProcessById(mainPid);
            mainProc.WaitForExit();
        }
        catch { }

        foreach (var svc in servicesToRestore)
        {
            for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (StartServiceInternal(svc)) break;
                }
                catch { }
                Thread.Sleep(500);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/OverlayService.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using HuntReplay.App.Views;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Decides when the over-the-game notification appears. The window is created on first use, so nothing exists
/// while the setting is off. Must be called on the UI thread.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class OverlayService(StudioLog log) : IDisposable
{
    private OverlayWindow? window;
    private bool skippingFullscreen;

    /// <summary>
    /// Shows a notification when it is enabled, Studio is not the active window (Studio shows its own status then)
    /// and no exclusive fullscreen game is running. A preview shows with the given, possibly unsaved, settings regardless.
    /// </summary>
    public void Notify(SystemSettings settings, OverlayKind kind, string title, string detail = "", bool preview = false)
    {
        if (!preview && (!settings.OverlayEnabled || StudioIsActive() || ExclusiveFullscreen())) return;
        try { (window ??= new OverlayWindow()).Notify(kind, title, detail, settings.OverlayCorner, settings.OverlaySeconds); }
        catch (Exception) when (!preview) { } // Best effort: a notification must never interrupt status updates or saving.
    }

    private static bool StudioIsActive()
    {
        _ = GetWindowThreadProcessId(GetForegroundWindow(), out uint process);
        return process == (uint)Environment.ProcessId;
    }

    // A window over an exclusive fullscreen Direct3D game occludes its output: the game may stop presenting and
    // freeze until the window is gone. Windows reports that state itself; notifications wait it out silently.
    private bool ExclusiveFullscreen()
    {
        bool exclusive = SHQueryUserNotificationState(out int state) == 0 && state == QunsRunningD3DFullScreen;
        if (exclusive && !skippingFullscreen) log.Write(Text.Get("Overlay.SkippedFullscreen"));
        skippingFullscreen = exclusive;
        return exclusive;
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        window?.Close();
        window = null;
    }

    private const int QunsRunningD3DFullScreen = 3;
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr window, out uint process);
    [DllImport("shell32")] private static extern int SHQueryUserNotificationState(out int state);
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/RecorderService.cs`:

```cs
using System.Threading.Channels;
using HuntReplay.App.Interop;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using HuntReplay.Core.Media;
using HuntReplay.Core.Replay;
using HuntReplay.Core.Storage;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal sealed record RecorderStatus(bool Running, BufferStatus Buffer, NativeStats Native, string Encoder, int Pending, int Exports);

internal sealed class RecorderService : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly object state = new();
    private readonly object exportGate = new();
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim lifecycle = new(1, 1);
    private readonly StudioLog log;
    private readonly string libraryRoot;
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource stop = new();
    private readonly Channel<ExportJob> exports = Channel.CreateBounded<ExportJob>(new BoundedChannelOptions(2)
    { SingleReader = true, FullMode = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait });
    private readonly Task timer;
    private readonly Task exporter;
    private NativeCaptureEngine? engine;
    private PacketRingBuffer? buffer;
    private HighlightPlanner? planner;
    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, Guid> pins = new();
    private bool stopping;
    private const int MaximumExportSnapshots = 2;
    private int exportCount;
    private TaskCompletionSource exportsIdle = CompletedSource();
    private Guid? protectedClip;
    private StudioSettings settings;
    public StudioSettings Settings { get { lock (state) return settings; } }
    public event Action<LibraryClip>? ClipSaved;
    public event Action? Changed;
    private sealed record ExportJob(NativeCaptureEngine Engine, ReplaySnapshot Snapshot, ClipPlan Plan, StudioSettings Settings);

    public RecorderService(StudioSettings settings, StudioLog log, string libraryRoot)
    {
        this.settings = settings.Clone(); this.log = log; this.libraryRoot = libraryRoot;
        timer = Task.Run(TimerLoopAsync);
        exporter = Task.Run(ExportLoopAsync);
    }

    public RecorderStatus Status
    {
        get
        {
            lock (state)
            {
                var native = engine?.Stats ?? default;
                return new(!stopping && native.Running != 0, buffer?.Status ?? default, native,
                    engine?.Description ?? Text.Get("Recorder.EncoderNotRunning"), planner?.PendingCount ?? 0, Volatile.Read(ref exportCount));
            }
        }
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Applies a UI preference (language, theme) that needs no capture restart. The live settings object is replaced,
    /// never mutated, so readers on other threads keep a consistent snapshot. Returns a copy to persist.
    /// </summary>
    public StudioSettings UpdatePreferences(Action<SystemSettings> change)
    {
        lock (state)
        {
            var next = settings.Clone(); change(next.System); next.Validate();
            settings = next;
            return next.Clone();
        }
    }
    public long NowUs { get { lock (state) return engine?.Stats.ElapsedUs ?? 0; } }
    public void ProtectPlayingClip(Guid? id) { lock (state) protectedClip = id; }

    public async Task StartAsync(IntPtr window, IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> devices)
    {
        await lifecycle.WaitAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        try
        {
            lock (state) if (engine is not null) throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Recorder.StopFirst"));
            var value = Settings.Clone(); value.Validate();
            if (value.Video.Source == CaptureSource.HuntWindow && window == IntPtr.Zero)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Recorder.GameWindowMissing"));
            var bytesPerSecond = value.Video.BitrateMbps * 1_000_000L / 8 + 48_000;
            var reserveSeconds = value.Replay.BufferSeconds + value.Replay.MaxSequenceSeconds + value.Replay.CoalesceGapSeconds + 32;
            var physical = GC.GetGCMemoryInfo().TotalAvailableMemoryBytes;
            long limit = Math.Min(bytesPerSecond * reserveSeconds + 32L * 1024 * 1024, Math.Max(64L * 1024 * 1024, physical / 4));
            var ram = new PacketRingBuffer(value.Replay.BufferSeconds, limit);
            var capture = new NativeCaptureEngine();
            capture.Packet += ram.Add;
            capture.Log += (level, message) => log.Write(message, level == 2 ? "ERROR" : level == 1 ? "WARN" : "MEDIA");
            try
            {
                await Task.Run(() => capture.Start(value, value.Video.Source == CaptureSource.HuntWindow ? window : IntPtr.Zero, devices)).ConfigureAwait(false);
                lock (state)
                {
                    engine = capture; buffer = ram; planner = new(value.Replay); pins.Clear(); stopping = false;
                }
            }
            catch { capture.Dispose(); throw; }
            log.Write(Text.Format("Log.BufferStarted", value.Replay.BufferSeconds, limit / 1024 / 1024));
            Changed?.Invoke();
        }
        finally { lifecycle.Release(); }
    }

    public bool TryHighlight(HighlightEvent evt)
    {
        lock (state)
        {
            if (engine is null || buffer is null || planner is null || stopping || engine.Stats.Running == 0 || buffer.Status.Seconds < 0.1) return false;
            try
            {
                var plan = planner.Register(evt);
                if (plan is null) return true;
                if (pins.TryGetValue(plan.Id, out var pin)) buffer.UpdatePin(pin, plan.StartUs);
                else pins[plan.Id] = buffer.Pin(plan.StartUs);
                log.Write(Text.Format("Log.HighlightPlanned", evt.HighlightId, plan.EventTag, plan.EndUs / 1_000_000d), "EVENT");
                Changed?.Invoke();
                return true;
            }
            catch (InvalidOperationException ex) { log.Write(ex.Message, "WARN"); return false; }
        }
    }

    public async Task SaveManualAsync()
    {
        await lifecycle.WaitAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        Guid? manualPin = null;
        try
        {
            long end;
            lock (state)
            {
                if (engine is null || buffer is null || stopping || engine.Stats.Running == 0)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Recorder.StartFirst"));
                end = buffer.Status.LatestUs;
                manualPin = buffer.Pin(Math.Max(0, end - settings.Replay.BufferSeconds * 1_000_000L));
            }
            // Allow the 120ms WASAPI jitter buffer and AAC frame to catch up to this exact request time.
            await Task.Delay(250).ConfigureAwait(false);
            lock (state)
            {
                var plan = new ClipPlan
                {
                    SessionId = "manual", GroupId = "manual", FirstEventUs = end, LastEventUs = end,
                    StartUs = Math.Max(0, end - settings.Replay.BufferSeconds * 1_000_000L), EndUs = end
                };
                plan.Events.Add("MANUAL");
                if (!QueuePlan(plan)) throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Recorder.NothingToSave"));
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            lock (state) if (manualPin is { } pin) buffer?.Unpin(pin);
            lifecycle.Release();
        }
    }

    public async Task StopAsync()
    {
        await lifecycle.WaitAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        try { await StopCoreAsync().ConfigureAwait(false); }
        finally { lifecycle.Release(); }
    }

    private async Task StopCoreAsync()
    {
        NativeCaptureEngine? capture;
        lock (state) { capture = engine; stopping = true; }
        if (capture is null) return;
        await Task.Run(capture.Stop).ConfigureAwait(false);
        // Drain in bounded waves, retaining the remaining plans and pins. A slow disk or
        // several simultaneously ready matches must not discard already accepted events.
        while (true)
        {
            int remaining;
            lock (state) { FlushReady(force: true); remaining = planner?.PendingCount ?? 0; }
            Task idle;
            lock (exportGate) idle = exportsIdle.Task;
            await idle.ConfigureAwait(false); // Codec headers stay alive through the last mux.
            if (remaining == 0) break;
        }
        lock (state)
        {
            capture.Dispose(); engine = null; buffer = null; planner = null; pins.Clear(); stopping = false;
        }
        log.Write(Text.Get("Log.BufferStopped"));
        Changed?.Invoke();
    }

    public async Task ApplySettingsAsync(StudioSettings value)
    {
        value.Validate();
        await lifecycle.WaitAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        try
        {
            await StopCoreAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
            lock (state) settings = value.Clone();
        }
        finally { lifecycle.Release(); }
    }

    private async Task TimerLoopAsync()
    {
        using var tick = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(250));
        try
        {
            while (await tick.WaitForNextTickAsync(stop.Token).ConfigureAwait(false))
            {
                lock (state) if (engine is not null && !stopping) FlushReady(force: false);
                Changed?.Invoke();
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stop.IsCancellationRequested) { }
        catch (Exception ex) { log.Write(Text.Format("Log.SchedulerError", ex.Message), "ERROR"); }
    }

    private void FlushReady(bool force)
    {
        if (planner is null || engine is null || buffer is null) return;
        while (Volatile.Read(ref exportCount) < MaximumExportSnapshots)
        {
            var ready = planner.TakeReady(engine.Stats.ElapsedUs - 250_000, force, maximum: 1);
            if (ready.Count == 0) break;
            var plan = ready[0];
            QueuePlan(plan); // Producers are serialized by state; only the consumer can reduce exportCount.
            if (pins.Remove(plan.Id, out var pin)) buffer.Unpin(pin);
        }
    }

    private bool QueuePlan(ClipPlan plan)
    {
        if (engine is null || buffer is null) return false;
        if (Volatile.Read(ref exportCount) >= MaximumExportSnapshots)
        {
            log.Write(Text.Get("Log.QueueFullManual"), "WARN");
            return false;
        }
        var snapshot = buffer.Snapshot(plan.StartUs, plan.EndUs);
        if (snapshot is null) { log.Write(Text.Format("Log.NoKeyframe", plan.EventTag), "WARN"); return false; }
        lock (exportGate)
        {
            if (exportCount == 0) exportsIdle = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            exportCount++;
            if (exports.Writer.TryWrite(new(engine, snapshot, plan, settings.Clone()))) return true;
            exportCount--;
            if (exportCount == 0) exportsIdle.TrySetResult();
        }
        snapshot.Dispose(); // Not queued: its payload chunks may be recycled right away.
        log.Write(Text.Get("Log.QueueFull"), "WARN");
        return false;
    }

    private async Task ExportLoopAsync()
    {
        await foreach (var job in exports.Reader.ReadAllAsync().ConfigureAwait(false))
        {
            string? temp = null;
            try
            {
                var library = new ClipLibrary(job.Settings.Storage.Directory, libraryRoot);
                var now = DateTimeOffset.Now;
                var final = library.NewPath(job.Settings.Storage.FileNameTemplate, job.Plan.EventTag, now);
                ClipLibrary.RequireDiskSpace(final, job.Snapshot.Bytes);
                temp = final + ".partial.mp4";
                // Exclusive reservation prevents accidentally overwriting a concurrently created file.
                using (new FileStream(temp, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None)) { }
                job.Engine.Export(job.Snapshot, temp);
                job.Snapshot.Dispose(); // The MP4 holds the data now; free the buffer chunks before slower file work.
                File.Move(temp, final); temp = null;
                var clip = library.Register(final, new ClipMetadata
                {
                    FileName = Path.GetFileName(final), EventTag = job.Plan.EventTag, Events = job.Plan.Events.ToArray(),
                    GroupId = job.Plan.GroupId, CreatedAt = now, DurationSeconds = job.Snapshot.DurationSeconds,
                    Encoder = job.Engine.Description, TruncatedStart = job.Snapshot.TruncatedStart,
                    TruncatedEnd = job.Snapshot.TruncatedEnd
                });
                try { NativeCaptureEngine.SaveThumbnail(final, clip.ThumbnailPath); }
                catch (Exception ex) { log.Write(Text.Format("Log.ThumbnailFailed", ex.Message), "WARN"); }
                log.Write(Text.Format("Log.ClipSaved", clip.Metadata.FileName, clip.Metadata.DurationSeconds), "SAVED");
                if (clip.Metadata.TruncatedStart || clip.Metadata.TruncatedEnd)
                    log.Write(Text.Get("Log.ClipTruncated"), "WARN");
                var protectedIds = new HashSet<Guid> { clip.Metadata.Id };
                lock (state) if (protectedClip is { } id) protectedIds.Add(id);
                try
                {
                    var removed = library.EnforceLimit(job.Settings.Storage, protectedIds);
                    if (removed > 0) log.Write(Text.Format("Log.AutoCleanup", removed));
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
                { log.Write(Text.Format("Log.AutoCleanupFailed", ex.Message), "WARN"); }
                ClipSaved?.Invoke(clip);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { log.Write(Text.Format("Log.ExportFailed", ex.Message), "ERROR"); }
            finally
            {
                job.Snapshot.Dispose(); // Idempotent; covers a failed export.
                if (temp is not null)
                    try { File.Delete(temp); } catch (IOException) { } catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
                lock (exportGate)
                {
                    exportCount--;
                    if (exportCount == 0) exportsIdle.TrySetResult();
                }
                Changed?.Invoke();
            }
        }
    }

    private static TaskCompletionSource CompletedSource()
    {
        var source = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously); source.SetResult(); return source;
    }
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        stop.Cancel(); await timer.ConfigureAwait(false);
        await StopAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        exports.Writer.TryComplete(); await exporter.ConfigureAwait(false);
        stop.Dispose(); lifecycle.Dispose();
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/SelfInstaller.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Security.AccessControl;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Text.Json;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using Microsoft.Win32;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal sealed record SetupStatus(bool DllValid, bool Registry64, bool Registry32, bool Conflict, bool NvidiaActive, string Detail)
{
    public bool Ready => DllValid && Registry64 && Registry32;
}

internal static class SelfInstaller
{
    public const string DllHash = "64e300997b5796da22ad8baa49e4eb919cdc170157cbe6770279f94508a84650";
    public const string ShimDirectory = @"C:\NvidiaShim";
    public const string DllPath = @"C:\NvidiaShim\MessageBus.dll";
    private const string BusKey = @"SOFTWARE\NVIDIA Corporation\NvContainer\MessageBus";
    private const string MapKey = @"SOFTWARE\NVIDIA Corporation\NvContainer\ModuleMap";
    private static string DataDirectory => Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.CommonApplicationData), "HuntReplayStudio");
    private static string BackupFile => Path.Combine(DataDirectory, "shim-installation.json");
    private static string LogDirectory => Path.Combine(DataDirectory, "MessageBusLogs");
    private static readonly RegistryView[] Views = [RegistryView.Registry64, RegistryView.Registry32];

    private sealed record BackupValue(RegistryView View, string Key, string Name, bool KeyExisted,
        bool Existed, RegistryValueKind Kind, JsonElement Value);
    private sealed class InstallationBackup
    {
        public string Owner { get; set; } = "HuntReplayStudio/1";
        public string Hash { get; set; } = DllHash;
        public bool CreatedDll { get; set; }
        public bool Completed { get; set; }
        public List<BackupValue> Values { get; set; } = [];
    }

    private static IEnumerable<(string Key, string Name, object Value, RegistryValueKind Kind)> DesiredValues()
    {
        yield return (BusKey, "InstallPath", ShimDirectory, RegistryValueKind.String);
        yield return (BusKey, "LogPath", LogDirectory, RegistryValueKind.String);
        yield return (BusKey, "LogLevel", 0, RegistryValueKind.DWord);
        yield return (MapKey, "MessageBus.dll", DllPath, RegistryValueKind.String);
    }

    public static SetupStatus Check()
    {
        var valid = false;
        var detail = Text.Get("Install.NotInstalled");
        if (File.Exists(DllPath))
        {
            try { CheckDll(DllPath); valid = true; detail = Text.Get("Install.Verified"); }
            catch (Exception ex) { detail = ex.Message; }
        }
        bool r64 = RegistryReady(RegistryView.Registry64), r32 = RegistryReady(RegistryView.Registry32);
        var conflict = Views.Any(view =>
        {
            using var hklm = RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, view);
            using var key = hklm.OpenSubKey(BusKey);
            using var map = hklm.OpenSubKey(MapKey);
            var install = key?.GetValue("InstallPath") as string;
            var dll = map?.GetValue("MessageBus.dll") as string;
            return (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(install) && !install.TrimEnd('\\').Equals(ShimDirectory, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ||
                   (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dll) && !dll.Equals(DllPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        });
        bool nvidiaActive = IsNvidiaActive();
        return new(valid, r64, r32, conflict, nvidiaActive, detail);
    }

    public static bool IsNvidiaActive()
    {
        try
        {
            var processes = Process.GetProcessesByName("nvcontainer");
            if (processes.Length > 0)
            {
                foreach (var p in processes) p.Dispose();
                return true;
            }
        }
        catch { }
        return false;
    }

    private static bool RegistryReady(RegistryView view)
    {
        using var hklm = RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, view);
        using var key = hklm.OpenSubKey(BusKey);
        using var map = hklm.OpenSubKey(MapKey);
        return string.Equals(key?.GetValue("InstallPath") as string, ShimDirectory, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
            key?.GetValue("LogPath") is string && key.GetValue("LogLevel") is int &&
            string.Equals(map?.GetValue("MessageBus.dll") as string, DllPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    public static async Task<int> RunElevatedAsync(bool uninstall = false, bool replaceNvidia = false)
    {
        var start = new ProcessStartInfo(Environment.ProcessPath ?? throw new IOException(Text.Get("Startup.ExePathUnknown")))
        {
            UseShellExecute = true, Verb = "runas",
            Arguments = uninstall ? "--uninstall-shim" : "--install-shim" + (replaceNvidia ? " --replace-nvidia" : "")
        };
        using var child = Process.Start(start) ?? throw new IOException(Text.Get("Install.UacDidNotStart"));
        await child.WaitForExitAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        return child.ExitCode;
    }

    public static void Install(bool replaceNvidia)
    {
        RequireAdministrator();
        RefuseLinks(ShimDirectory); RefuseLinks(DataDirectory);
        RefuseForeignOwner(ShimDirectory); RefuseForeignOwner(DataDirectory);
        var status = Check();
        if (status.Conflict && !replaceNvidia)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Install.ConflictNeedsConsent"));
        if (File.Exists(DllPath)) CheckDll(DllPath); // Never overwrite an unknown DLL.
        ProtectDirectory(DataDirectory, writableByUsers: false);
        if (File.Exists(BackupFile)) RefuseFileLink(BackupFile);
        var beforeAttempt = CaptureRegistryState();
        bool hadBackup = File.Exists(BackupFile);
        bool createdDllThisAttempt = false;
        InstallationBackup backup;
        if (hadBackup)
        {
            backup = ReadBackup();
            if (!backup.Completed) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Install.Incomplete"));
        }
        else
        {
            backup = beforeAttempt;
            SaveBackup(backup);
        }
        try
        {
            ProtectDirectory(ShimDirectory, writableByUsers: false);
            // NVIDIA logging is disabled. Keep even the log directory protected: an elevated
            // vendor process must never be redirected through a user-writable log junction.
            ProtectDirectory(LogDirectory, writableByUsers: false);
            if (!File.Exists(DllPath))
            {
                var temp = Path.Combine(ShimDirectory, "MessageBus." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp");
                try
                {
                    using (var source = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream("HuntReplay.Payload.MessageBus.dll")
                        ?? throw new FileNotFoundException(Text.Get("Install.PayloadMissing")))
                    using (var destination = new FileStream(temp, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None)) source.CopyTo(destination);
                    CheckDll(temp);
                    File.Move(temp, DllPath);
                    createdDllThisAttempt = true;
                }
                finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
            }
            ProtectFile(DllPath);
            foreach (var view in Views)
            foreach (var entry in DesiredValues())
            {
                using var hklm = RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, view);
                using var key = hklm.CreateSubKey(entry.Key, true);
                key.SetValue(entry.Name, entry.Value, entry.Kind);
                key.Flush();
            }
            backup.Completed = true;
            SaveBackup(backup);
        }
        catch (Exception installError)
        {
            try
            {
                // A failed repair returns to the state BEFORE this attempt, not before the first
                // successful installation. Preserve its original backup for a later uninstall.
                RestoreValues(beforeAttempt, onlyIfOwned: true);
                if (createdDllThisAttempt && File.Exists(DllPath) && !DllReferenced())
                { CheckDll(DllPath); File.Delete(DllPath); }
                if (!hadBackup && File.Exists(BackupFile)) File.Delete(BackupFile);
            }
            catch (Exception rollbackError)
            {
                throw new IOException(Text.Format("Install.RollbackFailed", rollbackError.Message),
                    new AggregateException(installError, rollbackError));
            }
            throw;
        }
    }

    public static void Uninstall()
    {
        RequireAdministrator();
        RefuseLinks(DataDirectory); RefuseLinks(ShimDirectory);
        if (!File.Exists(BackupFile)) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Install.NoBackup"));
        var backup = ReadBackup();
        RestoreValues(backup, onlyIfOwned: true);
        if (backup.CreatedDll && File.Exists(DllPath))
        {
            // Keep the DLL if any registry view still references it (e.g. a later installer changed LogPath).
            var referenced = DllReferenced();
            if (!referenced) { CheckDll(DllPath); File.Delete(DllPath); }
        }
        File.Delete(BackupFile);
        if (Directory.Exists(ShimDirectory) && !Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(ShimDirectory).Any()) Directory.Delete(ShimDirectory);
        // Never delete NVIDIA parent keys, clip storage, logs, or arbitrary contents of C:\NvidiaShim.
    }

    private static bool DllReferenced() => Views.Any(view =>
    {
        using var hklm = RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, view);
        using var map = hklm.OpenSubKey(MapKey);
        using var bus = hklm.OpenSubKey(BusKey);
        return string.Equals(map?.GetValue("MessageBus.dll") as string, DllPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            string.Equals(bus?.GetValue("InstallPath") as string, ShimDirectory, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    });

    private static InstallationBackup CaptureRegistryState()
    {
        var backup = new InstallationBackup { CreatedDll = !File.Exists(DllPath) };
        foreach (var view in Views)
        foreach (var entry in DesiredValues())
        {
            using var hklm = RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, view);
            using var key = hklm.OpenSubKey(entry.Key);
            var present = key?.GetValueNames().Contains(entry.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true;
            var value = present ? key!.GetValue(entry.Name, null, RegistryValueOptions.DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames) : null;
            backup.Values.Add(new(view, entry.Key, entry.Name, key is not null, present,
                present ? key!.GetValueKind(entry.Name) : RegistryValueKind.String, JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(value)));
        }
        return backup;
    }

    private static void RestoreValues(InstallationBackup backup, bool onlyIfOwned)
    {
        foreach (var item in backup.Values)
        {
            using var hklm = RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, item.View);
            using var current = hklm.OpenSubKey(item.Key, true);
            var expected = DesiredValues().Single(v => v.Key == item.Key && v.Name == item.Name);
            if (onlyIfOwned && !Equals(current?.GetValue(item.Name), expected.Value)) continue;
            if (item.Existed)
            {
                using var key = hklm.CreateSubKey(item.Key, true);
                object value = item.Kind switch
                {
                    RegistryValueKind.DWord => item.Value.GetInt32(), RegistryValueKind.QWord => item.Value.GetInt64(),
                    RegistryValueKind.Binary or RegistryValueKind.None => item.Value.GetBytesFromBase64(),
                    RegistryValueKind.MultiString => item.Value.Deserialize<string[]>()!,
                    _ => item.Value.GetString()!
                };
                key.SetValue(item.Name, value, item.Kind);
            }
            else current?.DeleteValue(item.Name, false);
        }
        foreach (var item in backup.Values.Where(v => !v.KeyExisted).DistinctBy(v => (v.View, v.Key)))
        {
            using var hklm = RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, item.View);
            bool empty;
            using (var key = hklm.OpenSubKey(item.Key)) empty = key is not null && key.ValueCount == 0 && key.SubKeyCount == 0;
            if (empty) hklm.DeleteSubKey(item.Key, false);
        }
    }

    private static InstallationBackup ReadBackup()
    {
        RefuseFileLink(BackupFile);
        var owner = new FileInfo(BackupFile).GetAccessControl().GetOwner(typeof(SecurityIdentifier)) as SecurityIdentifier
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Install.BackupOwnerUnknown"));
        if (!owner.IsWellKnown(WellKnownSidType.BuiltinAdministratorsSid) && !owner.IsWellKnown(WellKnownSidType.LocalSystemSid))
            throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Install.BackupOwnerForeign"));
        if (new FileInfo(BackupFile).Length > 65536) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Install.BackupInvalid"));
        var backup = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<InstallationBackup>(File.ReadAllText(BackupFile)) ?? throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Install.BackupEmpty"));
        if (backup.Owner != "HuntReplayStudio/1" || backup.Hash != DllHash || backup.Values.Count != 8 ||
            backup.Values.Any(v => !Views.Contains(v.View) || !DesiredValues().Any(e => e.Key == v.Key && e.Name == v.Name)) ||
            backup.Values.DistinctBy(v => (v.View, v.Key, v.Name)).Count() != 8)
            throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Install.BackupNotOurs"));
        return backup;
    }

    private static void SaveBackup(InstallationBackup backup)
    {
        var temp = BackupFile + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
        try
        {
            using (var file = new FileStream(temp, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 4096, FileOptions.WriteThrough))
            { JsonSerializer.Serialize(file, backup); file.Flush(true); }
            ProtectFile(temp);
            File.Move(temp, BackupFile, true);
        }
        finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
    }

    public static void CheckDll(string path)
    {
        RefuseFileLink(path);
        using (var stream = File.OpenRead(path))
            if (!Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(stream)).Equals(DllHash, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Install.DllHashMismatch"));
        Authenticode.VerifyNvidia(path);
    }

    private static void ProtectDirectory(string path, bool writableByUsers)
    {
        RefuseLinks(path);
        var directory = Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
        var acl = new DirectorySecurity();
        acl.SetAccessRuleProtection(true, false);
        var admins = new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.BuiltinAdministratorsSid, null);
        acl.SetOwner(admins);
        foreach (var sid in new[] { admins, new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.LocalSystemSid, null) })
            acl.AddAccessRule(new FileSystemAccessRule(sid, FileSystemRights.FullControl,
                InheritanceFlags.ContainerInherit | InheritanceFlags.ObjectInherit, PropagationFlags.None, AccessControlType.Allow));
        acl.AddAccessRule(new FileSystemAccessRule(new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.BuiltinUsersSid, null),
            writableByUsers ? FileSystemRights.Modify : FileSystemRights.ReadAndExecute,
            InheritanceFlags.ContainerInherit | InheritanceFlags.ObjectInherit, PropagationFlags.None, AccessControlType.Allow));
        directory.SetAccessControl(acl);
    }
    private static void ProtectFile(string path)
    {
        RefuseFileLink(path);
        var acl = new FileSecurity();
        acl.SetAccessRuleProtection(true, false);
        var admins = new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.BuiltinAdministratorsSid, null);
        acl.SetOwner(admins);
        acl.AddAccessRule(new FileSystemAccessRule(admins, FileSystemRights.FullControl, AccessControlType.Allow));
        acl.AddAccessRule(new FileSystemAccessRule(new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.LocalSystemSid, null), FileSystemRights.FullControl, AccessControlType.Allow));
        acl.AddAccessRule(new FileSystemAccessRule(new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.BuiltinUsersSid, null), FileSystemRights.ReadAndExecute, AccessControlType.Allow));
        new FileInfo(path).SetAccessControl(acl);
    }

    private static void RefuseLinks(string path)
    {
        for (var directory = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetFullPath(path)); directory is not null; directory = directory.Parent)
            if (directory.Exists && (directory.Attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0)
                throw new IOException(Text.Format("Install.ReparsePoint", directory.FullName));
    }
    // A standard user can pre-create these folders and keep an open handle across the ACL reset.
    private static void RefuseForeignOwner(string path)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(path)) return;
        var owner = new DirectoryInfo(path).GetAccessControl().GetOwner(typeof(SecurityIdentifier)) as SecurityIdentifier;
        if (owner is null || !(owner.IsWellKnown(WellKnownSidType.BuiltinAdministratorsSid) || owner.IsWellKnown(WellKnownSidType.LocalSystemSid)))
            throw new IOException(Text.Format("Install.ForeignOwner", path));
    }
    private static void RefuseFileLink(string path)
    {
        RefuseLinks(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
        if ((File.GetAttributes(path) & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Install.FileIsLink"));
    }
    private static void RequireAdministrator()
    {
        using var identity = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
        if (!new WindowsPrincipal(identity).IsInRole(WindowsBuiltInRole.Administrator))
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(Text.Get("Install.NeedsElevation"));
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/StudioLog.cs`:

```cs
using System.Threading.Channels;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

internal sealed record LogEntry(DateTimeOffset Time, string Level, string Message)
{
    public string Timestamp => Time.ToString("HH:mm:ss");
    public string Line => $"[{Timestamp}] [{Level}] {Message}";
}

internal sealed class StudioLog : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly Channel<LogEntry> queue = Channel.CreateBounded<LogEntry>(new BoundedChannelOptions(512)
    { SingleReader = true, FullMode = BoundedChannelFullMode.DropOldest });
    private readonly Task writer;
    public string DirectoryPath { get; }
    public event Action<LogEntry>? Entry;

    public StudioLog(string root)
    {
        DirectoryPath = Path.Combine(root, "logs");
        Directory.CreateDirectory(DirectoryPath);
        writer = Task.Run(WriteLoopAsync);
    }
    public void Write(string message, string level = "INFO")
    {
        var clean = new string(message.Where(c => !char.IsControl(c) || c == '\t').Take(2048).ToArray());
        var entry = new LogEntry(DateTimeOffset.Now, level, clean);
        queue.Writer.TryWrite(entry);
        try { Entry?.Invoke(entry); } catch { /* Logging cannot break a native callback. */ }
    }
    private async Task WriteLoopAsync()
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(DirectoryPath, "studio.log");
        await foreach (var entry in queue.Reader.ReadAllAsync())
        {
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(path) && new FileInfo(path).Length > 2 * 1024 * 1024)
                {
                    for (int i = 3; i >= 1; --i)
                    {
                        var from = i == 1 ? path : path + "." + (i - 1);
                        if (File.Exists(from)) File.Move(from, path + "." + i, true);
                    }
                }
                await File.AppendAllTextAsync(path, entry.Line + Environment.NewLine).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (IOException) { }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
    }
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() { queue.Writer.TryComplete(); await writer.ConfigureAwait(false); }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/ThemeService.cs`:

```cs
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Windows;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

public enum AppTheme
{
    Dark,
    Light
}

public sealed class ThemeService : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    public static ThemeService Instance { get; } = new();

    private AppTheme currentTheme = AppTheme.Dark;

    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

    public AppTheme CurrentTheme
    {
        get => currentTheme;
        set
        {
            if (currentTheme == value) return;
            currentTheme = value;
            Apply(currentTheme);
            PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(null));
        }
    }

    public bool IsDark => currentTheme == AppTheme.Dark;

    public string ThemeCode => currentTheme == AppTheme.Dark ? "dark" : "light";

    public void ToggleTheme()
    {
        CurrentTheme = currentTheme == AppTheme.Dark ? AppTheme.Light : AppTheme.Dark;
    }

    public void SetTheme(string? code)
    {
        if (string.Equals(code, "light", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            CurrentTheme = AppTheme.Light;
        }
        else
        {
            CurrentTheme = AppTheme.Dark;
        }
    }

    public static void Apply(AppTheme theme)
    {
        var app = Application.Current;
        if (app == null) return;

        void DoApply()
        {
            // Only the palette changes; Controls.xaml stays merged and picks the new brushes up through DynamicResource.
            var palette = new ResourceDictionary { Source = new Uri(
                $"/HuntReplayStudio;component/Themes/Palette.{(theme == AppTheme.Light ? "Light" : "Dark")}.xaml", UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute) };
            var dicts = app.Resources.MergedDictionaries;
            var index = dicts.ToList().FindIndex(d => d.Source?.OriginalString.Contains("Palette.", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == true);
            if (index >= 0) dicts[index] = palette; else dicts.Insert(0, palette);
        }

        if (app.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
        {
            DoApply();
        }
        else
        {
            app.Dispatcher.Invoke(DoApply);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/UpdateCheckerService.cs`:

```cs
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using HuntReplay.Core.Updates;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

public sealed record UpdateCheckResult(
    bool HasUpdate,
    string CurrentVersion,
    ReleaseInfo? Release,
    string? ErrorMessage)
{
    public string? LatestVersion => Release is { Version.Length: > 0 } r ? r.Version : null;
}

public static class UpdateCheckerService
{
    private const string ApiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" + AppUpdate.Repository + "/releases/latest";
    private static readonly HttpClient HttpClient = CreateHttpClient();

    private static HttpClient CreateHttpClient()
    {
        var client = new HttpClient
        {
            Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8)
        };
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.Add(new ProductInfoHeaderValue("HuntReplayStudio", GetCurrentVersionString()));
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.Add(new MediaTypeWithQualityHeaderValue("application/vnd.github.v3+json"));
        return client;
    }

    public static string GetCurrentVersionString()
    {
        var version = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetName().Version;
        return version != null ? $"{version.Major}.{version.Minor}.{version.Build}" : "0.0.0"; // Assembly version comes from <Version> in the csproj.
    }

    public static async Task<UpdateCheckResult> CheckForUpdatesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var current = GetCurrentVersionString();
        UpdateCheckResult Fail(string error) => new(false, current, null, error);
        try
        {
            using var response = await HttpClient.GetAsync(ApiUrl, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode) return Fail($"HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode} {response.ReasonPhrase}");
            await using var body = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            using var doc = await JsonDocument.ParseAsync(body, cancellationToken: cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            var release = AppUpdate.ParseRelease(doc.RootElement);
            return new(AppUpdate.IsNewer(release.Version, current), current, release, null);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { return Fail(Text.Get("Update.Cancelled")); }
        catch (Exception ex) { return Fail(ex.Message); }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/UpdateInstallerService.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using HuntReplay.Core.Updates;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

/// <summary>An update step failed; the message is localized and ready to show.</summary>
internal sealed class UpdateInstallException(string message, Exception? inner = null) : Exception(message, inner);

/// <summary>Downloads a verified release executable, swaps it for the running one and starts it.</summary>
internal static class UpdateInstallerService
{
    public const string UpdatedFromArgument = "--updated-from";
    private static readonly TimeSpan StallTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
    // No overall timeout: the executable is ~160 MB. A stalled read is caught per read instead.
    private static readonly HttpClient Http = CreateHttpClient();

    private static HttpClient CreateHttpClient()
    {
        var client = new HttpClient { Timeout = Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan };
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.Add(new ProductInfoHeaderValue("HuntReplayStudio", UpdateCheckerService.GetCurrentVersionString()));
        return client;
    }

    private static string ExecutablePath =>
        Environment.ProcessPath ?? throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Format("Update.Error.Replace", "Environment.ProcessPath"));

    /// <summary>Downloads beside the running executable and checks GitHub's SHA-256. Returns the staged file.</summary>
    public static async Task<string> DownloadAsync(ReleaseInfo release, IProgress<double> progress, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (release.AssetUrl is null) throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Get("Update.Error.NoAsset"));
        if (release.Sha256 is null) throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Get("Update.Error.NoDigest"));
        var staged = AppUpdate.StagingPath(ExecutablePath);
        try
        {
            FileStream output;
            try { output = new FileStream(staged, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 1 << 16, useAsync: true); }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException ex) { throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Format("Update.Error.NotWritable", Path.GetDirectoryName(staged)), ex); }
            await using (output)
            {
                using var stall = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
                try
                {
                    stall.CancelAfter(StallTimeout);
                    using var response = await Http.GetAsync(release.AssetUrl, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, stall.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
                        throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Format("Update.Error.Download", $"HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode} {response.ReasonPhrase}"));
                    long? total = response.Content.Headers.ContentLength;
                    await using var input = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(stall.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                    var buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
                    long received = 0;
                    int read;
                    stall.CancelAfter(StallTimeout);
                    while ((read = await input.ReadAsync(buffer, stall.Token).ConfigureAwait(false)) > 0)
                    {
                        await output.WriteAsync(buffer.AsMemory(0, read), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                        received += read;
                        if (total > 0) progress.Report(Math.Min(1, received / (double)total.Value));
                        stall.CancelAfter(StallTimeout);
                    }
                    if (total > 0 && received != total)
                        throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Format("Update.Error.Download", $"{received} / {total} B"));
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException ex) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Get("Update.Error.Stalled"), ex);
                }
            }
            if (!await AppUpdate.MatchesSha256Async(staged, release.Sha256, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
                throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Get("Update.Error.Digest"));
            return staged;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            TryDelete(staged);
            if (ex is UpdateInstallException or OperationCanceledException) throw;
            throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Format("Update.Error.Download", ex.Message), ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Moves the staged executable into place; on failure the current one stays as it was.</summary>
    public static void Install(string staged)
    {
        try { AppUpdate.Replace(ExecutablePath, staged); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            TryDelete(staged);
            throw new UpdateInstallException(Text.Format("Update.Error.Replace", ex.Message), ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Starts the new executable; it waits for this process to exit before it takes the single-instance lock.</summary>
    public static void Restart(bool portable)
    {
        var start = new ProcessStartInfo(ExecutablePath) { UseShellExecute = false, WorkingDirectory = AppContext.BaseDirectory };
        start.ArgumentList.Add(UpdatedFromArgument);
        start.ArgumentList.Add(Environment.ProcessId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        if (portable) start.ArgumentList.Add("--portable");
        using var _ = Process.Start(start);
    }

    /// <summary>Called by the new executable at startup: waits for the old process, then removes its leftovers.</summary>
    public static async Task FinishAsync(string[] args)
    {
        int index = Array.IndexOf(args, UpdatedFromArgument);
        if (index >= 0 && index + 1 < args.Length && int.TryParse(args[index + 1], NumberStyles.None, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out int pid))
        {
            try
            {
                using var previous = Process.GetProcessById(pid);
                using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2)); // Saving pending clips can take a while.
                await previous.WaitForExitAsync(timeout.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException or InvalidOperationException or OperationCanceledException) { }
        }
        if (Environment.ProcessPath is { } executable) AppUpdate.CleanUp(executable);
    }

    private static void TryDelete(string path)
    {
        try { File.Delete(path); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Services/VideoTrimmingService.cs`:

```cs
using HuntReplay.App.Interop;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Trims a clip between two timestamps with the HuntReplay.Media.dll engine, without modifying the source.
/// accurate re-encodes the cut boundaries; otherwise packets are stream-copied. Progress reports values in [0, 1].
/// </summary>
public sealed class VideoTrimmingService
{
    public static VideoTrimmingService Instance { get; } = new();

    public async Task<string> TrimVideoAsync(
        string sourcePath,
        string targetPath,
        double startSeconds,
        double endSeconds,
        bool accurate = false,
        IProgress<double>? progress = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath))
            throw new ArgumentException(Text.Get("Trim.SourceEmpty"), nameof(sourcePath));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetPath))
            throw new ArgumentException(Text.Get("Trim.TargetEmpty"), nameof(targetPath));

        if (!double.IsFinite(startSeconds))
            throw new ArgumentException(Text.Get("Trim.StartInvalid"), nameof(startSeconds));
        if (!double.IsFinite(endSeconds))
            throw new ArgumentException(Text.Get("Trim.EndInvalid"), nameof(endSeconds));

        string fullSource = Path.GetFullPath(sourcePath);
        string fullTarget = Path.GetFullPath(targetPath);

        if (!File.Exists(fullSource))
            throw new FileNotFoundException(Text.Get("Trim.SourceMissing"), fullSource);

        if (string.Equals(fullSource, fullTarget, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Trim.TargetIsSource"));

        if (startSeconds < 0.0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(startSeconds), Text.Get("Trim.StartNegative"));

        if (endSeconds <= startSeconds)
            throw new ArgumentException(Text.Get("Trim.EndBeforeStart"), nameof(endSeconds));

        if (endSeconds - startSeconds < 0.5)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Get("Trim.TooShort"));

        string? targetDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(fullTarget);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetDir) && !Directory.Exists(targetDir))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(targetDir);
        }

        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

        return await Task.Run(() =>
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            RuntimeAssets.EnsureLoaded();

            NativeMethods.hr_trim_progress_callback progressCallback = (IntPtr _, double progressValue) =>
            {
                try
                {
                    progress?.Report(Math.Clamp(progressValue, 0.0, 1.0));
                }
                catch
                {
                }
                return cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested ? 1 : 0;
            };

            // The engine deletes its output on any failure, so it never writes to the chosen path directly:
            // a file the user agreed to overwrite is replaced only by a finished fragment.
            string temp = fullTarget + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8] + ".partial.mp4";
            int result;
            try
            {
                result = NativeMethods.hr_trim(
                    fullSource,
                    temp,
                    startSeconds,
                    endSeconds,
                    accurate ? 1 : 0,
                    progressCallback,
                    IntPtr.Zero);
            }
            finally
            {
                GC.KeepAlive(progressCallback);
            }

            try
            {
                if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    throw new OperationCanceledException(cancellationToken);

                if (result < 0)
                {
                    string? nativeError = NativeMethods.GetLastError();
                    string message = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nativeError)
                        ? nativeError
                        : Text.Get("Trim.EngineError");
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
                }

                if (!File.Exists(temp))
                {
                    throw new IOException(Text.Get("Trim.OutputMissing"));
                }

                File.Move(temp, fullTarget, overwrite: true);
            }
            finally
            {
                TryCleanupFile(temp);
            }

            progress?.Report(1.0);
            return fullTarget;
        }, cancellationToken);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generates a non-colliding default target path formatted as `<Source>_trimmed.mp4`.
    /// </summary>
    public static string GenerateDefaultTargetPath(string sourcePath)
    {
        string dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(sourcePath) ?? "";
        string nameWithoutExt = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(sourcePath);
        string ext = Path.GetExtension(sourcePath);
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ext)) ext = ".mp4";

        string candidate = Path.Combine(dir, $"{nameWithoutExt}_trimmed{ext}");
        if (!File.Exists(candidate)) return candidate;

        for (int i = 1; i < 1000; i++)
        {
            candidate = Path.Combine(dir, $"{nameWithoutExt}_trimmed_{i}{ext}");
            if (!File.Exists(candidate)) return candidate;
        }

        return Path.Combine(dir, $"{nameWithoutExt}_trimmed_{Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]}{ext}");
    }

    private static void TryCleanupFile(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
        }
        catch
        {
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Helper utilities for formatting timestamps and calculating fine-tuning steps in player trimming controls.
/// </summary>
public static class VideoTrimmingFormatters
{
    public static string FormatTime(double seconds)
    {
        if (double.IsNaN(seconds) || seconds < 0.0) seconds = 0.0;
        var ts = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds);
        if (ts.TotalHours >= 1.0)
        {
            return $"{(int)ts.TotalHours:D2}:{ts.Minutes:D2}:{ts.Seconds:D2}";
        }
        return $"{ts.Minutes:D2}:{ts.Seconds:D2}";
    }

    public static double StepTime(double current, double delta, double min, double max)
    {
        double stepped = Math.Round(current + delta, 3);
        return Math.Clamp(stepped, min, max);
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/ViewModels/Choice.cs`:

```cs
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;

namespace HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;

// The label is what a ComboBox shows in both the closed box and the popup, even when a template
// does not forward DisplayMemberPath / ContentTemplate; "Choice { Value = …, Label = … }" must never appear.
internal sealed class Choice<T> : ObservableObject
{
    private string label;
    private bool isAvailable = true;
    public T Value { get; }
    public string Label
    {
        get => label;
        set => SetProperty(ref label, value);
    }
    // An unavailable choice stays in the list (replacing ItemsSource would reset the ComboBox selection) but is hidden.
    public bool IsAvailable
    {
        get => isAvailable;
        set => SetProperty(ref isAvailable, value);
    }

    public Choice(T value, string label)
    {
        Value = value;
        this.label = label;
    }

    public override string ToString() => Label;
}

```

```cs
using HuntReplay.Core.Storage;

namespace HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;

internal sealed class ClipViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private bool isPreviewing;
    // Set by MainViewModel.PreviewClip so the card can mark the clip shown in the player.
    public bool IsPreviewing { get => isPreviewing; set => SetProperty(ref isPreviewing, value); }
    private LibraryClip clip;
    // Replaced in place when only the record changes (a star), so the list keeps its selection and scroll position.
    public LibraryClip Clip { get => clip; set { if (SetProperty(ref clip, value)) OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsFavorite)); } }
    public bool IsFavorite => Clip.Metadata.Favorite;
    // Picks the badge colour: kills green, downs red, multi-kills blue, manual saves neutral.
    public string EventKind => Clip.Metadata.EventTag switch
    {
        var t when t.StartsWith("MULTI_KILL", StringComparison.Ordinal) => "Multi",
        "HUNTER_KILLED" => "Kill",
        "PLAYER_DOWNED" => "Down",
        _ => "Other"
    };
    public string FileName => Clip.Metadata.FileName;
    public string EventLabel
    {
        get
        {
            var loc = LocalizationService.Instance;
            if (Clip.Metadata.EventTag.StartsWith("MULTI_KILL", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                var suffix = Clip.Metadata.EventTag.Split('_').FirstOrDefault(s => s.StartsWith('x'));
                return loc.Format("Event.MultiKill", suffix);
            }
            return Clip.Metadata.EventTag switch
            {
                "HUNTER_KILLED" => loc["Event.HunterKilled"],
                "PLAYER_DOWNED" => loc["Event.PlayerDowned"],
                "MANUAL" => loc["Event.Manual"],
                _ => Clip.Metadata.EventTag.Replace('_', ' ')
            };
        }
    }
    public string Duration => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Max(0, Clip.Metadata.DurationSeconds)).ToString(@"mm\:ss");
    public string Size => LocalizationService.Instance.Format("Unit.MegabytesValue", Clip.Metadata.Bytes / 1024d / 1024);
    public string Date => Clip.Metadata.CreatedAt.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd MMM · HH:mm", HuntReplay.Core.Localization.Text.Culture);
    public string Detail => $"{Date}   /   {Size}";
    public string When => Clip.Metadata.CreatedAt.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd MMM yyyy  •  HH:mm", HuntReplay.Core.Localization.Text.Culture);
    // Search text: what the player shows under the clip.
    public string Meta => $"{When}  •  {Duration}  •  {Size}";
    // Generated names carry the {time} stamp (HH-mm-ss-fff) and read better as their date; a renamed clip keeps its own name.
    private static readonly Regex GeneratedName = new(@"\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{3}", RegexOptions.Compiled);
    private bool HasGeneratedName => GeneratedName.IsMatch(FileName);
    public string Title => HasGeneratedName ? Date : Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(FileName);
    // Only a name the user gave the clip is worth a line on the list card; generated names repeat the date.
    public string? CustomName => HasGeneratedName ? null : Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(FileName);
    public ImageSource? Thumbnail { get; }
    // A thumbnail file is written once per clip Id, so one decoded by an earlier library refresh is reused as is.
    public ClipViewModel(LibraryClip clip, ImageSource? decoded = null)
    {
        this.clip = clip;
        Thumbnail = decoded;
        if (decoded is not null) return;
        try
        {
            if (!File.Exists(clip.ThumbnailPath)) return;
            var image = new BitmapImage();
            image.BeginInit(); image.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
            // Gallery tiles are 240-500 px wide; 640 px decodes kept ~0.9 MB per clip in memory.
            image.DecodePixelWidth = 400; image.UriSource = new Uri(clip.ThumbnailPath); image.EndInit(); image.Freeze();
            Thumbnail = image;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or NotSupportedException or System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException) { }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/ViewModels/DeviceSelectionViewModel.cs`:

```cs
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
using HuntReplay.App.Interop;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;

/// <summary>
/// An empty device ID means Windows default. A null SelectedValue is a transient
/// Selector reset during ItemsSource changes, NOT a request to erase the saved ID.
/// Keep even disconnected IDs selectable so refresh never silently picks another device.
/// The saved Windows ID stays in settings and in DeviceOption.Id, but it is never shown as text:
/// monitor paths and audio endpoint GUIDs are not user-facing captions.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class DeviceSelectionViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private readonly int kind;
    private readonly Func<string> defaultLabelProvider;
    private readonly Func<string>? unavailableCaptionProvider;
    private readonly Func<string> readId;
    private readonly Action<string> writeId;
    private IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> options = [];
    private IEnumerable<DeviceOption> cachedDevices = [];
    private bool refreshing;

    public DeviceSelectionViewModel(int kind, string defaultLabel, Func<string> readId, Action<string> writeId)
        : this(kind, () => defaultLabel, null, readId, writeId)
    {
    }

    public DeviceSelectionViewModel(int kind, Func<string> defaultLabelProvider, Func<string>? unavailableCaptionProvider, Func<string> readId, Action<string> writeId)
    {
        this.kind = kind;
        this.defaultLabelProvider = defaultLabelProvider;
        this.unavailableCaptionProvider = unavailableCaptionProvider;
        this.readId = readId;
        this.writeId = writeId;
        Refresh([]);
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<DeviceOption> Options { get => options; private set => SetProperty(ref options, value); }

    private string UnavailableCaption => unavailableCaptionProvider?.Invoke() ?? (kind switch
    {
        0 => Text.Get("Choice.MonitorUnavailable"),
        3 => Text.Get("Choice.GpuUnavailable"),
        _ => Text.Get("Choice.AudioUnavailable")
    });

    public string? SelectedId
    {
        get => refreshing ? null : Effective(readId());
        set
        {
            if (value is null || refreshing || value == readId()) return;
            writeId(value);
            OnPropertyChanged();
        }
    }

    // A GPU saved by an older build (DXGI index) or by name shows as the adapter it resolves to. The stored value
    // changes only when the user picks an option, so opening Settings never creates an unsaved change.
    private string Effective(string saved) =>
        kind == 3 && saved.Length > 0 && DeviceOption.ResolveGpu(saved, cachedDevices) is { } gpu ? gpu.Id : saved;

    public void Refresh(IEnumerable<DeviceOption>? devices = null)
    {
        if (devices is not null) cachedDevices = devices;
        string selected = Effective(readId());
        var replacement = new List<DeviceOption> { new(kind, "", defaultLabelProvider()) };
        replacement.AddRange(cachedDevices.Where(d => d.Kind == kind && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(d.Id)));
        if (selected.Length > 0 && replacement.All(d => d.Id != selected))
            replacement.Add(new(kind, selected, UnavailableCaption));
        refreshing = true;
        try
        {
            // Clear only the presentation before replacing items. WPF may read the
            // source back while its internal selection change is still active; if
            // that read returns the old ID, SelectedValue can look restored while
            // SelectedItem remains null. Restore after the replacement has finished.
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedId));
            Options = replacement;
        }
        finally
        {
            refreshing = false;
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedId));
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
    public string Page
    {
        get => page;
        set
        {
            if (page == value) return;
            if (page == "Settings" && HasUnsavedSettings)
            {
                // This setter runs inside the navigation button's click and binding update. The dialog is shown once
                // that input has been processed, so no click is swallowed and the binding is not re-entered.
                dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, new Action(() => _ = HandleUnsavedAndNavigateAsync(value)));
                return;
            }
            if (SetProperty(ref page, value)) OnPropertyChanged(nameof(PageTitle));
        }
    }

    public async Task<bool> ConfirmLeaveSettingsAsync()
    {
        if (!HasUnsavedSettings) return true;
        var result = MessageBox.Show(
            Application.Current.MainWindow,
            Loc["Settings.UnsavedChangesPrompt"],
            Loc["Settings.UnsavedChangesTitle"],
            MessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel,
            MessageBoxImage.Question);

        if (result == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
        {
            return await SaveSettingsDirectAsync();
        }
        if (result == MessageBoxResult.No)
        {
            RevertSettings();
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private async Task HandleUnsavedAndNavigateAsync(string targetPage)
    {
        Mouse.Capture(null);
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Page)); // Keep the Settings button selected while the question is open.
        if (await ConfirmLeaveSettingsAsync())
        {
            // Outside the Page setter the caller name would be this method's: name the property explicitly, or the
            // page content (bound to Page) never switches while the title (notified below) does.
            if (SetProperty(ref page, targetPage, nameof(Page))) OnPropertyChanged(nameof(PageTitle));
        }
        else
        {
            // Re-trigger notification to ensure radio button stays on Settings
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Page));
        }
    }

    };
```
