```cs
    private void RebuildChoices()
    {
        sources[0].Label = Loc["Choice.SourceHuntWindow"];
        sources[1].Label = Loc["Choice.SourceMonitor"];

        RefreshResolutionChoices();

        encoders[0].Label = Loc["Choice.EncoderAuto"];
        encoders[4].Label = Loc["Choice.EncoderX264"];

        codecs[0].Label = Loc["Choice.CodecH264"];
        codecs[1].Label = Loc["Choice.CodecHevc"];
        codecs[2].Label = Loc["Choice.CodecAv1"];

        audioModes[0].Label = Loc["Choice.AudioMixed"];
        audioModes[1].Label = Loc["Choice.AudioSeparate"];

        diskLimits[0].Label = Loc.Format("Choice.DiskLimitGb", 15);
        diskLimits[1].Label = Loc.Format("Choice.DiskLimitGb", 30);
        diskLimits[2].Label = Loc.Format("Choice.DiskLimitGb", 60);
        diskLimits[3].Label = Loc["Choice.DiskUnlimited"];

        overlayCorners[0].Label = Loc["Choice.CornerTopLeft"];
        overlayCorners[1].Label = Loc["Choice.CornerTopRight"];
        overlayCorners[2].Label = Loc["Choice.CornerBottomLeft"];
        overlayCorners[3].Label = Loc["Choice.CornerBottomRight"];
        foreach (var duration in overlayDurations) duration.Label = Loc.Format("Choice.Seconds", duration.Value);
    }

    public MainViewModel(SettingsStore store, RecorderService recorder, HighlightsPipeServer pipe, StudioLog log, bool portable, string libraryRoot)
    {
        dispatcher = Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher;
        this.store = store; this.recorder = recorder; this.pipe = pipe; this.log = log; this.portable = portable; this.libraryRoot = libraryRoot;
        overlay = new(log);
        Loc.SetLanguage(recorder.Settings.System.Language);
        settingsEdit = recorder.Settings.Clone();
        MonitorSelection = new(0,
            () => Loc["Choice.MonitorDefault"],
            () => Loc["Choice.MonitorUnavailable"],
            () => SettingsEdit.Video.MonitorDevice, value => SettingsEdit.Video.MonitorDevice = value);
        OutputSelection = new(1,
            () => Loc["Choice.OutputDefault"],
            () => Loc["Choice.AudioUnavailable"],
            () => SettingsEdit.Audio.OutputDeviceId, value => SettingsEdit.Audio.OutputDeviceId = value);
        MicrophoneSelection = new(2,
            () => Loc["Choice.MicDefault"],
            () => Loc["Choice.AudioUnavailable"],
            () => SettingsEdit.Audio.MicrophoneDeviceId, value => SettingsEdit.Audio.MicrophoneDeviceId = value);
        GpuSelection = new(3,
            () => Loc["Choice.GpuDefault"],
            () => Loc["Choice.GpuUnavailable"],
            () => SettingsEdit.Video.GpuDevice, value => SettingsEdit.Video.GpuDevice = value);
        FilteredClips = CollectionViewSource.GetDefaultView(Clips);
        FilteredClips.Filter = value => value is ClipViewModel c &&
            (!FavoritesOnly || c.IsFavorite) && (EventFilter == "All" || c.EventKind == EventFilter) &&
            (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Search) || c.FileName.Contains(Search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || c.EventLabel.Contains(Search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || c.Meta.Contains(Search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        ToggleBufferCommand = Async(ToggleAsync, () => !Busy);
        SaveCommand = Async(recorder.SaveManualAsync, () => IsBufferActive && !Busy);
        ApplySettingsCommand = Async(ApplyAsync, () => !Busy);
        BrowseCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Safe(Browse));
        OpenFolderCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Safe(() => DesktopIntegration.OpenFolder(recorder.Settings.Storage.Directory)));
        RefreshCommand = Async(RefreshClipsAsync);
        DeleteCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(clip => Safe(() => DeleteClips(clip is ClipViewModel one ? [one] : SelectedClips.Count > 0 ? SelectedClips : Target(null) is { } single ? [single] : [])),
            clip => clip is ClipViewModel || SelectedClips.Count > 0 || Target(null) is not null);
        RenameCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(clip => Safe(() => RenameClip(Target(clip)!)), clip => Target(clip) is not null);
        TrimCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(clip => TrimRequested?.Invoke(Target(clip)!), clip => Target(clip) is not null);
        RevealCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(clip => Safe(() => DesktopIntegration.RevealFile(Target(clip)!.Clip.FullPath)), clip => Target(clip) is not null);
        OpenInPlayerCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(clip => Safe(() => DesktopIntegration.OpenWithDefaultPlayer(Target(clip)!.Clip.FullPath)), clip => Target(clip) is not null);
        ToggleFavoriteCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(clip => Safe(() => ToggleFavorite((clip as ClipViewModel ?? PreviewClip)!)), clip => clip is ClipViewModel || PreviewClip is not null);
        DiagnoseCommand = Async(DiagnoseAsync, () => !Busy);
        SaveReportCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Safe(SaveReport));
        InstallCommand = Async(InstallAsync, () => !Busy);
        UninstallCommand = Async(UninstallAsync, () => !Busy);
        OpenLogsCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Safe(() => DesktopIntegration.OpenFolder(log.DirectoryPath)));
        SelectRecentCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(value => { if (value is ClipViewModel clip) { Page = "Gallery"; PreviewClip = clip; } });
        CheckUpdateCommand = Async(CheckUpdateManualAsync);
        InstallUpdateCommand = new RelayCommand(() => { if (updateDownload is { } download) download.Cancel(); else _ = InstallUpdateAsync(); });
        ToggleLanguageCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Safe(ToggleLanguage));
        SupportCommand = new RelayCommand<object?>(value => Safe(() => UseSupportChannel(value)));
        ThemeSvc.SetTheme(recorder.Settings.System.Theme);
        ToggleThemeCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Safe(ToggleTheme));
        // Uses the unsaved position and duration, so they can be tried before saving.
        PreviewOverlayCommand = new RelayCommand(() => Safe(() =>
            overlay.Notify(SettingsEdit.System, OverlayKind.Info, Loc["Overlay.PreviewTitle"], Loc["Overlay.PreviewDetail"], preview: true)));
        RebuildChoices();
        log.Entry += OnLog;
        recorder.Changed += OnChanged;
        pipe.StateChanged += OnChanged;
        recorder.ClipSaved += OnSaved;
    }

    public async Task InitializeAsync(Window window)
    {
        await operation.WaitAsync(); Busy = true;
        try
        {
            hotkey = new HotkeyService(window, () => SaveCommand.Execute(null));
            try { hotkey.Register(recorder.Settings.System.HotkeyVirtualKey); } catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); }
            try { DesktopIntegration.ConfigureStartup(recorder.Settings.System.StartWithWindows, portable); } catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); }
            await ReloadDevicesAsync();
            try { setupReady = (await Task.Run(SelfInstaller.Check)).Ready; } catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); }
            await RefreshClipsAsync();
            RefreshStatus();
            if (!stop.IsCancellationRequested) watcher = Task.Run(WatchGameAsync);
            _ = Task.Run(() => CheckUpdateSilentAsync(stop.Token));
        }
        finally { Busy = false; operation.Release(); }
    }

    private async Task ReloadDevicesAsync()
    {
        try { Devices = await Task.Run(NativeCaptureEngine.EnumerateDevices); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); Devices = []; }
        RefreshDeviceSelections();
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(GpuStatus)); OnPropertyChanged(nameof(GpuDriver)); OnPropertyChanged(nameof(GpuMemory));
    }

    private void RefreshDeviceSelections()
    {
        MonitorSelection.Refresh(Devices);
        OutputSelection.Refresh(Devices);
        MicrophoneSelection.Refresh(Devices);
        GpuSelection.Refresh(Devices);
        RefreshResolutionChoices();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Labels each preset with the size it records from the monitor the capture uses, and hides presets that would
    /// scale that monitor up. The saved preset always stays visible. Window capture is sized from the window itself;
    /// the primary monitor stands in for it here.
    /// </summary>
    public void RefreshResolutionChoices()
    {
        var video = SettingsEdit.Video;
        var monitor = (video.Source == CaptureSource.Monitor && video.MonitorDevice.Length > 0
                ? Devices.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Kind == 0 && d.Id == video.MonitorDevice)
                : null)
            ?? Devices.FirstOrDefault(d => d.Kind == 0 && d.IsDefault);
        int width = monitor?.Width ?? 0, height = monitor?.Height ?? 0;
        foreach (var choice in resolutions)
        {
            if (choice.Value == VideoResolution.Native)
            {
                choice.Label = height > 0 ? $"{Loc["Choice.ResolutionNative"]} · {width} × {height}" : Loc["Choice.ResolutionNative"];
                continue;
            }
            int presetHeight = choice.Value.Height();
            if (height > 0)
            {
                var (outputWidth, outputHeight) = choice.Value.OutputSize(width, height);
                choice.Label = $"{presetHeight}p · {outputWidth} × {outputHeight}";
            }
            else choice.Label = $"{presetHeight}p";
            choice.IsAvailable = height == 0 || presetHeight < height || choice.Value == video.Resolution;
        }
    }

    private async Task ToggleAsync()
    {
        await operation.WaitAsync(); Busy = true;
        try
        {
            if (recorder.Status.Running)
            {
                userPaused = true; manuallyStarted = false;
                await recorder.StopAsync();
            }
            else
            {
                userPaused = false; manuallyStarted = true; retryCount = 0;
                await recorder.StopAsync();
                await StartCurrentAsync();
            }
        }
        finally { Busy = false; operation.Release(); RefreshStatus(); }
    }
    private async Task StartCurrentAsync()
    {
        var pid = pipe.Games.FirstOrDefault().Pid;
        var window = GameWindow.Find((int)pid);
        var devices = await Task.Run(NativeCaptureEngine.EnumerateDevices);
        await recorder.StartAsync(window, devices);
    }

    private async Task WatchGameAsync()
    {
        using var tick = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1.5));
        try
        {
            while (await tick.WaitForNextTickAsync(stop.Token).ConfigureAwait(false))
            {
                // The pipe can be busy at startup (NVIDIA) or its listen loop can fail later; claim it once it is free.
                if (!pipe.IsListening) pipe.TryStart(logFailure: false);
                // Process snapshots enumerate every process on the machine; probe on the thread pool, not the UI thread.
                int probePid = (int)pipe.Games.FirstOrDefault().Pid;
                var processes = ProcessSnapshot.Take();
                var probedWindow = GameWindow.Find(processes, probePid);
                bool probedRunning = probedWindow != IntPtr.Zero || pipe.Games.Count > 0 || GameWindow.HasGameProcess(processes, probePid);
                nvidiaActive = !pipe.IsListening && processes.Has("nvcontainer");
                // All automation state and user operations are serialized on the UI dispatcher.
                await dispatcher.InvokeAsync(async () =>
                {
                    if (stop.IsCancellationRequested || Busy || !await operation.WaitAsync(0)) return;
                    try
                    {
                        var window = probedWindow;
                        bool gameRunning = probedRunning;

                        if (window != lastGameWindow) { userPaused = false; retryCount = 0; nextRetry = 0; }
                        var previous = lastGameWindow; lastGameWindow = window;
                        // One status and settings read per pass; StopAsync below is the only thing that changes them here.
                        var settings = recorder.Settings;
                        var current = recorder.Status;
                        bool running = current.Running;
                        if (!running && current.Native.ElapsedUs > 0)
                        {
                            await recorder.StopAsync();
                            if (gameRunning || settings.Video.Source == CaptureSource.Monitor) retryCount++;
                            nextRetry = Environment.TickCount64 + 5000;
                        }

                        // Game window capture stops when the window disappears (auto mode) or is replaced.
                        // Monitor capture keeps running for as long as the game process runs.
                        bool autoStop = settings.System.AutoBufferWithGame && !manuallyStarted;
                        bool stopForSource = running && (settings.Video.Source == CaptureSource.HuntWindow
                            ? previous != IntPtr.Zero && (window == IntPtr.Zero ? autoStop : previous != window)
                            : autoStop && !gameRunning);
                        if (stopForSource)
                        {
                            await recorder.StopAsync();
                            running = false;
                        }

                        bool sourceAvailable = settings.Video.Source == CaptureSource.Monitor || window != IntPtr.Zero;
                        bool wanted = manuallyStarted || (settings.System.AutoBufferWithGame && gameRunning);
                        if (wanted && sourceAvailable && !userPaused && !running && retryCount < 3 && Environment.TickCount64 >= nextRetry)
                        {
                            Busy = true;
                            try { await StartCurrentAsync(); running = recorder.Status.Running; }
                            catch (Exception ex) { retryCount++; nextRetry = Environment.TickCount64 + retryCount * 15000; Error(ex); }
                            finally { Busy = false; }
                        }
                        if (retryCount >= 3 && wanted && !running)
                            Message = Loc["Status.AutoRetryStopped"];
                        RefreshStatus();
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); }
                    finally { operation.Release(); }
                }).Task.Unwrap().ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stop.IsCancellationRequested) { }
    }

    public bool HasUnsavedSettings => !SettingsEdit.IsEquivalent(recorder.Settings);

    public void RevertSettings()
    {
        SettingsEdit = recorder.Settings.Clone();
    }

    public async Task<bool> SaveSettingsDirectAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await ApplyAsync();
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Error(ex);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private async Task ApplyAsync()
    {
        if (Application.Current.MainWindow is { } root && HasFormErrors(root, new HashSet<DependencyObject>()))
            throw new InvalidDataException(Loc["Settings.InvalidFields"]);
        var updated = SettingsEdit.Clone(); updated.Validate();
        await operation.WaitAsync(); Busy = true;
        var old = recorder.Settings.Clone();
        var wasRunning = recorder.Status.Running;
        bool committed = false;
        try
        {
            hotkey?.Register(updated.System.HotkeyVirtualKey);
            DesktopIntegration.ConfigureStartup(updated.System.StartWithWindows, portable);
            store.Save(updated);
            await recorder.ApplySettingsAsync(updated);
            committed = true;
            SettingsEdit = updated.Clone();
            await ReloadDevicesAsync();
            await RefreshClipsAsync();
            Message = Loc["Settings.Saved"];
            retryCount = 0; nextRetry = 0; userPaused = false;
            int pid = (int)pipe.Games.FirstOrDefault().Pid;
            var processes = ProcessSnapshot.Take();
            bool gameActive = GameWindow.Find(processes, pid) != IntPtr.Zero || pipe.Games.Count > 0 || GameWindow.HasGameProcess(processes, pid);
            bool shouldRun = wasRunning || (updated.System.AutoBufferWithGame && gameActive);
            if (shouldRun)
            {
                await StartCurrentAsync();
            }
            log.Write(Loc[shouldRun ? "Log.SettingsAppliedRestarted" : "Log.SettingsAppliedIdle"]);
        }
        catch
        {
            // If persistence failed, preserve the previous functional shortcut/startup entry.
            if (!committed)
            {
                hotkey?.Register(old.System.HotkeyVirtualKey);
                DesktopIntegration.ConfigureStartup(old.System.StartWithWindows, portable);
            }
            throw;
        }
        finally { Busy = false; operation.Release(); RefreshStatus(); }
    }

    private static bool HasFormErrors(DependencyObject node, HashSet<DependencyObject> visited)
    {
        if (!visited.Add(node)) return false;
        if (System.Windows.Controls.Validation.GetHasError(node)) return true;
        foreach (var child in LogicalTreeHelper.GetChildren(node).OfType<DependencyObject>())
            if (HasFormErrors(child, visited)) return true;
        if (node is System.Windows.Media.Visual || node is System.Windows.Media.Media3D.Visual3D)
            for (int i = 0; i < System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(node); ++i)
                if (HasFormErrors(System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(node, i), visited)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private ClipLibrary Library() => new(recorder.Settings.Storage.Directory, libraryRoot);

    public async Task RefreshClipsAsync()
    {
        var directory = recorder.Settings.Storage.Directory;
        var selectedId = SelectedClip?.Clip.Metadata.Id;
        var previewId = PreviewClip?.Clip.Metadata.Id;
        // Runs after every saved clip, during a match: decode only thumbnails that are new since the last refresh.
        var decoded = new Dictionary<string, System.Windows.Media.ImageSource>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var clip in Clips) if (clip.Thumbnail is { } image) decoded.TryAdd(clip.Clip.ThumbnailPath, image);
        var result = await Task.Run(() =>
        {
            var library = new ClipLibrary(directory, libraryRoot);
            try
            {
                // Moves 0.1.2 sidecars out of the clips folder and tidies records of deleted MP4 files.
                var report = library.Maintain();
                if (report.Adopted + report.Relocated + report.Pruned > 0)
                    log.Write(Loc.Format("Log.LibraryMaintained", report.Adopted, report.Relocated, report.Pruned));
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
            { log.Write(Loc.Format("Log.LibraryMaintenanceSkipped", ex.Message), "WARN"); }
            return library.List().Take(500).Select(c => new ClipViewModel(c, decoded.GetValueOrDefault(c.ThumbnailPath))).ToArray();
        });
        Clips.Clear(); foreach (var clip in result) Clips.Add(clip);
        SelectedClip = Clips.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Clip.Metadata.Id == selectedId);
        PreviewClip = Clips.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Clip.Metadata.Id == previewId);
        NotifyLibrary();
    }
    private void Browse()
    {
        var dialog = new OpenFolderDialog { Title = Loc["Dialog.ClipsFolder"], InitialDirectory = SettingsEdit.Storage.Directory };
        if (dialog.ShowDialog() == true) { SettingsEdit.Storage.Directory = dialog.FolderName; SettingsEdit = SettingsEdit.Clone(); }
    }
    private void DeleteClips(IReadOnlyList<ClipViewModel> clips)
    {
        if (clips.Count == 0 || MessageBox.Show(
            clips.Count == 1 ? Loc.Format("Dialog.DeleteClipQuestion", clips[0].FileName) : Loc.Format("Dialog.DeleteClipsQuestion", clips.Count),
            Loc["Dialog.DeleteClipTitle"], MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Warning) != MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;
        ClosePlayer?.Invoke();
        var failed = Library().DeleteEach(clips.Select(c => c.Clip)).ToDictionary(f => f.Clip.FullPath, f => f.Error, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var clip in clips) if (!failed.ContainsKey(clip.Clip.FullPath)) Clips.Remove(clip);
        SelectedClip = null;
        if (PreviewClip is { } shown && !Clips.Contains(shown)) PreviewClip = null;
        foreach (var error in failed.Values) Error(error);
        if (failed.Count > 1) Message = Loc.Format("Status.ClipsNotDeleted", failed.Count, clips.Count);
        NotifyLibrary();
    }
    private void ToggleFavorite(ClipViewModel clip)
    {
        try { clip.Clip = Library().SetFavorite(clip.Clip, !clip.IsFavorite); }
        catch (IOException) when (!File.Exists(clip.Clip.FullPath))
        {
            _ = RefreshClipsAsync(); // Deleted outside Studio: drop it from the list instead of starring a clip that is gone.
            throw;
        }
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(FavoriteCount)); OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowFavoritesFilter));
        RefreshFilter();
    }

    private void RenameClip(ClipViewModel clip)
    {
        var dialog = new InputDialog(Loc["Dialog.RenameClip"], clip.FileName) { Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow };
        if (dialog.ShowDialog() != true) return;
        ClosePlayer?.Invoke();
        var renamed = Library().Rename(clip.Clip, dialog.Value);
        var index = Clips.IndexOf(clip); var model = new ClipViewModel(renamed);
        Clips[index] = model; if (SelectedClip == clip) SelectedClip = model; if (PreviewClip == clip) PreviewClip = model; NotifyLibrary();
    }
    private async Task DiagnoseAsync()
    {
        await operation.WaitAsync(); Busy = true; Page = "Diagnostics";
        try { Diagnostics = Loc["Diag.Testing"];
            Diagnostics = await Task.Run(() => DiagnosticsService.Run(recorder.Settings.Clone(), recorder, pipe)); }
        finally { Busy = false; operation.Release(); }
    }
    private void SaveReport()
    {
        var dialog = new SaveFileDialog { FileName = "HuntReplay-diagnostics.txt", Filter = Loc["Dialog.TextReportFilter"] };
        if (dialog.ShowDialog() == true) File.WriteAllText(dialog.FileName, Diagnostics);
    }
    private async Task InstallAsync()
    {
        await operation.WaitAsync(); Busy = true;
        try
        {
            var status = await Task.Run(SelfInstaller.Check);
            var wizard = new SetupWizard(status) { Owner = Application.Current.MainWindow };
            wizard.ShowDialog();
            setupReady = (await Task.Run(SelfInstaller.Check)).Ready; OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SetupLabel));
        }
        finally { Busy = false; operation.Release(); }
    }
    private async Task UninstallAsync()
    {
        await operation.WaitAsync(); Busy = true;
        try
        {
            if (MessageBox.Show(
                Loc["Dialog.RestoreNvidiaQuestion"],
                Loc["Dialog.RestoreNvidiaTitle"], MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Warning) != MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;
            var code = await SelfInstaller.RunElevatedAsync(uninstall: true);
            if (code != 0) throw new IOException(Loc["Error.RestoreFailed"]);
            setupReady = false; OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SetupLabel));
        }
        finally { Busy = false; operation.Release(); }
    }
    private void OnLog(LogEntry entry) => OnUi(() =>
    {
        Events.Insert(0, entry);
        while (Events.Count > 250) Events.RemoveAt(Events.Count - 1);
        if (entry.Level == "ERROR")
        {
            Message = entry.Message;
            overlay.Notify(recorder.Settings.System, OverlayKind.Problem, Loc["Overlay.Problem"], entry.Message);
        }
    });
    private void OnChanged() => OnUi(RefreshStatus);
    private void OnSaved(LibraryClip clip) => OnUi(async () =>
    {
        overlay.Notify(recorder.Settings.System, OverlayKind.Info, Loc["Overlay.ClipSaved"], clip.Metadata.FileName);
        try { await RefreshClipsAsync(); DesktopIntegration.NotifySaved(recorder.Settings); Message = Loc.Format("Status.ClipSaved", clip.Metadata.FileName); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); }
    });
    private void OnUi(Action action)
    {
        if (!dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted && !stop.IsCancellationRequested) dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action);
    }
    private static readonly string[] StatusProperties =
    [
        nameof(IsBufferActive), nameof(IsGameConnected), nameof(GameStatus), nameof(BufferStatus), nameof(BufferTime),
        nameof(BufferTarget), nameof(BufferFill), nameof(MemoryText), nameof(GpuStatus), nameof(VideoStatus), nameof(EncodingModeLabel), nameof(CaptureDetail), nameof(PendingText),
        nameof(ToggleLabel), nameof(ManualLabel), nameof(HotkeyLabel), nameof(SetupLabel), nameof(PipeLabel)
    ];
    private void RefreshStatus()
    {
        bool wasActive = IsBufferActive, wasRunning = status.Running;
        status = recorder.Status;
        foreach (var property in StatusProperties) OnPropertyChanged(property);
        if (status.Running != wasRunning)
            overlay.Notify(recorder.Settings.System, OverlayKind.Info,
                Loc[status.Running ? "Overlay.BufferStarted" : "Overlay.BufferStopped"],
                status.Running ? Loc.Format("Overlay.BufferStartedDetail", HotkeyLabel) : "");
        // Only SaveCommand depends on live capture state.
        if (IsBufferActive != wasActive) SaveCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
    }
    private void UseSupportChannel(object? value)
    {
        if (value is not SupportChannel channel) return;
        if (channel.IsLink) { DesktopIntegration.OpenUrl(channel.Value); return; }
        Clipboard.SetText(channel.Value);
        Message = Loc.Format("Support.Copied", channel.Name);
    }
    public void Error(Exception ex) { Message = ex.Message; log.Write(ex.Message, "ERROR"); }
    // A preview failure is not an export failure: the saved MP4 stays as written, so this is a warning, not an error.
    public void PlaybackFailed(int hresult, string fileName)
    {
        Message = Loc.Format("Status.PlaybackFailed", fileName, PlaybackDiagnostics.Code(hresult));
        log.Write(PlaybackDiagnostics.LogLine(hresult, fileName), "WARN");
    }
    private async Task CheckUpdateSilentAsync(CancellationToken token)
    {
        try
        {
            await Task.Delay(2500, token); // Let the app start up and render before network I/O
            var res = await UpdateCheckerService.CheckForUpdatesAsync(token);
            if (token.IsCancellationRequested) return;
            OnUi(() => ApplyUpdateCheck(res));
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            log.Write("Background update check: " + ex.Message, "DEBUG");
        }
    }

    public async Task CheckUpdateManualAsync()
    {
        isCheckingUpdate = true;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsCheckingUpdate));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateStatusLabel));
        Message = Loc["Update.CheckingGitHub"];
        try
        {
            var res = await Task.Run(() => UpdateCheckerService.CheckForUpdatesAsync(stop.Token));
            if (updateDownload is not null) return; // A check must not swap the release an install is using.
            ApplyUpdateCheck(res);

            if (res.HasUpdate)
            {
                Message = Loc.Format("Update.NewVersion", res.LatestVersion);
            }
            else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(res.ErrorMessage))
            {
                Message = Loc.Format("Update.Failed", res.ErrorMessage);
            }
            else
            {
                Message = Loc.Format("Update.Latest", res.CurrentVersion);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            isCheckingUpdate = false;
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsCheckingUpdate));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateStatusLabel));
        }
    }

    private void ApplyUpdateCheck(UpdateCheckResult res)
    {
        if (updateDownload is not null) return;
        hasUpdate = res.HasUpdate;
        latestVersion = res.LatestVersion;
        release = res.Release;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasUpdate));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(LatestVersion));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateButtonLabel));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateStatusLabel));
    }

    public void ReportUpdated() => Message = Loc.Format("Update.Installed", AppVersion);

    private async Task InstallUpdateAsync()
    {
        if (release is not { } target) return;
        var owner = Application.Current.MainWindow;
        var prompt = Loc.Format("Update.ConfirmPrompt", target.Version, AppVersion);
        if (status.Running) prompt += "\n\n" + Loc["Update.ConfirmRecording"];
        if (AppUpdate.PlainNotes(target.Notes) is { } notes) prompt += "\n\n" + (notes.Length > 1200 ? notes[..1200].TrimEnd() + "…" : notes.Trim());
        if (MessageBox.Show(owner, prompt, Loc["Update.ConfirmTitle"], MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Question) != MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;
        while (true)
        {
            try
            {
                await DownloadAndInstallAsync(target);
                return;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                Message = Loc["Update.DownloadCancelled"];
                return;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Every failure is explained, with the choice to try again or to download the release by hand.
                log.Write("Update failed: " + ex, "ERROR");
                Message = Loc.Format("Update.InstallFailed", ex.Message);
                if (stop.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                var dialog = new UpdateFailedDialog(ex.Message) { Owner = owner };
                dialog.ShowDialog();
                if (dialog.Choice == UpdateFailedChoice.Retry) continue;
                if (dialog.Choice == UpdateFailedChoice.OpenReleases) Safe(() => OpenReleasePage(target.PageUrl));
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task DownloadAndInstallAsync(ReleaseInfo target)
    {
        using var download = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(stop.Token);
        updateDownload = download;
        SetUpdateProgress(0);
        Message = Loc.Format("Update.Downloading", target.Version);
        try
        {
            // Created on the UI thread, so reports arrive there.
            var progress = new Progress<double>(SetUpdateProgress);
            var staged = await Task.Run(() => UpdateInstallerService.DownloadAsync(target, progress, download.Token));
            download.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            Message = Loc["Update.Installing"];
            UpdateInstallerService.Install(staged);
        }
        finally
        {
            updateDownload = null;
            SetUpdateProgress(0);
        }
        try { UpdateInstallerService.Restart(portable); }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // The new version is already in place; it runs from the next start.
            Error(new InvalidOperationException(Loc.Format("Update.RestartFailed", ex.Message), ex));
            return;
        }
        log.Write(Loc.Format("Update.Restarting", target.Version));
        await ((App)Application.Current).ExitAsync();
    }

    private void SetUpdateProgress(double value)
    {
        updateProgress = value;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateButtonLabel));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateButtonTooltip));
    }

    private static void OpenReleasePage(string? pageUrl)
    {
        // The URL comes from a network response; ReleaseInfo keeps it only when it is this repository's page.
        var url = AppUpdate.IsTrustedPageUrl(pageUrl) ? pageUrl! : AppUpdate.ReleasesPage;
        Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(url) { UseShellExecute = true });
    }

    private void ToggleLanguage()
    {
        Loc.ToggleLanguage();
        var language = Text.Language;
        store.Save(recorder.UpdatePreferences(s => s.Language = language));
        // Keep the edit copy in step, or the toggle reads as an unsaved change and a later Save reverts it.
        SettingsEdit.System.Language = language;
        RebuildChoices();
        // Monitor captions are built in the current language at enumeration time.
        _ = ReloadDevicesAsync();
        customMessage = null;
        customDiagnostics = null;
        // Language affects almost every computed label; an empty name refreshes all bindings on this view model.
        OnPropertyChanged(string.Empty);
        FilteredClips.Refresh();
    }

    private void ToggleTheme()
    {
        ThemeSvc.ToggleTheme();
        store.Save(recorder.UpdatePreferences(s => s.Theme = ThemeSvc.ThemeCode));
        SettingsEdit.System.Theme = ThemeSvc.ThemeCode;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ThemeButtonLabel));
    }

    private void Safe(Action action) { try { action(); } catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); } }
    // AsyncRelayCommand blocks re-entry while it runs; failures surface through Error like every other command.
    private AsyncRelayCommand Async(Func<Task> execute, Func<bool>? canExecute = null) =>
        new(async () => { try { await execute(); } catch (Exception ex) { Error(ex); } }, canExecute ?? (() => true));
    // Properties can change before the constructor has created every command.
    private static void NotifyCommands(params IRelayCommand?[] commands)
    {
        foreach (var command in commands) command?.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
    }
    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        stop.Cancel();
        if (watcher is not null) await watcher;
        await operation.WaitAsync(); // Wait for a user-initiated start/settings/probe/UAC workflow too.
        Busy = true;
        hotkey?.Dispose();
        overlay.Dispose();
        recorder.Changed -= OnChanged; recorder.ClipSaved -= OnSaved; pipe.StateChanged -= OnChanged; log.Entry -= OnLog;
        stop.Dispose(); operation.Dispose();
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Views/Converters.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;

public sealed class PageVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => Equals(value, parameter) ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => Binding.DoNothing;
}
public sealed class PageSelectedConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => Equals(value, parameter);
    public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => value is true ? parameter : Binding.DoNothing;
}
public sealed class BoolVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
{
    public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) =>
        (value is true) != Equals(parameter, "Invert") ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
    public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => Binding.DoNothing;
}
public sealed class StatusBrushConverter : IValueConverter
{
    private static readonly Brush On = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(203, 222, 144));
    private static readonly Brush Off = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(93, 107, 112));
    public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => value is true ? On : Off;
    public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture) => Binding.DoNothing;
}
```

```cs
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;
namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;
public partial class DashboardView : UserControl
{
    private const double RecentCardWidth = 330;

    public DashboardView()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        // One more recent clip per ~330 px instead of ever-wider thumbnails: 3 at the minimum window, up to 6.
        SizeChanged += (_, e) => { if (DataContext is MainViewModel model) model.RecentCount = Math.Clamp((int)(e.NewSize.Width / RecentCardWidth), 3, 6); };
    }
    private void OpenGallery(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { if (DataContext is MainViewModel model) model.Page = "Gallery"; }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Views/GalleryView.xaml.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using HuntReplay.App.Controls;
using HuntReplay.App.Interop;
using HuntReplay.App.Services;
using HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;
using HuntReplay.Core.Media;
using HuntReplay.Core.Storage;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;

public partial class GalleryView : UserControl
{
    // Frames are picked up once per WPF render pass, in step with the display, not on a 20 ms timer that beats against 60 FPS.
    private readonly RenderTicker timer = new();
    // Written on the UI thread, read by the background thumbnail preload.
    private readonly System.Collections.Concurrent.ConcurrentDictionary<int, BitmapSource> previewCache = new();
    private readonly object playerLock = new();
    private CancellationTokenSource? preloadCts;
    private CancellationTokenSource? previewCts;
    private IntPtr playerHandle = IntPtr.Zero;
    private WriteableBitmap? bitmap;
    private bool playing, dragging, updating;
    private double naturalDuration;
    private string? currentPath;    private int videoWidth, videoHeight;
    private double currentVolume = 1.0;
    private double lastNonZeroVolume = 1.0;

    // Trimming Mode State
    private bool isTrimMode;
    private bool isPreviewingFragment;
    private bool isExporting;
    private double trimStart;
    private double trimEnd;
    private const double MinTrimDuration = 0.5;
    private const double MinPlayerWidth = 560; // The trim toolbar wraps its end controls below this.
    private const double SplitterWidth = 16;
    private const double LibraryPanelWidth = 420; // A list card with its badge, metadata, star and menu on one line each.
    private const double SideBySideMinWidth = MinPlayerWidth + SplitterWidth + LibraryPanelWidth;
    private const double MinTileWidth = 180;
    private bool? sideBySide;
    // Side by side the split follows the window (see FitSideColumns) until the splitter is dragged; a dragged split is kept across stacked spells.
    private bool userSplit;
    private GridLength playerShare = new(1, GridUnitType.Star), libraryShare = new(LibraryPanelWidth);
    private bool gridView;
    private bool openedLatest; // The newest clip is put in the player on the first visit only.
    private Window? fullscreen;
    private CancellationTokenSource? exportCts;

    // Async Seek Infrastructure for Smooth Scrubbing
    private readonly object asyncSeekLock = new();
    private double? pendingLiveSeekTime;
    private bool isAsyncSeeking;
    private bool isLiveSeeking;

    public GalleryView()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        timer.Tick += OnTimerTick;
        ClipList.SizeChanged += OnClipListSizeChanged;
        SizeChanged += (_, e) =>
        {
            ApplyLayout(e.NewSize.Width >= SideBySideMinWidth);
            // Neither the splitter nor a narrower window may squeeze the player below what the trim toolbar needs.
            LibraryColumn.MaxWidth = Math.Max(LibraryPanelWidth, e.NewSize.Width - MinPlayerWidth - SplitterWidth);
            SelectionHints.Visibility = e.NewSize.Width >= 1120 ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        };
        BodyGrid.SizeChanged += (_, _) => FitPlayerScreen();
        PlayerCard.SizeChanged += (_, _) => FitPlayerScreen();
        Unloaded += (_, _) => { Close(); fullscreen?.Close(); };
        LocalizationService.Instance.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => UpdateLocalizedLabels();
        UpdateLocalizedLabels();
    }

    private void OnTimerTick(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || bitmap is null) return;
        NativeMethods.hr_player_get_state(playerHandle, out int isPlaying, out int isEnded, out double currentPts);
        if (isEnded == 1)
        {
            ShowPaused();
            timer.Stop();
        }
        if (isPlaying == 1)
        {
            CopyLatestFrame(playerHandle);

            if (isTrimMode)
            {
                if (isPreviewingFragment && currentPts >= trimEnd)
                {
                    ShowPaused();
                    NativeMethods.hr_player_pause(playerHandle);
                    timer.Stop();
                    isPreviewingFragment = false;

                    NativeMethods.hr_player_seek(playerHandle, trimEnd);
                    RefreshCurrentFrame();
                    TrimSlider.Playhead = trimEnd;
                    PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(trimEnd)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
                }
                else
                {
                    // While a fragment preview starts, the player may still report the position it is seeking away from;
                    // the indicator never leaves the selected fragment.
                    double shown = isPreviewingFragment ? Math.Clamp(currentPts, trimStart, trimEnd) : currentPts;
                    TrimSlider.Playhead = shown;
                    PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(shown)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
                }
            }
            else if (!dragging)
            {
                updating = true;
                Seek.Value = currentPts;
                PositionText.Text = $"{TimeSpan.FromSeconds(currentPts):mm\\:ss} / {TimeSpan.FromSeconds(naturalDuration):mm\\:ss}";
                updating = false;
            }
        }
    }

    private void ContextChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.OldValue is MainViewModel old) { old.ClosePlayer -= Close; old.TrimRequested -= TrimClip; old.PropertyChanged -= ModelPropertyChanged; }
        if (e.NewValue is MainViewModel model) { model.ClosePlayer += Close; model.TrimRequested += TrimClip; model.PropertyChanged += ModelPropertyChanged; }
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        timer.Stop();
        playing = false;
        currentPath = null;
        previewCache.Clear();

        preloadCts?.Cancel();
        preloadCts?.Dispose();
        preloadCts = null;

        previewCts?.Cancel();
        previewCts?.Dispose();
        previewCts = null;

        PreviewCard.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

        lock (asyncSeekLock)
        {
            pendingLiveSeekTime = null;
        }

        if (isTrimMode)
        {
            if (exportCts is not null)
            {
                exportCts.Cancel();
                exportCts.Dispose();
                exportCts = null;
            }
            isTrimMode = false;
            isPreviewingFragment = false;
            isExporting = false;
            TrimToolbar.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TrimProgressPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            TrimSlider.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            Seek.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }

        TrimButton.IsEnabled = false;

        IntPtr handleToClose = Interlocked.Exchange(ref playerHandle, IntPtr.Zero);
        if (handleToClose != IntPtr.Zero)
        {
            // Preview/seek workers hold playerLock for a whole decode; the UI thread must not wait for them.
            // Pause is lock-free in the native player and silences audio before the deferred close.
            NativeMethods.hr_player_pause(handleToClose);
            Task.Run(() => { lock (playerLock) NativeMethods.hr_player_close(handleToClose); });
        }

        bitmap = null;
        PlayerImage.Source = null;
        Seek.IsEnabled = false;
        PlayButton.IsEnabled = false;
        BackButton.IsEnabled = ForwardButton.IsEnabled = FullscreenButton.IsEnabled = false;
        PlayerMoreButton.IsEnabled = false;
        PlayButton.Content = "▶";
        updating = true;
        Seek.Value = 0;
        Seek.Maximum = 1;
        updating = false;
        PositionText.Text = "00:00 / 00:00";
        PlayerHint.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        PlayerHintText.Text = LocalizationService.Instance["Gallery.SelectClipHint"];
    }

    private void OnClipItemClicked(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not ListBoxItem item || item.DataContext is not ClipViewModel clip) return;
        // WPF's Shift-click replaces the selection with anchor..clip; here it fills every gap between the
        // outermost selected clips and the clicked one, so 1 and 4 selected plus Shift-click on 6 gives 1-6.
        if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Shift && ClipList.SelectedItems.Count > 0)
        {
            var indices = ClipList.SelectedItems.Cast<object>().Select(ClipList.Items.IndexOf).Append(ClipList.Items.IndexOf(clip)).ToArray();
            for (var i = indices.Min(); i <= indices.Max(); i++)
                if (!ClipList.SelectedItems.Contains(ClipList.Items[i])) ClipList.SelectedItems.Add(ClipList.Items[i]);
            item.Focus();
            e.Handled = true;
            return;
        }
        // Ctrl/Shift clicks build a selection for bulk actions; SelectionChanged decides what the player shows.
        if ((Keyboard.Modifiers & (ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift)) != 0) return;
        // The card checkbox does the same as a Ctrl-click; the star and menu buttons handle their own clicks.
        for (var d = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject; d is Visual && d != item; d = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(d))
            if (d is ButtonBase) return;
        if (DataContext is not MainViewModel model) return;
        model.PreviewClip = clip;
        ShowPreview(); // Also reopens a clip whose player was closed, when PreviewClip did not change.
        // A click only opens the clip; the selection for bulk actions changes through the box, Ctrl and Shift.
        item.Focus();
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    // A right-click on a clip outside the selection leaves the selection alone; the menu then acts on that clip.
    private void OnClipItemRightClicked(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is ListBoxItem { IsSelected: false } item) { item.Focus(); e.Handled = true; }
    }

    private void ClipListContextMenuOpening(object sender, ContextMenuEventArgs e)
    {
        var item = (e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject) is { } source ? ItemsControl.ContainerFromElement(ClipList, source) as ListBoxItem : null;
        item ??= Keyboard.FocusedElement as ListBoxItem; // Shift+F10 and the menu key.
        ClipMenu.Tag = item is { IsSelected: false, DataContext: ClipViewModel clip } ? clip : null;
    }

    private void ModelPropertyChanged(object? sender, System.ComponentModel.PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.PropertyName == nameof(MainViewModel.PreviewClip)) ShowPreview();
        else if (e.PropertyName == nameof(MainViewModel.HasClips)) OpenLatestOnce(); // Clips can arrive after the page is shown.
    }

    // Opens MainViewModel.PreviewClip in the player unless it is already there.
    private void ShowPreview()
    {
        var clip = (DataContext as MainViewModel)?.PreviewClip;
        if (clip is not null && playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero && currentPath == clip.Clip.FullPath) return;
        Close();
        if (!IsVisible || clip is null) return;
        currentPath = clip.Clip.FullPath;
        LoadVideo(currentPath);
    }

    // The first visit opens the newest clip (paused) instead of an empty player.
    private void OpenLatestOnce()
    {
        if (openedLatest || !IsVisible || DataContext is not MainViewModel model || !model.HasClips) return;
        openedLatest = true;
        model.PreviewClip ??= ClipList.Items.OfType<ClipViewModel>().FirstOrDefault() ?? model.Clips[0];
    }

    private void ClearSelectionClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => ClipList.UnselectAll();

    private void CardMoreClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Button button || button.DataContext is not ClipViewModel clip) return;
        // Like a right-click: on a clip in the selection the menu acts on all of it, on any other clip on that clip alone.
        var menu = ClipMenu;
        menu.Tag = ClipList.SelectedItems.Contains(clip) ? null : clip;
        menu.DataContext = DataContext; // Opened from the card, it would otherwise inherit the clip as its DataContext.
        // Placement stays at the mouse point, the default a later right-click relies on.
        menu.PlacementTarget = button;
        menu.IsOpen = true;
    }

    private void TrimClip(ClipViewModel clip)
    {
        if (DataContext is MainViewModel model) model.PreviewClip = clip;
        ShowPreview();
        EnterTrimMode();
        PlayerImage.BringIntoView();
    }

    // Esc clears the selection; Enter previews the focused card, or plays and pauses it once it is in the player.
    // Delete, F2 and Shift+F10 come from the list's bindings and menu.
    private void ClipListKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == Key.Escape && ClipList.SelectedItems.Count > 0) { ClipList.UnselectAll(); e.Handled = true; return; }
        if (DataContext is not MainViewModel model) return;
        // Plain arrows open the next clip without touching the selection; Shift+arrows still extend it.
        if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.None && e.Key is Key.Up or Key.Down or Key.Left or Key.Right)
        {
            var columns = gridView ? Math.Max(1, FindVisualChild<UniformGrid>(ClipList)?.Columns ?? 1) : 1;
            var step = e.Key switch { Key.Up => -columns, Key.Down => columns, Key.Left => gridView ? -1 : 0, _ => gridView ? 1 : 0 };
            var from = (Keyboard.FocusedElement as ListBoxItem)?.DataContext ?? model.PreviewClip;
            var index = from is null ? 0 : ClipList.Items.IndexOf(from) + step;
            if (step != 0 && index >= 0 && index < ClipList.Items.Count && ClipList.Items[index] is ClipViewModel next)
            {
                ClipList.ScrollIntoView(next);
                model.PreviewClip = next;
                (ClipList.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromItem(next) as ListBoxItem)?.Focus();
            }
            e.Handled = step != 0;
            return;
        }
        if (e.Key != Key.Enter) return;
        if ((Keyboard.FocusedElement as ListBoxItem)?.DataContext is ClipViewModel focused && focused != model.PreviewClip)
        {
            model.PreviewClip = focused;
            ShowPreview();
        }
        else PlayPause(ClipList, e);
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    private void SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (DataContext is not MainViewModel model) return;
        // The selection is for bulk actions only; the player keeps whatever it shows.
        model.SelectedClips = ClipList.SelectedItems.Cast<ClipViewModel>().ToArray();
    }

    private void LoadVideo(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            int w = 0, h = 0;
            double dur = 0;
            IntPtr opened = IntPtr.Zero;
            int res = NativeMethods.hr_player_open(path, out opened, out w, out h, out dur);
            if (res < 0 || opened == IntPtr.Zero)
            {
                PlayerHint.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                PlayerHintText.Text = LocalizationService.Instance["Gallery.OpenFailed"];
                return;
            }

            lock (playerLock)
            {
                playerHandle = opened;
            }

            videoWidth = w;
            videoHeight = h;
            naturalDuration = dur;
            bitmap = new WriteableBitmap(videoWidth, videoHeight, 96, 96, PixelFormats.Bgra32, null);
            PlayerImage.Source = bitmap;

            CopyLatestFrame(opened);

            PlayerHint.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PlayButton.IsEnabled = true;
            BackButton.IsEnabled = ForwardButton.IsEnabled = FullscreenButton.IsEnabled = true;
            PlayerMoreButton.IsEnabled = true;
            FitPlayerScreen();
            Seek.IsEnabled = naturalDuration > 0;
            if (naturalDuration > 0) Seek.Maximum = naturalDuration;
            PositionText.Text = $"00:00 / {TimeSpan.FromSeconds(naturalDuration):mm\\:ss}";
            NativeMethods.hr_player_set_volume(opened, (float)currentVolume);

            bool canTrim = naturalDuration >= MinTrimDuration;
            TrimButton.IsEnabled = canTrim;

            PreloadThumbnails(opened, naturalDuration);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            PlayerHint.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            PlayerHintText.Text = Loc.Format("Gallery.PlayerError", ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private void PreloadThumbnails(IntPtr handle, double duration)
    {
        preloadCts?.Cancel();
        preloadCts?.Dispose();
        var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        preloadCts = cts;
        var token = cts.Token;

        Task.Run(() =>
        {
            double step = duration > 40 ? 3.0 : 2.0;
            for (double s = 0; s <= duration; s += step)
            {
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested) break;
                int secKey = (int)Math.Round(s);
                if (previewCache.ContainsKey(secKey)) continue;
                if (playerHandle != handle) break; // Another clip took over; RenderPreview re-checks under the lock.
                if (RenderPreview(handle, s, token) is not { } bmp) continue;
                Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
                {
                    if (!token.IsCancellationRequested && playerHandle == handle) previewCache[secKey] = bmp;
                });
            }
        }, token);
    }

    private void PlayPause(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        if (isTrimMode)
        {
            PreviewRangeClick(sender, e);
            return;
        }
        playing = !playing;
        PlayButton.Content = playing ? "Ⅱ" : "▶";
        if (playing)
        {
            NativeMethods.hr_player_play(playerHandle);
            timer.Start();
        }
        else
        {
            NativeMethods.hr_player_pause(playerHandle);
            timer.Stop();
        }
    }

    private void ScreenClicked(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
        {
            PlayPause(this, new RoutedEventArgs());
        }
    }

    private void SeekMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!Seek.IsEnabled || naturalDuration <= 0) return;
        dragging = true;
        Seek.CaptureMouse();
        ApplySeekFromMouse(e);
    }

    private void SeekMouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (dragging && Seek.IsEnabled && naturalDuration > 0 && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
        {
            ApplySeekFromMouse(e);
        }
    }

    private void SeekMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
    {
        if (dragging)
        {
            dragging = false;
            Seek.ReleaseMouseCapture();
            ApplySeekFromMouse(e);
            if (!Seek.IsMouseOver) PreviewCard.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }
    }

    private void SeekHover(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration <= 0 || !Seek.IsEnabled)
        {
            PreviewCard.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            return;
        }

        var pos = e.GetPosition(Seek);
        double ratio = Math.Clamp(pos.X / Math.Max(1, Seek.ActualWidth), 0.0, 1.0);
        double targetSec = ratio * naturalDuration;
        int secondKey = (int)Math.Round(targetSec);

        Point mouseInCanvas = e.GetPosition(PreviewCanvas);
        double cardWidth = PreviewCard.ActualWidth > 0 ? PreviewCard.ActualWidth : 176;
        double canvasWidth = PreviewCanvas.ActualWidth > 0 ? PreviewCanvas.ActualWidth : ActualWidth;
        double cardX = Math.Clamp(mouseInCanvas.X - (cardWidth / 2), 4, Math.Max(4, canvasWidth - cardWidth - 4));
        Canvas.SetLeft(PreviewCard, cardX);
        PreviewTime.Text = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(targetSec).ToString(@"mm\:ss");
        PreviewCard.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

        if (previewCache.TryGetValue(secondKey, out var cachedBmp))
        {
            PreviewThumb.Source = cachedBmp;
            return;
        }

        int closestKey = -1;
        int minDiff = int.MaxValue;
        foreach (var key in previewCache.Keys)
        {
            int diff = Math.Abs(key - secondKey);
            if (diff < minDiff && diff <= 2)
            {
                minDiff = diff;
                closestKey = key;
            }
        }
        if (closestKey >= 0)
        {
            PreviewThumb.Source = previewCache[closestKey];
        }
        else
        {
            PreviewThumb.Source = null;
        }

        previewCts?.Cancel();
        previewCts?.Dispose();
        var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        previewCts = cts;
        var token = cts.Token;
        var handle = playerHandle;

        Task.Run(() =>
        {
            if (RenderPreview(handle, targetSec, token) is not { } bmp) return;
            Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(() =>
            {
                if (token.IsCancellationRequested || handle != playerHandle) return;
                previewCache[secondKey] = bmp;
                if (PreviewCard.Visibility != Visibility.Visible) return;
                var curPos = Mouse.GetPosition(Seek);
                double curRatio = Math.Clamp(curPos.X / Math.Max(1, Seek.ActualWidth), 0.0, 1.0);
                if (Math.Abs((int)Math.Round(curRatio * naturalDuration) - secondKey) <= 1) PreviewThumb.Source = bmp;
            });
        }, token);
    }

    private void SeekLeave(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!dragging)
        {
            PreviewCard.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            previewCts?.Cancel();
            previewCts?.Dispose();
            previewCts = null;
        }
    }

    private void ApplySeekFromMouse(MouseEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration <= 0) return;
        var pos = e.GetPosition(Seek);
        double ratio = Math.Clamp(pos.X / Math.Max(1, Seek.ActualWidth), 0.0, 1.0);
        double target = ratio * naturalDuration;
        updating = true;
        Seek.Value = target;
        PositionText.Text = $"{TimeSpan.FromSeconds(target):mm\\:ss} / {TimeSpan.FromSeconds(naturalDuration):mm\\:ss}";
        updating = false;
        ScheduleAsyncSeek(target);
    }

    private void SeekChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
    {
        if (!updating && !dragging && Seek.IsEnabled && playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
        {
            ScheduleAsyncSeek(Seek.Value);
        }
    }

    private void RefreshCurrentFrame()
    {
        if (bitmap is null || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        CopyLatestFrame(playerHandle);

        if (!isTrimMode)
        {
            PositionText.Text = $"{TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Seek.Value):mm\\:ss} / {TimeSpan.FromSeconds(naturalDuration):mm\\:ss}";
        }
        else
        {
            PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(TrimSlider.Playhead)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
        }
    }

    private void ScheduleAsyncSeek(double timestamp)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration <= 0) return;

        lock (asyncSeekLock)
        {
            pendingLiveSeekTime = timestamp;
            if (isAsyncSeeking) return;
            isAsyncSeeking = true;
        }

        Task.Run(() =>
        {
            while (true)
            {
                double target;
                lock (asyncSeekLock)
                {
                    if (!pendingLiveSeekTime.HasValue)
                    {
                        isAsyncSeeking = false;
                        break;
                    }
                    target = pendingLiveSeekTime.Value;
                    pendingLiveSeekTime = null;
                }

                lock (playerLock)
                {
                    if (playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
                    {
                        NativeMethods.hr_player_seek(playerHandle, target);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                }

                Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(RefreshCurrentFrame), DispatcherPriority.Render);
            }
        });
    }

    private void VisibilityChanged(object sender, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.NewValue is false)
        {
            fullscreen?.Close();
            Close();
        }
        else if (e.NewValue is true)
        {
            OpenLatestOnce();
            if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) ShowPreview();
        }
    }

    private void VolumeButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (VolumeSlider.Value > 0.001)
        {
            lastNonZeroVolume = VolumeSlider.Value;
            VolumeSlider.Value = 0;
        }
        else
        {
            VolumeSlider.Value = lastNonZeroVolume > 0.001 ? lastNonZeroVolume : 1.0;
        }
    }

    private void VolumeChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
    {
        currentVolume = Math.Clamp(VolumeSlider.Value, 0.0, 1.0);
        if (playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero)
        {
            NativeMethods.hr_player_set_volume(playerHandle, (float)currentVolume);
        }

        int percent = (int)Math.Round(currentVolume * 100);
        if (VolumeSlider is not null)
        {
            VolumeSlider.ToolTip = Loc.Format("Gallery.VolumeTooltip", percent);
        }

        if (VolumeIcon is not null && VolumeButton is not null)
        {
            if (currentVolume <= 0.001)
            {
                VolumeIcon.Text = "\uE74F";
                VolumeButton.ToolTip = Loc["Gallery.Unmute"];
            }
            else if (currentVolume < 0.5)
            {
                VolumeIcon.Text = "\uE993";
                VolumeButton.ToolTip = Loc.Format("Gallery.MuteTooltip", percent);
            }
            else
            {
                VolumeIcon.Text = "\uE767";
                VolumeButton.ToolTip = Loc.Format("Gallery.MuteTooltip", percent);
            }
        }
    }

    private void VolumeMouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
    {
        double step = e.Delta > 0 ? 0.05 : -0.05;
        VolumeSlider.Value = Math.Clamp(VolumeSlider.Value + step, 0.0, 1.0);
        e.Handled = true;
    }

    // The clip ListBox's own ScrollViewer swallows the wheel even with scrolling disabled; hand it to the page.
    // Side by side, the list scrolls itself.
    private void ClipListMouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sideBySide == true) return;
        e.Handled = true;
        PageScroll.RaiseEvent(new MouseWheelEventArgs(e.MouseDevice, e.Timestamp, e.Delta) { RoutedEvent = MouseWheelEvent, Source = sender });
    }

    // Wide enough for the player beside a library column: the clips scroll on their own so the player stays in view.
    // Narrower, the page stacks the player above the clips and scrolls as a whole.
    private void ApplyLayout(bool side)
    {
        if (sideBySide == side) return;
        if (!side && sideBySide == true) (playerShare, libraryShare) = (PlayerColumn.Width, LibraryColumn.Width);
        sideBySide = side;
        LibraryColumn.MinWidth = side ? LibraryPanelWidth : 0;
        PlayerColumn.MinWidth = side ? MinPlayerWidth : 0;
        PlayerColumn.Width = side ? playerShare : new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star);
        LibraryColumn.Width = side ? libraryShare : new GridLength(0);
        SplitterColumn.Width = new GridLength(side ? SplitterWidth : 0);
        LibrarySplitter.Visibility = side ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        BodyTopRow.Height = side ? new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) : GridLength.Auto;
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(PlayerCard, side ? 1 : 3);
        Grid.SetRow(LibraryPanel, side ? 0 : 1);
        Grid.SetColumn(LibraryPanel, side ? 2 : 0);
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(LibraryPanel, side ? 1 : 3);
        PlayerCard.Margin = side ? new Thickness(0) : new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 20);
        // Side by side the card runs the full column height and the screen takes what the bars leave; stacked it is sized by width.
        PlayerCard.VerticalAlignment = side ? VerticalAlignment.Stretch : VerticalAlignment.Top;
        PlayerScreenRow.Height = side ? new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) : GridLength.Auto;
        if (side) PlayerScreen.Height = double.NaN;
        // The narrower player has no room for both trim boundaries on one line, so the end controls drop below the start ones, still on the right like the end handle.
        Grid.SetRow(TrimEndControls, side ? 1 : 0);
        Grid.SetColumn(TrimEndControls, side ? 0 : 2);
        Grid.SetColumnSpan(TrimEndControls, side ? 3 : 1);
        TrimEndControls.HorizontalAlignment = side ? HorizontalAlignment.Right : HorizontalAlignment.Stretch;
        TrimEndControls.Margin = side ? new Thickness(0, 8, 0, 0) : new Thickness(0);
        PageScroll.VerticalScrollBarVisibility = side ? ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled : ScrollBarVisibility.Auto;
        BodyGrid.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, side ? 0 : 8, 0); // The gutter only makes room for the page scrollbar.
        ScrollViewer.SetVerticalScrollBarVisibility(ClipList, side ? ScrollBarVisibility.Auto : ScrollBarVisibility.Disabled);
        // Stacked, the list has no viewport of its own; a virtualizing panel would then measure to nothing.
        ScrollViewer.SetCanContentScroll(ClipList, side);
        FitPlayerScreen();
    }

    private double VideoAspect => videoWidth > 0 && videoHeight > 0 ? (double)videoHeight / videoWidth : 9.0 / 16;

    // Stacked, the screen takes the video's shape at the page width. Side by side, FitSideColumns sizes it.
    private void FitPlayerScreen()
    {
        if (sideBySide == true) { FitSideColumns(); return; }
        if (sideBySide is null || PlayerScreen.ActualWidth <= 0) return;
        double height = Math.Max(160, Math.Floor(Math.Min(PlayerScreen.ActualWidth * VideoAspect, 540)));
        if (double.IsNaN(PlayerScreen.Height) || Math.Abs(PlayerScreen.Height - height) >= 1) PlayerScreen.Height = height;
    }

    // Gives the player the width at which the video fills the column height, so no empty band is left under it.
    // The clip list keeps the rest, never less than its minimum or more than 45 % of the row; past those limits the video letterboxes.
    private void FitSideColumns()
    {
        if (userSplit || BodyGrid.ActualWidth <= 0 || PlayerScreen.ActualHeight <= 0) return;
        double total = BodyGrid.ActualWidth - SplitterWidth;
        double screenHeight = BodyGrid.ActualHeight - (PlayerCard.ActualHeight - PlayerScreen.ActualHeight);
        double player = Math.Max(screenHeight / VideoAspect, total * 0.55);
        double library = Math.Floor(Math.Max(LibraryPanelWidth, total - Math.Max(player, MinPlayerWidth)));
        if (LibraryColumn.Width.IsAbsolute && Math.Abs(LibraryColumn.Width.Value - library) < 1 && PlayerColumn.Width.IsStar) return;
        PlayerColumn.Width = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star);
        LibraryColumn.Width = new GridLength(library);
    }

    private void SplitterDragCompleted(object sender, DragCompletedEventArgs e) => userSplit = true;

    private void ViewModeChecked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (ClipList is null) return; // Raised while the view is still being built.
        gridView = GridViewToggle.IsChecked == true;
        ClipList.ItemTemplate = (DataTemplate)Resources[gridView ? "GridTile" : "ListCard"];
        ClipList.ItemsPanel = (ItemsPanelTemplate)Resources[gridView ? "GridPanel" : "ListPanel"];
        // Tiles sit apart on the grid; list cards stack with a hairline gap.
        ClipList.ItemContainerStyle = new Style(typeof(ListBoxItem), ClipList.ItemContainerStyle.BasedOn ?? ClipList.ItemContainerStyle);
        if (gridView) ClipList.ItemContainerStyle.Setters.Add(new Setter(PaddingProperty, new Thickness(0)));
        if (gridView) ClipList.ItemContainerStyle.Setters.Add(new Setter(MarginProperty, new Thickness(3)));
        Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(UpdateTileColumns, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
    }

    private void PlayerMoreClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (sender is not Button button) return;
        PlayerMenu.DataContext = DataContext; // The button sits in the clip's details, so it would otherwise get the clip.
        PlayerMenu.PlacementTarget = button;
        PlayerMenu.Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom;
        PlayerMenu.IsOpen = true;
    }

    private void PlaySelectedClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (DataContext is not MainViewModel model || model.SelectedClips.Count == 0) return;
        model.PreviewClip = model.SelectedClips[0];
        ShowPreview();
        if (!playing && playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero) PlayPause(this, e);
    }


    private void BackClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => SkipBy(-10);
    private void ForwardClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => SkipBy(10);

    private void SkipBy(double seconds)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration <= 0 || isTrimMode) return;
        double target = Math.Clamp(Seek.Value + seconds, 0, naturalDuration);
        Seek.Value = target; // SeekChanged schedules the seek.
        PositionText.Text = $"{TimeSpan.FromSeconds(target):mm\\:ss} / {TimeSpan.FromSeconds(naturalDuration):mm\\:ss}";
    }

    private void FullscreenClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => ToggleFullscreen();

    // A borderless window over the whole monitor showing the same live frame; Esc, F or a double-click leave it.
    private void ToggleFullscreen()
    {
        if (fullscreen is not null) { fullscreen.Close(); return; }
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        var image = new Image { Stretch = Stretch.Uniform };
        RenderOptions.SetBitmapScalingMode(image, BitmapScalingMode.Linear);
        image.SetBinding(Image.SourceProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(nameof(Image.Source)) { Source = PlayerImage });
        var owner = Window.GetWindow(this);
        var window = new Window
        {
            Owner = owner, Title = owner?.Title ?? "", Content = image, Background = Brushes.Black, Cursor = Cursors.Hand,
            WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None, ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize, ShowInTaskbar = false,
            WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner, Width = 640, Height = 360
        };
        window.Loaded += (_, _) => window.WindowState = WindowState.Maximized; // Maximized after placement, so on the owner's monitor.
        window.MouseLeftButtonUp += (_, _) => PlayPause(this, new RoutedEventArgs());
        window.MouseDoubleClick += (_, _) => window.Close();
        window.KeyDown += (_, e) =>
        {
            switch (e.Key)
            {
                case Key.Escape or Key.F: window.Close(); break;
                case Key.Space: PlayPause(this, new RoutedEventArgs()); break;
                case Key.Left: SkipBy(-10); break;
                case Key.Right: SkipBy(10); break;
            }
        };
        window.Closed += (_, _) => { fullscreen = null; owner?.Activate(); };
        fullscreen = window;
        window.Show();
    }

    private void OnClipListSizeChanged(object sender, SizeChangedEventArgs e) => UpdateTileColumns();

    private void UpdateTileColumns()
    {
        double availableWidth = ClipList.ActualWidth - 12; // Less the list scrollbar.
        if (availableWidth <= 0 || !gridView) return;
        const double gap = 8.0;
        int cols = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor((availableWidth + gap) / (MinTileWidth + gap)));

        var uniformGrid = FindVisualChild<UniformGrid>(ClipList);
        if (uniformGrid is not null && uniformGrid.Columns != cols)
        {
            uniformGrid.Columns = cols;
        }
    }

    private static T? FindVisualChild<T>(DependencyObject parent) where T : DependencyObject
    {
        int count = VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(parent);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            var child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(parent, i);
            if (child is T typed) return typed;
            var nested = FindVisualChild<T>(child);
            if (nested is not null) return nested;
        }
        return null;
    }

    #region Video Trimming Feature

    private void TrimButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration < MinTrimDuration) return;
        EnterTrimMode();
    }

    public void EnterTrimMode()
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration < MinTrimDuration) return;
        if (isTrimMode) return;

        if (playing)
        {
            playing = false;
            PlayButton.Content = "▶";
            NativeMethods.hr_player_pause(playerHandle);
            timer.Stop();
        }

        isTrimMode = true;
        isPreviewingFragment = false;

        PreviewCard.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        previewCts?.Cancel();
        previewCts?.Dispose();
        previewCts = null;

        trimStart = 0.0;
        trimEnd = naturalDuration;

        TrimSlider.Minimum = 0.0;
        TrimSlider.Maximum = naturalDuration;
        TrimSlider.MinRange = MinTrimDuration;
        TrimSlider.RangeStart = trimStart;
        TrimSlider.RangeEnd = trimEnd;
        TrimSlider.Playhead = Seek.Value;

        Seek.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        TrimSlider.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        TrimToolbar.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        TrimProgressPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

        TrimButton.IsEnabled = false;
 
        UpdateTrimTimeDisplays();
        Focus();
    }

    private void CancelTrimClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        ExitTrimMode();
    }

    public void ExitTrimMode()
    {
        if (!isTrimMode) return;

        if (playing)
        {
            ShowPaused();
            NativeMethods.hr_player_pause(playerHandle);
            timer.Stop();
        }

        if (exportCts is not null)
        {
            exportCts.Cancel();
            exportCts.Dispose();
            exportCts = null;
        }

        isTrimMode = false;
        isPreviewingFragment = false;
        isExporting = false;

        TrimToolbar.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        TrimProgressPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        TrimSlider.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        Seek.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

        bool canTrim = playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero && naturalDuration >= MinTrimDuration;
        TrimButton.IsEnabled = canTrim;

        if (playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero && naturalDuration > 0)
        {
            NativeMethods.hr_player_get_state(playerHandle, out _, out _, out double currentPts);
            updating = true;
            Seek.Value = Math.Clamp(currentPts, 0.0, naturalDuration);
            PositionText.Text = $"{TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Seek.Value):mm\\:ss} / {TimeSpan.FromSeconds(naturalDuration):mm\\:ss}";
            updating = false;
        }
    }

    private void OnTrimSliderLiveSeek(object sender, RangeSeekEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration <= 0) return;
        isLiveSeeking = true;
        try
        {
            TrimSlider.Playhead = e.Timestamp;
            PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(e.Timestamp)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
            UpdateTrimTimeDisplays();
            ScheduleAsyncSeek(e.Timestamp);
        }
        finally
        {
            isLiveSeeking = false;
        }
    }

    private void OnTrimDragStarted(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playing)
        {
            PauseTrimPlayback();
        }
    }

    private void OnTrimDragCompleted(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || naturalDuration <= 0) return;
        ScheduleAsyncSeek(TrimSlider.Playhead);
    }

    private void OnTrimSelectionStartChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        trimStart = e.NewValue;
        UpdateTrimTimeDisplays();
    }

    private void OnTrimSelectionEndChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        trimEnd = e.NewValue;
        UpdateTrimTimeDisplays();
    }

    private void OnTrimPlayheadChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<double> e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || playing || isLiveSeeking || TrimSlider.IsDragging) return;
        ScheduleAsyncSeek(e.NewValue);
        PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(e.NewValue)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
    }

    private void UpdateTrimTimeDisplays()
    {
        if (TrimStartText is not null)
            TrimStartText.Text = VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(trimStart);
        if (TrimEndText is not null)
            TrimEndText.Text = VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(trimEnd);
        if (TrimDurationText is not null)
            TrimDurationText.Text = VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(Math.Max(0.0, trimEnd - trimStart));
    }

    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        SetTrimStart(VideoTrimmingFormatters.StepTime(trimStart, -0.1, 0.0, trimEnd - MinTrimDuration));
    }

    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        SetTrimStart(VideoTrimmingFormatters.StepTime(trimStart, +0.1, 0.0, trimEnd - MinTrimDuration));
```
