```cs
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        SetTrimEnd(VideoTrimmingFormatters.StepTime(trimEnd, -0.1, trimStart + MinTrimDuration, naturalDuration));
    }

    private void StepEndPlusClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        SetTrimEnd(VideoTrimmingFormatters.StepTime(trimEnd, +0.1, trimStart + MinTrimDuration, naturalDuration));
    }

    private void SetTrimStart(double newStart)
    {
        trimStart = Math.Clamp(newStart, 0.0, trimEnd - MinTrimDuration);
        TrimSlider.RangeStart = trimStart;
        TrimSlider.Playhead = trimStart;
        UpdateTrimTimeDisplays();
        PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(trimStart)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
        ScheduleAsyncSeek(trimStart);
    }

    private void SetTrimEnd(double newEnd)
    {
        trimEnd = Math.Clamp(newEnd, trimStart + MinTrimDuration, naturalDuration);
        TrimSlider.RangeEnd = trimEnd;
        TrimSlider.Playhead = trimEnd;
        UpdateTrimTimeDisplays();
        PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(trimEnd)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
        ScheduleAsyncSeek(trimEnd);
    }

    private void JumpStartClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        if (playing) PauseTrimPlayback();
        TrimSlider.Playhead = trimStart;
        PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(trimStart)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
        ScheduleAsyncSeek(trimStart);
    }

    private void JumpEndClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        if (playing) PauseTrimPlayback();
        TrimSlider.Playhead = trimEnd;
        PositionText.Text = $"{VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(trimEnd)} / {VideoTrimmingFormatters.FormatTime(naturalDuration)}";
        ScheduleAsyncSeek(trimEnd);
    }

    private void MarkInClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        NativeMethods.hr_player_get_state(playerHandle, out _, out _, out double currentPts);
        SetTrimStart(currentPts);
    }

    private void MarkOutClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        NativeMethods.hr_player_get_state(playerHandle, out _, out _, out double currentPts);
        SetTrimEnd(currentPts);
    }

    private void PauseTrimPlayback()
    {
        ShowPaused();
        NativeMethods.hr_player_pause(playerHandle);
        timer.Stop();
        isPreviewingFragment = false;
    }

    private void PreviewRangeClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!isTrimMode || playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero) return;

        if (playing)
        {
            PauseTrimPlayback();
        }
        else
        {
            NativeMethods.hr_player_get_state(playerHandle, out _, out _, out double currentPts);
            if (currentPts < trimStart || currentPts >= trimEnd - 0.1)
            {
                NativeMethods.hr_player_seek(playerHandle, trimStart);
                RefreshCurrentFrame();
                TrimSlider.Playhead = trimStart;
            }

            isPreviewingFragment = true;
            playing = true;
            PlayButton.Content = "Ⅱ";
            if (PreviewRangeIcon is not null) PreviewRangeIcon.Text = "\uE769";
            if (PreviewRangeText is not null) PreviewRangeText.Text = Loc["Gallery.Pause"];
            NativeMethods.hr_player_play(playerHandle);
            timer.Start();
        }
    }

    private async void SaveFragmentClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentPath) || !File.Exists(currentPath)) return;
        if (isExporting) return;

        double start = TrimSlider.RangeStart;
        double end = TrimSlider.RangeEnd;

        if (double.IsNaN(start) || double.IsNaN(end) || start < 0.0 || end > naturalDuration)
        {
            UpdateStatusMessage(Loc["Gallery.InvalidBoundaries"]);
            return;
        }

        if (end <= start || end - start < MinTrimDuration)
        {
            UpdateStatusMessage(Loc.Format("Gallery.FragmentTooShort", MinTrimDuration));
            return;
        }

        if (playing) PauseTrimPlayback();

        string defaultCandidate = VideoTrimmingService.GenerateDefaultTargetPath(currentPath);
        string initialDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(defaultCandidate) ?? "";
        string defaultName = Path.GetFileName(defaultCandidate);

        var dialog = new Microsoft.Win32.SaveFileDialog
        {
            Title = Loc["Gallery.SaveDialogTitle"],
            InitialDirectory = initialDir,
            FileName = defaultName,
            Filter = Loc["Gallery.Mp4Filter"],
            DefaultExt = ".mp4",
            AddExtension = true,
            OverwritePrompt = true
        };

        var window = Window.GetWindow(this);
        if (dialog.ShowDialog(window) != true) return;

        string targetPath = dialog.FileName;

        if (string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(targetPath), Path.GetFullPath(currentPath), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            string errorMsg = Loc["Gallery.CannotOverwriteSource"];
            MessageBox.Show(window, errorMsg,
                Loc["Gallery.ExportErrorTitle"],
                MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
            return;
        }

        isExporting = true;
        exportCts?.Dispose();
        // Close() cancels and forgets this export; once another export owns exportCts, this one must not touch the UI.
        var cts = exportCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        var token = cts.Token;

        SetTrimControlsEnabled(false);
        TrimProgressPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        TrimProgressBar.Value = 0;
        TrimProgressPercent.Text = "0%";
        CancelExportButton.IsEnabled = true;
        CancelExportButton.Content = Loc["Common.Cancel"];
        TrimProgressStatus.Text = Loc.Format("Gallery.SavingProgress", 0);

        var progress = new Progress<double>(p =>
        {
            if (exportCts != cts) return;
            int percentage = (int)Math.Clamp(Math.Round(p * 100.0), 0, 100);
            TrimProgressBar.Value = percentage;
            TrimProgressPercent.Text = $"{percentage}%";
            TrimProgressStatus.Text = Loc.Format("Gallery.SavingProgress", percentage);
        });

        try
        {
            string exportedFile = await VideoTrimmingService.Instance.TrimVideoAsync(
                currentPath, targetPath, start, end, accurate: false, progress: progress, cancellationToken: token);

            if (!File.Exists(exportedFile))
            {
                throw new IOException(Loc["Gallery.FragmentMissing"]);
            }

            // After Close the player may show another clip: registering and leaving trim mode would act on that one.
            if (exportCts == cts) await HandleExportSuccess(exportedFile, start, end);
            else UpdateStatusMessage(Loc.Format("Gallery.FragmentSaved", Path.GetFileName(exportedFile)));
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            UpdateStatusMessage(Loc["Gallery.ExportCancelled"]);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // The service never leaves a partial file at targetPath, and a file already there is the user's.
            UpdateStatusMessage(Loc.Format("Gallery.ExportError", ex.Message));
        }
        finally
        {
            cts.Dispose();
            // Null: Close or Escape already cancelled this export and no newer one runs, so the UI is still ours.
            if (exportCts == cts || exportCts is null)
            {
                isExporting = false;
                TrimProgressPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                SetTrimControlsEnabled(true);
                exportCts = null;
            }
        }
    }

    private void CancelExportClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (exportCts is not null && !exportCts.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            CancelExportButton.IsEnabled = false;
            CancelExportButton.Content = Loc["Common.Cancelling"];
            exportCts.Cancel();
        }
    }

    private async Task HandleExportSuccess(string exportedFile, double start, double end)
    {
        var mainVm = DataContext as MainViewModel;
        string? libraryRoot = mainVm?.LibraryRoot;
        string clipsDir = Path.GetDirectoryName(currentPath!) ?? "";

        bool isInsideClipsDir = libraryRoot is not null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(clipsDir) &&
            string.Equals(Path.GetFullPath(Path.GetDirectoryName(exportedFile)!), Path.GetFullPath(clipsDir), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

        if (isInsideClipsDir)
        {
            try
            {
                var library = new ClipLibrary(clipsDir, libraryRoot!);
                var metadata = new ClipMetadata
                {
                    FileName = Path.GetFileName(exportedFile),
                    EventTag = "TRIMMED",
                    Events = ["TRIMMED"],
                    GroupId = "",
                    CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.Now,
                    DurationSeconds = Math.Max(0.1, end - start),
                    Encoder = "stream copy",
                    TruncatedStart = false,
                    TruncatedEnd = false
                };
                var registeredClip = library.Register(exportedFile, metadata);
                try
                {
                    NativeCaptureEngine.SaveThumbnail(exportedFile, registeredClip.ThumbnailPath);
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or InvalidOperationException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
                { /* A missing preview image never fails the export; the gallery shows a placeholder. */ }

                if (mainVm is not null)
                {
                    await mainVm.RefreshClipsAsync();
                    mainVm.PreviewClip = mainVm.Clips.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Clip.Metadata.Id == registeredClip.Metadata.Id) ?? mainVm.PreviewClip;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or InvalidDataException)
            {
                // The MP4 is on disk; say why it is missing from the gallery instead of reporting a clean success.
                UpdateStatusMessage(Loc.Format("Gallery.SavedNotRegistered", ex.Message));
                return;
            }
        }

        try
        {
            System.Media.SystemSounds.Asterisk.Play();
        }
        catch { }

        string saveNotice = Loc.Format("Gallery.FragmentSaved", Path.GetFileName(exportedFile));
        UpdateStatusMessage(saveNotice);

        ExitTrimMode();
    }

    private void SetTrimControlsEnabled(bool enabled)
    {
        TrimSlider.IsEnabled = enabled;
        SaveFragmentButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        CancelTrimButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        PreviewRangeButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        PlayButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        StepStartMinusButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        StepStartPlusButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        StepEndMinusButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        StepEndPlusButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        MarkInButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        MarkOutButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        JumpStartButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
        JumpEndButton.IsEnabled = enabled;
    }

    private void UpdateStatusMessage(string message)
    {
        if (DataContext is MainViewModel mainVm) mainVm.Message = message;
    }

    protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
        if (SearchBox.IsKeyboardFocused) return;
        if (!isTrimMode)
        {
            if (e.Key == Key.F && Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.None && playerHandle != IntPtr.Zero) { ToggleFullscreen(); e.Handled = true; }
            return;
        }

        switch (e.Key)
        {
            case Key.I:
                MarkInClick(this, new RoutedEventArgs());
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
            case Key.O:
                MarkOutClick(this, new RoutedEventArgs());
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
            case Key.Space:
                PreviewRangeClick(this, new RoutedEventArgs());
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
            case Key.Escape:
                ExitTrimMode();
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
            case Key.Left:
                if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Shift)
                    SetTrimStart(trimStart - 1.0);
                else
                    SetTrimStart(trimStart - 0.1);
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
            case Key.Right:
                if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Shift)
                    SetTrimStart(trimStart + 1.0);
                else
                    SetTrimStart(trimStart + 0.1);
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
            case Key.Home:
                JumpStartClick(this, new RoutedEventArgs());
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
            case Key.End:
                JumpEndClick(this, new RoutedEventArgs());
                e.Handled = true;
                break;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Start/Stop/Tick like a DispatcherTimer, but raised by CompositionTarget.Rendering.</summary>
    private sealed class RenderTicker
    {
        private bool running;
        public event EventHandler? Tick;
        public void Start()
        {
            if (running) return;
            running = true;
            CompositionTarget.Rendering += OnRendering;
        }
        public void Stop()
        {
            if (!running) return;
            running = false;
            CompositionTarget.Rendering -= OnRendering;
        }
        private void OnRendering(object? sender, EventArgs e) => Tick?.Invoke(this, e);
    }

    private void ShowPaused()
    {
        playing = false;
        PlayButton.Content = "▶";
        if (PreviewRangeIcon is not null) PreviewRangeIcon.Text = "\uE768";
        if (PreviewRangeText is not null) PreviewRangeText.Text = Loc["Gallery.Preview"];
    }

    private void CopyLatestFrame(IntPtr handle)
    {
        if (bitmap is null) return;
        bitmap.Lock();
        try
        {
            NativeMethods.hr_player_read_frame(handle, bitmap.BackBuffer, bitmap.BackBufferStride, videoWidth, videoHeight, out int updated, out _);
            if (updated == 1) bitmap.AddDirtyRect(new Int32Rect(0, 0, videoWidth, videoHeight));
        }
        finally { bitmap.Unlock(); }
    }

    // Decodes one preview frame; null when the player changed or the decode failed. One copy: native buffer to bitmap.
    private BitmapSource? RenderPreview(IntPtr handle, double seconds, CancellationToken token)
    {
        IntPtr pixels;
        int w, h, stride, res;
        lock (playerLock)
        {
            if (token.IsCancellationRequested || handle != playerHandle || handle == IntPtr.Zero) return null;
            res = NativeMethods.hr_player_preview(handle, seconds, 192, out pixels, out w, out h, out stride);
        }
        if (res != 0 || pixels == IntPtr.Zero) return null;
        try
        {
            var bmp = BitmapSource.Create(w, h, 96, 96, PixelFormats.Bgra32, null, pixels, checked(stride * h), stride);
            bmp.Freeze();
            return bmp;
        }
        finally { NativeMethods.hr_free(pixels); }
    }

    private static LocalizationService Loc => LocalizationService.Instance;

    // Static labels are XAML bindings to Loc[...]; only text that the code also changes at runtime is set here.
    private void UpdateLocalizedLabels()
    {
        if (CancelExportButton is not null && CancelExportButton.IsEnabled) CancelExportButton.Content = Loc["Common.Cancel"];
        if (PreviewRangeText is not null) PreviewRangeText.Text = Loc[isPreviewingFragment ? "Gallery.Pause" : "Gallery.Preview"];
        if (PlayerHintText is not null && (playerHandle == IntPtr.Zero || PlayerHint.Visibility == Visibility.Visible))
        {
            PlayerHintText.Text = LocalizationService.Instance["Gallery.SelectClipHint"];
        }
    }

    #endregion
}
```

```cs
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;
internal sealed class InputDialog : Window
{
    private readonly TextBox input;
    public string Value => input.Text.Trim();
    public InputDialog(string title, string value)
    {
        SourceInitialized += (_, _) => Interop.WindowAppearance.DarkCaption(this);
        Title = title; Width = 520; Height = 220; ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
        WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
        Background = (System.Windows.Media.Brush)FindResource("Background");
        var panel = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(24) };
        panel.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = title, FontSize = 18, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 20) });
        input = new TextBox { Text = value }; panel.Children.Add(input);
        var saveLabel = Services.LocalizationService.Instance["Common.Save"];
        var button = new Button { Content = saveLabel, IsDefault = true, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right, Margin = new Thickness(0, 20, 0, 0), Style = (Style)FindResource("PrimaryButton") };
        button.Click += (_, _) => { DialogResult = true; };
        panel.Children.Add(button); Content = panel;
        Loaded += (_, _) => { input.Focus(); input.Select(0, Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(value).Length); };
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Views/OverlayWindow.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Interop;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;

internal enum OverlayKind { Info, Problem }

/// <summary>
/// A small notification drawn over the game without touching the game process: a separate topmost window that never
/// takes focus, lets every click through and is excluded from screen capture. Nothing is drawn while it is hidden,
/// and while it is shown it is a static layered window, so the cost is one composition of a few hundred pixels.
/// </summary>
internal sealed class OverlayWindow : Window
{
    private readonly DispatcherTimer hideTimer = new();
    private readonly Border card;
    private readonly Border strip;
    private readonly TextBlock title = new() { FontSize = 13, FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold, TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis };
    private readonly TextBlock detail = new() { FontSize = 12, Margin = new(0, 3, 0, 0), TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis };
    private IntPtr handle, monitor;
    private OverlayCorner corner;

    public OverlayWindow()
    {
        WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None; AllowsTransparency = true; Background = Brushes.Transparent; ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;
        ShowInTaskbar = false; ShowActivated = false; Topmost = true; Focusable = false; IsHitTestVisible = false;
        WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.Manual; Left = -32000; Top = -32000; SizeToContent = SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight;
        FontFamily = new FontFamily("Segoe UI"); UseLayoutRounding = true;
        title.SetResourceReference(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, "Text");
        detail.SetResourceReference(TextBlock.ForegroundProperty, "Muted");
        strip = new Border { Width = 4, CornerRadius = new(8, 0, 0, 8) };
        var text = new StackPanel { Margin = new(14, 10, 18, 11), Children = { title, detail } };
        var layout = new DockPanel { LastChildFill = true };
        DockPanel.SetDock(strip, Dock.Left);
        layout.Children.Add(strip); layout.Children.Add(text);
        card = new Border
        {
            CornerRadius = new(8), BorderThickness = new(1), MinWidth = 240, MaxWidth = 400,
            HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left, VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top, Child = layout
        };
        card.SetResourceReference(Border.BackgroundProperty, "PopupBackground");
        card.SetResourceReference(Border.BorderBrushProperty, "Border");
        Content = card;
        hideTimer.Tick += (_, _) => { hideTimer.Stop(); Hide(); };
        // New text and a monitor with another scale both resize the window after it was placed: keep its corner where it was.
        SizeChanged += (_, _) => { if (IsVisible) Place(); };
    }

    protected override void OnSourceInitialized(EventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnSourceInitialized(e);
        handle = new WindowInteropHelper(this).Handle;
        // Clicks fall through to the game, and showing the window never activates it, so the game keeps focus and input.
        SetWindowLong(handle, GwlExStyle, GetWindowLong(handle, GwlExStyle) | WsExTransparent | WsExLayered | WsExNoActivate | WsExToolWindow);
        // Keeps the notification out of monitor capture (Windows 10 2004+). Window capture records only the game anyway.
        _ = SetWindowDisplayAffinity(handle, WdaExcludeFromCapture);
    }

    /// <summary>Shows the notification on the monitor the user is looking at, replacing one that is still visible.</summary>
    public void Notify(OverlayKind kind, string heading, string text, OverlayCorner where, int seconds)
    {
        title.Text = heading;
        detail.Text = text;
        detail.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        strip.SetResourceReference(Border.BackgroundProperty, kind == OverlayKind.Problem ? "Warning" : "Accent");
        corner = where;
        monitor = MonitorFromWindow(GetForegroundWindow(), MonitorDefaultToPrimary);
        if (handle == IntPtr.Zero) { Show(); Hide(); } // Lets WPF finish its first placement off-screen.
        Place(); // First guess from the measured card, so a hidden window does not appear at its old place.
        if (!IsVisible) Show();
        UpdateLayout(); // Sizes the window to the new text now instead of on the next layout pass.
        Place(); // From the real window size; also raises it above a game that became topmost after the last notification.
        hideTimer.Stop();
        hideTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds);
        hideTimer.Start();
    }

    private void Place()
    {
        if (handle == IntPtr.Zero || monitor == IntPtr.Zero) return;
        var info = new MonitorInfo { Size = Marshal.SizeOf<MonitorInfo>() };
        if (!GetMonitorInfo(monitor, ref info)) return;
        double scale = GetDpiForMonitor(monitor, 0, out uint dpi, out _) == 0 ? dpi / 96.0 : 1;
        int width, height;
        if (IsVisible && GetWindowRect(handle, out var bounds))
        {
            // The size WPF actually gave the window. Positioning the first notification from the Measure estimate
            // alone left it further right than the later ones.
            width = bounds.Right - bounds.Left; height = bounds.Bottom - bounds.Top;
        }
        else
        {
            card.Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
            width = (int)Math.Ceiling(card.DesiredSize.Width * scale); height = (int)Math.Ceiling(card.DesiredSize.Height * scale);
        }
        int margin = (int)Math.Round(24 * scale);
        // The whole monitor, not the work area: a fullscreen game covers the taskbar.
        var area = info.Monitor;
        int x = corner is OverlayCorner.TopLeft or OverlayCorner.BottomLeft ? area.Left + margin : area.Right - margin - width;
        int y = corner is OverlayCorner.TopLeft or OverlayCorner.TopRight ? area.Top + margin : area.Bottom - margin - height;
        SetWindowPos(handle, HwndTopmost, x, y, 0, 0, SwpNoActivate | SwpNoSize); // WPF sizes the window to the card itself.
    }

    private const int GwlExStyle = -20, WsExTransparent = 0x20, WsExLayered = 0x80000, WsExNoActivate = 0x8000000, WsExToolWindow = 0x80;
    private const uint WdaExcludeFromCapture = 0x11, MonitorDefaultToPrimary = 1, SwpNoActivate = 0x10, SwpNoSize = 0x1;
    private static readonly IntPtr HwndTopmost = new(-1);
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] private struct Rect { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] private struct MonitorInfo { public int Size; public Rect Monitor, Work; public uint Flags; }
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern int GetWindowLong(IntPtr window, int index);
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern int SetWindowLong(IntPtr window, int index, int value);
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern bool SetWindowDisplayAffinity(IntPtr window, uint affinity);
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern bool SetWindowPos(IntPtr window, IntPtr after, int x, int y, int width, int height, uint flags);
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr window, out Rect rect);
    [DllImport("user32")] private static extern IntPtr MonitorFromWindow(IntPtr window, uint flags);
    [DllImport("user32", EntryPoint = "GetMonitorInfoW")] private static extern bool GetMonitorInfo(IntPtr monitor, ref MonitorInfo info);
    [DllImport("shcore")] private static extern int GetDpiForMonitor(IntPtr monitor, int type, out uint dpiX, out uint dpiY);
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Views/SettingsView.xaml.cs`:

```cs
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;

public partial class SettingsView : UserControl
{
    private TabItem? previousTab;
    private bool suppressingSelection;

    public SettingsView()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        Loaded += (_, _) => previousTab = SettingsTabControl.SelectedItem as TabItem;
    }

    private void OnTabSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        // Only react to TabControl itself. A capture source or monitor picked in a ComboBox changes which presets fit.
        if (e.OriginalSource != SettingsTabControl)
        {
            if (e.OriginalSource is ComboBox) (DataContext as MainViewModel)?.RefreshResolutionChoices();
            return;
        }
        if (suppressingSelection) return;

        var targetTab = SettingsTabControl.SelectedItem as TabItem;
        if (targetTab == previousTab || previousTab is null)
        {
            previousTab = targetTab;
            return;
        }

        if (DataContext is MainViewModel vm && vm.HasUnsavedSettings)
        {
            // A TabItem selects on mouse-down, so this runs while the click still holds the mouse capture. A modal
            // dialog opened now swallows its first click. Stay on the current tab and ask once the click is over.
            SelectTab(previousTab);
            Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, new Action(async () => await AskAndSwitchAsync(vm, targetTab)));
            return;
        }

        previousTab = targetTab;
    }

    private async Task AskAndSwitchAsync(MainViewModel vm, TabItem? targetTab)
    {
        Mouse.Capture(null);
        if (!await vm.ConfirmLeaveSettingsAsync()) return; // Cancelled or the save failed: stay on this tab.
        SelectTab(targetTab);
        previousTab = targetTab;
    }

    private void SelectTab(TabItem? tab)
    {
        suppressingSelection = true;
        try
        {
            SettingsTabControl.SelectedItem = tab;
        }
        finally
        {
            suppressingSelection = false;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.App/Views/SetupWizard.xaml.cs`:

```cs
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Windows;
using HuntReplay.App.Services;

namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;
public partial class SetupWizard : Window
{
    private SetupStatus status;
    // A message that replaced the check result (consent needed, UAC cancelled, an error); re-read after a language switch.
    private Func<string>? message;
    private bool installing;
    internal SetupWizard(SetupStatus status)
    {
        InitializeComponent(); this.status = status;
        DataContext = new { Loc = LocalizationService.Instance };
        SourceInitialized += (_, _) => Interop.WindowAppearance.DarkCaption(this);
        ShowStatus();
        Closing += (_, args) => { if (installing) args.Cancel = true; };
    }

    // Text set from code does not follow the Loc bindings, so it is rebuilt here for the current language.
    private void ShowStatus()
    {
        var loc = LocalizationService.Instance;
        Title = loc["Wizard.Title"];
        ReplaceCheck.Visibility = status.Conflict ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        StatusText.Text = message?.Invoke()
            ?? (status.NvidiaActive ? loc["Wizard.NvidiaActive"] : status.Conflict ? loc["Wizard.ConflictFound"] : status.Detail);
        InstallButton.Content = status.Ready ? loc["Wizard.AllSet"] : loc["Wizard.Install"];
    }

    private void ShowMessage(Func<string> text) { message = text; ShowStatus(); }

    private async void LanguageClicked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (installing) return;
        LocalizationService.Instance.ToggleLanguage(); // App saves the chosen language with the first-run flag.
        ShowStatus();
        // The check result was worded in the previous language; checking again is quick and rewords it.
        try { status = await Task.Run(SelfInstaller.Check); } catch { return; }
        if (!installing) ShowStatus();
    }

    private void LaterClicked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { if (!installing) { DialogResult = false; Close(); } }
    private async void InstallClicked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (status.Ready) { DialogResult = true; Close(); return; }
        if (status.Conflict && ReplaceCheck.IsChecked != true) { ShowMessage(() => LocalizationService.Instance["Wizard.ConsentRequired"]); return; }
        installing = true; InstallButton.IsEnabled = false;
        try
        {
            ShowMessage(() => LocalizationService.Instance["Wizard.WaitingUac"]);
            var code = await SelfInstaller.RunElevatedAsync(replaceNvidia: ReplaceCheck.IsChecked == true);
            if (code != 0) throw new IOException(LocalizationService.Instance["Wizard.InstallIncomplete"]);
            var result = await Task.Run(SelfInstaller.Check);
            if (!result.Ready) throw new IOException(result.Detail);
            installing = false; DialogResult = true; Close();
        }
        catch (Win32Exception ex) when (ex.NativeErrorCode == 1223) { ShowMessage(() => LocalizationService.Instance["Wizard.UacCancelled"]); }
        catch (Exception ex) { ShowMessage(() => ex.Message); }
        finally { installing = false; InstallButton.IsEnabled = true; }
    }
}
```

```cs
namespace HuntReplay.App.Views;

internal enum UpdateFailedChoice { Close, Retry, OpenReleases }

/// <summary>Explains why an update failed and offers to retry or to download it from GitHub by hand.</summary>
internal sealed class UpdateFailedDialog : Window

    public UpdateFailedChoice Choice { get; private set; }

    public UpdateFailedDialog(string reason)
    {
        var loc = Services.LocalizationService.Instance;
        SourceInitialized += (_, _) => Interop.WindowAppearance.DarkCaption(this);
        Title = loc["Update.FailedTitle"]; Width = 560; SizeToContent = SizeToContent.Height; ResizeMode = ResizeMode.NoResize;

        panel.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = loc["Update.FailedTitle"], FontSize = 18, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 14) });
        panel.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = reason, TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap, Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10) });
        panel.Children.Add(new TextBlock { Text = loc["Update.FailedHint"], Style = (Style)FindResource("MutedText") });
        var buttons = new StackPanel { Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right, Margin = new Thickness(0, 22, 0, 0) };
        buttons.Children.Add(Option(loc["Common.Close"], UpdateFailedChoice.Close, isCancel: true));
        buttons.Children.Add(Option(loc["Update.OpenReleases"], UpdateFailedChoice.OpenReleases));
        var retry = Option(loc["Update.Retry"], UpdateFailedChoice.Retry);
        retry.IsDefault = true; retry.Style = (Style)FindResource("PrimaryButton");
        buttons.Children.Add(retry);
        panel.Children.Add(buttons); Content = panel;
    }

    private Button Option(string label, UpdateFailedChoice choice, bool isCancel = false)
    {
        var button = new Button { Content = label, IsCancel = isCancel, Margin = new Thickness(10, 0, 0, 0) };
        button.Click += (_, _) => { Choice = choice; DialogResult = true; };
        return button;
    }
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Configuration/ClipFileName.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;

public static class ClipFileName
{
    private static readonly char[] WindowsInvalid = "<>:\"/\\|?*".ToCharArray();

    public static void ValidateTemplate(string template)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(template) || template.Length > 150 ||
            template.IndexOfAny(WindowsInvalid) >= 0 || template.Any(char.IsControl) ||
            !template.EndsWith(".mp4", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("FileName.TemplateInvalid"));
        var remaining = template.Replace("{event}", "e").Replace("{date}", "d").Replace("{time}", "t");
        if (remaining.Contains('{') || remaining.Contains('}') || IsReserved(remaining))
            throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("FileName.TemplatePlaceholders"));
    }

    public static string Create(string template, string eventTag, DateTimeOffset time)
    {
        ValidateTemplate(template);
        var safeTag = SafeTagRegex.Replace(eventTag, "_");
        if (safeTag.Length > 80) safeTag = safeTag[..80];
        var name = template.Replace("{event}", safeTag)
            .Replace("{date}", time.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
            .Replace("{time}", time.ToString("HH-mm-ss-fff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        if (IsReserved(name)) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("FileName.Reserved"));
        return name;
    }

    public static bool IsSafeName(string name) => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name) && name.Length <= 220 &&
        name.IndexOfAny(WindowsInvalid) < 0 && !name.Any(char.IsControl) &&
        name == name.TrimEnd('.', ' ') && !IsReserved(name) &&
        name.EndsWith(".mp4", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private static bool IsReserved(string name)
    {
        var stem = name.Split('.')[0].TrimEnd(' ').ToUpperInvariant();
        return stem is "CON" or "PRN" or "AUX" or "NUL" or "CLOCK$" ||
               (stem.Length == 4 && (stem.StartsWith("COM", StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                 stem.StartsWith("LPT", StringComparison.Ordinal)) && stem[3] is >= '0' and <= '9');
    }

    private static readonly Regex SafeTagRegex = new("[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]", RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
}

```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Configuration/SettingsStore.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;

public sealed class SettingsStore(string path)
{
    public string FilePath { get; } = Path.GetFullPath(path);
    public string? LoadWarning { get; private set; }

    public StudioSettings Load()
    {
        if (!File.Exists(FilePath)) return new();
        try
        {
            var info = new FileInfo(FilePath);
            if (info.Length > 1024 * 1024) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Settings.FileTooLarge"));
            var value = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<StudioSettings>(File.ReadAllText(FilePath), StudioSettings.JsonOptions)
                ?? throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Settings.FileEmpty"));
            value.Validate();
            return value;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is JsonException or InvalidDataException or IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            // Preserve corrupt/future configs. The user can inspect them before saving again.
            LoadWarning = Text.Format("Settings.LoadFailed", ex.Message);
            return new();
        }
    }

    public void Save(StudioSettings value)
    {
        value.Validate();
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(FilePath)!);
        var temp = FilePath + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
        try
        {
            using (var stream = new FileStream(temp, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None,
                       4096, FileOptions.WriteThrough))
            {
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(stream, value, StudioSettings.JsonOptions);
                stream.Flush(true);
            }
            if (File.Exists(FilePath)) File.Copy(FilePath, FilePath + ".bak", true);
            File.Move(temp, FilePath, true);
            LoadWarning = null;
        }
        finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Configuration/StudioSettings.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;

public enum CaptureSource { HuntWindow, Monitor }
public enum VideoEncoder { Auto, Amf, Nvenc, Qsv, X264 }
public enum VideoCodec { H264, Hevc, Av1 }
// Each preset is an output height; the width follows the source's aspect ratio. FullHd, Qhd and Uhd keep their
// names from older configs (1080p, 1440p, 2160p); the other presets were added after them.
public enum VideoResolution { Native, FullHd, Qhd, Uhd, P720, P900, P1200, P1600 }
public enum AudioMode { Mix, SeparateTracks }
public enum OverlayCorner { TopLeft, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomRight }

public static class VideoResolutions
{
    /// <summary>Every preset other than Native, from the smallest output to the largest.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<VideoResolution> Presets { get; } = [
        VideoResolution.P720, VideoResolution.P900, VideoResolution.FullHd, VideoResolution.P1200,
        VideoResolution.Qhd, VideoResolution.P1600, VideoResolution.Uhd];

    /// <summary>The output height of a preset; 0 for Native.</summary>
    public static int Height(this VideoResolution resolution) => resolution switch
    {
        VideoResolution.P720 => 720, VideoResolution.P900 => 900, VideoResolution.FullHd => 1080, VideoResolution.P1200 => 1200,
        VideoResolution.Qhd => 1440, VideoResolution.P1600 => 1600, VideoResolution.Uhd => 2160, _ => 0
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// The size recorded from a source of the given size. Mirrors hr::fit_output in native/src/capture.cpp:
    /// the source's aspect ratio is kept, dimensions are even, and a preset never scales the source up.
    /// </summary>
    public static (int Width, int Height) OutputSize(this VideoResolution resolution, int sourceWidth, int sourceHeight)
    {
        int height = resolution.Height();
        if (height == 0 || height >= sourceHeight) return (sourceWidth / 2 * 2, sourceHeight / 2 * 2);
        int width = (int)Math.Round((double)sourceWidth * height / sourceHeight, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero);
        return (Math.Max(2, width / 2 * 2), height / 2 * 2);
    }
}

public sealed class StudioSettings
{
    public int SchemaVersion { get; set; } = 1;
    public VideoSettings Video { get; set; } = new();
    public AudioSettings Audio { get; set; } = new();
    public ReplaySettings Replay { get; set; } = new();
    public StorageSettings Storage { get; set; } = new();
    public SystemSettings System { get; set; } = new();

    public static JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions { get; } = new()
    {
        WriteIndented = true,
        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
        Converters = { new JsonStringEnumConverter() }
    };

    public StudioSettings Clone() => JsonSerializer.Deserialize<StudioSettings>(
        JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, JsonOptions), JsonOptions)!;

    public bool IsEquivalent(StudioSettings? other)
    {
        if (other is null) return false;
        string a = JsonSerializer.Serialize(this, JsonOptions);
        string b = JsonSerializer.Serialize(other, JsonOptions);
        return string.Equals(a, b, StringComparison.Ordinal);
    }

    public void Validate()
    {
        if (SchemaVersion != 1) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Settings.UnsupportedSchema"));
        if (Video is null || Audio is null || Replay is null || Storage is null || System is null)
            throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Settings.MissingSection"));
        Require(Enum.IsDefined(Video.Source) && Enum.IsDefined(Video.Encoder) &&
                Enum.IsDefined(Video.Codec) && Enum.IsDefined(Video.Resolution), "Settings.UnknownVideoMode");
        Require(Video.Fps is 30 or 60 or 120, "Settings.FpsRange");
        Require(Video.BitrateMbps is >= 10 and <= 80, "Settings.BitrateRange");
        Require(Video.GopSeconds is 1 or 2, "Settings.GopRange");
        Require(Video.Encoder != VideoEncoder.X264 || Video.Codec == VideoCodec.H264,
            "Settings.X264H264Only");
        Require(Video.MonitorDevice is not null, "Settings.MonitorMissing");
        Require(Video.GpuDevice is not null, "Settings.GpuMissing");
        Require(Enum.IsDefined(Audio.Mode), "Settings.UnknownAudioMode");
        Require(Audio.MicrophoneVolume is >= 0 and <= 100, "Settings.MicVolumeRange");
        Require(Audio.OutputDeviceId is not null && Audio.MicrophoneDeviceId is not null, "Settings.AudioDevicesMissing");
        Require(Replay.BufferSeconds is >= 15 and <= 300, "Settings.BufferRange");
        Require(double.IsFinite(Replay.PostEventSeconds) && Replay.PostEventSeconds is >= 0 and <= 30,
            "Settings.PostRollRange");
        Require(Replay.CoalesceGapSeconds is >= 1 and <= 30, "Settings.CoalesceRange");
        Require(Replay.MaxSequenceSeconds is >= 15 and <= 120, "Settings.SequenceRange");
        Require(Replay.PreEventSeconds is >= 1 and <= 300, "Settings.PreRollRange");
        Require(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Storage.Directory) && Path.IsPathFullyQualified(Storage.Directory),
            "Settings.StorageAbsolute");
        Require(Storage.LimitGb is 0 or 15 or 30 or 60, "Settings.DiskLimitRange");
        ClipFileName.ValidateTemplate(Storage.FileNameTemplate);
        Require(System.HotkeyVirtualKey is >= 0x70 and <= 0x7B, "Settings.HotkeyRange");
        Require(Enum.IsDefined(System.OverlayCorner) && System.OverlaySeconds is 2 or 3 or 5, "Settings.OverlayRange");
    }

    // Validation messages are catalog keys, resolved in the current UI language when a rule fails.
    private static void Require(bool condition, string messageKey)
    {
        if (!condition) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get(messageKey));
    }
}

public sealed class VideoSettings
{
    public CaptureSource Source { get; set; } = CaptureSource.HuntWindow;
    // Persist the Windows display device name, never a transient HMONITOR.
    private string monitorDevice = "";
    // Old UI versions could serialize null during ComboBox refresh. Recover as Windows default.
    [AllowNull]
    public string MonitorDevice { get => monitorDevice; set => monitorDevice = value ?? ""; }
    private string gpuDevice = "";
    [AllowNull]
    public string GpuDevice { get => gpuDevice; set => gpuDevice = value ?? ""; }
    public VideoResolution Resolution { get; set; } = VideoResolution.Native;
    public int Fps { get; set; } = 60;
    public VideoEncoder Encoder { get; set; } = VideoEncoder.Auto;
    public VideoCodec Codec { get; set; } = VideoCodec.H264;
    // Hunt is often very dark; lower rates band and smear shadows. A saved config keeps its own rate.
    public int BitrateMbps { get; set; } = 40;
    public int GopSeconds { get; set; } = 1;
}

public sealed class AudioSettings
{
    private string outputDeviceId = "", microphoneDeviceId = "";
    [AllowNull]
    public string OutputDeviceId { get => outputDeviceId; set => outputDeviceId = value ?? ""; }
    public bool MicrophoneEnabled { get; set; }
    [AllowNull]
    public string MicrophoneDeviceId { get => microphoneDeviceId; set => microphoneDeviceId = value ?? ""; }
    public int MicrophoneVolume { get; set; } = 80;
    public AudioMode Mode { get; set; } = AudioMode.Mix;
}

public sealed class ReplaySettings
{
    public int BufferSeconds { get; set; } = 60;
    public double PostEventSeconds { get; set; } = 7;
    public bool Coalesce { get; set; } = true;
    public int CoalesceGapSeconds { get; set; } = 15;
    public int MaxSequenceSeconds { get; set; } = 60;
    public int PreEventSeconds { get; set; } = 20;
    public bool HunterKilled { get; set; } = true;
    public bool PlayerDowned { get; set; } = true;
    // Other Highlights games can opt in by editing this array. Never execute it as code.
    public string[] AdditionalEvents { get; set; } = [];

    public bool IsEnabled(string id) => id switch
    {
        "HUNTER_KILLED" => HunterKilled,
        "PLAYER_DOWNED" => PlayerDowned,
        _ => AdditionalEvents?.Contains(id, StringComparer.Ordinal) == true
    };
}

public sealed class StorageSettings
{
    public string Directory { get; set; } = Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyVideos), "HuntHighlights");
    public string FileNameTemplate { get; set; } = "Hunt_{event}_{date}_{time}.mp4";
    public bool AutoCleanup { get; set; }
    public int LimitGb { get; set; } = 30;
}

public sealed class SystemSettings
{
    public int HotkeyVirtualKey { get; set; } = 0x78; // RegisterHotKey F9, NOT SendInput.
    public bool SoundOnSave { get; set; } = true;
    // A small click-through notification over the game, never recorded into clips. Off unless the user enables it.
    public bool OverlayEnabled { get; set; }
    public OverlayCorner OverlayCorner { get; set; } = OverlayCorner.TopRight;
    public int OverlaySeconds { get; set; } = 3;
    public bool StartWithWindows { get; set; }
    public bool AutoBufferWithGame { get; set; } = true;
    public bool CloseToTray { get; set; } = true;
    public bool FirstRunCompleted { get; set; }
    // A saved config keeps its language; only a new one starts in the Windows display language.
    public string Language { get; set; } = Text.WindowsDefault;
    public string Theme { get; set; } = "dark";
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Localization/Text.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

/// <summary>
/// The single source of user-visible text for every layer (Core, Protocol, App). Catalogs are embedded JSON files,
/// <c>{language}.json</c>, so the portable single-file build needs no satellite assemblies. Russian is the
/// reference catalog: a key missing from another language falls back to it, and an unknown key returns the key itself.
/// A unit test keeps the catalogs in step (same keys, same <c>{n}</c> placeholders) and checks every key used in source.
/// </summary>
public static class Text
{
    public const string Russian = "ru";
    public const string English = "en";
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Languages { get; } = [Russian, English];

    private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>> Catalogs =
        Languages.ToDictionary(language => language, Load);
    // One reference swap per language change; readers on any thread see a complete catalog.
    private static volatile IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> current = Catalogs[Russian];

    public static string Language { get; private set; } = Russian;

    /// <summary>The language of a first start: Russian when Windows displays Russian, English for any other language.</summary>
    public static string WindowsDefault => CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture.TwoLetterISOLanguageName == Russian ? Russian : English;

    /// <summary>Culture for language-dependent formatting such as month names. Numbers keep the OS culture.</summary>
    public static CultureInfo Culture => CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo(Language == English ? "en-US" : "ru-RU");

    /// <summary>Raised after the language changes, on the thread that changed it.</summary>
    public static event Action? LanguageChanged;

    /// <summary>Selects a language by code ("en", "english", "ru"...). Anything unrecognized selects Russian.</summary>
    public static void SetLanguage(string? code)
    {
        var language = code?.Trim().ToLowerInvariant() switch
        {
            "en" or "english" => English,
            _ => Russian
        };
        if (language == Language) return;
        current = Catalogs[language];
        Language = language;
        LanguageChanged?.Invoke();
    }

    public static string Get(string key) =>
        current.TryGetValue(key, out var value) || Catalogs[Russian].TryGetValue(key, out value) ? value : key;

    public static string Format(string key, params object?[] args) =>
        string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, Get(key), args);

    /// <summary>The raw catalog of one language; used by the consistency tests.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Catalog(string language) => Catalogs[language];

    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Load(string language)
    {
        var name = $"HuntReplay.Core.Localization.{language}.json";
        using var stream = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetManifestResourceStream(name)
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing embedded localization catalog " + name);
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(stream)
            ?? throw new InvalidDataException("Empty localization catalog " + name);
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Media/EncodedPacket.cs`:

```cs
namespace HuntReplay.Core.Media;

// Payload ownership transfers to the buffer; it must never be mutated after publication.
// All timestamps use one capture epoch in microseconds. Video is encoded with B-frames disabled.
// Chunk is set when the payload lives in a PayloadArena; the replay buffer then releases it on eviction.
public sealed record EncodedPacket(int StreamIndex, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> Payload, long PtsUs, long DtsUs,
    long DurationUs, bool IsKeyFrame)
{
    public PayloadChunk? Chunk { get; init; }
    public bool IsVideo => StreamIndex == 0;
    public long EndUs => PtsUs + Math.Max(DurationUs, 1);
}

/// <summary>
/// Packets of one clip. A snapshot holds a reference on every arena chunk it reads, so the data cannot be recycled
/// while the clip is being written; dispose it once the export is finished (or abandoned).
/// </summary>
public sealed record ReplaySnapshot(IReadOnlyList<EncodedPacket> Packets, long StartUs, long EndUs,
    bool TruncatedStart, bool TruncatedEnd) : IDisposable
{
    private int disposed;
    public long Bytes => Packets.Sum(x => (long)x.Payload.Length);
    public double DurationSeconds => (EndUs - StartUs) / 1_000_000d;

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref disposed, 1) != 0) return;
        foreach (var packet in Packets) packet.Chunk?.Release();
    }
}

public readonly record struct BufferStatus(long Bytes, double Seconds, long FirstUs, long LatestUs,
    long EvictedGops, bool MemoryPressure);
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Media/PacketRingBuffer.cs`:

```cs
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Media;

/// <summary>
/// Compressed RAM-only buffer, per-stream FIFO, GOP-aligned eviction. Snapshots share immutable
/// payloads rather than copying megabytes. Leases retain an in-flight sequence across the normal
/// time horizon; the hard byte cap takes precedence and truncation is reported, never hidden.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PacketRingBuffer
{
    private readonly object gate = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<int, LinkedList<EncodedPacket>> streams = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<Guid, long> pins = new();
    private readonly long durationUs;
    private readonly long byteLimit;
    private long bytes;
    private long latestVideoEnd;
    private long evictedGops;
    private bool pressure;

    public PacketRingBuffer(int seconds, long byteLimit)
    {
        if (seconds <= 0 || byteLimit <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(seconds));
        durationUs = seconds * 1_000_000L;
        this.byteLimit = byteLimit;
        streams[0] = new();
    }

    /// <summary>Takes ownership of the packet, including its arena chunk reference, whether it is kept or not.</summary>
    public void Add(EncodedPacket packet)
    {
        bool kept = false;
        try
        {
            if (packet.StreamIndex is < 0 or > 2 || packet.Payload.Length == 0 || packet.DurationUs < 0 ||
                packet.PtsUs < -1_000_000 || packet.DtsUs < -1_000_000 ||
                packet.PtsUs > long.MaxValue - packet.DurationUs)
                throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Buffer.InvalidPacket"));
            lock (gate)
            {
                var video = streams[0];
                if (video.Count == 0 && !(packet.IsVideo && packet.IsKeyFrame)) return;
                if (!streams.TryGetValue(packet.StreamIndex, out var queue)) streams[packet.StreamIndex] = queue = new();
                if (queue.Last is { } last && packet.DtsUs <= last.Value.DtsUs)
                    throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Buffer.DtsBackwards"));
                if (!packet.IsVideo && packet.DtsUs < video.First!.Value.DtsUs) return;
                queue.AddLast(packet);
                kept = true;
                bytes += packet.Payload.Length;
                if (packet.IsVideo) latestVideoEnd = Math.Max(latestVideoEnd, packet.EndUs);
                Evict();
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            if (!kept) packet.Chunk?.Release(); // A rejected packet must not pin its chunk forever.
        }
    }

    public Guid Pin(long desiredStartUs)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            var id = Guid.NewGuid();
            pins[id] = desiredStartUs;
            return id;
        }
    }

    public void UpdatePin(Guid id, long desiredStartUs)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (pins.ContainsKey(id)) pins[id] = Math.Min(pins[id], desiredStartUs);
        }
    }

    public void Unpin(Guid id)
    {
        lock (gate) { pins.Remove(id); Evict(); }
    }

    public BufferStatus Status
    {
        get
        {
            lock (gate)
            {
                var first = streams[0].First?.Value.PtsUs ?? 0;
                return new(bytes, streams[0].Count == 0 ? 0 : (latestVideoEnd - first) / 1_000_000d,
                    first, latestVideoEnd, evictedGops, pressure);
            }
        }
    }

    public ReplaySnapshot? Snapshot(long desiredStartUs, long desiredEndUs)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (desiredEndUs <= desiredStartUs) return null;
            var video = streams[0];
            EncodedPacket? key = null;
            foreach (var packet in video)
            {
                if (packet.PtsUs >= desiredEndUs) break;
                if (!packet.IsKeyFrame) continue;
                if (key is null || packet.PtsUs <= desiredStartUs) key = packet;
                if (packet.PtsUs > desiredStartUs) break;
            }
            if (key is null) return null;
            var packets = video.Where(p => p.DtsUs >= key.DtsUs && p.PtsUs < desiredEndUs).ToList();
            if (packets.Count == 0) return null;
            var end = packets.Max(p => p.EndUs);
            foreach (var (id, queue) in streams)
            {
                if (id == 0) continue;
                packets.AddRange(queue.Where(p => p.DtsUs >= key.DtsUs && p.PtsUs < end));
            }
            // The snapshot outlives eviction: it keeps its chunks alive until it is disposed after the export.
            foreach (var packet in packets) packet.Chunk?.AddReference();
            // Stable ordering puts the IDR before an audio packet with the same DTS.
            packets.Sort((a, b) => a.DtsUs != b.DtsUs ? a.DtsUs.CompareTo(b.DtsUs) : a.StreamIndex.CompareTo(b.StreamIndex));
            return new(packets, key.PtsUs, end, key.PtsUs > Math.Max(desiredStartUs, 0),
                end + 50_000 < desiredEndUs);
        }
    }

    private void Evict()
    {
        var video = streams[0];
        if (video.Count == 0) return;
        var cutoff = latestVideoEnd - durationUs;
        if (pins.Count > 0) cutoff = Math.Min(cutoff, pins.Values.Min());
        pressure = bytes > byteLimit;
        while (video.First is not null)
        {
            var nextKey = video.First.Next;
            while (nextKey is not null && !nextKey.Value.IsKeyFrame) nextKey = nextKey.Next;
            if (nextKey is null)
            {
                if (bytes <= byteLimit) break;
                // Even one GOP can exceed a configured cap. Drop it and wait for the next IDR.
                foreach (var queue in streams.Values)
                {
                    foreach (var dropped in queue) dropped.Chunk?.Release();
                    queue.Clear();
                }
                bytes = 0;
                latestVideoEnd = 0;
                evictedGops++;
                break;
            }
            if (nextKey.Value.PtsUs > cutoff && bytes <= byteLimit) break;
            var keepDts = nextKey.Value.DtsUs;
            foreach (var queue in streams.Values)
            {
                while (queue.First is { } head && head.Value.DtsUs < keepDts)
                {
                    bytes -= head.Value.Payload.Length;
                    head.Value.Chunk?.Release();
                    queue.RemoveFirst();
                }
            }
            evictedGops++;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Media/PayloadArena.cs`:

```cs
namespace HuntReplay.Core.Media;

/// <summary>
/// Storage for encoded packet payloads during a capture session. Instead of one new array per packet (at 40+ Mbps
/// most video frames exceed the 85 KB large-object threshold, so every frame became a large-object-heap allocation),
/// payloads are bump-allocated into reusable fixed-size chunks.
/// <para>
/// Each chunk counts its references: one per packet still held by the replay buffer, plus one per packet in every
/// snapshot that is being exported. A chunk is recycled only when that count is zero and it is no longer the chunk
/// being filled, so data that a buffer or an export can still read is never overwritten.
/// </para>
/// </summary>
public sealed class PayloadArena(int chunkBytes = PayloadArena.DefaultChunkBytes, int maxIdleChunks = 4)
{
    public const int DefaultChunkBytes = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
    private readonly object gate = new();
    private readonly Stack<PayloadChunk> idle = new();
    private PayloadChunk? current;

    /// <summary>Chunks allocated over the arena's lifetime; recycling keeps this near limit / chunk size.</summary>
    public int AllocatedChunks { get; private set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Reserves space for one payload. The returned chunk carries one reference for the caller, released through
    /// <see cref="PayloadChunk.Release"/> (the replay buffer does this when it drops or evicts the packet).
    /// </summary>
    public (PayloadChunk Chunk, ArraySegment<byte> Segment) Rent(int length)
    {
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(length);
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (length > chunkBytes)
            {
                // A packet larger than a chunk (a huge keyframe) gets a one-off chunk that is never pooled.
                var oversized = new PayloadChunk(this, new byte[length], pooled: false);
                AllocatedChunks++;
                return (oversized.Take(length), new ArraySegment<byte>(oversized.Data, 0, length));
            }
            if (current is null || current.Used + length > current.Data.Length)
            {
                var retired = current;
                current = idle.Count > 0 ? idle.Pop() : NewChunk();
                if (retired is not null && retired.References == 0) Recycle(retired);
            }
            int offset = current.Used;
            return (current.Take(length), new ArraySegment<byte>(current.Data, offset, length));
        }
    }

    internal void AddReference(PayloadChunk chunk)
    {
        lock (gate) chunk.References++;
    }

    internal void Release(PayloadChunk chunk)
    {
        lock (gate)
        {
            if (chunk.References <= 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Payload chunk released more often than referenced.");
            if (--chunk.References == 0 && chunk != current) Recycle(chunk);
        }
    }

    private PayloadChunk NewChunk()
    {
        AllocatedChunks++;
        return new PayloadChunk(this, GC.AllocateUninitializedArray<byte>(chunkBytes), pooled: true);
    }

    private void Recycle(PayloadChunk chunk)
    {
        if (!chunk.Pooled || idle.Count >= maxIdleChunks) return; // Surplus chunks go back to the GC.
        chunk.Used = 0;
        idle.Push(chunk);
    }
}

/// <summary>A block of payload memory owned by a <see cref="PayloadArena"/>; see the arena for the lifetime rules.</summary>
public sealed class PayloadChunk
{
    private readonly PayloadArena arena;
    internal PayloadChunk(PayloadArena arena, byte[] data, bool pooled)
    {
        this.arena = arena;
        Data = data;
        Pooled = pooled;
    }
    internal byte[] Data { get; }
    internal bool Pooled { get; }
    internal int Used { get; set; }
    internal int References { get; set; }

    internal PayloadChunk Take(int length)
    {
        Used += length;
        References++;
        return this;
    }

    public void AddReference() => arena.AddReference(this);
    public void Release() => arena.Release(this);
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Media/PlaybackDiagnostics.cs`:

```cs
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Media;

/// <summary>
/// Wording for a failed in-app preview. Preview is a convenience only: the recorder wrote the MP4 and
/// export used stream copy, so a playback failure never proves the saved clip is broken, and nothing
/// here re-encodes, deletes or changes the file or the user's codec setting.
/// </summary>
public static class PlaybackDiagnostics
{
    // Windows Media Player's generic "file open failed" (NS_E_WMP_FILE_OPEN_FAILED). The code does not
    // name the codec or the cause, so the hint offers possibilities and never a diagnosis.
    private const int FileOpenFailed = unchecked((int)0xC00D11B1);

    public static string Code(int hresult) => $"0x{(uint)hresult:X8}";

    public static string? SymbolName(int hresult) => hresult == FileOpenFailed ? "NS_E_WMP_FILE_OPEN_FAILED" : null;

    public static string Hint(int hresult)
    {
        var code = Code(hresult);
        if (hresult == FileOpenFailed)
            return Text.Format("Playback.OpenFailedGeneric", code);
        var detail = hresult == 0 ? "" : Text.Format("Playback.CodeSuffix", code);
        return Text.Format("Playback.OpenFailed", detail);
    }

    public static string LogLine(int hresult, string fileName)
    {
        var symbol = SymbolName(hresult);
        return Text.Format("Playback.LogLine", fileName, Code(hresult)) + (symbol is null ? "" : " · " + symbol);
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Replay/HighlightPlanner.cs`:

```cs
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Replay;

public sealed record HighlightEvent(string SessionId, string RequestId, string GroupId, string HighlightId,
    long AtUs, int StartDeltaMs = 0, int EndDeltaMs = 0);

public sealed class ClipPlan
{
    public Guid Id { get; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public required string SessionId { get; init; }
    public required string GroupId { get; init; }
    public required long FirstEventUs { get; init; }
    public long LastEventUs { get; set; }
    public long StartUs { get; set; }
    public long EndUs { get; set; }
    public long ReadyAtUs { get; set; }
    public List<string> Events { get; } = [];
    public int KillCount => Events.Count(e => e == "HUNTER_KILLED");
    public string EventTag
    {
        get
        {
            var tags = new List<string>();
            if (KillCount > 1) tags.Add($"MULTI_KILL_x{KillCount}");
            else if (KillCount == 1) tags.Add("HUNTER_KILLED");
            tags.AddRange(Events.Where(e => e != "HUNTER_KILLED").Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal));
            return string.Join("_", tags);
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Deterministic event-to-clip planning. Uses the capture's monotonic clock, not wall-clock time.
/// Coalescing waits for the gap horizon (15s) but ends the actual video at last kill + post-roll (7s).
/// That distinction allows kills 10–15s apart to really merge without adding eight seconds of dead air.
/// The caller serializes access, owns RAM leases and schedules the ready plans.
/// </summary>
public sealed class HighlightPlanner(ReplaySettings settings)
{
    private readonly List<ClipPlan> pending = [];
    private readonly HashSet<string> seen = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Queue<string> seenOrder = new();
    public int PendingCount => pending.Count;

    public ClipPlan? Register(HighlightEvent evt)
    {
        if (!settings.IsEnabled(evt.HighlightId)) return null;
        var dedup = evt.SessionId + "\0" + evt.RequestId;
        if (seen.Contains(dedup)) return null;
        if (evt.AtUs < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(evt));
        // Never trust game-provided deltas to reserve unbounded RAM.
        var preMs = evt.StartDeltaMs < 0
            ? Math.Min(-(long)evt.StartDeltaMs, settings.BufferSeconds * 1000L)
            : settings.PreEventSeconds * 1000L;
        var start = evt.AtUs - preMs * 1000;
        var postUs = (long)(Math.Max(settings.PostEventSeconds,
            Math.Clamp(evt.EndDeltaMs / 1000d, 0, 30)) * 1_000_000);
        var end = evt.AtUs + postUs;
        var gapUs = settings.CoalesceGapSeconds * 1_000_000L;
        var plan = settings.Coalesce ? pending.LastOrDefault(p =>
            p.SessionId == evt.SessionId && p.GroupId == evt.GroupId &&
            evt.AtUs >= p.LastEventUs && evt.AtUs - p.LastEventUs <= gapUs &&
            evt.AtUs - p.FirstEventUs <= settings.MaxSequenceSeconds * 1_000_000L) : null;
        if (plan is null)
        {
            // Bound outstanding leases even if an untrusted pipe peer floods new groups.
            if (pending.Count >= 8) throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Format("Planner.QueueFull", 8));
            plan = new ClipPlan
            {
                SessionId = evt.SessionId, GroupId = evt.GroupId,
                FirstEventUs = evt.AtUs, StartUs = Math.Max(start, 0)
            };
            pending.Add(plan);
        }
        if (plan.Events.Count >= 256) throw new InvalidOperationException(Text.Format("Planner.TooManyEvents", 256));
        seen.Add(dedup);
        seenOrder.Enqueue(dedup);
        while (seenOrder.Count > 4096) seen.Remove(seenOrder.Dequeue());
        plan.StartUs = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(plan.StartUs, start));
        plan.LastEventUs = evt.AtUs;
        plan.EndUs = Math.Max(plan.EndUs, end);
        plan.ReadyAtUs = Math.Max(plan.EndUs, evt.AtUs + (settings.Coalesce ? gapUs : 0));
        plan.Events.Add(evt.HighlightId);
        return plan;
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<ClipPlan> TakeReady(long nowUs, bool force = false, int maximum = int.MaxValue)
    {
        if (maximum < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maximum));
        var ready = pending.Where(p => force || p.ReadyAtUs <= nowUs).Take(maximum).ToArray();
        foreach (var plan in ready) pending.Remove(plan);
        return ready;
    }
}
```
