`src/HuntReplay.Core/Storage/ClipLibrary.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Storage;

public sealed record ClipMetadata
{
    public string Owner { get; init; } = "HuntReplayStudio/1";
    public Guid Id { get; init; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public required string FileName { get; init; }
    public required string EventTag { get; init; }
    public string[] Events { get; init; } = [];
    public string GroupId { get; init; } = "";
    public DateTimeOffset CreatedAt { get; init; } = DateTimeOffset.Now;
    public double DurationSeconds { get; init; }
    public long Bytes { get; init; }
    public string Encoder { get; init; } = "";
    public bool TruncatedStart { get; init; }
    public bool TruncatedEnd { get; init; }
    /// <summary>Starred in the gallery. Lives in the record, so it follows a rename and goes with a delete.</summary>
    public bool Favorite { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>
/// A managed clip. For a clip stored by this version, <see cref="RecordPath"/> and <see cref="ThumbnailPath"/> point
/// into the application library, never into the clips folder. A 0.1.2 clip that Maintain has not adopted yet
/// points at its own sidecar files instead.
/// </summary>
public sealed record LibraryClip(string FullPath, ClipMetadata Metadata, string RecordPath, string ThumbnailPath);

/// <summary>What <see cref="ClipLibrary.Maintain"/> changed. Used for logging only.</summary>
public sealed record LibraryMaintenance(int Adopted, int Relocated, int Pruned);

/// <summary>On-disk library record: the clips folder that owns the clip, plus the clip metadata.</summary>
internal sealed record ClipRecord
{
    public required string Folder { get; init; }
    public required ClipMetadata Clip { get; init; }
}

/// <summary>A 0.1.2 sidecar (<c>name.mp4.hunt.json</c>) found in the clips folder.</summary>
internal sealed record LegacyClip(string Mp4Path, string SidecarPath, ClipMetadata Data);

/// <summary>
/// Clip library for one clips folder. The folder holds only MP4 files. Ownership and metadata are stored in
/// <c>{storeRoot}\records\{Id}.json</c>, thumbnails in <c>{storeRoot}\thumbs\{Id}.png</c>.
/// Sidecars written by 0.1.2 and earlier (<c>*.mp4.hunt.json</c>, <c>*.mp4.thumb.png</c>) are still read,
/// and <see cref="Maintain"/> moves them into the store.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ClipLibrary(string directory, string storeRoot)
{
    private const long MaxRecordBytes = 128 * 1024;
    private static readonly TimeSpan StaleTemporaryAge = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(10);
    // Mutations are serialized in-process so a rename, a retention pass and a maintenance pass cannot interleave.
    private static readonly object Gate = new();

    private readonly string recordsDirectory = Path.Combine(Path.GetFullPath(storeRoot), "records");
    private readonly string thumbnailsDirectory = Path.Combine(Path.GetFullPath(storeRoot), "thumbs");

    public string Root { get; } = Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(Path.GetFullPath(directory));

    /// <summary>Managed clips in this folder, newest first. Read-only.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<LibraryClip> List()
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(Root)) return [];
        var byPath = new Dictionary<string, LibraryClip>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var (filePath, record) in ReadRecords().OrderBy(r => r.FilePath, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            if (!SameFolder(record.Folder)) continue;
            var path = Path.Combine(Root, record.Clip.FileName);
            var metadata = Measure(path, record.Clip);
            if (metadata is not null) byPath.TryAdd(path, new(path, metadata, filePath, ThumbnailPathFor(record.Clip.Id)));
        }
        // 0.1.2 clips stay visible even before Maintain has moved them into the store.
        foreach (var legacy in ReadLegacy())
        {
            if (byPath.ContainsKey(legacy.Mp4Path)) continue;
            var metadata = Measure(legacy.Mp4Path, legacy.Data);
            // Until Maintain adopts it, a 0.1.2 clip is addressed through its own sidecar files. An Id shared with
            // another clip's record therefore can never make Delete or Rename touch that record or its thumbnail.
            if (metadata is not null)
                byPath.Add(legacy.Mp4Path, new(legacy.Mp4Path, metadata, legacy.SidecarPath, legacy.Mp4Path + ".thumb.png"));
        }
        return byPath.Values.OrderByDescending(c => c.Metadata.CreatedAt).ToArray();
    }

    public string NewPath(string template, string eventTag, DateTimeOffset time)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Root);
        var name = ClipFileName.Create(template, eventTag, time);
        var path = Resolve(name);
        if (File.Exists(path) || File.Exists(path + ".partial.mp4") || File.Exists(path + ".hunt.json") || RecordedFileNames().Contains(name))
            path = Resolve(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(name) + "_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8] + ".mp4");
        return path;
    }

    public LibraryClip Register(string path, ClipMetadata metadata)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            EnsureChild(path);
            if (!File.Exists(path) || IsLink(path)) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Library.ClipMissingOrLink"));
            return WriteRecord(path, metadata with { FileName = Path.GetFileName(path), Bytes = new FileInfo(path).Length });
        }
    }

    public LibraryClip Rename(LibraryClip clip, string newName)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            EnsureOwned(clip);
            if (!ClipFileName.IsSafeName(newName)) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Library.InvalidMp4Name"));
            var target = Resolve(newName);
            if (string.Equals(clip.FullPath, target, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return clip;
            if (File.Exists(target) || File.Exists(target + ".hunt.json")) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Library.NameTaken"));
            File.Move(clip.FullPath, target);
            LibraryClip renamed;
            try { renamed = WriteRecord(target, clip.Metadata with { FileName = newName, Id = FreeId(clip) }); }
            catch { File.Move(target, clip.FullPath); throw; } // The record did not change, so the MP4 goes back.
            // The record is authoritative now; 0.1.2 leftovers beside the old name are retired best-effort.
            RetireLegacy(clip.FullPath, renamed.Metadata.Id);
            return renamed;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Stars or unstars a clip. The MP4 is never touched; a 0.1.2 clip is adopted into the store on the way.</summary>
    public LibraryClip SetFavorite(LibraryClip clip, bool favorite)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            EnsureOwned(clip);
            var updated = WriteRecord(clip.FullPath, clip.Metadata with { Favorite = favorite, Id = FreeId(clip) });
            if (!string.Equals(clip.RecordPath, updated.RecordPath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) RetireLegacy(clip.FullPath, updated.Metadata.Id);
            return updated;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The Id a clip keeps when its record is rewritten. A 0.1.2 clip whose Id is already used by another record
    /// or thumbnail (a copied clips folder) gets a fresh Id, so the other clip's files are never overwritten.
    /// </summary>
    private Guid FreeId(LibraryClip clip)
    {
        var id = clip.Metadata.Id;
        var isOwnRecord = string.Equals(clip.RecordPath, RecordPathFor(id), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        return isOwnRecord || (!File.Exists(RecordPathFor(id)) && !File.Exists(ThumbnailPathFor(id))) ? id : Guid.NewGuid();
    }

    public void Delete(LibraryClip clip)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            EnsureOwned(clip);
            DeleteListed(clip);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes each clip on its own and returns the ones that failed: a clip whose MP4 is locked stays listed,
    /// the rest are still deleted. One listing proves ownership for all of them.
    /// </summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<(LibraryClip Clip, Exception Error)> DeleteEach(IEnumerable<LibraryClip> clips)
    {
        var failed = new List<(LibraryClip, Exception)>();
        lock (Gate)
        {
            var listed = List().ToDictionary(c => c.FullPath, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var clip in clips)
            {
                try
                {
                    if (!listed.TryGetValue(clip.FullPath, out var actual) || actual.Metadata.Id != clip.Metadata.Id)
                        throw new IOException(Text.Get("Library.NotOwned"));
                    DeleteListed(actual);
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { failed.Add((clip, ex)); }
            }
        }
        return failed;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Deletes a clip whose ownership is already proven: the caller holds <see cref="Gate"/> and took the clip
    /// from <see cref="List"/> in the same critical section, so the full record re-scan of EnsureOwned is skipped.
    /// </summary>
    private void DeleteListed(LibraryClip clip)
    {
        EnsureNoLinks(clip);
        File.Delete(clip.FullPath); // If locked by a player, metadata remains intact.
        // Metadata goes last: if the MP4 survives, the clip stays listed and can be retried.
        DeleteIfExists(clip.ThumbnailPath);
        DeleteIfExists(clip.RecordPath);
        RetireLegacy(clip.FullPath, null);
    }

    public int EnforceLimit(StorageSettings settings, ISet<Guid>? protectedIds = null)
    {
        if (!settings.AutoCleanup || settings.LimitGb == 0) return 0;
        return EnforceByteLimit(settings.LimitGb * 1_000_000_000L, protectedIds);
    }

    public int EnforceByteLimit(long limit, ISet<Guid>? protectedIds = null)
    {
        if (limit < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(limit));
        if (limit == 0) return 0;
        lock (Gate)
        {
            // One listing for the whole pass: per-clip Delete would re-read every record for each removal.
            var clips = List();
            var bytes = clips.Sum(c => c.Metadata.Bytes);
            var removed = 0;
            foreach (var clip in clips.OrderBy(c => c.Metadata.CreatedAt))
            {
                if (bytes <= limit) break;
                if (protectedIds?.Contains(clip.Metadata.Id) == true) continue;
                try { DeleteListed(clip); bytes -= clip.Metadata.Bytes; removed++; }
                catch (IOException) { /* Busy files are not force-deleted. */ }
                catch (UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
            }
            return removed;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Brings the store in line with the clips folder: moves 0.1.2 sidecars into the store, follows a renamed
    /// clips folder, and removes records and thumbnails whose MP4 was deleted outside Studio.
    /// Files Studio did not write are never touched, and broken records are left in place.
    /// </summary>
    public LibraryMaintenance Maintain()
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(recordsDirectory);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(thumbnailsDirectory);
            var adopted = AdoptLegacy();
            var relocated = FollowFolderMove();
            var pruned = PruneOrphans();
            RemoveStaleTemporaryFiles();
            return new(adopted, relocated, pruned);
        }
    }

    public static void RequireDiskSpace(string path, long estimatedBytes)
    {
        var root = Path.GetPathRoot(Path.GetFullPath(path))!;
        DriveInfo drive;
        try { drive = new DriveInfo(root); }
        catch (ArgumentException) { return; } // UNC shares cannot be queried; a full share still fails the write itself.
        if (drive.IsReady && drive.AvailableFreeSpace < estimatedBytes + 128L * 1024 * 1024)
            throw new IOException(Text.Get("Library.NotEnoughSpace"));
    }

    private LibraryClip WriteRecord(string path, ClipMetadata clip)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(recordsDirectory);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(thumbnailsDirectory);
        var recordPath = RecordPathFor(clip.Id);
        WriteJson(recordPath, new ClipRecord { Folder = Root, Clip = clip });
        return new(path, clip, recordPath, ThumbnailPathFor(clip.Id));
    }

    private int AdoptLegacy()
    {
        var adopted = 0;
        var records = ReadRecords();
        foreach (var legacy in ReadLegacy())
        {
            try
            {
                var fileName = Path.GetFileName(legacy.Mp4Path);
                var owner = records.FirstOrDefault(r => SameFolder(r.Record.Folder) &&
                    string.Equals(r.Record.Clip.FileName, fileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (owner.Record is not null)
                {
                    // The store already owns this file. The same Id means an earlier run stopped before the sidecar was removed.
                    if (owner.Record.Clip.Id == legacy.Data.Id) RetireLegacy(legacy.Mp4Path, legacy.Data.Id);
                    continue;
                }
                // Keep the Id unless a record or thumbnail with it already exists (for example, a copied clips folder).
                var id = File.Exists(RecordPathFor(legacy.Data.Id)) || File.Exists(ThumbnailPathFor(legacy.Data.Id))
                    ? Guid.NewGuid() : legacy.Data.Id;
                var clip = legacy.Data with { Id = id, Bytes = new FileInfo(legacy.Mp4Path).Length };
                WriteJson(RecordPathFor(id), new ClipRecord { Folder = Root, Clip = clip });
                RetireLegacy(legacy.Mp4Path, id);
                adopted++;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
            { /* The sidecar stays; the clip remains visible through the legacy path in List(). */ }
        }
        return adopted;
    }

    private int FollowFolderMove()
    {
        var moved = 0;
        var records = ReadRecords();
        var claimed = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var (filePath, record) in records)
        {
            try
            {
                if (SameFolder(record.Folder) || !Directory.Exists(Root)) continue;
                var name = record.Clip.FileName;
                // The old MP4 is gone and the same name exists here: the clips folder was moved or renamed.
                if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(record.Folder, name)) || !IsManagedMp4(Path.Combine(Root, name)) || !claimed.Add(name)) continue;
                if (records.Any(other => SameFolder(other.Record.Folder) &&
                    string.Equals(other.Record.Clip.FileName, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) continue;
                WriteJson(filePath, record with { Folder = Root });
                moved++;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        return moved;
    }

    private int PruneOrphans()
    {
        var pruned = 0;
        // Records are read before the folder listing: a clip registered after this point is never pruned.
        var records = ReadRecords();
        if (Directory.Exists(Root) && PresentFileNames() is { } present)
        {
            foreach (var (filePath, record) in records)
            {
                if (!SameFolder(record.Folder) || present.Contains(record.Clip.FileName)) continue;
                try
                {
                    DeleteIfExists(filePath);
                    DeleteIfExists(ThumbnailPathFor(record.Clip.Id));
                    pruned++;
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
            }
            pruned += PruneLegacyOrphans(present);
        }
        foreach (var thumbnail in FilesMatching(thumbnailsDirectory, "*.png"))
        {
            try
            {
                if (Guid.TryParseExact(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(thumbnail), "D", out var id) && !File.Exists(RecordPathFor(id)))
                {
                    File.Delete(thumbnail);
                    pruned++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        return pruned;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 0.1.2 leftovers whose MP4 was deleted outside Studio. Only valid sidecars and their thumbnails are removed;
    /// a broken sidecar is kept, as is anything whose MP4 still exists.
    /// </summary>
    private int PruneLegacyOrphans(HashSet<string> present)
    {
        var pruned = 0;
        foreach (var sidecar in FilesMatching(Root, "*.mp4.hunt.json"))
        {
            try
            {
                if (IsLink(sidecar) || new FileInfo(sidecar).Length > MaxRecordBytes) continue;
                var data = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ClipMetadata>(File.ReadAllText(sidecar), StudioSettings.JsonOptions);
                if (data is null || !IsValid(data) || present.Contains(data.FileName)) continue;
                var mp4 = Path.Combine(Root, data.FileName);
                if (!string.Equals(mp4 + ".hunt.json", sidecar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                RetireLegacy(mp4, null);
                pruned++;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or JsonException or UnauthorizedAccessException or InvalidDataException or NotSupportedException)
            { /* Broken sidecars are never deleted automatically. */ }
        }
        foreach (var thumbnail in FilesMatching(Root, "*.mp4.thumb.png"))
        {
            try
            {
                var mp4Name = Path.GetFileName(thumbnail)[..^".thumb.png".Length];
                if (present.Contains(mp4Name) || IsLink(thumbnail)) continue;
                File.Delete(thumbnail);
                pruned++;
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
        }
        return pruned;
    }

    private void RemoveStaleTemporaryFiles()
    {
        // *.partial.mp4 in the clips folder is an export or trim that a crash or power loss interrupted.
        foreach (var (directory, pattern) in new[] { (recordsDirectory, "*.tmp"), (thumbnailsDirectory, "*.tmp"), (Root, "*.partial.mp4") })
        {
            foreach (var temp in FilesMatching(directory, pattern))
            {
                try { if (!IsLink(temp) && DateTime.UtcNow - File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(temp) > StaleTemporaryAge) File.Delete(temp); }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { }
            }
        }
    }

    private HashSet<string>? PresentFileNames()
    {
        try
        {
            var names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(Root)) names.Add(Path.GetFileName(file));
            return names;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { return null; }
    }

    private HashSet<string> RecordedFileNames() =>
        ReadRecords().Where(r => SameFolder(r.Record.Folder)).Select(r => r.Record.Clip.FileName)
            .ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>Removes 0.1.2 sidecars beside an MP4. With an Id, its legacy thumbnail moves into the store.</summary>
    private void RetireLegacy(string mp4Path, Guid? keepThumbnailFor)
    {
        try
        {
            var legacyThumbnail = mp4Path + ".thumb.png";
            if (File.Exists(legacyThumbnail) && keepThumbnailFor is { } id && !File.Exists(ThumbnailPathFor(id)))
                File.Move(legacyThumbnail, ThumbnailPathFor(id));
            else
                DeleteIfExists(legacyThumbnail);
            DeleteIfExists(mp4Path + ".hunt.json");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        { /* Best effort: the store record is authoritative, and List() never shows a duplicate. */ }
    }

    /// <summary>Valid records in the store. Broken files are skipped, never deleted.</summary>
    private List<(string FilePath, ClipRecord Record)> ReadRecords()
    {
        var result = new List<(string FilePath, ClipRecord Record)>();
        foreach (var file in FilesMatching(recordsDirectory, "*.json"))
        {
            try
            {
                if (IsLink(file) || new FileInfo(file).Length > MaxRecordBytes) continue;
                var record = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ClipRecord>(File.ReadAllText(file), StudioSettings.JsonOptions);
                if (record is not null && IsValidRecord(file, record)) result.Add((file, record));
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or JsonException or UnauthorizedAccessException or InvalidDataException or NotSupportedException)
            { /* One broken record does not hide healthy clips. */ }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>0.1.2 sidecars in the clips folder whose MP4 exists. Broken sidecars are skipped, never deleted.</summary>
    private List<LegacyClip> ReadLegacy()
    {
        var result = new List<LegacyClip>();
        foreach (var sidecar in FilesMatching(Root, "*.mp4.hunt.json"))
        {
            try
            {
                if (IsLink(sidecar) || new FileInfo(sidecar).Length > MaxRecordBytes) continue;
                var data = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ClipMetadata>(File.ReadAllText(sidecar), StudioSettings.JsonOptions);
                if (data is null || !IsValid(data)) continue;
                var mp4 = Path.Combine(Root, data.FileName);
                if (!string.Equals(mp4 + ".hunt.json", sidecar, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || !IsManagedMp4(mp4)) continue;
                result.Add(new(mp4, sidecar, data));
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or JsonException or UnauthorizedAccessException or InvalidDataException or NotSupportedException)
            { /* One broken sidecar does not hide all healthy clips. */ }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static string[] FilesMatching(string directory, string pattern)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(directory)) return [];
        try
        {
            return Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, pattern, new EnumerationOptions
            {
                RecurseSubdirectories = false, MatchCasing = MatchCasing.CaseInsensitive, IgnoreInaccessible = true
            }).ToArray();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { return []; }
    }

    private static ClipMetadata? Measure(string mp4Path, ClipMetadata data)
    {
        try { return IsManagedMp4(mp4Path) ? data with { Bytes = new FileInfo(mp4Path).Length } : null; }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { return null; }
    }

    private static bool IsValid(ClipMetadata data) =>
        data.Owner == "HuntReplayStudio/1" && data.Id != Guid.Empty && ClipFileName.IsSafeName(data.FileName) &&
        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(data.EventTag) && data.EventTag.Length <= 512 &&
        double.IsFinite(data.DurationSeconds) && data.DurationSeconds >= 0 && data.DurationSeconds <= 86400;

    private static bool IsValidRecord(string filePath, ClipRecord record) =>
        Path.IsPathFullyQualified(record.Folder) && IsValid(record.Clip) &&
        string.Equals(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(filePath), record.Clip.Id.ToString("D"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private bool SameFolder(string folder) => string.Equals(folder, Root, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private static bool IsManagedMp4(string path) => File.Exists(path) && !IsLink(path);

    private string RecordPathFor(Guid id) => Path.Combine(recordsDirectory, id.ToString("D") + ".json");

    private string ThumbnailPathFor(Guid id) => Path.Combine(thumbnailsDirectory, id.ToString("D") + ".png");

    private string Resolve(string name)
    {
        if (!ClipFileName.IsSafeName(name)) throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Library.InvalidClipName"));
        var path = Path.Combine(Root, name);
        EnsureChild(path);
        return path;
    }

    private void EnsureChild(string path)
    {
        if (!string.Equals(Path.GetDirectoryName(Path.GetFullPath(path)), Root, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidDataException(Text.Get("Library.OutsideLibrary"));
        if (Directory.Exists(Root) && IsLink(Root)) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Library.RootIsLink"));
    }

    private void EnsureNoLinks(LibraryClip clip)
    {
        EnsureChild(clip.FullPath);
        if (IsLink(clip.FullPath) || IsExistingLink(clip.RecordPath) || IsExistingLink(clip.ThumbnailPath) ||
            IsExistingLink(clip.FullPath + ".hunt.json") || IsExistingLink(clip.FullPath + ".thumb.png"))
            throw new IOException(Text.Get("Library.LinksForbidden"));
    }

    private void EnsureOwned(LibraryClip clip)
    {
        EnsureNoLinks(clip);
        var actual = List().FirstOrDefault(c => c.FullPath == clip.FullPath);
        if (actual?.Metadata.Id != clip.Metadata.Id) throw new IOException(Text.Get("Library.NotOwned"));
    }

    private static bool IsExistingLink(string path) => File.Exists(path) && IsLink(path);

    private static bool IsLink(string path) => (File.GetAttributes(path) & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0;

    private static void DeleteIfExists(string path)
    {
        if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
    }

    private static void WriteJson<T>(string path, T value)
    {
        var temp = path + "." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N") + ".tmp";
        try
        {
            File.WriteAllText(temp, JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, StudioSettings.JsonOptions));
            File.Move(temp, path, true);
        }
        finally { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); }
    }
}
```

```cs
using HuntReplay.Core.Updates;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Support;

public enum SupportKind { Link, Address }

/// <summary>One voluntary way to support the project: a web page to open or a wallet address to copy.</summary>
public sealed record SupportChannel(string Name, string Value, SupportKind Kind)
{
    public bool IsLink => Kind == SupportKind.Link;
}

/// <summary>
/// The support options shown under the sidebar menu. Empty values and non-https links are never shown.
/// </summary>
public static class SupportChannels
{
    private static readonly SupportChannel[] All =
    [
        new("GitHub  ★", "https://github.com/" + AppUpdate.Repository, SupportKind.Link),
        new("BTC", "bc1qw832etct0lnqt44kypfafcaja2ct2y87fesmfd", SupportKind.Address),
        new("USDT (TRC20)", "TFjByTWMDwAzK5YjQtZnQGudf9opdTPJvb", SupportKind.Address),
        new("GRAM (TON)", "UQAeC2GV1UvNG1hujzujOTVuyaO5MMMl-BaUMTLM8Zz5lrxF", SupportKind.Address),
        new("Solana (SOL)", "8JGp9eLaCN5HfCP1JDcjCi4wywJD2nSzCECT5UUSyMsD", SupportKind.Address),
    ];

    public static IReadOnlyList<SupportChannel> Available { get; } = Filter(All);

    public static IReadOnlyList<SupportChannel> Filter(IEnumerable<SupportChannel> channels) =>
        channels.Where(c => c.Kind == SupportKind.Link ? IsSafeLink(c.Value) : !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(c.Value)).ToArray();

    public static bool IsSafeLink(string? url) =>
        Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri) && uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps;
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Core/Updates/AppUpdate.cs`:

```cs
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace HuntReplay.Core.Updates;

/// <summary>The parts of a GitHub release the updater needs. Every URL is already checked against this repository.</summary>
public sealed record ReleaseInfo(string Version, string? PageUrl, string? Notes, string? AssetUrl, string? Sha256);

/// <summary>Release parsing, download verification and the in-place executable swap; no network or UI.</summary>
public static class AppUpdate
{
    public const string Repository = "Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights";
    public const string ReleasesPage = "https://github.com/" + Repository + "/releases";
    public const string AssetName = "HuntReplayStudio.exe";

    /// <summary>Reads a GitHub "latest release" response. Untrusted URLs and malformed digests become null.</summary>
    public static ReleaseInfo ParseRelease(JsonElement root)
    {
        static string Prop(JsonElement e, string name) =>
            e.TryGetProperty(name, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? v.GetString() ?? "" : "";
        string? assetUrl = null, sha256 = null;
        if (root.TryGetProperty("assets", out var assets) && assets.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
            foreach (var asset in assets.EnumerateArray())
            {
                if (!string.Equals(Prop(asset, "name"), AssetName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                var url = Prop(asset, "browser_download_url");
                assetUrl = IsTrustedAssetUrl(url) ? url : null;
                sha256 = ParseSha256Digest(Prop(asset, "digest"));
                break;
            }
        var page = Prop(root, "html_url");
        var notes = Prop(root, "body");
        return new(Prop(root, "tag_name").TrimStart('v', 'V').Trim(), IsTrustedPageUrl(page) ? page : null,
            notes.Length == 0 ? null : notes, assetUrl, sha256);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Release notes as plain text for a message box: links cannot be clicked there, so URLs and lines that were only a
    /// link ("**Full Changelog**: https://...") go, and Markdown markers become plain text. Null when nothing is left.
    /// </summary>
    public static string? PlainNotes(string? markdown)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(markdown)) return null;
        var lines = new List<string>();
        foreach (var raw in markdown.Replace("\r", "").Split('\n'))
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw)) { lines.Add(""); continue; } // Paragraph break.
            var line = Url.Replace(Link.Replace(raw, "$1"), "").Replace("**", "").Replace("__", "").Replace("`", "").TrimEnd();
            line = TrailingIn.Replace(line, ""); // GitHub's generated notes: "* Change by @user in <PR link>".
            var content = line.TrimStart('#', ' ', '\t');
            // Drop lines that were only a link, including a label pointing at it.
            if (content.TrimEnd(':').Trim().Length == 0 || content.EndsWith(':') && raw.Contains("://", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
            if (line.TrimStart().StartsWith('#')) line = content;
            else if (line.TrimStart() is ['*' or '-', ' ', ..] item) line = "• " + item[2..];
            lines.Add(line);
        }
        var text = string.Join('\n', lines).Trim();
        while (text.Contains("\n\n\n", StringComparison.Ordinal)) text = text.Replace("\n\n\n", "\n\n");
        return text.Length == 0 ? null : text;
    }

    private static readonly Regex Link = new(@"\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
    private static readonly Regex Url = new(@"<?https?://\S+?>?(?=[\s)\]]|$)", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);
    private static readonly Regex TrailingIn = new(@"\s+in\s*$", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    public static bool IsNewer(string latest, string current) =>
        Version.TryParse(latest, out var l) && Version.TryParse(current, out var c) && l > c;

    /// <summary>Only this repository's pages on github.com, over HTTPS.</summary>
    public static bool IsTrustedPageUrl(string? url) =>
        Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var u) && u.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps && u.Host == "github.com" &&
        u.AbsolutePath.StartsWith("/" + Repository + "/", StringComparison.Ordinal);

    /// <summary>Only this repository's release downloads; GitHub redirects them to its own storage over HTTPS.</summary>
    public static bool IsTrustedAssetUrl(string? url) =>
        Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var u) && u.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps && u.Host == "github.com" &&
        u.AbsolutePath.StartsWith("/" + Repository + "/releases/download/", StringComparison.Ordinal) &&
        u.AbsolutePath.EndsWith("/" + AssetName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    /// <summary>GitHub's asset digest is "sha256:&lt;64 hex&gt;"; returns the lower-case hex, or null for anything else.</summary>
    public static string? ParseSha256Digest(string? digest)
    {
        const string prefix = "sha256:";
        if (digest is null || !digest.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return null;
        var hex = digest[prefix.Length..].Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
        return hex.Length == 64 && hex.All(Uri.IsHexDigit) ? hex : null;
    }

    public static async Task<bool> MatchesSha256Async(string path, string expectedHex, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await using var stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, 1 << 16, useAsync: true);
        var hash = await SHA256.HashDataAsync(stream, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return string.Equals(Convert.ToHexString(hash), expectedHex, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    /// <summary>Where the new executable is downloaded: beside the current one, so the final move stays on one volume.</summary>
    public static string StagingPath(string executable) => executable + ".download";
    /// <summary>Where the replaced executable waits until the next start deletes it.</summary>
    public static string BackupPath(string executable) => executable + ".old";

    /// <summary>
    /// Puts <paramref name="staged"/> in place of <paramref name="executable"/>. Windows allows renaming a running
    /// executable, so the current one moves aside first; if the new one cannot be moved in, the old one is put back.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Replace(string executable, string staged)
    {
        var backup = BackupPath(executable);
        if (File.Exists(backup)) File.Delete(backup);
        File.Move(executable, backup);
        try { File.Move(staged, executable); }
        catch
        {
            File.Move(backup, executable);
            throw;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Best effort: removes what a previous update left behind. Returns false when a file is still locked.</summary>
    public static bool CleanUp(string executable)
    {
        bool clean = true;
        foreach (var path in new[] { BackupPath(executable), StagingPath(executable) })
        {
            try { if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path); }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException) { clean = false; }
        }
        return clean;
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Protocol/BusFraming.cs`:

```cs
using System.Buffers.Binary;
using Google.Protobuf;
using HuntReplay.Protocol.Generated;

namespace HuntReplay.Protocol;

public static class BusFraming
{
    public const int MaximumMessageBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

    public static async ValueTask<BusMessage?> ReadAsync(Stream stream, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var header = new byte[4];
        // An idle game may have no events for a long time. Only a started frame gets a deadline.
        if (await stream.ReadAsync(header.AsMemory(0, 1), token).ConfigureAwait(false) == 0) return null;
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(token);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header.AsMemory(1), deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        var length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32BigEndian(header);
        if (length == 0 || length > MaximumMessageBytes) throw new InvalidDataException("Invalid bus frame length.");
        var payload = new byte[checked((int)length)];
        await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(payload, deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return BusMessage.Parser.ParseFrom(payload);
    }

    public static async ValueTask WriteAsync(Stream stream, BusMessage message, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var payload = message.ToByteArray();
        if (payload.Length > MaximumMessageBytes) throw new InvalidDataException("Bus response too large.");
        var header = new byte[4];
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt32BigEndian(header, (uint)payload.Length);
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(token);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));
        await stream.WriteAsync(header, deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await stream.WriteAsync(payload, deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        await stream.FlushAsync(deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
    }
}
```

`src/HuntReplay.Protocol/HighlightsSession.cs`:

```cs
using Google.Protobuf;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;
using HuntReplay.Core.Replay;
using HuntReplay.Protocol.Generated;

namespace HuntReplay.Protocol;

/// <summary>One protocol state machine per pipe connection; no shared game/group state.</summary>
public sealed class HighlightsSession
{
    private readonly Func<long> nowUs;
    private readonly Func<string, bool> enabled;
    private readonly Func<HighlightEvent, bool> onHighlight;
    private readonly Action<string> log;
    private readonly uint clientPid;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, BusMessage[]> responses = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Queue<string> responseOrder = new();
    private readonly HashSet<string> definitions = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> groups = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> groupEpochs = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private readonly HashSet<string> closedGroups = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private bool joined;
    private bool authorized;
    private bool controlIdentifierLogged;
    private int sdkSequence, currentOrdinal;
    private string joinedSystem = "", joinedModule = "";
    public string SessionId { get; } = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
    public string? GameName { get; private set; }
    public event Action<string?>? GameChanged;

    public HighlightsSession(uint clientPid, Func<long> nowUs, Func<string, bool> enabled,
        Func<HighlightEvent, bool> onHighlight, Action<string> log)
    {
        this.clientPid = clientPid;
        this.nowUs = nowUs;
        this.enabled = enabled;
        this.onHighlight = onHighlight;
        this.log = log;
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<BusMessage> Process(BusMessage bus)
    {
        // Bus-level ACKs/presence/leave frames are not SDK calls. Their protobuf
        // strings may be empty, and IDs need not identify new SDK requests. The
        // original server ignored them: don't disconnect, cache or ACK an ACK.
        if (bus.EncryptedBusMessage is not null || bus.Encryptionsetup is not null)
            throw new InvalidDataException("Encrypted NVIDIA IPC is not supported by this video protocol implementation.");
        SDKIPCRequest? request = null;
        if (!bus.Joined)
        {
            if (bus.Generic is not { Data.Length: > 0 } generic) return [];
            var message = SDKIPCMessage.Parser.ParseFrom(generic.Data);
            if (message.MessageCase != SDKIPCMessage.MessageOneofCase.Request) return [];
            if (!joined) throw new InvalidDataException("SDK request before bus JOIN.");
            request = message.Request;
        }
        string kind = bus.Joined ? "JOIN" : "SDK/" + request!.RequestCase;
        // Opaque correlation token: bounded and well-formed, never normalized. Control characters
        // (the field report had a 37-unit token) are echoed exactly so the game can match replies.
        CheckCorrelationId(bus.Uniqueid, kind);
        if (!controlIdentifierLogged && bus.Uniqueid.Any(char.IsControl))
        {
            controlIdentifierLogged = true;
            log(Text.Format("Ipc.ControlCharsInId", DescribeControls(bus.Uniqueid)));
        }
        // Routing identity can be omitted on subsequent messages on an already joined pipe.
        CheckText(bus.SourceSystem, 256, $"BusMessage.source_system ({kind})", allowEmpty: !bus.Joined);
        CheckText(bus.SourceModule, 256, $"BusMessage.source_module ({kind})", allowEmpty: !bus.Joined);
        if (responses.TryGetValue(bus.Uniqueid, out var cached)) return cached;
        var replies = new List<BusMessage>();
        if (bus.Joined)
        {
            joined = true;
            joinedSystem = bus.SourceSystem; joinedModule = bus.SourceModule;
            var reply = ReplyEnvelope(bus, "MessageBusBroadcast", "Broadcaster");
            reply.BusPeer.Add(new BusMessage.Types.Peer { System = "NvNode", Module = "SDKAPI" });
            replies.Add(reply);
            replies.Add(new BusMessage
            {
                Uniqueid = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), SourceSystem = "NvNode", SourceModule = "SDKAPI", Joined = true
            });
            log($"IPC JOIN · {Clean(bus.SourceSystem)}:{Clean(bus.SourceModule)} · PID {clientPid}");
        }
        else if (request is not null)
        {
            // Per-session ordinal correlates request and refusal lines without printing the token.
            var ordinal = currentOrdinal = ++sdkSequence;
            if (request.RequestCase != SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.IsClientAliveRequest)
                log($"IPC SDK #{ordinal} · {request.RequestCase} · PID {clientPid}");
            currentRequestId = bus.Uniqueid;
            SDKIPCResponse response;
            try { response = Handle(request); }
            catch (InvalidDataException ex)
            {
                // The SDK call is correlatable: reject it without tearing down a healthy pipe.
                response = Failure(ex.Message);
            }
            if (response.Retval != 0) log(Text.Format("Ipc.Refused", ordinal, request.RequestCase, response.Retstatus));
            var envelope = ReplyEnvelope(bus, "NvNode", "SDKAPI");
            envelope.Generic = new BusMessage.Types.Generic
            {
                Type = 2, Data = new SDKIPCMessage { Response = response }.ToByteString()
            };
            replies.Add(envelope);
            if (request.RequestCase == SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.RequestPermissionRequest && response.Retval == 0)
            {
                var notification = new PermissionsChangedNotification();
                foreach (var scope in request.RequestPermissionRequest.Scopes)
                    notification.ScopePermission.Add(new ScopePermission { Scope = scope, Permission = scope is >= 1 and <= 7 ? 1u : 0u });
                var notice = ReplyEnvelope(bus, "NvNode", "SDKAPI");
                notice.Generic = new BusMessage.Types.Generic
                {
                    Type = 3, Data = new SDKIPCMessage
                    {
                        Notification = new SDKIPCNotification
                        {
                            Component = request.Component, PermissionsChangedNotification = notification
                        }
                    }.ToByteString()
                };
                replies.Add(notice);
            }
        }
        var result = replies.ToArray();
        responses[bus.Uniqueid] = result;
        responseOrder.Enqueue(bus.Uniqueid);
        // Also bounds response cache memory: incoming configuration art is never echoed back.
        while (responseOrder.Count > 128) responses.Remove(responseOrder.Dequeue());
        return result;
    }

    private SDKIPCResponse Handle(SDKIPCRequest request)
    {
        var response = new SDKIPCResponse { Retval = 0, Retstatus = "SUCCESS" };
        if (request.VersionMajor != 1) return Failure("UNSUPPORTED_IPC_VERSION");
        if (!authorized && request.RequestCase is not (SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.CreateSDKInstanceRequest or
                SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.GetUILanguageRequest or SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.IsClientAliveRequest))
            return Failure("SDK_INSTANCE_REQUIRED");
        switch (request.RequestCase)
        {
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.CreateSDKInstanceRequest:
                var create = request.CreateSDKInstanceRequest;
                if (create.ClientPID != clientPid) return Failure("CLIENT_PID_MISMATCH");
                // client is descriptive text, not authentication. A required proto2 string
                // can validly be empty; authorization still requires the actual pipe-client PID.
                CheckText(create.Client, 256, "createSDKInstanceRequest.client", allowEmpty: true);
                var instance = new CreateSDKInstanceResponse
                {
                    InstalledGfeVersion = "3.28.0.412", InstalledGfeSDKIPCVersionMajor = 1, InstalledGfeSDKIPCVersionMinor = 0
                };
                var scopes = create.Scopes.Count > 0 ? create.Scopes.ToArray() : [1u, 2u, 3u, 4u, 5u, 6u, 7u];
                if (scopes.Length > 32) return Failure("TOO_MANY_SCOPES");
                foreach (var scope in scopes)
                    instance.ScopePermission.Add(new ScopePermission { Scope = scope, Permission = scope is >= 1 and <= 7 ? 1u : 0u });
                response.CreateSDKInstanceResponse = instance;
                authorized = true;
                GameName = Clean(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(create.GameName) ? create.ClientProcessName : create.GameName);
                GameChanged?.Invoke(GameName);
                log(Text.Format("Ipc.Authorized", GameName));
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.ConfigureHighlightsRequest:
                var highlights = request.ConfigureHighlightsRequest.HighlightTable;
                if (highlights.Count > 256) return Failure("TOO_MANY_DEFINITIONS");
                // Validate before replacing live state; a rejected request must not
                // leave half a configuration on the now-still-connected session.
                foreach (var item in highlights) CheckText(item.HighlightId, 128, "configureHighlightsRequest.highlightId");
                definitions.Clear();
                foreach (var item in highlights) definitions.Add(item.HighlightId);
                log(Text.Format("Ipc.EventsRegistered", string.Join(", ", definitions.Select(Clean))));
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.OpenGroupRequest:
                var group = request.OpenGroupRequest.GroupId;
                CheckText(group, 256, "openGroupRequest.groupId");
                if (groups.Count >= 128 && !groups.ContainsKey(group)) return Failure("TOO_MANY_GROUPS");
                if (!groups.ContainsKey(group) || closedGroups.Remove(group))
                {
                    groups[group] = 0;
                    groupEpochs[group] = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
                }
                log(Text.Format("Ipc.MatchStarted", Clean(group)));
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.CloseGroupRequest:
                // Do not cancel post-roll and do not delete real files on destroyHighlights.
                // The SDK owns virtual groups; the user's library owns saved clips.
                var close = request.CloseGroupRequest;
                CheckText(close.GroupId, 256, "closeGroupRequest.groupId");
                if (!groups.ContainsKey(close.GroupId)) return Failure("GROUP_NOT_FOUND");
                closedGroups.Add(close.GroupId);
                if (close.DestroyHighlights)
                {
                    groups.Remove(close.GroupId); groupEpochs.Remove(close.GroupId); closedGroups.Remove(close.GroupId);
                }
                log(Text.Format("Ipc.MatchEnded", Clean(close.GroupId)));
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.SetVideoHighlightRequest:
                var video = request.SetVideoHighlightRequest;
                CheckText(video.HighlightId, 128, "setVideoHighlightRequest.highlightId");
                CheckText(video.GroupId, 256, "setVideoHighlightRequest.groupId");
                if (!groups.ContainsKey(video.GroupId)) return Failure("GROUP_NOT_FOUND");
                if (!definitions.Contains(video.HighlightId)) return Failure("HIGHLIGHT_NOT_CONFIGURED");
                if (!enabled(video.HighlightId))
                {
                    // A user-disabled event is a valid no-op; log it so a missing clip is traceable.
                    log(Text.Format("Ipc.EventDisabled", currentOrdinal, Clean(video.HighlightId)));
                    break;
                }
                // baseTimeStamp has an SDK-specific clock domain; never compare it to Unix time/QPC.
                var evt = new HighlightEvent(SessionId + ":" + groupEpochs[video.GroupId], currentRequestId, video.GroupId, video.HighlightId,
                    nowUs(), video.StartDelta, video.EndDelta);
                if (!onHighlight(evt)) return Failure("CAPTURE_NOT_READY_OR_QUEUE_FULL");
                groups[video.GroupId]++;
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.GetUserConfigRequest:
                var config = new GetUserConfigResponse { GameEnabled = true };
                foreach (var id in definitions)
                    config.HighlightTable.Add(new GetUserConfigResponse.Types.HighlightConfig { HighlightId = id, UserEnabled = enabled(id) });
                response.GetUserConfigResponse = config;
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.GetUILanguageRequest:
                response.GetUILanguageResponse = new GetUILanguageResponse { LocaleName = "en-US" };
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.IsClientAliveRequest:
                response.IsClientAliveResponse = new IsClientAliveResponse { Alive = true };
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupRequest:
                CheckText(request.GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupRequest.GroupId, 256, "getNumberOfHighlightsInGroupRequest.groupId");
                response.GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupResponse = new GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupResponse
                {
                    NumberOfHighlights = groups.GetValueOrDefault(request.GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupRequest.GroupId)
                };
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.DestroySDKInstanceRequest:
                authorized = false;
                GameName = null;
                GameChanged?.Invoke(null);
                definitions.Clear();
                groups.Clear(); groupEpochs.Clear(); closedGroups.Clear();
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.RequestPermissionRequest:
                if (request.RequestPermissionRequest.Scopes.Count > 32) return Failure("TOO_MANY_SCOPES");
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.OpenGroupSummaryRequest:
                log(Text.Get("Ipc.SummaryRequested"));
                break;
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.SetScreenshotHighlightRequest:
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.ToggleOverlayRequest:
            case SDKIPCRequest.RequestOneofCase.OpsOptimizeRequest:
            default:
                // Do not pretend to provide an NVIDIA overlay, driver optimizer or screenshot API.
                return Failure("NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BY_STANDALONE_VIDEO_RECORDER");
        }
        return response;
    }

    private string currentRequestId = "";
    private BusMessage ReplyEnvelope(BusMessage source, string system, string module)
    {
        return new BusMessage
        {
            Uniqueid = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), ReferenceUniqueid = source.Uniqueid,
            SourceSystem = system, SourceModule = module,
            TargetSystem = string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.SourceSystem) ? joinedSystem : source.SourceSystem,
            TargetModule = string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.SourceModule) ? joinedModule : source.SourceModule,
            Status = new BusMessage.Types.Status { Code = BusMessage.Types.Status.Types.Code.Completed }
        };
    }

    private static SDKIPCResponse Failure(string status) => new() { Retval = -1, Retstatus = status };
    // BusMessage.uniqueid: 1–128 UTF-16 code units (unchanged limit). Control characters are allowed
    // because the token is opaque; only unpaired surrogates are refused, since they have no UTF-8 form.
    private void CheckCorrelationId(string value, string kind)
    {
        var field = $"BusMessage.uniqueid ({kind})";
        if (value.Length == 0)
            throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid IPC identifier: {field} is empty.");
        if (value.Length > 128)
            throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid IPC identifier: {field} length {value.Length} exceeds 128.");
        for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
        {
            if (char.IsHighSurrogate(value[i]) && i + 1 < value.Length && char.IsLowSurrogate(value[i + 1])) { i++; continue; }
            if (char.IsSurrogate(value[i]))
                throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid IPC identifier: {field} is not well-formed UTF-16 (U+{(int)value[i]:X4}@{i}).");
        }
    }

    private static void CheckText(string value, int limit, string field, bool allowEmpty = false)
    {
        if (!allowEmpty && string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
            throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid IPC identifier: {field} is empty.");
        if (value.Length > limit)
            throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid IPC identifier: {field} length {value.Length} exceeds {limit}.");
        if (value.Any(char.IsControl))
            throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid IPC identifier: {field} contains control characters ({DescribeControls(value)}).");
    }

    // Diagnostics name control characters by code point and index only; raw identifiers are never printed.
    private static string DescribeControls(string value)
    {
        var found = new List<string>();
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
        {
            if (!char.IsControl(value[i])) continue;
            total++;
            if (found.Count < 4) found.Add($"U+{(int)value[i]:X4}@{i}");
        }
        if (total > found.Count) found.Add($"+{total - found.Count} more");
        return string.Join(", ", found);
    }
    private static string Clean(string value) => new(value.Where(c => !char.IsControl(c)).Take(256).ToArray());
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Markup;
using System.Windows.Threading;

using HuntReplay.TestShared;

namespace HuntReplay.E2ETests;

public static class E2EInfrastructure
{
    private static bool nativeLoaded;
    private static string? cachedRepoRoot;
    private static Assembly? cachedAppAssembly;

    public static string RepoRoot
    {
        get
        {
            if (cachedRepoRoot != null) return cachedRepoRoot;
            string current = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
            var dir = new DirectoryInfo(current);
            while (dir != null)
            {
                if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "HuntReplayStudio.sln")))
                {
                    cachedRepoRoot = dir.FullName;
                    return cachedRepoRoot;
                }
                dir = dir.Parent;
            }
            cachedRepoRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory());
            return cachedRepoRoot;
        }
    }

    public static string ResolveBundledTool(string toolName) => MediaTestKit.ResolveBundledTool(toolName);

    public static string ResolveNativeDll()
    {
        string[] candidates = [
            Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "artifacts", "runtime", "HuntReplay.Media.dll"),
            Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "artifacts", "native", "Release", "HuntReplay.Media.dll"),
            Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "artifacts", "native", "Debug", "HuntReplay.Media.dll")
        ];
        string? found = candidates.FirstOrDefault(File.Exists);
        if (found != null) return found;
        throw new FileNotFoundException("HuntReplay.Media.dll not found in artifacts/runtime or artifacts/native.");
    }

    public static Assembly GetAppAssembly()
    {
        if (cachedAppAssembly != null) return cachedAppAssembly;
        string[] candidates = [
            Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "x64", "Debug", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll"),
            Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "x64", "Release", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll"),
            Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "Debug", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll"),
            Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "Release", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll")
        ];
        string? found = candidates.FirstOrDefault(File.Exists);
        if (found == null)
        {
            var files = Directory.GetFiles(Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin"), "HuntReplayStudio.dll", SearchOption.AllDirectories);
            found = files.FirstOrDefault();
        }
        if (found == null) throw new FileNotFoundException("HuntReplayStudio.dll could not be located in src/HuntReplay.App/bin.");
        cachedAppAssembly = Assembly.LoadFrom(found);
        return cachedAppAssembly;
    }

    public static void EnsureNativeLoaded()
    {
        if (nativeLoaded) return;
        string dllPath = ResolveNativeDll();
        IntPtr handle = NativeLibrary.Load(dllPath);
        if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
            throw new Win32Exception(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"Failed to load native library {dllPath}");

        NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver(typeof(E2EInfrastructure).Assembly, (name, _, _) =>
        {
            if (name == "HuntReplay.Media.dll") return handle;
            return IntPtr.Zero;
        });
        nativeLoaded = true;
    }

    public static class NativeTrimInterop
    {

    public static void RunProcess(string exePath, string arguments, int timeoutMs = 30000) =>
        MediaTestKit.RunProcess(exePath, arguments, timeoutMs);

    public static string GenerateSampleClip(string dir, string fileName, double duration = 6.0, bool hasAudio = true)
    {
        string ffmpeg = ResolveBundledTool("ffmpeg.exe");
        string outPath = Path.Combine(dir, fileName);
        string durStr = duration.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string args = hasAudio
            ? $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=640x360:rate=30 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=1000:duration={durStr} -c:v libx264 -g 30 -bf 0 -c:a aac -pix_fmt yuv420p -y \"{outPath}\""
            : $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=640x360:rate=30 -an -c:v libx264 -g 30 -bf 0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -y \"{outPath}\"";
        RunProcess(ffmpeg, args);
        return outPath;
    }

    public static string GenerateMultiAudioClip(string dir, string fileName, double duration = 12.0)
    {
        string ffmpeg = ResolveBundledTool("ffmpeg.exe");
        string outPath = Path.Combine(dir, fileName);
        string durStr = duration.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string args = $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=1280x720:rate=30 " +
                      $"-f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration={durStr} " +
                      $"-f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:sample_rate=44100:duration={durStr} " +
                      "-map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a " +
                      "-c:v libx264 -g 30 -bf 0 -pix_fmt yuv420p " +
                      "-c:a:0 aac -ac:a:0 2 -ar:a:0 48000 " +
                      "-c:a:1 aac -ac:a:1 1 -ar:a:1 44100 " +
                      $"-y \"{outPath}\"";
        RunProcess(ffmpeg, args);
        return outPath;
    }

    public static string GenerateThreeAudioClip(string dir, string fileName, double duration = 10.0)
    {
        string ffmpeg = ResolveBundledTool("ffmpeg.exe");
        string outPath = Path.Combine(dir, fileName);
        string durStr = duration.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string args = $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=640x360:rate=30 " +
                      $"-f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration={durStr} " +
                      $"-f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:sample_rate=44100:duration={durStr} " +
                      $"-f lavfi -i sine=frequency=1200:sample_rate=32000:duration={durStr} " +
                      "-map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -map 3:a " +
                      "-c:v libx264 -g 30 -bf 0 -pix_fmt yuv420p " +
                      "-c:a:0 aac -ac:a:0 2 -ar:a:0 48000 " +
                      "-c:a:1 aac -ac:a:1 1 -ar:a:1 44100 " +
                      "-c:a:2 aac -ac:a:2 2 -ar:a:2 32000 " +
                      $"-y \"{outPath}\"";
        RunProcess(ffmpeg, args);
        return outPath;
    }

    public static string GenerateLongClip(string dir, string fileName, double duration = 60.0)
    {
        string ffmpeg = ResolveBundledTool("ffmpeg.exe");
        string outPath = Path.Combine(dir, fileName);
        string durStr = duration.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string args = $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=640x360:rate=30 " +
                      $"-f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration={durStr} " +
                      $"-f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:sample_rate=44100:duration={durStr} " +
                      "-map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a " +
                      "-c:v libx264 -g 30 -bf 0 -pix_fmt yuv420p " +
                      "-c:a:0 aac -ac:a:0 2 -ar:a:0 48000 " +
                      "-c:a:1 aac -ac:a:1 1 -ar:a:1 44100 " +
                      $"-y \"{outPath}\"";
        RunProcess(ffmpeg, args, 60000);
        return outPath;
    }

    public record StreamInfo(int Index, string CodecType, string CodecName, int SampleRate, int Channels, string TimeBase);
    public record MediaProbeResult(double Duration, List<StreamInfo> Streams);

    public static MediaProbeResult ProbeMedia(string filePath)
    {
        string json = MediaTestKit.RunForOutput(ResolveBundledTool("ffprobe.exe"),
            ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-show_entries", "stream=index,codec_name,codec_type,sample_rate,channels,time_base", "-of", "json", filePath], 10000);

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        var root = doc.RootElement;
        double duration = 0.0;
        if (root.TryGetProperty("format", out var formatElem) && formatElem.TryGetProperty("duration", out var durElem))
        {
            duration = double.Parse(durElem.GetString()!, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        var streams = new List<StreamInfo>();
        if (root.TryGetProperty("streams", out var streamsElem))
        {
            foreach (var stream in streamsElem.EnumerateArray())
            {
                int idx = stream.GetProperty("index").GetInt32();
                string type = stream.GetProperty("codec_type").GetString()!;
                string codec = stream.GetProperty("codec_name").GetString()!;
                int rate = stream.TryGetProperty("sample_rate", out var r) && r.GetString() != null ? int.Parse(r.GetString()!) : 0;
                int channels = stream.TryGetProperty("channels", out var c) ? c.GetInt32() : 0;
                string tb = stream.TryGetProperty("time_base", out var t) && t.GetString() != null ? t.GetString()! : "";
                streams.Add(new StreamInfo(idx, type, codec, rate, channels, tb));
            }
        }
        return new MediaProbeResult(duration, streams);
    }

    public record PacketInfo(double PtsTime, double DtsTime, double DurationTime);

    public static List<PacketInfo> ReadPackets(string filePath, string streamSpec)
    {
        string json = MediaTestKit.RunForOutput(ResolveBundledTool("ffprobe.exe"),
            ["-v", "error", "-select_streams", streamSpec, "-show_packets", "-show_entries", "packet=pts_time,dts_time,duration_time", "-of", "json", filePath], 20000);

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        var packets = new List<PacketInfo>();
        if (doc.RootElement.TryGetProperty("packets", out var pktList))
        {
            foreach (var p in pktList.EnumerateArray())
            {
                if (p.TryGetProperty("pts_time", out var ptsElem) &&
                    double.TryParse(ptsElem.GetString(), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double pts))
                {
                    double dts = pts;
                    if (p.TryGetProperty("dts_time", out var dtsElem) &&
                        double.TryParse(dtsElem.GetString(), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double parsedDts))
                    {
                        dts = parsedDts;
                    }
                    double dur = 0;
                    if (p.TryGetProperty("duration_time", out var durElem) &&
                        double.TryParse(durElem.GetString(), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out double parsedDur))
                    {
                        dur = parsedDur;
                    }
                    packets.Add(new PacketInfo(pts, dts, dur));
                }
            }
        }
        return packets;
    }

    public static string ComputeFileSha256(string path)
    {
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(stream));
    }

    public static void InTemp(Action<string> test)
    {
        string tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "HR_E2E_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
        try
        {
            test(tempDir);
        }
        finally
        {
            try { if (Directory.Exists(tempDir)) Directory.Delete(tempDir, true); } catch { }
        }
    }

    public static async Task InTempAsync(Func<string, Task> test)
    {
        string tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "HR_E2E_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
        Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
        try
        {
            await test(tempDir);
        }
        finally
        {
            try { if (Directory.Exists(tempDir)) Directory.Delete(tempDir, true); } catch { }
        }
    }

    public static ResourceDictionary LoadProductionTheme()
    {
        string themes = Path.Combine(RepoRoot, "src", "HuntReplay.App", "Themes");
        ResourceDictionary Parse(string file) => (ResourceDictionary)XamlReader.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(themes, file)).Replace(
            "clr-namespace:HuntReplay.App.Views\"",
            "clr-namespace:HuntReplay.App.Views;assembly=HuntReplay.E2ETests\"",
            StringComparison.Ordinal));
        var theme = new ResourceDictionary();
        theme.MergedDictionaries.Add(Parse("Palette.Dark.xaml"));
        theme.MergedDictionaries.Add(Parse("Controls.xaml"));
        return theme;
    }

    public static void WithThemedWindow(Action<Window, StackPanel> test)
    {
        var host = new StackPanel { Resources = LoadProductionTheme(), Width = 640 };
        var window = new Window { Content = host, Width = 680, Height = 480, ShowInTaskbar = false, ShowActivated = false };
        window.Show();
        try
        {
            Pump();
            test(window, host);
        }
        finally
        {
            window.Close();
            Pump();
        }
    }

    public static void Pump()
    {
        var frame = new DispatcherFrame();
        Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle, new Action(() => frame.Continue = false));
        Dispatcher.PushFrame(frame);
    }

    public static void True(bool condition, string message = "Expected true")
    {
        if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
    }

    public static void False(bool condition, string message = "Expected false") => True(!condition, message);

    public static void Equal<T>(T expected, T actual, string? message = null)
    {
        if (!EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(expected, actual))
            throw new InvalidOperationException(message ?? $"Expected '{expected}', but got '{actual}'");
    }

    public static void InRange(double actual, double min, double max, string? message = null)
    {
        if (actual < min || actual > max)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(message ?? $"Expected value in range [{min}, {max}], but got {actual}");
    }

    public static void Throws<T>(Action action) where T : Exception
    {
        try
        {
            action();
        }
        catch (T)
        {
            return;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Expected exception of type {typeof(T).Name}, but caught {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
        }
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Expected exception of type {typeof(T).Name}, but no exception was thrown.");
    }

    public static async Task ThrowsAsync<T>(Func<Task> action) where T : Exception
    {
        try
        {
            await action();
        }
        catch (T)
        {
            return;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Expected exception of type {typeof(T).Name}, but caught {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
        }
        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Expected exception of type {typeof(T).Name}, but no exception was thrown.");
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.E2ETests/Program.cs`:

```cs
using System.Windows;
using HuntReplay.TestShared;

namespace HuntReplay.E2ETests;

/// <summary>
/// The four E2E tiers as MSTest cases, run on the shared STA thread with one WPF Application.
/// Each case name starts with its tier, so a tier can be run alone: dotnet run --project tests/HuntReplay.E2ETests -- --filter "Name~Tier 2"
/// </summary>
[TestClass]
public sealed class E2ESuite
{
    public static IEnumerable<object[]> Cases => StaWorker.Invoke(() => TestRegistry.Rows(RegisterAll));
    public static string CaseName(System.Reflection.MethodInfo method, object[] row) => (string)row[0];

    [TestMethod]
    [DynamicData(nameof(Cases), DynamicDataDisplayName = nameof(CaseName))]
    public void Run(string name) => StaWorker.Run(() => TestRegistry.Run(name));

    private static void RegisterAll()
    {
        // WPF allows one Application per process; the tests use its dispatcher for STA work.
        if (Application.Current is null) _ = new Application { ShutdownMode = ShutdownMode.OnExplicitShutdown };
        Register("Tier 1", Tier1_FeatureCoverageTests.RunAll);
        Register("Tier 2", Tier2_BoundaryTests.RunAll);
        Register("Tier 3", Tier3_CrossFeatureTests.RunAll);
        Register("Tier 4", Tier4_RealWorldScenariosTests.RunAll);
    }

    private static void Register(string tier, Action<Action<string, Action>, Action<string, Func<Task>>> runAll) =>
        runAll((name, body) => TestRegistry.Add($"{tier}: {name}", body),
               (name, body) => TestRegistry.Add($"{tier}: {name}", body));
}
```
