`tests/HuntReplay.E2ETests/Tier1_FeatureCoverageTests.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using static HuntReplay.E2ETests.E2EInfrastructure;

namespace HuntReplay.E2ETests;

public static class Tier1_FeatureCoverageTests
{
    public static void RunAll(Action<string, Action> test, Action<string, Func<Task>> testAsync)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=======================================================");
        Console.WriteLine("  TIER 1: FEATURE COVERAGE (ISOLATED HAPPY PATH)");
        Console.WriteLine("=======================================================");

        test("T1-01 §R1: Trim Video button & smooth entry into trim mode swaps Seek slider for RangeSlider", () =>
        {
            WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var seek = new Slider { Name = "Seek", Visibility = Visibility.Visible, Minimum = 0, Maximum = 60 };
                var trimSliderContainer = new ContentControl { Name = "TrimSlider", Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed };
                var trimToolbar = new StackPanel { Name = "TrimToolbar", Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed };

                host.Children.Add(seek);
                host.Children.Add(trimSliderContainer);
                host.Children.Add(trimToolbar);
                Pump();

                // Initial normal playback state
                Equal(Visibility.Visible, seek.Visibility);
                Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, trimSliderContainer.Visibility);
                Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, trimToolbar.Visibility);

                // Enter trim mode
                bool isTrimMode = true;
                bool isPlaying = true;
                if (isTrimMode && isPlaying) isPlaying = false; // Player must pause on entry

                seek.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
                trimSliderContainer.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                trimToolbar.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                Pump();

                False(isPlaying, "Player should be paused on entering trim mode");
                Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, seek.Visibility);
                Equal(Visibility.Visible, trimSliderContainer.Visibility);
                Equal(Visibility.Visible, trimToolbar.Visibility);
            });
        });

        test("T1-02 §R1: Dual-handle timeline initializes to clip bounds with accent highlight", () =>
        {
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var sliderType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Controls.RangeSlider")
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("RangeSlider type not found in HuntReplayStudio.dll");

            WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = (FrameworkElement)Activator.CreateInstance(sliderType!)!;
                slider.Width = 500;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Pump();

                var propMin = sliderType.GetProperty("Minimum")!;
                var propMax = sliderType.GetProperty("Maximum")!;
                var propStart = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeStart")!;
                var propEnd = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeEnd")!;
                var propMinRange = sliderType.GetProperty("MinRange")!;

                propMin.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax.SetValue(slider, 30.0);
                propMinRange.SetValue(slider, 0.5);
                propStart.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, 30.0);
                Pump();

                Equal(0.0, (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!);
                Equal(30.0, (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!);
                Equal(0.5, (double)propMinRange.GetValue(slider)!);
            });
        });

        test("T1-03 §R1: Real-time timestamp formatting for sub-hour and hour-plus durations", () =>
        {
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var formatterType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingFormatters");
            MethodInfo formatMethod = formatterType?.GetMethod("FormatTime")!;
            Func<double, string> format = sec => (string)formatMethod.Invoke(null, [sec])!;

            // Sub-hour conversions
            Equal("00:00", format(0.0));
            Equal("00:05", format(5.0));
            Equal("01:23", format(83.0));
            Equal("59:59", format(3599.0));

            // Hour-plus conversions
            Equal("01:00:00", format(3600.0));
            Equal("01:05:30", format(3930.0));
            Equal("10:00:00", format(36000.0));
        });

        test("T1-04 §R1: Fine-tuning stepping controls adjust start and end points precisely by 0.1s", () =>
        {
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var formatterType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingFormatters")!;
            var stepMethod = formatterType.GetMethod("StepTime")!;
            Func<double, double, double, double, double> step = (cur, delta, min, max) =>
                (double)stepMethod.Invoke(null, [cur, delta, min, max])!;

            double duration = 50.0;
            double start = 5.0;
            double end = 15.0;
            const double minRange = 0.5;

            // Step Start down (-0.1s)
            start = step(start, -0.1, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Equal(4.9, start);

            // Step Start up (+0.1s)
            start = step(start, +0.1, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Equal(5.0, start);

            // Step End down (-0.1s)
            end = step(end, -0.1, start + minRange, duration);
            Equal(14.9, end);

            // Step End up (+0.1s)
            end = step(end, +0.1, start + minRange, duration);
            Equal(15.0, end);
        });

        test("T1-05 §R1: Mark In [I] and Mark Out [O] adjust boundaries to current player PTS", () =>
        {
            const double minRange = 0.5;
            double maxDuration = 60.0;
            double start = 0.0;
            double end = 60.0;

            // Player seeks to PTS 14.2s and triggers Mark In [I]
            double currentPts = 14.2;
            start = Math.Clamp(currentPts, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Equal(14.2, start);

            // Player seeks to PTS 35.8s and triggers Mark Out [O]
            currentPts = 35.8;
            end = Math.Clamp(currentPts, start + minRange, maxDuration);
            Equal(35.8, end);

            // Verify span duration
            Equal(21.6, Math.Round(end - start, 2));
        });

        test("T1-06 §R1: Selection preview seeks to start and automatically pauses upon reaching end boundary", () =>
        {
            double trimStart = 5.0;
            double trimEnd = 10.0;
            bool isPlaying = false;
            bool isPreviewingFragment = false;

            // 1. User clicks Preview: should seek to trimStart and begin playback
            double currentPts = 1.0;
            if (currentPts < trimStart || currentPts >= trimEnd - 0.1)
            {
                currentPts = trimStart;
            }
            isPlaying = true;
            isPreviewingFragment = true;

            Equal(5.0, currentPts);
            True(isPlaying);
            True(isPreviewingFragment);

            // 2. Playback advances inside fragment window
            currentPts = 8.5;
            if (isPreviewingFragment && currentPts >= trimEnd)
            {
                isPlaying = false;
                isPreviewingFragment = false;
            }
            True(isPlaying);

            // 3. Playback reaches trimEnd: timer must pause player and clear preview mode
            currentPts = 10.0;
            if (isPreviewingFragment && currentPts >= trimEnd)
            {
                isPlaying = false;
                isPreviewingFragment = false;
            }
            False(isPlaying, "Player must automatically pause at fragment end");
            False(isPreviewingFragment, "Preview mode flag must reset");
        });

        test("T1-07 §R1: Cancel action restores normal player state without altering source file", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_cancel.mp4", 5.0, hasAudio: true);
            string initialHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);
            DateTime initialTime = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source);

            // Simulate UI trim state
            bool isTrimMode = true;
            double trimStart = 1.0;
            double trimEnd = 4.0;

            // Trigger Cancel
            isTrimMode = false;
            trimStart = 0.0;
            trimEnd = 0.0;

            False(isTrimMode);
            Equal(0.0, trimStart);
            Equal(0.0, trimEnd);

            // Source file must remain completely byte-for-byte identical
            Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
            Equal(initialTime, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source));
        }));

        test("T1-08 §R2: Native fast stream copying remuxes packets without re-encoding", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_fast.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
            string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_fast.mp4");

            int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
            Equal(0, res, $"hr_trim failed: {NativeTrimInterop.GetLastError()}");
            True(File.Exists(target), "Target file must exist");

            var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
            InRange(probe.Duration, 2.5, 3.5, "Trimmed duration should be ~3.0s");

            var vStreams = probe.Streams.FindAll(s => s.CodecType == "video");
            var aStreams = probe.Streams.FindAll(s => s.CodecType == "audio");

            Equal(1, vStreams.Count);
            Equal("h264", vStreams[0].CodecName);
            Equal(1, aStreams.Count);
            Equal("aac", aStreams[0].CodecName);
        }));

        test("T1-09 §R2: Native frame-accurate trimming mode flag executes successfully", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_acc.mp4", 5.0, hasAudio: true);
            string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_acc.mp4");

            int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 3.5, 1, null, IntPtr.Zero);
            Equal(0, res, $"hr_trim accurate mode failed: {NativeTrimInterop.GetLastError()}");
            True(File.Exists(target), "Target file must exist");

            var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
            InRange(probe.Duration, 2.0, 3.0);
        }));

        test("T1-10 §R2: Multi-track audio preservation retains all tracks with original rates and channels", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            string source = GenerateMultiAudioClip(dir, "source_multi.mp4", 8.0);
            string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_multi.mp4");

            int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 5.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
            Equal(0, res);
            True(File.Exists(target));

            var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
            var aStreams = probe.Streams.FindAll(s => s.CodecType == "audio");

            Equal(2, aStreams.Count, "Target must preserve exactly 2 audio streams");
            Equal("aac", aStreams[0].CodecName);
            Equal(48000, aStreams[0].SampleRate);
            Equal(2, aStreams[0].Channels);

            Equal("aac", aStreams[1].CodecName);
            Equal(44100, aStreams[1].SampleRate);
            Equal(1, aStreams[1].Channels);
        }));

        test("T1-11 §R2: Audio/Video synchronization packet timestamps maintain < 25ms drift", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            string source = GenerateMultiAudioClip(dir, "source_sync.mp4", 10.0);
            string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_sync.mp4");

            int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 2.0, 7.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
            Equal(0, res);

            var vPackets = ReadPackets(target, "v:0");
            var a0Packets = ReadPackets(target, "a:0");
            var a1Packets = ReadPackets(target, "a:1");

            True(vPackets.Count > 30, "Should have sufficient video packets");
            True(a0Packets.Count > 30, "Should have sufficient audio 0 packets");
            True(a1Packets.Count > 30, "Should have sufficient audio 1 packets");

            // Initial packet PTS offset check
            double offsetA0 = Math.Abs(a0Packets[0].PtsTime - vPackets[0].PtsTime);
            double offsetA1 = Math.Abs(a1Packets[0].PtsTime - vPackets[0].PtsTime);

            True(offsetA0 < 0.025, $"Initial A0 offset ({offsetA0*1000:F2}ms) must be < 25ms");
            True(offsetA1 < 0.025, $"Initial A1 offset ({offsetA1*1000:F2}ms) must be < 25ms");
        }));

        test("T1-12 §R2: Source video file is completely immutable across trimming operations", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_immutable.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
            string initialHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);
            DateTime initialWriteTime = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source);

            // Operation 1: Successful trim
            string target1 = Path.Combine(dir, "out1.mp4");
            Equal(0, NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target1, 1.0, 3.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero));
            Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
            Equal(initialWriteTime, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source));

            // Operation 2: Cancelled trim
            string target2 = Path.Combine(dir, "out2.mp4");
            NativeTrimInterop.ProgressCallback cancelCb = (_, _) => 1;
            int cancelRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target2, 1.0, 4.0, 0, cancelCb, IntPtr.Zero);
            True(cancelRes < 0);
            Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
            Equal(initialWriteTime, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source));

            // Operation 3: Failing trim
            int failRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, source, 1.0, 3.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
            True(failRes < 0);
            Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
            Equal(initialWriteTime, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source));
        }));

        testAsync("T1-13 §R2: Asynchronous trimming service progress reporting reaches 1.0 (100%)", async () =>
```

```cs
            True(res0 < 0, "Early cancellation must return negative code");
            False(File.Exists(target0), "Partial file must be deleted");

            // Stage 2: Halfway cancellation at 50%

            True(sw.ElapsedMilliseconds < 300, $"Cancellation abort took {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms, must be < 300ms");

            False(File.Exists(target95), "Partial file must be deleted");
```

`tests/HuntReplay.E2ETests/Tier3_CrossFeatureTests.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows;
using static HuntReplay.E2ETests.E2EInfrastructure;

namespace HuntReplay.E2ETests;

public static class Tier3_CrossFeatureTests
{
    public static void RunAll(Action<string, Action> test, Action<string, Func<Task>> testAsync)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=======================================================");
        Console.WriteLine("  TIER 3: CROSS-FEATURE COMBINATIONS & PAIRWISE");
        Console.WriteLine("=======================================================");

        test("T3-01 §R1: Interactive workflow: fine-tune stepping -> jump to start -> preview playback -> boundary pause", () =>
        {
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var sliderType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Controls.RangeSlider")!;
            var formatterType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingFormatters")!;
            var stepMethod = formatterType.GetMethod("StepTime")!;

            WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = (FrameworkElement)Activator.CreateInstance(sliderType)!;
                slider.Width = 500;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Pump();

                var propMin = sliderType.GetProperty("Minimum")!;
                var propMax = sliderType.GetProperty("Maximum")!;
                var propStart = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeStart")!;
                var propEnd = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeEnd")!;
                var propPlayhead = sliderType.GetProperty("Playhead")!;

                propMin.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax.SetValue(slider, 30.0);
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, 15.0);
                propStart.SetValue(slider, 5.0);
                Pump();

                // 1. Fine-tune stepping
                double start = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                double end = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!;

                // Step start +0.3s (3 clicks)
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) start = (double)stepMethod.Invoke(null, [start, +0.1, 0.0, end - 0.5])!;
                propStart.SetValue(slider, start);

                // Step end -0.5s (5 clicks)
                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) end = (double)stepMethod.Invoke(null, [end, -0.1, start + 0.5, 30.0])!;
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, end);
                Pump();

                Equal(5.3, (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!);
                Equal(14.5, (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!);

                // 2. Jump to start
                propPlayhead.SetValue(slider, start);
                Pump();
                Equal(5.3, (double)propPlayhead.GetValue(slider)!);

                // 3. Preview playback simulation
                bool isPlaying = true;
                bool isPreviewing = true;
                double currentPts = (double)propPlayhead.GetValue(slider)!;

                // Advance playhead in ticks
                currentPts += 4.0; // 9.3s
                propPlayhead.SetValue(slider, currentPts);
                Pump();
                True(isPlaying);

                currentPts = end; // Reaches 14.5s
                if (isPreviewing && currentPts >= end)
                {
                    isPlaying = false;
                    isPreviewing = false;
                }
                propPlayhead.SetValue(slider, currentPts);
                Pump();

                False(isPlaying, "Preview playback must halt at boundary end");
                Equal(14.5, (double)propPlayhead.GetValue(slider)!);
            });
        });

        testAsync("T3-02 §R1, §R2: Mark In [I] & Mark Out [O] followed by direct export verification", async () =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var serviceType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingService")!;
            var instance = serviceType.GetProperty("Instance")!.GetValue(null)!;
            var trimMethod = serviceType.GetMethod("TrimVideoAsync")!;

            await InTempAsync(async dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "src_mark_export.mp4", 12.0, hasAudio: true);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "out_mark_export.mp4");

                // Simulate player at 2.0s -> Mark In
                double markInPts = 2.0;
                // Simulate player at 8.0s -> Mark Out
                double markOutPts = 8.0;

                // Export via service
                var task = (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(instance, [source, target, markInPts, markOutPts, false, null, CancellationToken.None])!;
                string result = await task;

                Equal(target, result);
                True(File.Exists(result));

                var probe = ProbeMedia(result);
                InRange(probe.Duration, 5.5, 6.5, "Exported duration must match Mark Out - Mark In span (~6.0s)");
            });
        });

        testAsync("T3-03 §R1, §R2: Export cancellation cleans up resources and allows clean trim mode exit", async () =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var serviceType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingService")!;
            var instance = serviceType.GetProperty("Instance")!.GetValue(null)!;
            var trimMethod = serviceType.GetMethod("TrimVideoAsync")!;

            await InTempAsync(async dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "src_cancel_workflow.mp4", 15.0, hasAudio: true);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "out_cancel_workflow.mp4");

                var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
                var progress = new Progress<double>(p =>
                {
                    if (p >= 0.20) cts.Cancel();
                });

                var task = (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(instance, [source, target, 1.0, 14.0, false, progress, cts.Token])!;
                await ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(async () => await task);

                // Target file must be cleaned up
                False(File.Exists(target), "Cancelled export target must be deleted");

                // Simulate exiting trim mode
                bool isTrimMode = false;
                False(isTrimMode);
            });
        });

        test("T3-04 §R2: Consecutive trimming passes on the same source video remain independent", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "src_consec.mp4", 15.0, hasAudio: true);
            string initialHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);

            // Pass 1: [1.0s, 4.0s] (3.0s duration)
            string out1 = Path.Combine(dir, "pass1.mp4");
            Equal(0, NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, out1, 1.0, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero));
            InRange(ProbeMedia(out1).Duration, 2.5, 3.5);

            // Pass 2: [5.0s, 9.0s] (4.0s duration)
            string out2 = Path.Combine(dir, "pass2.mp4");
            Equal(0, NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, out2, 5.0, 9.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero));
            InRange(ProbeMedia(out2).Duration, 3.5, 4.5);

            // Pass 3: [10.0s, 14.0s] (4.0s duration)
            string out3 = Path.Combine(dir, "pass3.mp4");
            Equal(0, NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, out3, 10.0, 14.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero));
            InRange(ProbeMedia(out3).Duration, 3.5, 4.5);

            // All 3 output files must exist simultaneously
            True(File.Exists(out1));
            True(File.Exists(out2));
            True(File.Exists(out3));

            // Source video must be 100% byte-identical
            Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
        }));

        test("T3-05 §R2: Concurrent multi-threaded trimming isolates thread-local state and error reporting", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "src_parallel.mp4", 10.0, hasAudio: true);

            int concurrency = 8;
            var barrier = new Barrier(concurrency);
            var results = new ConcurrentDictionary<int, (int Code, string? Error, bool FileCreated)>();

            var threads = new List<Thread>();
            for (int i = 0; i < concurrency; i++)
            {
                int tid = i;
                var t = new Thread(() =>
                {
                    barrier.SignalAndWait(); // Synchronize all 8 threads to start concurrently
                    string target = Path.Combine(dir, $"parallel_{tid}.mp4");

                    if (tid % 4 == 0 || tid % 4 == 2) // Valid trim
                    {
                        int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                        string? err = NativeTrimInterop.GetLastError();
                        results[tid] = (res, err, File.Exists(target));
                    }
                    else if (tid % 4 == 1) // Deliberate failure (bad path)
                    {
                        int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim("nonexistent_input.mp4", target, 0, 5, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                        string? err = NativeTrimInterop.GetLastError();
                        results[tid] = (res, err, File.Exists(target));
                    }
                    else // Cancelled trim
                    {
                        NativeTrimInterop.ProgressCallback cancel = (_, prog) => prog >= 0.3 ? 1 : 0;
                        int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 8.0, 0, cancel, IntPtr.Zero);
                        string? err = NativeTrimInterop.GetLastError();
                        results[tid] = (res, err, File.Exists(target));
                    }
                });
                threads.Add(t);
                t.Start();
            }

            foreach (var t in threads) t.Join();

            // Validate results
            for (int i = 0; i < concurrency; i++)
            {
                var r = results[i];
                if (i % 4 == 0 || i % 4 == 2)
                {
                    Equal(0, r.Code, $"Thread {i} expected success");
                    True(r.FileCreated, $"Thread {i} expected output file");
                    True(string.IsNullOrEmpty(r.Error), $"Thread {i} expected no error");
                }
                else if (i % 4 == 1)
                {
                    True(r.Code < 0, $"Thread {i} expected failure");
                    False(r.FileCreated, $"Thread {i} expected no file");
                    True(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(r.Error), $"Thread {i} expected error message");
                }
                else
                {
                    True(r.Code < 0, $"Thread {i} expected cancellation");
                    False(r.FileCreated, $"Thread {i} expected target cleanup");
                }
            }
        }));

        test("T3-06 §R1: LiveSeek scrubbing event updates playhead and player frame", () =>
        {
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var sliderType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Controls.RangeSlider")!;

            WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = (FrameworkElement)Activator.CreateInstance(sliderType)!;
                slider.Width = 500;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Pump();

                var propMin = sliderType.GetProperty("Minimum")!;
                var propMax = sliderType.GetProperty("Maximum")!;
                var propStart = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeStart")!;
                var propEnd = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeEnd")!;
                var propPlayhead = sliderType.GetProperty("Playhead")!;

                propMin.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax.SetValue(slider, 60.0);
                propStart.SetValue(slider, 10.0);
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, 40.0);
                Pump();

                // Scrub playhead to 25.0s
                propPlayhead.SetValue(slider, 25.0);
                Pump();
                Equal(25.0, (double)propPlayhead.GetValue(slider)!);

                // Scrub playhead to 38.0s
                propPlayhead.SetValue(slider, 38.0);
                Pump();
                Equal(38.0, (double)propPlayhead.GetValue(slider)!);
            });
        });
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;

using HuntReplay.Core.Storage;

namespace HuntReplay.E2ETests;

public static class Tier4_RealWorldScenariosTests
{
    public static void RunAll(Action<string, Action> test, Action<string, Func<Task>> testAsync)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("\n=======================================================");
        Console.WriteLine("  TIER 4: REAL-WORLD APPLICATION SCENARIOS");
        Console.WriteLine("=======================================================");

        testAsync("T4-01 §R1, §R2: Realistic game replay 30s recording trimmed to 7s highlight and playable in engine", async () =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var serviceType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingService")!;
            var instance = serviceType.GetProperty("Instance")!.GetValue(null)!;
            var trimMethod = serviceType.GetMethod("TrimVideoAsync")!;
            var namingMethod = serviceType.GetMethod("GenerateDefaultTargetPath")!;

            await InTempAsync(async dir =>
            {
                // 1. Generate realistic 30s match recording
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "Hunt_Match_2026-10-11.mp4", 30.0, hasAudio: true);
                string preHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);

                // 2. Compute non-colliding default target name
                string target = (string)namingMethod.Invoke(null, [source])!;
                True(target.Contains("_trimmed"), "Default name should contain '_trimmed'");

                // 3. User trims [15.0s, 22.0s] (7.0s kill highlight)
                var task = (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(instance, [source, target, 15.0, 22.0, false, null, CancellationToken.None])!;
                string result = await task;

                Equal(target, result);
                True(File.Exists(result));

                // 4. Verify media probe
                var probe = ProbeMedia(result);
                InRange(probe.Duration, 6.5, 7.5, "Highlight duration should be ~7.0s");

                // 5. Verify playable in native player engine
                int openRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_open(result, out IntPtr player, out int w, out int h, out double dur);
                Equal(0, openRes);
                try
                {
                    True(w > 0 && h > 0);
                    InRange(dur, 6.5, 7.5);

                    // Seek test
                    Equal(0, NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_seek(player, 2.0));

                    // Thumbnail generation
                    int thumbRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_thumbnail(result, 320, out IntPtr pixels, out int tw, out int th, out int stride);
                    Equal(0, thumbRes);
                    try
                    {
                        True(pixels != IntPtr.Zero && tw > 0 && th > 0 && stride > 0);
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        NativeTrimInterop.hr_free(pixels);
                    }
                }
                finally
                {
                    NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_close(player);
                }

                // 6. Source video file remains untouched
                Equal(preHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
            });
        });

        test("T4-02 §R2: Gameplay clip with multi-track commentary (game sound + mic) preserves A/V sync", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            // Source clip with game audio (48kHz) and mic audio (44.1kHz)
            string source = GenerateMultiAudioClip(dir, "Hunt_Commentary.mp4", 15.0);
            string target = Path.Combine(dir, "Hunt_Commentary_highlight.mp4");

            // Extract 5-second highlight [4.0s, 9.0s]
            int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 4.0, 9.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
            Equal(0, res);

            var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
            var aStreams = probe.Streams.FindAll(s => s.CodecType == "audio");

            Equal(2, aStreams.Count, "Must preserve both game audio and mic tracks");
            Equal(48000, aStreams[0].SampleRate);
            Equal(44100, aStreams[1].SampleRate);

            // Check A/V drift across packets
            var vPackets = ReadPackets(target, "v:0");
            var a0Packets = ReadPackets(target, "a:0");
            var a1Packets = ReadPackets(target, "a:1");

            double offset0 = Math.Abs(a0Packets[0].PtsTime - vPackets[0].PtsTime);
            double offset1 = Math.Abs(a1Packets[0].PtsTime - vPackets[0].PtsTime);

            True(offset0 < 0.025, $"Game audio offset ({offset0*1000:F2}ms) must be < 25ms");
            True(offset1 < 0.025, $"Mic audio offset ({offset1*1000:F2}ms) must be < 25ms");
        }));

        test("T4-03 §R2, §R3: Silent gameplay clip highlight extraction and thumbnail verification", () => InTemp(dir =>

        }));

        testAsync("T4-04 §R1, §R2: Multi-highlight batch extraction from match recording registered in ClipLibrary", async () =>
        {
            EnsureNativeLoaded();
            var asm = GetAppAssembly();
            var serviceType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingService")!;
            var instance = serviceType.GetProperty("Instance")!.GetValue(null)!;
            var trimMethod = serviceType.GetMethod("TrimVideoAsync")!;
            var namingMethod = serviceType.GetMethod("GenerateDefaultTargetPath")!;

            await InTempAsync(async dir =>
            {
                string storeDir = Path.Combine(dir, "store");
                Directory.CreateDirectory(storeDir);
                var library = new ClipLibrary(dir, storeDir);

                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "Match_Full_Session.mp4", 25.0, hasAudio: true);
                string preHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);

                // Highlight 1: First Kill [2.0s, 6.0s]
                string target1 = (string)namingMethod.Invoke(null, [source])!;
                await (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(instance, [source, target1, 2.0, 6.0, false, null, CancellationToken.None])!;
                var clip1 = library.Register(target1, new ClipMetadata
                {
                    FileName = Path.GetFileName(target1),
                    EventTag = "FIRST_KILL",
                    DurationSeconds = 4.0,
                    CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.Now
                });

                // Highlight 2: Double Kill [10.0s, 15.0s]
                string target2 = (string)namingMethod.Invoke(null, [source])!;
                await (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(instance, [source, target2, 10.0, 15.0, false, null, CancellationToken.None])!;
                var clip2 = library.Register(target2, new ClipMetadata
                {
                    FileName = Path.GetFileName(target2),
                    EventTag = "MULTI_KILL",
                    DurationSeconds = 5.0,
                    CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.Now
                });

                // Highlight 3: Extraction [18.0s, 23.0s]
                string target3 = (string)namingMethod.Invoke(null, [source])!;
                await (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(instance, [source, target3, 18.0, 23.0, false, null, CancellationToken.None])!;
                var clip3 = library.Register(target3, new ClipMetadata
                {
                    FileName = Path.GetFileName(target3),
                    EventTag = "EXTRACTION",
                    DurationSeconds = 5.0,
                    CreatedAt = DateTimeOffset.Now
                });

                // Verify library inventory
                var clips = library.List();
                Equal(3, clips.Count, "Library should contain exactly 3 trimmed highlight clips");
                True(clips.Any(c => c.Metadata.EventTag == "FIRST_KILL"));
                True(clips.Any(c => c.Metadata.EventTag == "MULTI_KILL"));
                True(clips.Any(c => c.Metadata.EventTag == "EXTRACTION"));

                // Verify source file untouched
                Equal(preHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
            });
        });

        test("T4-05 §R2, §R3: Long gameplay recording (60s) final clutch play extraction near EOF", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
```

```cs
    private static void DeviceSelectionTests()
    {

            Equal("1", selector.Options[2].Id);
            Equal("1", selector.SelectedId);
            Equal("NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090", selector.Options[2].Name);
        });
        // Native IDs since v0.1.8: the adapter description, unless two adapters share it.
        DeviceOption[] laptop =
        [
            new(3, "Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics", "Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics", IsDefault: true, Vendor: 0x8086),
            new(3, "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU", "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU", Vendor: 0x10de)
        ];
        Test("saved gpu survives a restart even when the adapter order changes", () =>

            Equal(3, selector.Options.Count);
            Equal("1", saved);
            Equal("NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU", DeviceOption.ResolveGpu(saved, laptop)?.Id);
            // Picking the shown adapter again replaces the old index with the stable ID.
            selector.SelectedId = "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU";
            Equal("NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU", saved);
        });
        Test("gpu saved by name resolves regardless of case and surrounding spaces", () =>
        {
            Equal("Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics", DeviceOption.ResolveGpu(" intel(r) iris(r) xe graphics ", laptop)?.Id);
            True(DeviceOption.ResolveGpu("", laptop) is null);
            True(DeviceOption.ResolveGpu("2", laptop) is null);
            True(DeviceOption.ResolveGpu("-1", laptop) is null);
            True(DeviceOption.ResolveGpu("AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT", laptop) is null);
        });
        Test("gpu selector survives transient null selection without clearing setting", () =>
        {
            string saved = "0";
            var selector = new DeviceSelectionViewModel(3, "Авто", () => saved, value => saved = value);
            selector.Refresh([
                new DeviceOption(3, "0", "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080", IsDefault: true, Vendor: 0x10de)
            ]);
            selector.SelectedId = null;
            Equal("0", saved);
            Equal("0", selector.SelectedId);
        });
        // Named wait handles exist only on Windows; the core suite also runs on the Linux CI runner.
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) Test("nvidia keeper ready event handles signaling, reset and disposal safely", () =>
        {
            string eventName = @"Local\HuntReplay.TestReady." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
            using var ev = new EventWaitHandle(false, EventResetMode.ManualReset, eventName, out bool createdNew);
            True(createdNew);
            False(ev.WaitOne(0));
            ev.Set();
            True(ev.WaitOne(0));
            ev.Reset();
            False(ev.WaitOne(0));
        });
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.Tests/IpcCorrelationTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using Google.Protobuf;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Replay;
using HuntReplay.Protocol;
using HuntReplay.Protocol.Generated;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

// BusMessage.uniqueid is an opaque, bounded correlation token. These regressions cover the
// field report "Invalid IPC identifier: BusMessage.uniqueid (SDK/CreateSDKInstanceRequest)
// contains control characters (length 37)", which disconnected a healthy game client after JOIN.
// The fixture python-synthetic-uniqueid-wire.json is SYNTHETIC: generated from the repository's
// original Python proto modules, not a captured game trace.
public static partial class Program
{
    private const string SyntheticToken = "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6f-9a7b-1c2d3e4f5a6b";
    private const string SyntheticFixture = "python-synthetic-uniqueid-wire.json";

    private static void IpcCorrelationTests()
    {
        Test("NUL-suffixed 37-unit correlation ID is accepted and echoed exactly", () =>
        {
            var s = Session(); s.Process(Join());
            var id = SyntheticToken + "\0";
            Equal(37, id.Length);
            var replies = s.Process(Request(id, new() { CreateSDKInstanceRequest = new() { Client = "Hunt", ClientPID = 42 } }));
            Equal(0, Response(replies).Retval);
            Equal(id, replies[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
            Equal(37, replies[0].ReferenceUniqueid.Length);
        });
        Test("every control-character class is opaque in JOIN and SDK correlation", () =>
        {
            var s = Session();
            var joinId = SyntheticToken + "\u0010"; // distinct from every SDK token below (reply cache is per uniqueid)
            var joinReplies = s.Process(new BusMessage { Uniqueid = joinId, SourceSystem = "Hunt1896", SourceModule = "GfeSDK", Joined = true });
            Equal(joinId, joinReplies[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
            string[] suffixes = ["\u0000", "\u0001", "\t", "\n", "\r\n", "\u001F", "\u007F", "\u0085"];
            foreach (var suffix in suffixes)
            {
                var id = SyntheticToken + suffix;
                var replies = s.Process(Request(id, new() { IsClientAliveRequest = new() }));
                True(Response(replies).IsClientAliveResponse.Alive);
                Equal(id, replies[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
            }
            var leading = "\u0001" + SyntheticToken;
            Equal(leading, s.Process(Request(leading, new() { IsClientAliveRequest = new() }))[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
        });
        Test("retransmitted control-character request reports one highlight", () =>
        {
            var events = new List<HighlightEvent>();
            var s = Armed(events, out var group);
            var kill = Request(SyntheticToken + "\u0085", new() { SetVideoHighlightRequest = new()
                { GroupId = group, HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED", StartDelta = -20000, EndDelta = 5000 } });
            var first = s.Process(kill);
            var second = s.Process(kill);
            Equal(1, events.Count);
            Equal(SyntheticToken + "\u0085", first[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
            Equal(first[0].ReferenceUniqueid, second[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
            Equal(0, Response(second).Retval);
        });
        Test("correlation IDs differing only by control characters are distinct requests", () =>
        {
            var events = new List<HighlightEvent>();
            var s = Armed(events, out var group);
            var shortId = SyntheticToken + "\u0004";
            var longId = SyntheticToken + "\u0004\0";
            s.Process(Request(shortId, new() { SetVideoHighlightRequest = new()
                { GroupId = group, HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED", StartDelta = -20000, EndDelta = 5000 } }));
            s.Process(Request(longId, new() { SetVideoHighlightRequest = new()
                { GroupId = group, HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED", StartDelta = -20000, EndDelta = 5000 } }));
            Equal(2, events.Count);
            False(events[0].RequestId == events[1].RequestId);
            Equal(shortId, events[0].RequestId);
            Equal(longId, events[1].RequestId);
            Equal(2, Response(s.Process(Request(SyntheticToken + "\u0005", new()
                { GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupRequest = new() { GroupId = group } }))).GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupResponse.NumberOfHighlights);
        });
        Test("malformed UTF-16 correlation ID is rejected with code point and index only", () =>
        {
            var s = Session(); s.Process(Join());
            var bad = SyntheticToken + "\uD800";
            try { s.Process(Request(bad, new() { IsClientAliveRequest = new() })); }
            catch (InvalidDataException ex)
            {
                True(ex.Message.Contains("BusMessage.uniqueid")); True(ex.Message.Contains("IsClientAliveRequest"));
                True(ex.Message.Contains("well-formed")); True(ex.Message.Contains("U+D800@36"));
                False(ex.Message.Contains('\uD800')); False(ex.Message.Contains(SyntheticToken));
                return;
            }
            throw new Exception("Expected malformed UTF-16 identifier to be rejected.");
        });
        Test("correlation ID length bound is 128 UTF-16 units, unchanged", () =>
        {
            var s = Session(); s.Process(Join());
            var limit = new string('a', 128);
            True(Response(s.Process(Request(limit, new() { IsClientAliveRequest = new() }))).IsClientAliveResponse.Alive);
            InvalidIdentifier(() => s.Process(Request(new string('a', 129), new() { IsClientAliveRequest = new() })),
                "BusMessage.uniqueid", "IsClientAliveRequest", "length 129 exceeds 128");
        });
        Test("control characters in group IDs stay rejected with code point and index", () =>
        {
            var s = Authorized();
            var reply = Response(s.Process(Request("open-bad", new() { OpenGroupRequest = new() { GroupId = "match\u0007" } })));
            Equal(-1, reply.Retval);
            True(reply.Retstatus.Contains("openGroupRequest.groupId")); True(reply.Retstatus.Contains("control characters"));
            True(reply.Retstatus.Contains("U+0007@5")); False(reply.Retstatus.Contains('\u0007'));
        });
        Test("synthetic fixture is labelled synthetic and carries named frames", () =>
        {
            var json = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(FixturePath(SyntheticFixture))).RootElement;
            True(json.GetProperty("synthetic").GetBoolean());
            Equal(10, json.GetProperty("frames").GetArrayLength());
        });
        Test("synthetic protobuf sequence: exact correlation, one highlight per kill, planned tail", () =>
        {
            var frames = NamedFixtures(SyntheticFixture);
            var logs = new List<string>();
            var clock = new Queue<long>(new long[] { 100_000_000, 101_000_000 });
            var events = new List<HighlightEvent>();
            var s = Logged(logs, e => { events.Add(e); return true; }, () => clock.Dequeue());
            var replies = new Dictionary<string, IReadOnlyList<BusMessage>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var (name, message) in frames)
            {
                var reply = s.Process(message);
                True(reply.Count > 0);
                Equal(message.Uniqueid, reply[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
                if (message.Joined) { replies[name] = reply; continue; }
                Equal(0, Response(reply).Retval);
                replies[name] = reply;
            }
            Equal(2, events.Count);
            Equal("PLAYER_DOWNED", events[0].HighlightId); Equal("HUNTER_KILLED", events[1].HighlightId);
            Equal(frames[4].Message.Uniqueid, events[0].RequestId);
            Equal(frames[5].Message.Uniqueid, events[1].RequestId);
            Equal(2, Response(replies["count"]).GetNumberOfHighlightsInGroupResponse.NumberOfHighlights);
            var config = Response(replies["config"]).GetUserConfigResponse;
            Equal(2, config.HighlightTable.Count); True(config.HighlightTable.All(h => h.UserEnabled));

            var planner = new HighlightPlanner(new ReplaySettings());
            foreach (var evt in events) planner.Register(evt);
            Equal(1, planner.PendingCount);
            var plan = planner.TakeReady(long.MaxValue, force: true).Single();
            Equal("HUNTER_KILLED_PLAYER_DOWNED", plan.EventTag);
            Equal(1, plan.KillCount);
            Equal(80_000_000L, plan.StartUs);       // 20 s pre-roll before the first event (SmartTrim)
            Equal(108_000_000L, plan.EndUs);        // last event + 7 s post-roll tail
            Equal(116_000_000L, plan.ReadyAtUs);    // last event + 15 s coalesce horizon
        });
        Test("synthetic retransmit reuses the cached reply without a second highlight", () =>
        {
            var frames = NamedFixtures(SyntheticFixture);
            var events = new List<HighlightEvent>();
            var s = Logged(new List<string>(), e => { events.Add(e); return true; });
            foreach (var (_, message) in frames.Take(6)) s.Process(message);
            Equal(2, events.Count);
            var replay = s.Process(frames[6].Message);
            Equal("hunter-killed-retransmit", frames[6].Name);
            Equal(2, events.Count);
            Equal(frames[5].Message.Uniqueid, replay[0].ReferenceUniqueid);
        });
        Test("synthetic PID, JOIN and bounds checks keep the pipe state machine intact", () =>
        {
            var frames = NamedFixtures(SyntheticFixture);
            Throws<InvalidDataException>(() => Session().Process(frames[1].Message));
            var s = Logged(new List<string>());
            s.Process(frames[0].Message);
            var spoofed = frames[1].Message.Clone();
            var request = SDKIPCMessage.Parser.ParseFrom(spoofed.Generic.Data);
            request.Request.CreateSDKInstanceRequest.ClientPID = 99;
            spoofed.Generic.Data = request.ToByteString();
            Equal("CLIENT_PID_MISMATCH", Response(s.Process(spoofed)).Retstatus);
            Equal("SDK_INSTANCE_REQUIRED", Response(s.Process(frames[2].Message)).Retstatus);
            var oversized = frames[0].Message.Clone();
            oversized.Uniqueid = new string('j', 129);
            InvalidIdentifier(() => Session().Process(oversized), "BusMessage.uniqueid", "JOIN", "length 129 exceeds 128");
        });
        Test("user-disabled highlight is a traceable no-op with its request ordinal", () =>
        {
            var logs = new List<string>(); var events = new List<HighlightEvent>();
            var s = new HighlightsSession(42, () => 100_000_000, id => id != "HUNTER_KILLED", e => { events.Add(e); return true; }, logs.Add);
            s.Process(new BusMessage { Uniqueid = SyntheticToken, SourceSystem = "Hunt1896", SourceModule = "GfeSDK", Joined = true });
            s.Process(Request(SyntheticToken + "\u0001", new() { CreateSDKInstanceRequest = new() { Client = "Hunt", ClientPID = 42 } }));
            var configure = new SDKIPCRequest { ConfigureHighlightsRequest = new() };
            configure.ConfigureHighlightsRequest.HighlightTable.Add(new ConfigureHighlightsRequest.Types.HighlightDefinition { HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED" });
            s.Process(Request(SyntheticToken + "\u0002", configure));
            s.Process(Request(SyntheticToken + "\u0003", new() { OpenGroupRequest = new() { GroupId = "match" } }));
            Equal(0, Response(s.Process(Request(SyntheticToken + "\u0004", new() { SetVideoHighlightRequest = new()
                { GroupId = "match", HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED", StartDelta = -20000, EndDelta = 5000 } }))).Retval);
            Equal(0, events.Count);
            True(logs.Any(line => line.Contains("#4") && line.Contains("HUNTER_KILLED") && line.Contains("отключено")));
        });
        Test("synthetic logs carry code points and indexes, never the raw correlation token", () =>
        {
            var frames = NamedFixtures(SyntheticFixture);
            var logs = new List<string>();
            var clock = new Queue<long>(new long[] { 100_000_000, 101_000_000 });
            var s = Logged(logs, _ => true, () => clock.Dequeue());
            foreach (var (_, message) in frames) s.Process(message);
            True(logs.Count > 0);
            True(logs.Any(line => line.Contains("U+0000@36")));
            foreach (var line in logs)
            {
                False(line.Contains(SyntheticToken));
                False(line.Any(char.IsControl));
            }
        });
    }

    private static string FixturePath(string fileName)
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "Fixtures", fileName);
        return File.Exists(path) ? path : Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), "tests", "HuntReplay.Tests", "Fixtures", fileName);
    }

    private static (string Name, BusMessage Message)[] NamedFixtures(string fileName)
    {
        using var json = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(FixturePath(fileName)));
        var root = json.RootElement;
        var frames = root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object ? root.GetProperty("frames") : root;
        return frames.EnumerateArray().Select(e => (e.GetProperty("name").GetString()!,
            BusMessage.Parser.ParseFrom(Convert.FromBase64String(e.GetProperty("base64").GetString()!)))).ToArray();
    }

    private static HighlightsSession Logged(List<string> logs, Func<HighlightEvent, bool>? sink = null, Func<long>? clock = null) =>
        new(42, clock ?? (() => 100_000_000), _ => true, sink ?? (_ => true), logs.Add);

    // JOIN, CreateSDKInstance, ConfigureHighlights (both events) and OpenGroup, all on control-character tokens.
    private static HighlightsSession Armed(List<HighlightEvent> events, out string group)
    {
        group = "match-1896";
        var s = Logged(new List<string>(), e => { events.Add(e); return true; });
        // Every request carries its own token: the reply cache is keyed by BusMessage.uniqueid.
        s.Process(new BusMessage { Uniqueid = SyntheticToken, SourceSystem = "Hunt1896", SourceModule = "GfeSDK", Joined = true });
        Equal(0, Response(s.Process(Request(SyntheticToken + "\0", new() { CreateSDKInstanceRequest = new() { Client = "Hunt", ClientPID = 42 } }))).Retval);
        var configure = new SDKIPCRequest { ConfigureHighlightsRequest = new() };
        configure.ConfigureHighlightsRequest.HighlightTable.Add(new ConfigureHighlightsRequest.Types.HighlightDefinition { HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED" });
        configure.ConfigureHighlightsRequest.HighlightTable.Add(new ConfigureHighlightsRequest.Types.HighlightDefinition { HighlightId = "PLAYER_DOWNED" });
        Equal(0, Response(s.Process(Request(SyntheticToken + "\u0001", configure))).Retval);
        Equal(0, Response(s.Process(Request("\u001f" + SyntheticToken, new() { OpenGroupRequest = new() { GroupId = group } }))).Retval);
        return s;
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.Tests/LocalizationTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Localization;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

public static partial class Program
{
    private static readonly Regex Placeholder = new(@"\{(\d+)(?:[:,][^}]*)?\}", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant);

    // Keys referenced in source: Loc["X"], Loc.Format("X", ...), Text.Get("X"), Text.Format("X", ...),
    // Loc[cond ? "X" : "Y"], XAML {Binding Loc[X]} / {Binding [X], Source=...} and Require(..., "Settings.X").
    private static readonly Regex[] KeyUsages =
    [
        new(@"\b(?:Loc|loc|Text|LocalizationService\.Instance)(?:\.(?:Get|Format))?\s*[\[(]\s*""([A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z0-9.]+)""", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant),
        new(@"\?\s*""([A-Z][A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z0-9.]+)""\s*:\s*""([A-Z][A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z0-9.]+)""", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant),
        new(@"\bLoc\[([A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z0-9.]+)\]", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant),
        new(@"\{Binding \[([A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z0-9.]+)\]", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant),
        new(@"\bRequire\([^;]*""(Settings\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)""\)", RegexOptions.CultureInvariant | RegexOptions.Singleline),
    ];

    private static void LocalizationTests()
    {
        Test("localization catalogs have identical keys in every language", () =>
        {
            var reference = Text.Catalog(Text.Russian);
            foreach (var language in Text.Languages)
            {
                var catalog = Text.Catalog(language);
                var missing = reference.Keys.Except(catalog.Keys).ToArray();
                var extra = catalog.Keys.Except(reference.Keys).ToArray();
                if (missing.Length + extra.Length > 0)
                    throw new Exception($"{language}: missing [{string.Join(", ", missing)}], extra [{string.Join(", ", extra)}]");
            }
        });
        Test("localization catalogs use the same {n} placeholders in every language", () =>
        {
            var reference = Text.Catalog(Text.Russian);
            foreach (var language in Text.Languages)
                foreach (var (key, value) in Text.Catalog(language))
                {
                    var expected = Placeholders(reference[key]);
                    var actual = Placeholders(value);
                    if (!expected.SetEquals(actual))
                        throw new Exception($"{language}/{key}: placeholders {{{string.Join(",", actual)}}} differ from ru {{{string.Join(",", expected)}}}");
                }
        });
        Test("every localization key used in source exists in the catalog, and every catalog key is used", () =>
        {
            var root = RepositoryRoot();
            if (root is null) return; // Installed test runs without sources have nothing to scan.
            var catalog = Text.Catalog(Text.Russian);
            var unknown = new SortedSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var used = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var sources = Directory.EnumerateFiles(Path.Combine(root, "src"), "*.*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .Where(path => path.EndsWith(".cs", StringComparison.Ordinal) || path.EndsWith(".xaml", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                .Where(path => !path.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "obj" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar) &&
                               !path.Contains(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar + "bin" + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
            foreach (var path in sources)
            {
                var text = File.ReadAllText(path);
                foreach (var usage in KeyUsages)
                    foreach (Match match in usage.Matches(text))
                        foreach (Group group in match.Groups.Values.Skip(1))
                        {
                            if (!group.Success) continue;
                            used.Add(group.Value);
                            if (!catalog.ContainsKey(group.Value)) unknown.Add($"{Path.GetFileName(path)}: {group.Value}");
                        }
            }
            if (unknown.Count > 0) throw new Exception("Unknown localization keys: " + string.Join("; ", unknown));
            var unused = catalog.Keys.Where(key => !used.Contains(key)).OrderBy(key => key, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
            if (unused.Length > 0) throw new Exception("Unused localization keys (remove them): " + string.Join(", ", unused));
        });
        Test("language switch changes text and an unknown key falls back to the key itself", () =>
        {
            var original = Text.Language;
            try
            {
                Text.SetLanguage("en");
                Equal("Cancel", Text.Get("Common.Cancel"));
                Equal("Saved: clip.mp4", Text.Format("Status.ClipSaved", "clip.mp4"));
                Text.SetLanguage("something-else");
                Equal(Text.Russian, Text.Language);
                Equal("Отмена", Text.Get("Common.Cancel"));
                Equal("No.Such.Key", Text.Get("No.Such.Key"));
            }
            finally { Text.SetLanguage(original); }
        });
        Test("first start follows the Windows display language", () =>
        {
            var original = System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture;
            try
            {
                System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = new("ru-RU");
                Equal(Text.Russian, new SystemSettings().Language);
                System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = new("en-US");
                Equal(Text.English, new SystemSettings().Language);
                System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = new("uk-UA");
                Equal(Text.English, new SystemSettings().Language);
            }
            finally { System.Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = original; }
        });
        Test("a saved language survives loading", () =>
            Equal(Text.English, System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<StudioSettings>("""{"System":{"Language":"en"}}""", StudioSettings.JsonOptions)!.System.Language));
    }

    private static HashSet<int> Placeholders(string value) =>
        Placeholder.Matches(value).Select(m => int.Parse(m.Groups[1].Value)).ToHashSet();

    private static string? RepositoryRoot()
    {
        for (var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory); dir is not null; dir = dir.Parent)
            if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "HuntReplayStudio.sln"))) return dir.FullName;
        return null;
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.Tests/PayloadArenaTests.cs`:

```cs
using HuntReplay.Core.Media;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

public static partial class Program
{
    private static void PayloadArenaTests()
    {
        Test("payload arena recycles chunks once the buffer evicts their packets", () =>
        {
            var arena = new PayloadArena(chunkBytes: 64, maxIdleChunks: 4);
            var ring = new PacketRingBuffer(2, 1_000_000);
            for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) ring.Add(ArenaPacket(arena, i, key: true, fill: (byte)i, size: 16));
            // 2 s window of 16-byte packets = 3 packets live: steady state needs a handful of 64-byte chunks, not 250.
            True(arena.AllocatedChunks <= 4);
        });
        Test("payload arena never overwrites data a snapshot still holds", () =>
        {
            var arena = new PayloadArena(chunkBytes: 64, maxIdleChunks: 4);
            var ring = new PacketRingBuffer(2, 1_000_000);
            ring.Add(ArenaPacket(arena, 0, key: true, fill: 0xAB, size: 16));
            using var snapshot = ring.Snapshot(0, 1_000_000)!;
            for (int i = 1; i < 500; i++) ring.Add(ArenaPacket(arena, i, key: true, fill: (byte)i, size: 16));
            True(snapshot.Packets[0].Payload.Span.ToArray().All(b => b == 0xAB));
        });
        Test("payload arena reuses a snapshot's chunk only after it is disposed", () =>
        {
            var arena = new PayloadArena(chunkBytes: 64, maxIdleChunks: 4);
            var ring = new PacketRingBuffer(2, 1_000_000);
            ring.Add(ArenaPacket(arena, 0, key: true, fill: 1, size: 16));
            var snapshot = ring.Snapshot(0, 1_000_000)!;
            for (int i = 1; i < 200; i++) ring.Add(ArenaPacket(arena, i, key: true, fill: 2, size: 16));
            int whileHeld = arena.AllocatedChunks;
            snapshot.Dispose();
            snapshot.Dispose(); // Idempotent: a second dispose must not release twice.
            for (int i = 200; i < 400; i++) ring.Add(ArenaPacket(arena, i, key: true, fill: 3, size: 16));
            True(arena.AllocatedChunks <= whileHeld + 1);
        });
        Test("payload arena chunks of rejected packets are released", () =>
        {
            var arena = new PayloadArena(chunkBytes: 64, maxIdleChunks: 4);
            var ring = new PacketRingBuffer(2, 1_000_000);
            // Audio before the first keyframe is dropped by the buffer; its chunk reference must not leak.
            for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
            {
                var (chunk, segment) = arena.Rent(16);
                ring.Add(new EncodedPacket(1, segment, i, i, 1, false) { Chunk = chunk });
            }
            True(arena.AllocatedChunks <= 2);
        });
        Test("payload arena gives a packet larger than a chunk its own block", () =>
        {
            var arena = new PayloadArena(chunkBytes: 64, maxIdleChunks: 4);
            var (chunk, segment) = arena.Rent(200);
            Equal(200, segment.Count);
            segment.AsSpan().Fill(7);
            chunk.Release();
            Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => chunk.Release());
        });
    }

    private static EncodedPacket ArenaPacket(PayloadArena arena, int second, bool key, byte fill, int size)
    {
        var (chunk, segment) = arena.Rent(size);
        segment.AsSpan().Fill(fill);
        return new EncodedPacket(0, segment, second * 1_000_000L, second * 1_000_000L, 1_000_000, key) { Chunk = chunk };
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.Tests/PlaybackDiagnosticsTests.cs`:

```cs
using HuntReplay.Core.Media;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

public static partial class Program
{
    private static void PlaybackDiagnosticsTests()
    {
        const int fileOpenFailed = unchecked((int)0xC00D11B1);
        Test("preview error keeps the HRESULT and its documented WMP symbol", () =>
        {
            Equal("0xC00D11B1", PlaybackDiagnostics.Code(fileOpenFailed));
            Equal("NS_E_WMP_FILE_OPEN_FAILED", PlaybackDiagnostics.SymbolName(fileOpenFailed));
            Equal("0x80004005", PlaybackDiagnostics.Code(unchecked((int)0x80004005)));
            True(PlaybackDiagnostics.SymbolName(unchecked((int)0x80004005)) is null);
        });
        Test("generic file-open hint offers possible causes without a diagnosis", () =>
        {
            var hint = PlaybackDiagnostics.Hint(fileOpenFailed);
            True(hint.Contains("0xC00D11B1")); True(hint.Contains("не называет конкретную причину"));
            True(hint.Contains("может быть видеокодек")); True(hint.Contains("AV1")); True(hint.Contains("HEVC"));
            False(hint.Contains("точно")); False(hint.Contains("отсутствует")); False(hint.Contains("не установлен"));
        });
        Test("hint says the saved clip is intact and offers Windows playback and H.264 for new clips", () =>
        {
            var hint = PlaybackDiagnostics.Hint(fileOpenFailed);
            True(hint.Contains("Клип сохранён и не изменён"));
            True(hint.Contains("Открыть в проигрывателе")); True(hint.Contains("H.264"));
            var other = PlaybackDiagnostics.Hint(unchecked((int)0x80004005));
            True(other.Contains("0x80004005")); True(other.Contains("Клип сохранён и не изменён"));
            False(other.Contains("NS_E_WMP"));
            var unknown = PlaybackDiagnostics.Hint(0);
            False(unknown.Contains("0x00000000")); True(unknown.Contains("Клип сохранён и не изменён"));
        });
        Test("log line names the code and file but carries no control characters", () =>
        {
            var line = PlaybackDiagnostics.LogLine(fileOpenFailed, "Hunt_HUNTER_KILLED_2026-10-08.mp4");
            True(line.Contains("0xC00D11B1")); True(line.Contains("NS_E_WMP_FILE_OPEN_FAILED"));
            True(line.Contains("Hunt_HUNTER_KILLED_2026-10-08.mp4"));
            False(line.Any(char.IsControl));
        });
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Text.Json;
using Google.Protobuf;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Media;
using HuntReplay.Core.Replay;
using HuntReplay.Core.Storage;
using HuntReplay.Protocol;
using HuntReplay.Protocol.Generated;

using HuntReplay.TestShared;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

/// <summary>Every registered core test as its own MSTest case.</summary>
[TestClass]
public sealed class CoreSuite
{
    public static IEnumerable<object[]> Cases => TestRegistry.Rows(Program.RegisterAll);
    public static string CaseName(System.Reflection.MethodInfo method, object[] row) => (string)row[0];

    [TestMethod]
    [DynamicData(nameof(Cases), DynamicDataDisplayName = nameof(CaseName))]
    public Task Run(string name) => TestRegistry.Run(name);
}

public static partial class Program
{
    /// <summary>Records every core test with <see cref="TestRegistry"/>; <see cref="CoreSuite"/> runs them under MSTest.</summary>
    internal static void RegisterAll()
    {
        Test("defaults satisfy the settings contract", () => Settings().Validate());
        Test("unknown enum rejected", () => { var s = Settings(); s.Video.Codec = (VideoCodec)99; Throws<InvalidDataException>(s.Validate); });
        Test("NaN post-roll rejected", () => { var s = Settings(); s.Replay.PostEventSeconds = double.NaN; Throws<InvalidDataException>(s.Validate); });
        Test("unsupported FPS rejected", () => { var s = Settings(); s.Video.Fps = 59; Throws<InvalidDataException>(s.Validate); });
        Test("older resolution names still load", () => Equal(VideoResolution.Qhd, JsonSerializer.Deserialize<StudioSettings>("""{"Video":{"Resolution":"Qhd"}}""", StudioSettings.JsonOptions)!.Video.Resolution));
        Test("resolution presets cover every enum value except Native", () => Equal(Enum.GetValues<VideoResolution>().Length - 1, VideoResolutions.Presets.Distinct().Count()));
        Test("resolution presets ascend by height", () => True(VideoResolutions.Presets.Zip(VideoResolutions.Presets.Skip(1)).All(p => p.First.Height() < p.Second.Height())));
        Test("resolution preset keeps the source aspect ratio", () =>
        {
            Equal((1920, 1080), VideoResolution.FullHd.OutputSize(2560, 1440));
            Equal((2580, 1080), VideoResolution.FullHd.OutputSize(3440, 1440));
            Equal((1728, 1080), VideoResolution.FullHd.OutputSize(1920, 1200));
            Equal((1280, 720), VideoResolution.P720.OutputSize(1366, 768)); // 1280.6 rounds to 1281, then down to even.
        });
        Test("resolution preset never scales the source up", () =>
        {
            Equal((1920, 1080), VideoResolution.Uhd.OutputSize(1920, 1080));
            Equal((1920, 1080), VideoResolution.FullHd.OutputSize(1920, 1080));
            Equal((1366, 768), VideoResolution.Native.OutputSize(1367, 769));
        });
        Test("overlay is off until enabled", () => False(Settings().System.OverlayEnabled));
        Test("unsupported overlay duration rejected", () => { var s = Settings(); s.System.OverlaySeconds = 4; Throws<InvalidDataException>(s.Validate); });
        Test("unknown overlay corner rejected", () => { var s = Settings(); s.System.OverlayCorner = (OverlayCorner)9; Throws<InvalidDataException>(s.Validate); });
        Test("x264 is explicit and H264-only", () => { var s = Settings(); s.Video.Encoder = VideoEncoder.X264; s.Video.Codec = VideoCodec.Hevc; Throws<InvalidDataException>(s.Validate); });
        Test("empty event selection disables both events", () => { var r = new ReplaySettings { HunterKilled = false, PlayerDowned = false }; False(r.IsEnabled("HUNTER_KILLED")); False(r.IsEnabled("PLAYER_DOWNED")); });
        Test("safe template and multi-kill name", () => Equal("Hunt_MULTI_KILL_x2_2026-10-08_12-13-14-000.mp4", ClipFileName.Create("Hunt_{event}_{date}_{time}.mp4", "MULTI_KILL_x2", new DateTimeOffset(2026,10,8,12,13,14,TimeSpan.Zero))));
        Test("template traversal rejected", () => Throws<InvalidDataException>(() => ClipFileName.ValidateTemplate("../{event}.mp4")));
        Test("unknown filename tokens rejected", () => Throws<InvalidDataException>(() => ClipFileName.ValidateTemplate("Hunt_{pid}.mp4")));
        Test("Windows reserved file names rejected on every OS", () => { False(ClipFileName.IsSafeName("CON.mp4")); False(ClipFileName.IsSafeName("LPT1.mp4")); False(ClipFileName.IsSafeName("x.mp4 ")); });
        Test("untrusted event names cannot become paths", () => False(ClipFileName.Create("{event}.mp4", "../../escape:C", DateTimeOffset.Now).Contains('/')));
        Test("atomic settings save and backup", () => InTemp(path => { var store = new SettingsStore(Path.Combine(path,"config.json")); var s = Settings(); store.Save(s); s.Video.BitrateMbps = 40; store.Save(s); Equal(40,store.Load().Video.BitrateMbps); True(File.Exists(store.FilePath+".bak")); Equal(0, Directory.GetFiles(path,"*.tmp").Length); }));
        Test("corrupt config is not overwritten on load", () => InTemp(path => { var file = Path.Combine(path,"config.json"); File.WriteAllText(file,"{bad"); var store = new SettingsStore(file); _ = store.Load(); True(store.LoadWarning is not null); Equal("{bad",File.ReadAllText(file)); }));
        Test("future config schema is not silently accepted", () => InTemp(path => { var file = Path.Combine(path,"config.json"); var s = Settings(); s.SchemaVersion=42; File.WriteAllText(file,JsonSerializer.Serialize(s)); var store = new SettingsStore(file); _ = store.Load(); True(store.LoadWarning is not null); }));

        Test("empty buffer has no snapshot", () => True(new PacketRingBuffer(60,1000).Snapshot(0,1_000_000) is null));
        Test("P frames before first IDR are ignored", () => { var ring = new PacketRingBuffer(60,1000); ring.Add(Video(1,false)); ring.Add(Audio(1)); Equal(0L,ring.Status.Bytes); });
        Test("smart trim starts on the previous keyframe", () => { var ring = Filled(); var snap = ring.Snapshot(5_500_000,9_000_000)!; Equal(4_000_000L,snap.StartUs); True(snap.Packets.First(p=>p.IsVideo).IsKeyFrame); False(snap.TruncatedStart); });
        Test("export excludes future video and aligns audio", () => { var snap=Filled().Snapshot(5_500_000,9_000_000)!; True(snap.Packets.All(p=>p.DtsUs>=snap.StartUs && p.PtsUs<9_000_000)); Equal(9_000_000L,snap.EndUs); });
        Test("per-stream ordering accepts interleaved callbacks", () => { var r=new PacketRingBuffer(60,10000); r.Add(Video(0,true)); r.Add(Video(1,false)); r.Add(Audio(0)); r.Add(Audio(1)); Equal(4,r.Snapshot(0,2_000_000)!.Packets.Count); });
        Test("nonmonotonic encoder DTS rejected", () => { var r=Filled(); Throws<InvalidDataException>(()=>r.Add(Video(1,false))); });
        Test("duplicate encoder DTS rejected rather than eviction loop", () => { var r=new PacketRingBuffer(60,1000); r.Add(Video(0,true)); Throws<InvalidDataException>(()=>r.Add(Video(0,true))); });
        Test("time eviction preserves a complete leading GOP", () => { var r=new PacketRingBuffer(5,10000); for(int i=0;i<20;i++)r.Add(Video(i,i%2==0)); Equal(14_000_000L,r.Status.FirstUs); True(r.Snapshot(0,20_000_000)!.TruncatedStart); });
        Test("pending sequence lease survives normal eviction", () => { var r=new PacketRingBuffer(5,10000); for(int i=0;i<6;i++)r.Add(Video(i,i%2==0)); var pin=r.Pin(2_000_000); for(int i=6;i<20;i++)r.Add(Video(i,i%2==0)); Equal(2_000_000L,r.Status.FirstUs); r.Unpin(pin); Equal(14_000_000L,r.Status.FirstUs); });
        Test("hard RAM limit overrides leases at GOP boundaries", () => { var r=new PacketRingBuffer(300,24); var pin=r.Pin(0); for(int i=0;i<20;i++)r.Add(Video(i,i%2==0)); True(r.Status.Bytes<=24); True(r.Status.EvictedGops>0); True(r.Snapshot(0,20_000_000)!.Packets.First().IsKeyFrame); r.Unpin(pin); });

        Test("post-roll and coalesce horizon are separate", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var plan=p.Register(Event("one",100))!; Equal(107_000_000L,plan.EndUs); Equal(115_000_000L,plan.ReadyAtUs); Equal(0,p.TakeReady(107_000_000).Count); Equal(1,p.TakeReady(115_000_000).Count); });
        Test("kills 12 seconds apart form one clip", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var a=p.Register(Event("a",100))!; var b=p.Register(Event("b",112))!; Equal(a.Id,b.Id); Equal("MULTI_KILL_x2",b.EventTag); Equal(80_000_000L,b.StartUs); Equal(119_000_000L,b.EndUs); Equal(127_000_000L,b.ReadyAtUs); });
        Test("exact 15-second boundary merges", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var a=p.Register(Event("a",100))!; Equal(a.Id,p.Register(Event("b",115))!.Id); });
        Test("outside coalesce gap becomes a new clip", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var a=p.Register(Event("a",100))!; False(a.Id==p.Register(Event("b",116))!.Id); });
        Test("different matches never coalesce", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var a=p.Register(Event("a",100))!; False(a.Id==p.Register(Event("b",101) with{GroupId="other"})!.Id); });
        Test("different game clients never coalesce", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var a=p.Register(Event("a",100))!; False(a.Id==p.Register(Event("b",101) with{SessionId="other"})!.Id); });
        Test("retransmitted request never doubles the kill count", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var e=Event("same",100); var a=p.Register(e)!; True(p.Register(e) is null); Equal(1,a.KillCount); });
        Test("disabled coalescing saves at post-roll", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new(){Coalesce=false}); var a=p.Register(Event("a",100))!; Equal(107_000_000L,a.ReadyAtUs); False(a.Id==p.Register(Event("b",101))!.Id); });
        Test("continuous kill chain has a maximum sequence length", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); var a=p.Register(Event("0",100))!; for(int i=1;i<=6;i++)Equal(a.Id,p.Register(Event(i.ToString(),100+i*10))!.Id); False(a.Id==p.Register(Event("7",170))!.Id); });
        Test("signed int32 startDelta cannot overflow", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); Equal(40_000_000L,p.Register(Event("a",100) with{StartDeltaMs=int.MinValue})!.StartUs); });
        Test("untrusted endDelta is capped at 30 seconds", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); Equal(130_000_000L,p.Register(Event("a",100) with{EndDeltaMs=int.MaxValue})!.EndUs); });
        Test("bounded pending plans reject event floods", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new(){Coalesce=false}); for(int i=0;i<8;i++)p.Register(Event(i.ToString(),100+i)); Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>p.Register(Event("overflow",109))); });
        Test("export backpressure retains unconsumed pending plans", () =>
        {
            var p = new HighlightPlanner(new() { Coalesce = false });
            for (int i=0; i<8; i++) p.Register(Event(i.ToString(),100+i));
            Equal(2, p.TakeReady(999_000_000, maximum: 2).Count); Equal(6, p.PendingCount);
            Equal(6, p.TakeReady(999_000_000, force: true).Count); Equal(0, p.PendingCount);
        });
        Test("force flush returns each pending plan only once", () => { var p=new HighlightPlanner(new()); p.Register(Event("a",100)); Equal(1,p.TakeReady(101_000_000,true).Count); Equal(0,p.TakeReady(999_000_000,true).Count); });

        Test("library rename moves MP4 and keeps the same record Id", () => InLibrary((path, store) => { var l=new ClipLibrary(path+Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, store); var c=CreateClip(l,"a.mp4",10); var r=l.Rename(c,"b.mp4"); True(File.Exists(r.FullPath)); False(File.Exists(c.FullPath)); Equal(c.Metadata.Id,l.List().Single().Metadata.Id); }));
```
