`tests/HuntReplay.Tests/RuntimeRegressionTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Google.Protobuf;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;
using HuntReplay.Core.Replay;
using HuntReplay.Protocol.Generated;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

public static partial class Program
{
    private static void RuntimeRegressionTests()
    {
        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) TestAsync("Highlights pipe server restarts after its listen loop failed", async () =>
        {
            if (AppAssembly() is not { } app) return;
            var root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "HuntReplay-pipe-test-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            var name = "HuntReplayTest." + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
            var log = (IAsyncDisposable)Activator.CreateInstance(app.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.StudioLog")!, root)!;
            var recorder = (IAsyncDisposable)Activator.CreateInstance(app.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.RecorderService")!,
                new StudioSettings(), log, Path.Combine(root, "library"))!;
            var serverType = app.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.HighlightsPipeServer")!;
            var server = (IAsyncDisposable)Activator.CreateInstance(serverType, recorder, log, name)!;
            bool TryStart() => (bool)serverType.GetMethod("TryStart")!.Invoke(server, [false])!;
            bool Listening() => (bool)serverType.GetProperty("IsListening")!.GetValue(server)!;
            var blockers = new List<System.IO.Pipes.NamedPipeServerStream>();
            try
            {
                True(TryStart());
                // Take the other 15 of the 16 instances: after the next connection the server cannot create
                // a listening instance, and its listen loop ends with an IOException.
                for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
                    blockers.Add(new(name, System.IO.Pipes.PipeDirection.InOut, 16, System.IO.Pipes.PipeTransmissionMode.Byte,
                        System.IO.Pipes.PipeOptions.Asynchronous | System.IO.Pipes.PipeOptions.CurrentUserOnly));
                using (var first = new System.IO.Pipes.NamedPipeClientStream(".", name, System.IO.Pipes.PipeDirection.InOut))
                {
                    await first.ConnectAsync(5000);
                    for (int wait = 0; wait < 100 && Listening(); wait++) await Task.Delay(50);
                    False(Listening());
                }
                foreach (var blocker in blockers) blocker.Dispose();
                blockers.Clear();
                // The watcher's next retry must start a fresh loop, not report the dead one as running.
                True(TryStart());
                True(Listening());
                using var client = new System.IO.Pipes.NamedPipeClientStream(".", name, System.IO.Pipes.PipeDirection.InOut);
                await client.ConnectAsync(5000);
                True(client.IsConnected);
            }
            finally
            {
                foreach (var blocker in blockers) blocker.Dispose();
                await server.DisposeAsync();
                await recorder.DisposeAsync();
                await log.DisposeAsync();
                Directory.Delete(root, true);
            }
        });

        if (OperatingSystem.IsWindows()) TestAsync("stopping the recorder saves every accepted highlight", async () =>
        {
            if (AppAssembly() is not { } app) return;
            var root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "HuntReplay-recorder-test-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            var settings = new StudioSettings();
            settings.Video.Source = CaptureSource.Monitor; settings.Video.Encoder = VideoEncoder.X264; settings.Video.Codec = VideoCodec.H264;
            settings.Video.Fps = 30; settings.Video.BitrateMbps = 10; settings.Video.Resolution = VideoResolution.P720;
            settings.Replay.BufferSeconds = 15; settings.Replay.PreEventSeconds = 2; settings.Replay.PostEventSeconds = 5; settings.Replay.Coalesce = false;
            settings.Storage.Directory = Path.Combine(root, "clips");
            var log = (IAsyncDisposable)Activator.CreateInstance(app.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.StudioLog")!, root)!;
            var recorderType = app.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.RecorderService")!;
            var recorder = (IAsyncDisposable)Activator.CreateInstance(recorderType, settings, log, Path.Combine(root, "library"))!;
            int saved = 0;
            recorderType.GetEvent("ClipSaved")!.AddEventHandler(recorder, new Action<HuntReplay.Core.Storage.LibraryClip>(_ => Interlocked.Increment(ref saved)));
            object Status() => recorderType.GetProperty("Status")!.GetValue(recorder)!;
            T Field<T>(string name) => (T)Status().GetType().GetProperty(name)!.GetValue(Status())!;
            try
            {
                var devices = app.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Interop.NativeCaptureEngine")!.GetMethod("EnumerateDevices")!.Invoke(null, null);
                try { await (Task)recorderType.GetMethod("StartAsync")!.Invoke(recorder, [IntPtr.Zero, devices])!; }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    // CI runners may have no display or audio endpoint; the drain logic needs a real capture.
                    Console.WriteLine("SKIP: capture unavailable: " + ex.Message);
                    return;
                }
                for (int wait = 0; wait < 150 && Field<HuntReplay.Core.Media.BufferStatus>("Buffer").Seconds < 3; wait++) await Task.Delay(100);
                var tryHighlight = recorderType.GetMethod("TryHighlight")!;
                long now = (long)recorderType.GetProperty("NowUs")!.GetValue(recorder)!;
                // Three matches, so three plans; only two exports run at once and none has reached its post-roll yet.
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                    True((bool)tryHighlight.Invoke(recorder, [new HighlightEvent("session", "request" + i, "match" + i, "HUNTER_KILLED", now)])!);
                Equal(3, Field<int>("Pending"));
                await (Task)recorderType.GetMethod("StopAsync")!.Invoke(recorder, null)!;
                Equal(3, saved);
                Equal(0, Field<int>("Pending"));
                Equal(0, Field<int>("Exports"));
                var files = Directory.GetFiles(settings.Storage.Directory);
                Equal(3, files.Count(f => f.EndsWith(".mp4", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && !f.EndsWith(".partial.mp4", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
                Equal(3, files.Length);
            }
            finally
            {
                await recorder.DisposeAsync();
                await log.DisposeAsync();
                Directory.Delete(root, true);
            }
        });

        {

            Throws<InvalidDataException>(() => Session().Process(bus));
        });
    }

    private static void InvalidIdentifier(Action action, string field, string kind, string reason)
    {
        try { action(); }
        catch (InvalidDataException ex)
        {
            True(ex.Message.Contains(field)); True(ex.Message.Contains(kind)); True(ex.Message.Contains(reason));
            False(ex.Message.Contains("do-not-echo")); return;
        }
        throw new Exception("Expected a precise InvalidDataException for " + field);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using HuntReplay.Core.Support;
using HuntReplay.Core.Updates;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

public static partial class Program
{
    private const string AssetUrl = "https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/download/v0.2.0/HuntReplayStudio.exe";
    private static readonly string Digest = new('a', 64);

    private static ReleaseInfo Release(string assetUrl = AssetUrl, string digest = "sha256:", string name = "HuntReplayStudio.exe", string page = "https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/tag/v0.2.0")
    {
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            tag_name = "v0.2.0", html_url = page, body = "Notes",
            assets = new object[]
            {
                new { name = "SHA256SUMS.txt", browser_download_url = "https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/download/v0.2.0/SHA256SUMS.txt", digest = "sha256:" + new string('b', 64) },
                new { name, browser_download_url = assetUrl, digest = digest == "sha256:" ? digest + Digest : digest },
            },
        });
        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        return AppUpdate.ParseRelease(doc.RootElement);
    }

    private static void UpdateTests()
    {
        Test("update release parsing picks the executable asset and its digest", () =>
        {
            var r = Release();
            Equal("0.2.0", r.Version); Equal(AssetUrl, r.AssetUrl); Equal(Digest, r.Sha256); Equal("Notes", r.Notes);
            Equal("https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/tag/v0.2.0", r.PageUrl);
        });
        Test("update release without the executable has nothing to install", () =>
        {
            var r = Release(name: "Other.exe");
            True(r.AssetUrl is null); True(r.Sha256 is null);
        });
        Test("update download URLs outside this repository's releases are dropped", () =>
        {
            True(Release(assetUrl: "http://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/download/v0.2.0/HuntReplayStudio.exe").AssetUrl is null);
            True(Release(assetUrl: "https://evil.example/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/download/v0.2.0/HuntReplayStudio.exe").AssetUrl is null);
            True(Release(assetUrl: "https://github.com/Someone/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/download/v0.2.0/HuntReplayStudio.exe").AssetUrl is null);
            True(Release(assetUrl: "https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/raw/main/HuntReplayStudio.exe").AssetUrl is null);
            True(Release(assetUrl: "https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/releases/download/v0.2.0/payload.exe").AssetUrl is null);
            True(Release(page: "https://example.com/release").PageUrl is null);
        });
        Test("update digest must be a full SHA-256", () =>
        {
            Equal(Digest, AppUpdate.ParseSha256Digest("SHA256:" + Digest.ToUpperInvariant()));
            True(AppUpdate.ParseSha256Digest(null) is null);
            True(AppUpdate.ParseSha256Digest("sha1:" + new string('a', 40)) is null);
            True(AppUpdate.ParseSha256Digest("sha256:" + new string('a', 63)) is null);
            True(AppUpdate.ParseSha256Digest("sha256:" + new string('g', 64)) is null);
            True(Release(digest: "").Sha256 is null);
        });
        Test("update notes drop links that cannot be clicked in a message box", () =>
        {
            True(AppUpdate.PlainNotes("**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/compare/v0.1.8...v0.1.9") is null);
            True(AppUpdate.PlainNotes(null) is null);
            Equal("What's Changed\n• Faster export by @Mlovo\n• See the guide\n\nFixed crash",
                AppUpdate.PlainNotes("## What's Changed\r\n* Faster export by @Mlovo in https://github.com/Mlovo/HuntOpenHighlights/pull/7\r\n" +
                    "- See [the guide](https://example.com/guide)\r\n\r\n\r\n**Fixed** crash\r\n\r\n**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/x/y/compare/a...b"));
        });
        Test("update version comparison", () =>
        {
            True(AppUpdate.IsNewer("0.2.0", "0.1.9")); True(AppUpdate.IsNewer("0.1.10", "0.1.9"));
            False(AppUpdate.IsNewer("0.1.9", "0.1.9")); False(AppUpdate.IsNewer("0.1.8", "0.1.9")); False(AppUpdate.IsNewer("", "0.1.9"));
        });
        Test("update file hash is checked against the digest", () => InTemp(path =>
        {
            var file = Path.Combine(path, "new.exe");
            var content = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("new build");
            File.WriteAllBytes(file, content);
            var hex = Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(content)).ToLowerInvariant();
            True(AppUpdate.MatchesSha256Async(file, hex).GetAwaiter().GetResult());
            False(AppUpdate.MatchesSha256Async(file, Digest).GetAwaiter().GetResult());
        }));
        Test("update replaces the executable and keeps the old one aside", () => InTemp(path =>
        {
            var exe = Path.Combine(path, "HuntReplayStudio.exe");
            File.WriteAllText(exe, "old"); File.WriteAllText(AppUpdate.BackupPath(exe), "stale");
            File.WriteAllText(AppUpdate.StagingPath(exe), "new");
            AppUpdate.Replace(exe, AppUpdate.StagingPath(exe));
            Equal("new", File.ReadAllText(exe)); Equal("old", File.ReadAllText(AppUpdate.BackupPath(exe)));
            False(File.Exists(AppUpdate.StagingPath(exe)));
            True(AppUpdate.CleanUp(exe));
            False(File.Exists(AppUpdate.BackupPath(exe))); True(File.Exists(exe));
        }));
        Test("failed update swap puts the current executable back", () => InTemp(path =>
        {
            var exe = Path.Combine(path, "HuntReplayStudio.exe");
            File.WriteAllText(exe, "old");
            Throws<IOException>(() => AppUpdate.Replace(exe, Path.Combine(path, "missing.exe")));
            Equal("old", File.ReadAllText(exe)); False(File.Exists(AppUpdate.BackupPath(exe)));
        }));
        Test("support channels hide empty entries and non-https links", () =>
        {
            var shown = SupportChannels.Filter([
                new("Page", "https://example.com/donate", SupportKind.Link),
                new("Empty", "", SupportKind.Link),
                new("Plain http", "http://example.com", SupportKind.Link),
                new("Script", "javascript:alert(1)", SupportKind.Link),
                new("Wallet", "TXYZ", SupportKind.Address),
                new("No wallet", " ", SupportKind.Address),
            ]);
            Equal("Page,Wallet", string.Join(",", shown.Select(c => c.Name)));
            True(SupportChannels.Available.All(c => !c.IsLink || SupportChannels.IsSafeLink(c.Value)));
        });
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.Tests/VideoTrimmingTests.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

using static HuntReplay.TestShared.MediaTestKit;

namespace HuntReplay.Tests;

public static partial class Program
{
    private static bool nativeLoaded;

    [DllImport("kernel32", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
    private static extern IntPtr LoadLibraryEx(string fileName, IntPtr reserved, uint flags);

    private static class NativeTrimInterop
    {
        [UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
        public delegate int ProgressCallback(IntPtr user, double progress);

        [DllImport("HuntReplay.Media.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        public static extern int hr_trim(
            string source_path,
            string target_path,
            double start_seconds,
            double end_seconds,
            int accurate,
            ProgressCallback? progress_cb,
            IntPtr user);

        [DllImport("HuntReplay.Media.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
        public static extern IntPtr hr_last_error();

        public static string? GetLastError() => Marshal.PtrToStringUni(hr_last_error());

        [DllImport("HuntReplay.Media.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        public static extern int hr_player_open(string path, out IntPtr player, out int width, out int height, out double duration);

        [DllImport("HuntReplay.Media.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
        public static extern void hr_player_close(IntPtr player);

        [DllImport("HuntReplay.Media.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
        public static extern int hr_player_seek(IntPtr player, double seconds);

        [DllImport("HuntReplay.Media.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        public static extern int hr_thumbnail(string path, int maxWidth, out IntPtr pixels, out int width, out int height, out int stride);

        [DllImport("HuntReplay.Media.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
        public static extern void hr_free(IntPtr memory);
    }

    private static bool TryEnsureNativeLoaded()
    {
        if (nativeLoaded) return true;
        string dir = AppContext.BaseDirectory;
        string? dllPath = null;
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        {
            string candidate = Path.Combine(dir, "artifacts", "runtime", "HuntReplay.Media.dll");
            if (File.Exists(candidate)) { dllPath = candidate; break; }
            string? parent = Path.GetDirectoryName(dir.TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar));
            if (parent == null || parent == dir) break;
            dir = parent;
        }
        if (dllPath == null)
        {
            string candidate = Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), "artifacts", "runtime", "HuntReplay.Media.dll");
            if (File.Exists(candidate)) dllPath = candidate;
        }
        if (dllPath == null) return false;

        string? ffmpeg = TryResolveBundledTool("ffmpeg.exe");
        if (ffmpeg == null) return false;

        try
        {
            IntPtr handle = LoadLibraryEx(dllPath, IntPtr.Zero, 0x100 | 0x1000);
            if (handle == IntPtr.Zero) return false;
            NativeLibrary.SetDllImportResolver(typeof(Program).Assembly, (name, _, _) =>
            {
                if (name == "HuntReplay.Media.dll") return handle;
                return IntPtr.Zero;
            });
            nativeLoaded = true;
            return true;
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }


    private static string GenerateSampleClip(string dir, string fileName, double duration = 6.0, bool hasAudio = true)
    {
        string ffmpeg = ResolveBundledTool("ffmpeg.exe");
        string outPath = Path.Combine(dir, fileName);
        string durStr = duration.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string args = hasAudio
            ? $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=640x360:rate=30 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=1000:duration={durStr} -c:v libx264 -g 30 -c:a aac -pix_fmt yuv420p -y \"{outPath}\""
            : $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=640x360:rate=30 -an -c:v libx264 -g 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -y \"{outPath}\"";
        RunProcess(ffmpeg, args);
        return outPath;
    }

    private static string GenerateDualAudioClip(string dir, string fileName, double duration = 6.0)
    {
        string ffmpeg = ResolveBundledTool("ffmpeg.exe");
        string outPath = Path.Combine(dir, fileName);
        string durStr = duration.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        string args = $"-f lavfi -i testsrc=duration={durStr}:size=640x360:rate=30 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration={durStr} -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:duration={durStr} -map 0:v -map 1:a -map 2:a -c:v libx264 -g 30 -c:a aac -pix_fmt yuv420p -y \"{outPath}\"";
        RunProcess(ffmpeg, args);
        return outPath;
    }

    private record MediaProbeResult(double Duration, List<string> VideoStreams, List<string> AudioStreams);

    private static MediaProbeResult ProbeMedia(string filePath)
    {
        string json = RunForOutput(ResolveBundledTool("ffprobe.exe"),
            ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-show_entries", "stream=index,codec_name,codec_type", "-of", "json", filePath]);

        using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        var root = doc.RootElement;
        double duration = 0.0;
        if (root.TryGetProperty("format", out var formatElem) && formatElem.TryGetProperty("duration", out var durElem))
        {
            duration = double.Parse(durElem.GetString()!, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }

        var videoStreams = new List<string>();
        var audioStreams = new List<string>();
        if (root.TryGetProperty("streams", out var streamsElem))
        {
            foreach (var stream in streamsElem.EnumerateArray())
            {
                string type = stream.GetProperty("codec_type").GetString()!;
                string codec = stream.GetProperty("codec_name").GetString()!;
                if (type == "video") videoStreams.Add(codec);
                else if (type == "audio") audioStreams.Add(codec);
            }
        }
        return new MediaProbeResult(duration, videoStreams, audioStreams);
    }

    private static string ComputeFileSha256(string path)
    {
        using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        return Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(stream));
    }

    private static void ValidateTrimmingParameters(string? sourcePath, string? targetPath, double startSeconds, double endSeconds)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sourcePath))
            throw new ArgumentException("Исходный путь к видеофайлу не может быть пустым.", nameof(sourcePath));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(targetPath))
            throw new ArgumentException("Целевой путь для сохранения не может быть пустым.", nameof(targetPath));

        if (double.IsNaN(startSeconds) || double.IsInfinity(startSeconds))
            throw new ArgumentException("Время начала содержит некорректное значение.", nameof(startSeconds));
        if (double.IsNaN(endSeconds) || double.IsInfinity(endSeconds))
            throw new ArgumentException("Время окончания содержит некорректное значение.", nameof(endSeconds));

        string fullSource = Path.GetFullPath(sourcePath);
        string fullTarget = Path.GetFullPath(targetPath);

        if (!File.Exists(fullSource))
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Исходный видеофайл не найден на диске.", fullSource);

        if (string.Equals(fullSource, fullTarget, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Целевой путь сохранения не может совпадать с исходным файлом.");

        if (startSeconds < 0.0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(startSeconds), "Время начала фрагмента должно быть неотрицательным.");

        if (endSeconds <= startSeconds)
            throw new ArgumentException("Время окончания фрагмента должно строго превышать время начала.", nameof(endSeconds));

        if (endSeconds - startSeconds < 0.5)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Длительность фрагмента должна составлять не менее 0.5 с.");
    }

    private static class LocalFormatters
    {
        public static string FormatTime(double seconds)
        {
            if (double.IsNaN(seconds) || seconds < 0.0) seconds = 0.0;
            var ts = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds);
            if (ts.TotalHours >= 1.0)
            {
                return $"{(int)ts.TotalHours:D2}:{ts.Minutes:D2}:{ts.Seconds:D2}";
            }
            return $"{ts.Minutes:D2}:{ts.Seconds:D2}";
        }

        public static double StepTime(double current, double delta, double min, double max)
        {
            double stepped = Math.Round(current + delta, 3);
            return Math.Clamp(stepped, min, max);
        }
    }

    private static async Task VideoTrimmingTestsAsync()
    {
        // Parameter validation tests
        Test("trim validation rejects empty source path", () =>
        {
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters("", "target.mp4", 0, 5));
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters("   ", "target.mp4", 0, 5));
        });

        Test("trim validation rejects empty target path", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            string source = Path.Combine(dir, "source.mp4");
            File.WriteAllBytes(source, [1, 2, 3]);
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, "", 0, 5));
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, "   ", 0, 5));
        }));

        Test("trim validation requires existing source file", () =>
        {
            Throws<FileNotFoundException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters("nonexistent_file.mp4", "out.mp4", 0, 5));
        });

        Test("trim validation rejects identical source and target paths", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            string source = Path.Combine(dir, "clip.mp4");
            File.WriteAllBytes(source, [1, 2, 3]);
            Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, source, 0, 5));
            Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, Path.Combine(dir, "CLIP.mp4"), 0, 5));
        }));

        Test("trim validation rejects negative start timestamp", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            string source = Path.Combine(dir, "source.mp4");
            File.WriteAllBytes(source, [1, 2, 3]);
            Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, Path.Combine(dir, "out.mp4"), -1.0, 5.0));
        }));

        Test("trim validation rejects end time less than or equal to start", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            string source = Path.Combine(dir, "source.mp4");
            File.WriteAllBytes(source, [1, 2, 3]);
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, Path.Combine(dir, "out.mp4"), 5.0, 5.0));
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, Path.Combine(dir, "out.mp4"), 5.0, 4.0));
        }));

        Test("trim validation enforces minimum duration", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            string source = Path.Combine(dir, "source.mp4");
            File.WriteAllBytes(source, [1, 2, 3]);
            Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, Path.Combine(dir, "out.mp4"), 2.0, 2.3));
        }));

        Test("trim validation rejects NaN or infinite timestamps", () => InTemp(dir =>
        {
            string source = Path.Combine(dir, "source.mp4");
            File.WriteAllBytes(source, [1, 2, 3]);
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, Path.Combine(dir, "out.mp4"), double.NaN, 5.0));
            Throws<ArgumentException>(() => ValidateTrimmingParameters(source, Path.Combine(dir, "out.mp4"), 0.0, double.PositiveInfinity));
        }));

        // Formatters tests
        Test("timestamp formatting converts sub-hour seconds to MM:SS", () =>
        {
            Equal("00:00", LocalFormatters.FormatTime(0.0));
            Equal("00:05", LocalFormatters.FormatTime(5.0));
            Equal("01:23", LocalFormatters.FormatTime(83.0));
            Equal("59:59", LocalFormatters.FormatTime(3599.0));
        });

        Test("timestamp formatting converts hour-plus seconds to HH:MM:SS", () =>
        {
            Equal("01:00:00", LocalFormatters.FormatTime(3600.0));
            Equal("01:05:30", LocalFormatters.FormatTime(3930.0));
            Equal("10:00:00", LocalFormatters.FormatTime(36000.0));
        });

        Test("fine-tuning step increments clamp within valid range", () =>
        {
            Equal(5.1, LocalFormatters.StepTime(5.0, +0.1, 0.0, 10.0));
            Equal(4.9, LocalFormatters.StepTime(5.0, -0.1, 0.0, 10.0));
            Equal(0.0, LocalFormatters.StepTime(0.05, -0.1, 0.0, 10.0));
            Equal(10.0, LocalFormatters.StepTime(9.95, +0.1, 0.0, 10.0));
        });

        // Windows native engine integration tests
        if (RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform(OSPlatform.Windows))
        {
            if (!TryEnsureNativeLoaded())
            {
                Console.WriteLine("SKIP: Native media engine (HuntReplay.Media.dll / ffmpeg.exe) not built yet.");
                return;
            }

            Test("native trim rejects invalid input and sets hr_last_error", () =>
            {
                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim("nonexistent.mp4", "out.mp4", 0, 5, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                True(res < 0);
                string? err = NativeTrimInterop.GetLastError();
                True(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(err));
            });

            Test("native trim standard clip preserves video and audio", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
                string preHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target.mp4");

                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                Equal(0, res);
                True(File.Exists(target));

                var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
                True(probe.Duration >= 2.5 && probe.Duration <= 3.5);
                True(probe.VideoStreams.Contains("h264"));
                True(probe.AudioStreams.Contains("aac"));

                string postHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);
                Equal(preHash, postHash);
            }));

            Test("native trim source file is immutable across trims", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "immutable.mp4", 5.0, hasAudio: true);
                string initialHash = ComputeFileSha256(source);
                DateTime initialTime = File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source);

                // Successful trim
                string target1 = Path.Combine(dir, "t1.mp4");
                Equal(0, NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target1, 1.0, 3.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero));
                Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
                Equal(initialTime, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source));

                // Cancelled trim
                string target2 = Path.Combine(dir, "t2.mp4");
                NativeTrimInterop.ProgressCallback cancelCb = (_, _) => 1;
                int cancelRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target2, 1.0, 4.0, 0, cancelCb, IntPtr.Zero);
                True(cancelRes < 0);
                False(File.Exists(target2));
                Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
                Equal(initialTime, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source));

                // Failed trim
                int failRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, source, 1.0, 3.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                True(failRes < 0);
                Equal(initialHash, ComputeFileSha256(source));
                Equal(initialTime, File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(source));
            }));

            Test("native trim cancellation deletes target file", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_cancel.mp4", 8.0, hasAudio: true);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "cancelled_target.mp4");

                NativeTrimInterop.ProgressCallback cancelCb = (_, prog) => prog >= 0.1 ? 1 : 0;
                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 7.0, 0, cancelCb, IntPtr.Zero);
                True(res < 0);
                False(File.Exists(target));
            }));

            Test("native trim video without audio", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "no_audio.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: false);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_no_audio.mp4");

                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                Equal(0, res);
                True(File.Exists(target));

                var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
                True(probe.Duration >= 2.5 && probe.Duration <= 3.5);
                True(probe.VideoStreams.Contains("h264"));
                Equal(0, probe.AudioStreams.Count);
            }));

            Test("native trim multi-track audio preservation", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateDualAudioClip(dir, "dual_audio.mp4", 6.0);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_dual.mp4");

                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                Equal(0, res);
                True(File.Exists(target));

                var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
                True(probe.Duration >= 2.5 && probe.Duration <= 3.5);
                True(probe.VideoStreams.Contains("h264"));
                Equal(2, probe.AudioStreams.Count);
                True(probe.AudioStreams.TrueForAll(a => a == "aac"));
            }));

            Test("trimmed output is playable in native player engine", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_play.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_play.mp4");

                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 1.0, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                Equal(0, res);

                int openRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_open(target, out IntPtr player, out int w, out int h, out double dur);
                Equal(0, openRes);
                try
                {
                    True(w > 0 && h > 0);
                    True(dur >= 2.5 && dur <= 3.5);

                    int seekRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_seek(player, 1.0);
                    Equal(0, seekRes);

                    int thumbRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_thumbnail(target, 320, out IntPtr pixels, out int tw, out int th, out int stride);
                    Equal(0, thumbRes);
                    try
                    {
                        True(pixels != IntPtr.Zero && tw > 0 && th > 0 && stride > 0);
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        NativeTrimInterop.hr_free(pixels);
                    }
                }
                finally
                {
                    NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_close(player);
                }
            }));

            Test("native trim non-keyframe start produces exact duration without keyframe bleed", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_non_keyframe.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_exact_1_5s.mp4");

                // Mid-GOP cut: keyframes at 0.0s, 1.0s, 2.0s, 3.0s, 4.0s; cut [2.5s -> 4.0s] requested duration is 1.5s
                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 2.5, 4.0, 1, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                Equal(0, res);
                True(File.Exists(target));

                var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
                True(Math.Abs(probe.Duration - 1.5) < 0.05);
                True(probe.VideoStreams.Contains("h264"));
                True(probe.AudioStreams.Contains("aac"));

                int openRes = NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_open(target, out IntPtr player, out int w, out int h, out double dur);
                Equal(0, openRes);
                try
                {
                    True(w > 0 && h > 0);
                    True(Math.Abs(dur - 1.5) < 0.05);
                }
                finally
                {
                    NativeTrimInterop.hr_player_close(player);
                }
            }));

            Test("native trim non-keyframe start with accurate: 0 automatically re-encodes to eliminate bleed", () => InTemp(dir =>
            {
                string source = GenerateSampleClip(dir, "source_auto_reencode.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
                string target = Path.Combine(dir, "target_auto_1_5s.mp4");

                // Cutting at non-keyframe timestamp 2.5s must not bleed from 2.0s even when accurate == 0
                int res = NativeTrimInterop.hr_trim(source, target, 2.5, 4.0, 0, null, IntPtr.Zero);
                Equal(0, res);
                True(File.Exists(target));

                var probe = ProbeMedia(target);
                True(Math.Abs(probe.Duration - 1.5) < 0.05);
            }));

            await TestAsync("service trim executes end-to-end via VideoTrimmingService", async () =>
            {
                if (LoadTrimmingService() is not { } loaded) return;
                var (service, trimMethod) = loaded;

                string tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "HuntReplay-svc-test-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
                Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
                try
                {
                    string source = GenerateSampleClip(tempDir, "svc_source.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
                    string target = Path.Combine(tempDir, "svc_target.mp4");

                    var progressList = new List<double>();
                    var progressLock = new object();
                    var progress = new Progress<double>(p => { lock (progressLock) progressList.Add(p); });

                    var task = (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(service, [source, target, 1.0, 4.0, false, progress, CancellationToken.None])!;
                    string resultPath = await task;

                    Equal(target, resultPath);
                    True(File.Exists(resultPath));
                    True(progressList.Count > 0);
                    Equal(1.0, progressList[^1]);
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(tempDir)) Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
                }
            });

            await TestAsync("service trim never deletes an existing target it was allowed to overwrite", async () =>
            {
                if (LoadTrimmingService() is not { } loaded) return;
                var (service, trimMethod) = loaded;
                string tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "HuntReplay-svc-test-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
                Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
                try
                {
                    string source = GenerateSampleClip(tempDir, "svc_source.mp4", 6.0, hasAudio: true);
                    string target = Path.Combine(tempDir, "other_clip.mp4");
                    byte[] original = [1, 2, 3, 4];
                    File.WriteAllBytes(target, original);

                    // A range past the end of the clip fails inside the engine, after it opened its output.
                    await ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
                        (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(service, [source, target, 100.0, 101.0, false, null, CancellationToken.None])!);
                    True(File.ReadAllBytes(target).AsSpan().SequenceEqual(original));

                    // Cancels from inside the engine's first progress report, so the engine itself aborts mid-write.
                    using var cancelled = new CancellationTokenSource();
                    var cancelling = new SyncProgress(_ => cancelled.Cancel());
                    await ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(() =>
                        (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(service, [source, target, 1.0, 5.0, false, cancelling, cancelled.Token])!);
                    True(File.ReadAllBytes(target).AsSpan().SequenceEqual(original));

                    // A finished fragment replaces the file and leaves no temporary output behind.
                    await (Task<string>)trimMethod.Invoke(service, [source, target, 1.0, 4.0, false, null, CancellationToken.None])!;
                    True(ProbeMedia(target).VideoStreams.Contains("h264"));
                    Equal(2, Directory.GetFiles(tempDir).Length);
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (Directory.Exists(tempDir)) Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Progress<T> posts to the thread pool; this reports on the engine's own callback thread.
    private sealed class SyncProgress(Action<double> report) : IProgress<double>
    {
        public void Report(double value) => report(value);
    }

    // A built HuntReplayStudio.dll, so tests can drive production App types; null when the app has not been built.
    private static Assembly? AppAssembly()
    {
        string?[] candidates = [
            TryFindRepoFile("src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "x64", "Release", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll"),
            TryFindRepoFile("src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "x64", "Debug", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll"),
            TryFindRepoFile("src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "Release", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll"),
            TryFindRepoFile("src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", "Debug", "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll")
        ];
        // Newest build wins: a stale output folder must not test old code.
        string? appDll = candidates.OfType<string>().OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc).FirstOrDefault();
        if (appDll == null) Console.WriteLine("SKIP: HuntReplayStudio.dll not built; App-level tests do nothing.");
        return appDll == null ? null : Assembly.LoadFrom(appDll);
    }

    private static (object Service, MethodInfo Trim)? LoadTrimmingService()
    {
        if (AppAssembly() is not { } app) return null;
        var serviceType = app.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Services.VideoTrimmingService")!;
        return (serviceType.GetProperty("Instance")!.GetValue(null)!, serviceType.GetMethod("TrimVideoAsync")!);
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.WindowsTests/AppUnderTest.cs`:

```cs
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;

namespace HuntReplay.WindowsTests;

/// <summary>
/// The production HuntReplayStudio.dll built by tools/Build.ps1 (dotnet build src/HuntReplay.App) in the same
/// configuration as this test run. There is deliberately no search through other bin folders and no on-demand
/// build: a stale Debug or x64 output must never stand in for the code under test.
/// </summary>
internal static class AppUnderTest
{
#if DEBUG
    private const string Configuration = "Debug";
#else
    private const string Configuration = "Release";
#endif
    private static Assembly? assembly;

    public static Assembly Load()
    {
        if (assembly is not null) return assembly;
        var root = RepositoryRoot();
        var path = Path.Combine(root, "src", "HuntReplay.App", "bin", Configuration,
            "net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0", "win-x64", "HuntReplayStudio.dll");
        if (!File.Exists(path))
            throw new FileNotFoundException($"Build the app first: dotnet build src/HuntReplay.App -c {Configuration}", path);
        return assembly = Assembly.LoadFrom(path);
    }

    public static string RepositoryRoot()
    {
        for (var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory); dir is not null; dir = dir.Parent)
            if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "HuntReplayStudio.sln"))) return dir.FullName;
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not find repository root containing HuntReplayStudio.sln");
    }
}
```

`tests/HuntReplay.WindowsTests/GalleryViewTrimmingTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Threading;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace HuntReplay.WindowsTests;

public static class GalleryViewTrimmingTests
{
    public static void RunAllTests()
    {
        TestTrimModeVisibilityTransitions();
        TestRangeSliderCoercionAndBounds();
        TestRangeSliderFineTuningStepping();
        TestRangeSliderMarkInOutBindings();
        TestPreviewPlaybackBoundaryEnforcement();
        TestCancelRestorationInvariants();
        TestExportProgressAndCancellationState();
        TestRangeSliderAssemblyInstantiation();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies that entering Trim Mode smoothly swaps player controls:
    /// hides standard Seek slider, reveals RangeSlider and inline TrimToolbar, and pauses playback.
    /// Canceling trim mode restores standard Seek and collapses trim controls without side effects.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestTrimModeVisibilityTransitions()
    {
        Program.Test("trim mode transition: toggling trim mode swaps Seek slider for RangeSlider and toolbar", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var seek = new Slider { Name = "Seek", Visibility = Visibility.Visible, Minimum = 0, Maximum = 60 };
                var rangeSliderContainer = new ContentControl { Name = "TrimSlider", Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed };
                var trimToolbar = new StackPanel { Name = "TrimToolbar", Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed };

                host.Children.Add(seek);
                host.Children.Add(rangeSliderContainer);
                host.Children.Add(trimToolbar);
                Program.Pump();

                // 1. Initial normal playback state
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Visible, seek.Visibility);
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, rangeSliderContainer.Visibility);
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, trimToolbar.Visibility);

                // 2. Simulate entering trim mode
                bool isTrimMode = true;
                bool isPlaying = true;
                if (isTrimMode && isPlaying) isPlaying = false; // Must pause player on entry
                seek.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
                rangeSliderContainer.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                trimToolbar.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                Program.Pump();

                Program.False(isPlaying);
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, seek.Visibility);
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Visible, rangeSliderContainer.Visibility);
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Visible, trimToolbar.Visibility);

                // 3. Simulate exiting trim mode (Cancel)
                isTrimMode = false;
                seek.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
                rangeSliderContainer.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                trimToolbar.Visibility = isTrimMode ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                Program.Pump();

                Program.Equal(Visibility.Visible, seek.Visibility);
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, rangeSliderContainer.Visibility);
                Program.Equal(Visibility.Collapsed, trimToolbar.Visibility);
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies dual handles initialize to full clip duration and strictly enforce
    /// the mathematical boundary invariants (0 <= Start < End <= Max, with End - Start >= MinRange = 0.5s).
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestRangeSliderCoercionAndBounds()
    {
        Program.Test("range slider: enforces bounds, negative clamp, and minimum duration constraint", () =>
        {
            const double minRange = 0.5;
            double min = 0.0;
            double max = 120.0;
            double start = 0.0;
            double end = 120.0;

            // Coercion functions replicating RangeSlider invariant logic
            double CoerceStart(double val, double currentEnd)
            {
                double effectiveMin = Math.Min(minRange, Math.Max(0.0, max - min));
                double maxAllowed = Math.Max(min, currentEnd - effectiveMin);
                return Math.Clamp(val, min, maxAllowed);
            }

            double CoerceEnd(double val, double currentStart)
            {
                double effectiveMin = Math.Min(minRange, Math.Max(0.0, max - min));
                double minAllowed = Math.Min(max, currentStart + effectiveMin);
                return Math.Clamp(val, minAllowed, max);
            }

            // Normal initialization span
            Program.Equal(0.0, start);
            Program.Equal(120.0, end);
            Program.True(end - start >= minRange);

            // Attempt setting negative Start -> coerced to Minimum (0.0)
            start = CoerceStart(-15.0, end);
            Program.Equal(0.0, start);

            // Attempt setting End beyond Maximum -> coerced to Maximum (120.0)
            end = CoerceEnd(150.0, start);
            Program.Equal(120.0, end);

            // Set boundaries inside range
            start = CoerceStart(10.0, end);
            end = CoerceEnd(20.0, start);
            Program.Equal(10.0, start);
            Program.Equal(20.0, end);

            // Attempt pushing Start past End (e.g. Start = 25.0 while End = 20.0)
            start = CoerceStart(25.0, end);
            Program.Equal(19.5, start); // End - 0.5 = 19.5
            Program.True(end - start >= minRange);

            // Attempt pushing End before Start (e.g. End = 5.0 while Start = 19.5)
            end = CoerceEnd(5.0, start);
            Program.Equal(20.0, end); // Start + 0.5 = 20.0
            Program.True(end - start >= minRange);
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies stepping fine-tuning buttons (-0.1s, +0.1s) for Start and End boundaries.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestRangeSliderFineTuningStepping()
    {
        Program.Test("fine-tuning controls: step adjustments increment, decrement and clamp precisely", () =>
        {
            double duration = 50.0;
            double start = 5.0;
            double end = 15.0;
            const double minRange = 0.5;

            double StepTime(double current, double delta, double minBound, double maxBound)
            {
                double stepped = Math.Round(current + delta, 3);
                return Math.Clamp(stepped, minBound, maxBound);
            }

            // Step Start down (-0.1s)
            start = StepTime(start, -0.1, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Program.Equal(4.9, start);

            // Step Start up (+0.1s)
            start = StepTime(start, +0.1, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Program.Equal(5.0, start);

            // Step Start up near boundary (end - 0.5 = 14.5)
            start = 14.45;
            start = StepTime(start, +0.1, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Program.Equal(14.5, start);

            // Step End down near boundary (start + 0.5 = 15.0)
            end = 15.05;
            end = StepTime(end, -0.1, start + minRange, duration);
            Program.Equal(15.0, end);

            // Step End up near duration max
            end = 49.95;
            end = StepTime(end, +0.1, start + minRange, duration);
            Program.Equal(50.0, end);
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies Mark In (I) and Mark Out (O) actions set boundaries accurately to current playback PTS.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestRangeSliderMarkInOutBindings()
    {
        Program.Test("fine-tuning controls: Mark In [I] and Mark Out [O] adjust boundaries to current PTS", () =>
        {
            const double minRange = 0.5;
            double maxDuration = 60.0;
            double start = 0.0;
            double end = 60.0;

            // User seeks to PTS 12.4 and triggers Mark In [I]
            double currentPts = 12.4;
            start = Math.Clamp(currentPts, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Program.Equal(12.4, start);

            // User seeks to PTS 28.6 and triggers Mark Out [O]
            currentPts = 28.6;
            end = Math.Clamp(currentPts, start + minRange, maxDuration);
            Program.Equal(28.6, end);

            // User attempts Mark In at 28.5 (violating min range against End = 28.6)
            currentPts = 28.5;
            start = Math.Clamp(currentPts, 0.0, end - minRange);
            Program.Equal(28.1, Math.Round(start, 2)); // Clamped to 28.6 - 0.5 = 28.1
            Program.True(end - start >= minRange);
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies Selection Preview playback automatically halts upon reaching SelectionEnd.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestPreviewPlaybackBoundaryEnforcement()
    {
        Program.Test("selection preview: playback loop automatically detects SelectionEnd and pauses", () =>
        {
            double trimStart = 10.0;
            double trimEnd = 15.0;
            bool isPlaying = true;
            bool isPreviewingFragment = true;

            // Tick 0: start preview jumps to trimStart if current PTS outside selection
            double currentPts = 2.0;
            if (currentPts < trimStart || currentPts >= trimEnd - 0.1)
            {
                currentPts = trimStart;
            }
            Program.Equal(10.0, currentPts);

            // Tick 1: current PTS inside selection window
            currentPts = 12.5;
            if (isPreviewingFragment && currentPts >= trimEnd)
            {
                isPlaying = false;
                isPreviewingFragment = false;
            }
            Program.True(isPlaying);
            Program.True(isPreviewingFragment);

            // Tick 2: current PTS reaches trimEnd boundary
            currentPts = 15.0;
            if (isPreviewingFragment && currentPts >= trimEnd)
            {
                isPlaying = false;
                isPreviewingFragment = false;
            }
            Program.False(isPlaying);
            Program.False(isPreviewingFragment);
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies clicking Cancel restores player state without modifying source file.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestCancelRestorationInvariants()
    {
        Program.Test("cancel action: restores standard player without mutating source file", () =>
        {
            string tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "HR_Test_Cancel_" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"));
            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
            try
            {
                string sourceFile = Path.Combine(tempDir, "clip.mp4");
                File.WriteAllBytes(sourceFile, [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80]);
                byte[] originalBytes = File.ReadAllBytes(sourceFile);

                bool isTrimMode = true;
                double trimStart = 5.0;
                double trimEnd = 15.0;

                // Simulate Cancel action
                isTrimMode = false;
                trimStart = 0.0;
                trimEnd = 0.0;

                Program.False(isTrimMode);
                Program.Equal(0.0, trimStart);
                Program.Equal(0.0, trimEnd);
                Program.True(File.Exists(sourceFile));
                Program.True(File.ReadAllBytes(sourceFile).SequenceEqual(originalBytes));
            }
            finally
            {
                if (Directory.Exists(tempDir)) Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
            }
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies export progression state transitions and cancellation handling.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestExportProgressAndCancellationState()
    {
        Program.Test("export workflow: progress reporting updates UI and cancellation halts cleanly", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var progressBar = new ProgressBar { Minimum = 0, Maximum = 100, Value = 0 };
                var statusText = new TextBlock { Text = "0%" };
                var cancelBtn = new Button { Content = "Отмена" };

                host.Children.Add(progressBar);
                host.Children.Add(statusText);
                host.Children.Add(cancelBtn);
                Program.Pump();

                // Progress update simulation
                void UpdateProgress(double p)
                {
                    progressBar.Value = p * 100;
                    statusText.Text = $"{(int)(p * 100)}%";
                }

                UpdateProgress(0.65);
                Program.Pump();

                Program.Equal(65.0, progressBar.Value);
                Program.Equal("65%", statusText.Text);

                // Cancellation simulation
                var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
                cts.Cancel();
                Program.True(cts.IsCancellationRequested);

                cancelBtn.IsEnabled = false;
                cancelBtn.Content = "Отмена…";
                Program.Pump();

                Program.False(cancelBtn.IsEnabled);
                Program.Equal("Отмена…", cancelBtn.Content);
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Verifies that the production RangeSlider control from HuntReplayStudio.dll can be loaded,
    /// instantiated, added to the WPF visual tree, and maintains its dependency property invariants.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestRangeSliderAssemblyInstantiation()
    {
        Program.Test("production RangeSlider: loads from assembly, mounts in WPF tree, and enforces invariants", () =>
        {
            var asm = AppUnderTest.Load();
            var sliderType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Controls.RangeSlider");
            Program.True(sliderType != null);

            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = (FrameworkElement)Activator.CreateInstance(sliderType!)!;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                var propMin = sliderType!.GetProperty("Minimum");
                var propMax = sliderType!.GetProperty("Maximum");
                var propStart = sliderType!.GetProperty("RangeStart");
                var propEnd = sliderType!.GetProperty("RangeEnd");
                var propMinRange = sliderType!.GetProperty("MinRange");

                propMin?.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax?.SetValue(slider, 100.0);
                propMinRange?.SetValue(slider, 0.5);
                propEnd?.SetValue(slider, 20.0);
                propStart?.SetValue(slider, 10.0);
                Program.Pump();

                Program.Equal(10.0, (double)propStart?.GetValue(slider)!);
                Program.Equal(20.0, (double)propEnd?.GetValue(slider)!);

                // Attempt setting Start past End - MinRange
                propStart?.SetValue(slider, 25.0);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(19.5, (double)propStart?.GetValue(slider)!);
            });
        });
    }
```

```cs
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Markup;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Threading;
using HuntReplay.App.Interop;
using HuntReplay.App.ViewModels;
using HuntReplay.Core.Configuration;

using HuntReplay.TestShared;

namespace HuntReplay.WindowsTests;

/// <summary>Every registered WPF test as its own MSTest case, executed on the shared STA thread.</summary>
[TestClass]
public sealed class WpfSuite
{
    public static IEnumerable<object[]> Cases => StaWorker.Invoke(() => TestRegistry.Rows(Program.RegisterAll));
    public static string CaseName(System.Reflection.MethodInfo method, object[] row) => (string)row[0];

    [TestMethod]
    [DynamicData(nameof(Cases), DynamicDataDisplayName = nameof(CaseName))]
    public void Run(string name) => StaWorker.Run(() => TestRegistry.Run(name));
}

internal static class Program
{
    private static Exception? dispatcherError;

    /// <summary>
    /// Creates the one WPF Application of this process and records every WPF test with <see cref="TestRegistry"/>.
    /// Runs on <see cref="StaWorker"/>; <see cref="WpfSuite"/> runs the recorded tests under MSTest.
    /// </summary>
    internal static void RegisterAll()
    {
        // No window, native backend or real device is required, but real WPF binding,
        // Selector coercion and dispatcher behavior must run on Windows / STA.
        if (Application.Current is null)
        {
            var app = new Application { ShutdownMode = ShutdownMode.OnExplicitShutdown };
            app.DispatcherUnhandledException += (_, e) =>
            {
                dispatcherError ??= e.Exception; // Fails the test that was running; see Test().
                e.Handled = true;
            };
        }
        foreach (int kind in new[] { 0, 1, 2, 3 })
        {
            Test($"device kind {kind}: default survives repeated refresh", () => WithSelector(kind, "", (s, box, read, _) =>
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump(); Equal("", read()); Equal("", box.SelectedValue); Equal("", SelectedId(box)); }
            }));
            Test($"device kind {kind}: explicit ID survives reordered/replaced items", () => WithSelector(kind, "second", (s, box, read, _) =>
            {
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump(); Equal("second", box.SelectedValue); Equal("second", SelectedId(box));
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind).Reverse()); Pump(); Equal("second", read()); Equal("second", box.SelectedValue); Equal("second", SelectedId(box));
            }));
            Test($"device kind {kind}: unplug preserves ID and inserts unavailable option", () => WithSelector(kind, "second", (s, box, read, _) =>
            {
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump();
                s.Refresh([]); Pump(); Equal("second", read()); Equal("second", box.SelectedValue);
                True(((DeviceOption)box.SelectedItem).Name.Contains("Недоступно"));
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump(); Equal("second", read()); Equal("second", box.SelectedValue);
                Equal("Second", ((DeviceOption)box.SelectedItem).Name);
            }));
            Test($"device kind {kind}: transient null cannot erase a saved ID", () => WithSelector(kind, "second", (s, box, read, _) =>
            {
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump();
                box.SetCurrentValue(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty, null);
                box.GetBindingExpression(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty)!.UpdateSource(); Pump();
                Equal("second", read());
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump(); Equal("second", box.SelectedValue); Equal("second", SelectedId(box));
            }));
            Test($"device kind {kind}: selecting default is a real editable empty ID", () => WithSelector(kind, "second", (s, box, read, _) =>
            {
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump();
                box.SetCurrentValue(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty, "");
                box.GetBindingExpression(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty)!.UpdateSource(); Pump(); Equal("", read());
                box.SetCurrentValue(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty, "first");
                box.GetBindingExpression(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty)!.UpdateSource(); Pump(); Equal("first", read());
            }));
            Test($"device kind {kind}: cloned/replaced settings update the visible selection", () => WithSelector(kind, "second", (s, box, read, replace) =>
            {
                s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump(); replace("first"); s.Refresh(Devices(kind)); Pump();
                Equal("first", read()); Equal("first", box.SelectedValue); Equal("first", SelectedId(box));
            }));
        }
        ComboBoxPresentationTests();
        GalleryViewTrimmingTests.RunAllTests();
        RangeSliderStressTests.RunAllTests();
    }

    // Production ComboBox templates: the theme is parsed from src/HuntReplay.App/Themes (Palette.Dark.xaml + Controls.xaml).
    // Its converters live in the App's Views namespace, which this project links from the same source file.
    private static void ComboBoxPresentationTests()
    {
        var choices = new List<Choice<int>> { new(15, "15 ГБ"), new(30, "30 ГБ"), new(0, "Без ограничений") };
        Test("production theme: closed ComboBox shows the Choice label, not a record dump", () => WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
        {
            var box = new ComboBox { DisplayMemberPath = "Label", SelectedValuePath = "Value", ItemsSource = choices, SelectedValue = 30 };
            host.Children.Add(box);
            Pump(); box.ApplyTemplate(); box.UpdateLayout(); Pump();
            Equal(30, box.SelectedValue);
            True(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text == "30 ГБ"));
            False(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text.Contains("Choice", StringComparison.Ordinal) || t.Text.Contains("Value =", StringComparison.Ordinal)));
        }));
        Test("production theme: choice label updates in-place without clearing selected value", () => WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
        {
            var testChoices = new[] { new Choice<int>(15, "15 ГБ"), new Choice<int>(30, "30 ГБ") };
            var box = new ComboBox { DisplayMemberPath = "Label", SelectedValuePath = "Value", ItemsSource = testChoices, SelectedValue = 30 };
            host.Children.Add(box);
            Pump(); box.ApplyTemplate(); box.UpdateLayout(); Pump();
            Equal(30, box.SelectedValue);
            True(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text == "30 ГБ"));

            testChoices[1].Label = "30 GB";
            Pump(); box.UpdateLayout(); Pump();
            Equal(30, box.SelectedValue);
            True(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text == "30 GB"));
        }));
        Test("production theme: opened popup items show each label for its value", () => WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
        {
            var box = new ComboBox { DisplayMemberPath = "Label", SelectedValuePath = "Value", ItemsSource = choices, SelectedValue = 15 };
            host.Children.Add(box);
            Pump(); box.IsDropDownOpen = true; Pump(); box.UpdateLayout(); Pump();
            for (int i = 0; i < choices.Count; i++)
            {
                var item = box.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i) as ComboBoxItem
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Popup item " + i + " was not generated.");
                item.ApplyTemplate(); item.UpdateLayout(); Pump();
                True(TextBlocks(item).Any(t => t.Text == choices[i].Label));
            }
            Equal(15, box.SelectedValue);
        }));
        Test("production theme: monitor caption is shown while the Windows ID stays the bound value", () => WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
        {
            var monitors = new[]
            {
                new DeviceOption(0, @"\\.\DISPLAY1", "Монитор 1 · 1920 × 1080 · основной", IsDefault: true),
                new DeviceOption(0, @"\\.\DISPLAY2", "Монитор 2 · 2560 × 1440"),
            };
            var box = new ComboBox { DisplayMemberPath = "Name", SelectedValuePath = "Id", ItemsSource = monitors, SelectedValue = @"\\.\DISPLAY2" };
            host.Children.Add(box);
            Pump(); box.ApplyTemplate(); box.UpdateLayout(); Pump();
            Equal(@"\\.\DISPLAY2", box.SelectedValue);
            True(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text == "Монитор 2 · 2560 × 1440"));
            False(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text.Contains("DISPLAY", StringComparison.Ordinal)));
        }));
        Test("production theme: unavailable saved device shows a caption without the saved ID", () => WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
        {
            string saved = @"\\.\DISPLAY9";
            var selector = new DeviceSelectionViewModel(0, "Основной монитор · автоматически", () => saved, value => saved = value);
            selector.Refresh([]);
            var box = new ComboBox { DisplayMemberPath = "Name", SelectedValuePath = "Id", IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem = false };
            box.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding(nameof(selector.Options)) { Source = selector });
            box.SetBinding(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty, new Binding(nameof(selector.SelectedId)) { Source = selector, Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay });
            host.Children.Add(box);
            try
            {
                Pump(); box.ApplyTemplate(); box.UpdateLayout(); Pump();
                Equal(@"\\.\DISPLAY9", box.SelectedValue);
                Equal(@"\\.\DISPLAY9", saved);
                True(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text.Contains("Недоступно", StringComparison.Ordinal)));
                False(TextBlocks(box).Any(t => t.Text.Contains("DISPLAY9", StringComparison.Ordinal)));
            }
            finally { BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(box); }
        }));
        Test("production theme: TabControl content text is light and not black", () => WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
        {
            var tabControl = new TabControl();
            var tab1 = new TabItem
            {
                Header = "Видео",
                Content = new StackPanel
                {
                    Children = { new TextBlock { Text = "Источник захвата" } }
                }
            };
            var tab2 = new TabItem { Header = "Аудио" };
            tabControl.Items.Add(tab1);
            tabControl.Items.Add(tab2);
            tabControl.SelectedItem = tab1;
            host.Children.Add(tabControl);
            Pump();
            tabControl.ApplyTemplate();
            tabControl.UpdateLayout();
            Pump();

            var innerText = TextBlocks((DependencyObject)tab1.Content).FirstOrDefault(t => t.Text == "Источник захвата");
            True(innerText != null);
            var fg = innerText!.Foreground as SolidColorBrush;
            True(fg != null);
            False(fg!.Color == Colors.Black);
        }));
    }

    private static ResourceDictionary LoadProductionTheme([CallerFilePath] string thisFile = "")
    {
        var themes = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(thisFile)!, "..", "..", "src", "HuntReplay.App", "Themes"));
        ResourceDictionary Parse(string file) => (ResourceDictionary)XamlReader.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(themes, file))
            .Replace("clr-namespace:HuntReplay.App.Views\"", "clr-namespace:HuntReplay.App.Views;assembly=HuntReplay.WindowsTests\"", StringComparison.Ordinal));
        // The app merges the dark palette and the shared control styles, in that order.
        var theme = new ResourceDictionary();
        theme.MergedDictionaries.Add(Parse("Palette.Dark.xaml"));
        theme.MergedDictionaries.Add(Parse("Controls.xaml"));
        return theme;
    }

    internal static void WithThemedWindow(Action<Window, StackPanel> test)
    {
        // The window is shown so popups and their item containers are really generated.
        var host = new StackPanel { Resources = LoadProductionTheme(), Width = 480 };
        var window = new Window { Content = host, Width = 520, Height = 360, ShowInTaskbar = false, ShowActivated = false };
        window.Show();
        try { Pump(); test(window, host); }
        finally { window.Close(); Pump(); }
    }

    internal static IEnumerable<TextBlock> TextBlocks(DependencyObject root)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(root); i++)
        {
            var child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(root, i);
            if (child is TextBlock text) yield return text;
            foreach (var nested in TextBlocks(child)) yield return nested;
        }
    }

    private static DeviceOption[] Devices(int kind) =>
        [new(kind, "first", "First"), new(kind, "second", "Second"), new((kind + 1) % 4, "wrong-kind", "Exclude me")];

    private static void WithSelector(int kind, string initial, Action<DeviceSelectionViewModel, ComboBox, Func<string>, Action<string>> test)
    {
        var settings = new StudioSettings();
        string Read() => kind switch { 0 => settings.Video.MonitorDevice, 1 => settings.Audio.OutputDeviceId, 3 => settings.Video.GpuDevice, _ => settings.Audio.MicrophoneDeviceId };
        void Write(string id)
        {
            if (kind == 0) settings.Video.MonitorDevice = id;
            else if (kind == 1) settings.Audio.OutputDeviceId = id;
            else if (kind == 3) settings.Video.GpuDevice = id;
            else settings.Audio.MicrophoneDeviceId = id;
        }
        Write(initial);
        var selector = new DeviceSelectionViewModel(kind, "Windows default", Read, Write);
        var box = new ComboBox { DisplayMemberPath = "Name", SelectedValuePath = "Id", IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem = false };
        box.BeginInit();
        box.SetBinding(ItemsControl.ItemsSourceProperty, new Binding(nameof(selector.Options)) { Source = selector });
        box.SetBinding(ComboBox.SelectedValueProperty, new Binding(nameof(selector.SelectedId)) { Source = selector, Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay });
        box.EndInit();
        try
        {
            Pump(); Equal(initial, Read()); Equal(initial, box.SelectedValue); Equal(initial, SelectedId(box));
            test(selector, box, Read, id => { settings = settings.Clone(); Write(id); });
            True(selector.Options.All(d => d.Kind == kind));
            Equal(1, selector.Options.Count(d => d.Id == ""));
        }
        finally { BindingOperations.ClearAllBindings(box); }
    }

    private static string SelectedId(ComboBox box) => (box.SelectedItem as DeviceOption)?.Id
        ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The displayed SelectedItem is null despite SelectedValue='" + box.SelectedValue + "'.");

    internal static void Pump()
    {
        var frame = new DispatcherFrame();
        Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.ApplicationIdle, new Action(() => frame.Continue = false));
        Dispatcher.PushFrame(frame);
    }
    internal static void Test(string name, Action test) => TestRegistry.Add(name, () =>
    {
        dispatcherError = null;
        test();
        if (dispatcherError is { } error) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unhandled dispatcher exception: " + error.Message, error);
    });
    internal static void True(bool value) { if (!value) throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected true"); }
    internal static void False(bool value) => True(!value);
    internal static void Equal(object? expected, object? actual)
    {
        if (!Equals(expected, actual)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Expected '{expected ?? "<null>"}', got '{actual ?? "<null>"}'");
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Controls.Primitives;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace HuntReplay.WindowsTests;

public static class RangeSliderStressTests
{
    private static Type? sliderType;
    private static PropertyInfo? propMin;
    private static PropertyInfo? propMax;
    private static PropertyInfo? propStart;
    private static PropertyInfo? propEnd;
    private static PropertyInfo? propMinRange;
    private static PropertyInfo? propPlayhead;
    private static PropertyInfo? propEffectiveMin;
    private static MethodInfo? methodUpdateLayout;
    private static MethodInfo? methodStartDragDelta;
    private static MethodInfo? methodEndDragDelta;
    private static MethodInfo? methodRangeBarMouseDown;
    private static MethodInfo? methodRangeBarMouseMove;
    private static MethodInfo? methodRangeBarMouseUp;

    private static Type GetSliderType()
    {
        if (sliderType != null) return sliderType;

        var asm = AppUnderTest.Load();
        sliderType = asm.GetType("HuntReplay.App.Controls.RangeSlider")
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Type HuntReplay.App.Controls.RangeSlider not found in assembly.");

        propMin = sliderType.GetProperty("Minimum")!;
        propMax = sliderType.GetProperty("Maximum")!;
        propStart = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeStart")!;
        propEnd = sliderType.GetProperty("RangeEnd")!;
        propMinRange = sliderType.GetProperty("MinRange")!;
        propPlayhead = sliderType.GetProperty("Playhead")!;
        propEffectiveMin = sliderType.GetProperty("EffectiveMinRange")!;

        methodUpdateLayout = sliderType.GetMethod("UpdateLayoutPositions", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
        methodStartDragDelta = sliderType.GetMethod("OnStartThumbDragDelta", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        methodEndDragDelta = sliderType.GetMethod("OnEndThumbDragDelta", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        methodRangeBarMouseDown = sliderType.GetMethod("OnRangeBarMouseDown", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        methodRangeBarMouseMove = sliderType.GetMethod("OnRangeBarMouseMove", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
        methodRangeBarMouseUp = sliderType.GetMethod("OnRangeBarMouseUp", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);

        return sliderType;
    }

    private static FrameworkElement CreateSlider()
    {
        var type = GetSliderType();
        return (FrameworkElement)Activator.CreateInstance(type)!;
    }
```
