```cs
    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 2: Boundary limits Start=0, End=Maximum.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestBoundaryLimits()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL: RangeSlider boundary limits Start=0, End=Maximum", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax!.SetValue(slider, 120.0);
                propStart!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propEnd!.SetValue(slider, 120.0);
                Program.Pump();

                Program.Equal(0.0, (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!);
                Program.Equal(120.0, (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!);

                // Start cannot be pushed below Minimum
                propStart.SetValue(slider, -10.0);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(0.0, (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!);

                // End cannot be pushed above Maximum
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, 150.0);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(120.0, (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!);
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 3: Minimal duration constraint stops at 0.5s separation.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestMinimalDurationConstraint()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL: Minimal duration constraint enforces >= 0.5s separation", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                slider.Width = 400;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax!.SetValue(slider, 100.0);
                propMinRange!.SetValue(slider, 0.5);
                propStart!.SetValue(slider, 10.0);
                propEnd!.SetValue(slider, 20.0);
                Program.Pump();

                // 1. Move Start towards End (attempt 19.8s when End is 20.0s)
                propStart.SetValue(slider, 19.8);
                Program.Pump();
                double actualStart = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                Program.Equal(19.5, actualStart);

                // 2. Move End towards Start (attempt 19.6s when Start is 19.5s)
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, 19.6);
                Program.Pump();
                double actualEnd = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!;
                Program.Equal(20.0, actualEnd);

                // 3. Simulate drag delta on StartThumb moving towards End
                // Usable width = 400 - 14 = 386. Range = 100. Delta +50px = +12.95s
                var dragEvent = new DragDeltaEventArgs(100.0, 0.0);
                methodStartDragDelta?.Invoke(slider, [slider, dragEvent]);
                Program.Pump();
                actualStart = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                // End is 20.0, so Start must not exceed 19.5
                Program.True(actualStart <= 19.5);
                Program.Equal(19.5, actualStart);
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 4: Crossing bounds (Start past End, End before Start).
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestCrossingBounds()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL: Crossing bounds is prevented by coercion and dragging clamps", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                slider.Width = 400;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax!.SetValue(slider, 60.0);
                propStart!.SetValue(slider, 10.0);
                propEnd!.SetValue(slider, 30.0);
                Program.Pump();

                // Direct attempt to cross: Start = 50.0 (past End=30.0)
                propStart.SetValue(slider, 50.0);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(29.5, (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!);

                // Direct attempt to cross: End = 5.0 (before Start=29.5)
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, 5.0);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(30.0, (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!);

                // Dragging End backwards by huge negative delta
                var dragEventBackwards = new DragDeltaEventArgs(-500.0, 0.0);
                methodEndDragDelta?.Invoke(slider, [slider, dragEventBackwards]);
                Program.Pump();
                double endAfterDrag = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!;
                double startAfterDrag = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                Program.True(endAfterDrag >= startAfterDrag + 0.5);
                Program.Equal(30.0, endAfterDrag);
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 5: Stress test invalid numbers (NaN, Infinity, negative values, zero duration).
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestInvalidNumbersAndExtremes()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL: Invalid numbers (NaN, Infinity, negative, zero duration) handled safely", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                slider.Width = 300;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax!.SetValue(slider, 100.0);
                propStart!.SetValue(slider, 10.0);
                propEnd!.SetValue(slider, 50.0);
                Program.Pump();

                // NaN RangeStart -> coerced to Minimum
                propStart.SetValue(slider, double.NaN);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(0.0, (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!);

                // Positive Infinity RangeStart -> coerced to maxStart (49.5)
                propStart.SetValue(slider, double.PositiveInfinity);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(0.0, (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!); // double.IsInfinity returns Minimum

                // NaN RangeEnd -> coerced to Maximum
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, double.NaN);
                Program.Pump();
                Program.Equal(100.0, (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!);

                // Zero duration: Maximum == Minimum
                propMin.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                Program.Pump();
                double s = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                double e = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!;
                Program.Equal(0.0, s);
                Program.Equal(0.0, e);

                // Layout update should not throw DivideByZeroException
                methodUpdateLayout?.Invoke(slider, null);
                Program.Pump();
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 6A: Translation dragging to the LEFT maintains duration window.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestTranslationDraggingLeft()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL: Translation dragging to the LEFT maintains duration window", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                slider.Width = 400;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax!.SetValue(slider, 100.0);
                propMinRange!.SetValue(slider, 0.5);
                propEnd!.SetValue(slider, 40.0);
                propStart!.SetValue(slider, 30.0); // Duration = 10.0s
                Program.Pump();

                double initialDuration = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)! - (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                Program.Equal(10.0, initialDuration);

                // Drag left: candStart = 15.0, candEnd = 25.0
                double candStart = 15.0;
                double candEnd = 25.0;

                // When moving left, RangeStart is decreased first:
                propStart.SetValue(slider, candStart);
                propEnd.SetValue(slider, candEnd);
                Program.Pump();

                double resultStart = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                double resultEnd = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!;
                double resultingDuration = resultEnd - resultStart;

                Program.Equal(15.0, resultStart);
                Program.Equal(25.0, resultEnd);
                Program.Equal(initialDuration, resultingDuration);
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 6B: Translation dragging to the RIGHT maintains duration window.
    /// STRESS TEST: When moving right, RangeStart is assigned before RangeEnd, causing RangeStart to be coerced
    /// against old RangeEnd, which distorts the duration window!
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestTranslationDraggingRight()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL STRESS: Translation dragging to the RIGHT maintains duration window", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                slider.Width = 400;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax!.SetValue(slider, 100.0);
                propMinRange!.SetValue(slider, 0.5);
                propEnd!.SetValue(slider, 20.0);
                propStart!.SetValue(slider, 10.0); // Duration = 10.0s
                Program.Pump();

                double initialDuration = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)! - (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                Program.Equal(10.0, initialDuration);

                // Drag right by +25s: candStart = 35.0, candEnd = 45.0
                double deltaSec = 25.0;
                double candStart = 10.0 + deltaSec;
                double candEnd = 20.0 + deltaSec;

                var methodSetRange = GetSliderType().GetMethod("SetRange", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (methodSetRange != null)
                {
                    methodSetRange.Invoke(slider, [candStart, candEnd]);
                }
                else
                {
                    propEnd.SetValue(slider, candEnd);
                    propStart.SetValue(slider, candStart);
                }
                Program.Pump();

                double resultStart = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                double resultEnd = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!;
                double resultingDuration = resultEnd - resultStart;

                Console.WriteLine($"\n[DIAGNOSTIC] Translation drag right: Expected Duration=10.0, Actual Duration={resultingDuration} (Start={resultStart}, End={resultEnd})");

                if (Math.Abs(resultingDuration - initialDuration) > 1e-4)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"BUG CONFIRMED: Setting RangeStart before RangeEnd during translation drag corrupts the duration window! " +
                        $"Expected duration={initialDuration}, but got duration={resultingDuration} (RangeStart={resultStart}, RangeEnd={resultEnd})");
                }
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 7: Changing Maximum when RangeStart/RangeEnd exceed new Maximum.
    /// STRESS TEST: When Maximum is reduced below RangeEnd or RangeStart, is the invariant RangeStart <= RangeEnd <= Maximum maintained?
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestMaximumReductionInvariant()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL STRESS: Reducing Maximum maintains RangeStart <= RangeEnd <= Maximum invariant", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 0.0);
                propMax!.SetValue(slider, 100.0);
                propEnd!.SetValue(slider, 80.0);
                propStart!.SetValue(slider, 50.0);
                Program.Pump();

                // Now reduce Maximum to 30.0 (less than both RangeStart and RangeEnd)
                propMax.SetValue(slider, 30.0);
                Program.Pump();

                double curStart = (double)propStart.GetValue(slider)!;
                double curEnd = (double)propEnd.GetValue(slider)!;
                double curMax = (double)propMax.GetValue(slider)!;

                Console.WriteLine($"\n[DIAGNOSTIC] Maximum reduced to {curMax}: RangeStart={curStart}, RangeEnd={curEnd}");

                if (curStart > curEnd)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"BUG CONFIRMED: Invariant violated! RangeStart ({curStart}) > RangeEnd ({curEnd}) after reducing Maximum to {curMax}!");
                }

                if (curStart > curMax)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"BUG CONFIRMED: Invariant violated! RangeStart ({curStart}) > Maximum ({curMax})!");
                }

                if (curEnd > curMax)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        $"BUG CONFIRMED: Invariant violated! RangeEnd ({curEnd}) > Maximum ({curMax})!");
                }
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 8: Minimum > Maximum throws unhandled ArgumentException in CoercePlayhead.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestMinimumGreaterThanMaximumCrash()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL STRESS: Setting Minimum > Maximum does not throw unhandled exception", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                // Current Maximum is 1.0. Set Minimum to 10.0.
                // In RangeSlider.xaml.cs, CoercePlayhead executes Math.Clamp(val, slider.Minimum, slider.Maximum).
                // When Minimum > Maximum, Math.Clamp throws ArgumentException!
                propMin!.SetValue(slider, 10.0);
                Program.Pump();
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 8: Visual geometry with boundary conditions (width=0, width=1, negative positions).
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestVisualGeometryAndZeroWidth()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL: RangeSlider handles zero and extreme widths without layout errors", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                slider.Width = 0;
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                // Force layout update with Width = 0
                methodUpdateLayout?.Invoke(slider, null);
                Program.Pump();

                slider.Width = 10;
                methodUpdateLayout?.Invoke(slider, null);
                Program.Pump();

                slider.Width = 5000;
                methodUpdateLayout?.Invoke(slider, null);
                Program.Pump();
            });
        });
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// EMPIRICAL TEST 9: Fuzzing random operations to stress invariants.
    /// </summary>
    private static void TestFuzzRandomOperations()
    {
        Program.Test("EMPIRICAL: Fuzzing 500 randomized property updates preserves structural invariants", () =>
        {
            Program.WithThemedWindow((_, host) =>
            {
                var slider = CreateSlider();
                host.Children.Add(slider);
                Program.Pump();

                var rng = new Random(42);
                int violations = 0;

                for (int i = 0; i < 500; i++)
                {
                    int op = rng.Next(6);
                    double val = (rng.NextDouble() * 200.0) - 20.0; // [-20.0, 180.0]

                    switch (op)
                    {
                        case 0:
                            propMin!.SetValue(slider, Math.Max(0.0, val));
                            break;
                        case 1:
                            propMax!.SetValue(slider, Math.Max((double)propMin!.GetValue(slider)!, val));
                            break;
                        case 2:
                            propStart!.SetValue(slider, val);
                            break;
                        case 3:
                            propEnd!.SetValue(slider, val);
                            break;
                        case 4:
                            propPlayhead!.SetValue(slider, val);
                            break;
                        case 5:
                            methodUpdateLayout?.Invoke(slider, null);
                            break;
                    }
                    Program.Pump();

                    double s = (double)propStart!.GetValue(slider)!;
                    double e = (double)propEnd!.GetValue(slider)!;
                    double min = (double)propMin!.GetValue(slider)!;
                    double max = (double)propMax!.GetValue(slider)!;

                    double normMin = Math.Min(min, max);
                    double normMax = Math.Max(min, max);

                    // Check invariants
                    if (s < normMin - 1e-4 || s > normMax + 1e-4 || e < normMin - 1e-4 || e > normMax + 1e-4 || s > e + 1e-4)
                    {
                        if (violations == 0)
                        {
                            Console.WriteLine($"\n[FIRST VIOLATION] op={op}, val={val}: min={min}, max={max}, normMin={normMin}, normMax={normMax}, start={s}, end={e}");
                        }
                        violations++;
                    }
                }

                Console.WriteLine($"\n[DIAGNOSTIC] Fuzzing results: {violations} invariant violations detected in 500 random operations.");
                if (violations > 0)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Structural invariants violated {violations} times during fuzzing!");
                }
            });
        });
    }
}
```

`tests/Shared/MediaTestKit.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;

namespace HuntReplay.TestShared;

/// <summary>
/// Process and file helpers shared by the core and E2E media suites (linked into both projects).
/// Child output is always drained concurrently: a full stdout or stderr pipe can never deadlock a test.
/// </summary>
internal static class MediaTestKit
{
    /// <summary>A file under the repository (e.g. native/vendor/ffmpeg/bin/ffmpeg.exe), searched upward from the test binaries.</summary>
    public static string? TryFindRepoFile(params string[] relative)
    {
        for (var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory); dir is not null; dir = dir.Parent)
        {
            var candidate = Path.Combine([dir.FullName, .. relative]);
            if (File.Exists(candidate)) return candidate;
        }
        var fromWorkingDirectory = Path.Combine([Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), .. relative]);
        return File.Exists(fromWorkingDirectory) ? fromWorkingDirectory : null;
    }

    public static string? TryResolveBundledTool(string toolName) =>
        TryFindRepoFile("native", "vendor", "ffmpeg", "bin", toolName);

    public static string ResolveBundledTool(string toolName) =>
        TryResolveBundledTool(toolName) ?? throw new FileNotFoundException($"Bundled tool {toolName} not found.");

    public static void RunProcess(string exePath, string arguments, int timeoutMs = 30000) =>
        Run(new ProcessStartInfo(exePath, arguments), timeoutMs);

    /// <summary>Runs a tool with discrete arguments and returns its standard output.</summary>
    public static string RunForOutput(string exePath, IEnumerable<string> arguments, int timeoutMs = 30000)
    {
        var psi = new ProcessStartInfo(exePath);
        foreach (var argument in arguments) psi.ArgumentList.Add(argument);
        return Run(psi, timeoutMs);
    }

    private static string Run(ProcessStartInfo psi, int timeoutMs)
    {
        psi.UseShellExecute = false;
        psi.CreateNoWindow = true;
        psi.RedirectStandardOutput = true;
        psi.RedirectStandardError = true;
        using var proc = Process.Start(psi) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed to start {psi.FileName}");
        var stdout = proc.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync();
        var stderr = proc.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync();
        var name = Path.GetFileName(psi.FileName);
        if (!proc.WaitForExit(timeoutMs))
        {
            proc.Kill(entireProcessTree: true);
            throw new TimeoutException($"{name} exceeded {timeoutMs} ms");
        }
        if (proc.ExitCode != 0) throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name} failed with exit code {proc.ExitCode}: {stderr.Result}");
        return stdout.Result;
    }
}
```

`tests/Shared/StaWorker.cs`:

```cs
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Threading;

namespace HuntReplay.TestShared;

/// <summary>
/// One long-lived STA thread for the WPF suites. WPF allows a single Application per process and ties windows and
/// dispatchers to their thread, so registration, the Application object and every test body run on this thread,
/// one at a time, exactly as the suites' old hand-written Main did.
/// </summary>
internal static class StaWorker
{
    private static readonly BlockingCollection<Action> Work = new();
    private static readonly Thread Thread = StartThread();

    private static Thread StartThread()
    {
        var thread = new Thread(() => { foreach (var item in Work.GetConsumingEnumerable()) item(); })
        {
            IsBackground = true,
            Name = "WPF test STA thread"
        };
        thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
        thread.Start();
        return thread;
    }

    public static T Invoke<T>(Func<T> body)
    {
        if (Thread.CurrentThread == Thread) return body();
        var done = new TaskCompletionSource<T>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        Work.Add(() =>
        {
            try { done.SetResult(body()); }
            catch (Exception ex) { done.SetException(ex); }
        });
        return done.Task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }

    public static void Invoke(Action body) => Invoke(() => { body(); return true; });

    /// <summary>Runs an async test body to completion on the STA thread (blocking it, as the old runners did).</summary>
    public static void Run(Func<Task> body) => Invoke(() => body().GetAwaiter().GetResult());
}
```

`tests/Shared/TestRegistry.cs`:

```cs
namespace HuntReplay.TestShared;

/// <summary>
/// Bridges the suites' compact <c>Test("name", body)</c> style to MSTest. Registration only records each body;
/// an MSTest <c>[DynamicData]</c> method then runs every case as its own test, so each one is reported, filtered
/// and timed separately (<c>dotnet run --project ... -- --filter "Name~trim"</c>).
/// </summary>
internal static class TestRegistry
{
    private static readonly object Gate = new();
    private static readonly List<string> Order = [];
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, Func<Task>> Bodies = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
    private static bool registered;

    public static void Add(string name, Action body) => Add(name, () => { body(); return Task.CompletedTask; });

    public static void Add(string name, Func<Task> body)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            if (!Bodies.TryAdd(name, body)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Duplicate test name: " + name);
            Order.Add(name);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Runs the suite's registration once and returns one data row per test, in registration order.</summary>
    public static IEnumerable<object[]> Rows(Action register)
    {
        lock (Gate)
        {
            if (!registered)
            {
                register();
                registered = true;
            }
            return Order.Select(name => new object[] { name }).ToArray();
        }
    }

    public static Task Run(string name)
    {
        Func<Task> body;
        lock (Gate)
            if (!Bodies.TryGetValue(name, out body!)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Unknown test: " + name);
        return body();
    }
}
```

```ps1
#requires -Version 5.1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Debug','Release')][string]$Configuration = 'Release',
    [string]$FFmpegArchive = '',
    [switch]$Offline,
    [switch]$SkipTests,
    [switch]$NoPublish
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -ne [PlatformID]::Win32NT) { throw 'The WPF + WGC backend must be built on Windows x64.' }
$Root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
Set-Location $Root
function Invoke-Checked([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Arguments) {
    Write-Host "==> Executing: $Exe $($Arguments -join ' ')"
    & $Exe @Arguments
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "$Exe $($Arguments -join ' ') exited with $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}
trap {
    if ($env:GITHUB_ACTIONS -eq 'true') {
        $Detail = ($_ | Out-String).Replace('%', '%25').Replace("`r", '%0D').Replace("`n", '%0A')
        Write-Host "::error title=Windows build::$Detail"
    }
    throw
}
Get-Command dotnet, cmake -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
if (!(Test-Path 'bin/MessageBus.dll')) { throw 'The original signed MessageBus.dll is missing from the repository.' }
$ExpectedBus = '64e300997b5796da22ad8baa49e4eb919cdc170157cbe6770279f94508a84650'
if ((Get-FileHash 'bin/MessageBus.dll' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $ExpectedBus) { throw 'The NVIDIA payload hash changed. Review the binary before updating the pin.' }
$Signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature 'bin/MessageBus.dll'
if ($Signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $Signature.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'NVIDIA Corporation') {
    throw "MessageBus.dll signature check failed: $($Signature.Status). No unsigned replacement will be embedded."
}
& (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'PrepareFFmpeg.ps1') -ArchivePath $FFmpegArchive -Offline:$Offline
# Without -G, CMake reuses the generator of an existing build tree or picks the newest Visual Studio installed.
Invoke-Checked 'cmake' @('-S','native','-B','artifacts/native','-A','x64',"-DFFMPEG_ROOT=$Root/native/vendor/ffmpeg")
Invoke-Checked 'cmake' @('--build','artifacts/native','--config',$Configuration,'--parallel')
$Runtime = Join-Path $Root 'artifacts/runtime'
if (Test-Path $Runtime) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Runtime -Recurse -Force }
New-Item $Runtime -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item "artifacts/native/$Configuration/HuntReplay.Media.dll" $Runtime
Copy-Item 'native/vendor/ffmpeg/bin/*.dll' $Runtime
$Manifest = Get-ChildItem $Runtime -Filter '*.dll' | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object {
    "{0}  {1}" -f (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(), $_.Name
}
# ASCII without BOM. This manifest and every DLL are embedded resources, not sidecar dependencies.
$Manifest | Set-Content (Join-Path $Runtime 'native.sha256') -Encoding Ascii
Invoke-Checked 'dotnet' @('build','src/HuntReplay.App','--configuration',$Configuration)
# Tests run against the runtime built above, never a previous build's DLL.
if (!$SkipTests) {
    Invoke-Checked 'dotnet' @('run','--project','tests/HuntReplay.Tests','--configuration',$Configuration)
    Invoke-Checked 'dotnet' @('run','--project','tests/HuntReplay.WindowsTests','--configuration',$Configuration)
    Invoke-Checked 'dotnet' @('run','--project','tests/HuntReplay.E2ETests','--configuration',$Configuration)
}
if ($NoPublish) {
    Write-Host 'Build complete (no portable executable requested).'
    exit 0
}
$Publish = Join-Path $Root 'artifacts/publish'
New-Item $Publish -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
# Single-file, self-contained and compression settings live in HuntReplay.App.csproj.
Invoke-Checked 'dotnet' @('publish','src/HuntReplay.App','--configuration',$Configuration,'-p:DebugType=embedded','--output',$Publish)
Copy-Item 'LICENSE','THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md' $Publish
$Licenses = Join-Path $Publish 'licenses'
New-Item $Licenses -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item 'licenses/*' $Licenses
Get-ChildItem 'native/vendor/ffmpeg' -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(LICENSE|COPYING)' } | Copy-Item -Destination $Licenses
$Exe = Join-Path $Publish 'HuntReplayStudio.exe'
(Get-FileHash $Exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() + '  HuntReplayStudio.exe' | Set-Content (Join-Path $Publish 'SHA256SUMS.txt') -Encoding Ascii
Write-Host "`nPortable self-contained executable: $Exe" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host 'No OBS, Python, FFmpeg executable, VC++ redistributable or .NET installation is needed on the target PC.'
Write-Host 'This build is unsigned unless YOU sign it. Test it on real hardware and complete the third-party redistribution checks before release.'
```

`tools/CheckSource.py`:

```py
"""Dependency-free static sanity check; not a substitute for a Windows compile or GPU test."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
errors = []

def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        errors.append(message)

for pattern in ("*.xaml", "*.csproj", "*.props", "*.manifest"):
    for path in ROOT.rglob(pattern):
        if any(part in {".cache", "obj", "vendor", "artifacts", ".git"} for part in path.parts):
            continue
        try:
            ET.parse(path)
        except ET.ParseError as exc:
            errors.append(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)}: {exc}")

require(hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "bin/MessageBus.dll").read_bytes()).hexdigest() ==
        "64e300997b5796da22ad8baa49e4eb919cdc170157cbe6770279f94508a84650", "NVIDIA payload hash changed")
lock = json.loads((ROOT / "tools/ffmpeg.lock.json").read_text())
require(len(lock["sha256"]) == 64 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]+", lock["sha256"]), "Unpinned FFmpeg archive")
require("latest" not in lock["url"], "Floating FFmpeg release URL is not allowed")

production = list((ROOT / "src").rglob("*.cs")) + list((ROOT / "native/src").glob("*.cpp")) + list((ROOT / "native/src").glob("*.h"))
for path in production:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    require(not re.search(r"\b(?:SendInput|keybd_event|SendKeys|WriteProcessMemory|CreateRemoteThread)\s*\(", text),
            f"Forbidden injection/input API: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    require(not re.search(r"\b(?:NotImplementedException|TODO|FIXME)\b", text), f"Unimplemented production placeholder: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    require(not re.search(r"(?:obsws|obs-websocket|streamlabs)", text, flags=re.I), f"External recorder dependency: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    require(not re.search(r"Process\.Start\s*\(\s*\"(?:ffmpeg|ffprobe|obs|python)", text, flags=re.I), f"External recording process: {path.relative_to(ROOT)}")

# Every native ABI export must have a corresponding managed import (hr_free included).
header = (ROOT / "native/include/huntreplay_media.h").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
imports = (ROOT / "src/HuntReplay.App/Interop/NativeMethods.cs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
exports = set(re.findall(r"HR_CALL\s+(hr_\w+)\s*\(", header))
managed = set(re.findall(r"\b(hr_\w+)\s*\(", imports))
require(exports <= managed, "Missing managed ABI imports: " + str(exports - managed))

# Python-generated golden wire messages remain deterministic and present.
fixtures = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/HuntReplay.Tests/Fixtures/python-wire.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
require([f["name"] for f in fixtures] == ["join", "create", "configure", "open", "kill", "config", "count", "close"], "Unexpected protocol fixtures")
controls = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/HuntReplay.Tests/Fixtures/python-control-wire.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
require([f["name"] for f in controls] == ["join", "empty-ack", "echo-join-ack", "create-no-client-label", "sdk-response", "keepalive"], "Unexpected control-frame fixtures")
# Opaque BusMessage.uniqueid regression input: synthetic (generated from the Python proto modules), not a game trace.
synthetic = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/HuntReplay.Tests/Fixtures/python-synthetic-uniqueid-wire.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
require(synthetic.get("synthetic") is True, "IPC uniqueid fixture must be labelled synthetic")
require([f["name"] for f in synthetic["frames"]] == ["join", "create", "configure", "open", "player-downed", "hunter-killed",
        "hunter-killed-retransmit", "config", "count", "close"], "Unexpected synthetic uniqueid fixtures")
# Pin the allocation policy which is incompatible with NV12 render-target arrays in FFmpeg 8.1.
video = (ROOT / "native/src/video.cpp").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
require(re.search(r"fc->initial_pool_size\s*=\s*0\s*;", video), "NV12 capture must use standalone dynamic-pool GPU textures")
# The application version has one source, <Version> in the App csproj; the footer binds it at runtime.
# The native ABI (hr_abi_version) and the CMake project version are deliberately not bumped by app releases
# unless the native contract changes.
csproj_version = re.search(r"<Version>([0-9.]+)</Version>",
                           (ROOT / "src/HuntReplay.App/HuntReplay.App.csproj").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
require(csproj_version is not None, "HuntReplay.App.csproj has no <Version>")
footer = (ROOT / "src/HuntReplay.App/MainWindow.xaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
require("{Binding AppVersion" in footer and not re.search(r"STUDIO\s+/\s+[0-9]", footer),
        "MainWindow footer must bind AppVersion instead of a hard-coded version")
if errors:
    raise SystemExit("\n".join(errors))
print(f"PASS: XML, pinned payloads, {len(production)} production source files, {len(exports)} ABI exports, golden fixtures.")
```

`tools/PipeSmoke/LivePipeSmoke.cs`:

```cs
using System.IO.Pipes;
using Google.Protobuf;
using HuntReplay.Protocol;
using HuntReplay.Protocol.Generated;

namespace HuntReplay.PipeSmoke;

/// <summary>An explicit developer tool, never included in the recorder. No game injection or keyboard input.</summary>
internal static class LivePipeSmoke
{
    public static async Task<int> RunAsync(bool multi, bool controlId = false)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("This sends real test highlight events to a running Studio. Start its buffer first.");
        Console.WriteLine("Use an explicitly selected monitor or a visible game window. No recording source is changed by this tool.");
        if (controlId) Console.WriteLine("SDK requests carry a 37-unit correlation ID ending in U+0000, the field-report shape.");
        using var stop = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60));
        using var pipe = new NamedPipeClientStream(".", "NvMessageBusBroadcast", PipeDirection.InOut, PipeOptions.Asynchronous);
        try
        {
            await pipe.ConnectAsync(5000, stop.Token);
            var join = Envelope(); join.Joined = true;
            await BusFraming.WriteAsync(pipe, join, stop.Token);
            var ack = await BusFraming.ReadAsync(pipe, stop.Token);
            var presence = await BusFraming.ReadAsync(pipe, stop.Token);
            if (ack?.ReferenceUniqueid != join.Uniqueid || presence?.Joined != true) throw new IOException("JOIN handshake failed.");
            await BusFraming.WriteAsync(pipe, new BusMessage
            {
                Uniqueid = "", SourceSystem = "", SourceModule = "", ReferenceUniqueid = ack.Uniqueid,
                Status = new() { Code = BusMessage.Types.Status.Types.Code.Completed }
            }, stop.Token); // No reply is expected for a service ACK.
            await Send(new() { CreateSDKInstanceRequest = new() { Client = "HuntReplay smoke test", ClientPID = (ulong)Environment.ProcessId, GameName = "HuntReplay diagnostic client" } });
            var config = new ConfigureHighlightsRequest();
            config.HighlightTable.Add(new ConfigureHighlightsRequest.Types.HighlightDefinition { HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED" });
            await Send(new() { ConfigureHighlightsRequest = config });
            const string group = "studio-smoke-test";
            await Send(new() { OpenGroupRequest = new() { GroupId = group } });
            await Send(new() { SetVideoHighlightRequest = new() { GroupId = group, HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED", StartDelta = -5000, EndDelta = 5000 } });
            if (multi)
            {
                Console.WriteLine("First kill accepted. Waiting 12 seconds (longer than post-roll, within coalescing gap)...");
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12), stop.Token);
                await Send(new() { SetVideoHighlightRequest = new() { GroupId = group, HighlightId = "HUNTER_KILLED", StartDelta = -5000, EndDelta = 5000 } });
            }
            await Send(new() { CloseGroupRequest = new() { GroupId = group } });
            Console.WriteLine("Events accepted. Wait 16 seconds, then verify one playable MP4 with audio in Studio's gallery.");
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(16), stop.Token);
            return 0;

            async Task Send(SDKIPCRequest request)
            {
                request.VersionMajor = 1; request.VersionMinor = 0; request.Component = (SDKComponent)1;
                var bus = Envelope();
                if (controlId) bus.Uniqueid += "\0"; // opaque token: the reply must echo it exactly
                bus.Generic = new BusMessage.Types.Generic { Type = 1, Data = new SDKIPCMessage { Request = request }.ToByteString() };
                await BusFraming.WriteAsync(pipe, bus, stop.Token);
                var reply = await BusFraming.ReadAsync(pipe, stop.Token) ?? throw new EndOfStreamException();
                if (reply.ReferenceUniqueid != bus.Uniqueid) throw new IOException("Response correlation mismatch.");
                var response = SDKIPCMessage.Parser.ParseFrom(reply.Generic.Data).Response;
                if (response.Retval != 0) throw new IOException(response.Retstatus);
                Console.WriteLine("OK " + request.RequestCase);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) { Console.Error.WriteLine("Live smoke test failed: " + ex.Message); return 1; }
    }
    private static BusMessage Envelope() => new()
    {
        Uniqueid = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), SourceSystem = "HuntReplayDiagnostic",
        SourceModule = "GfeSDK", SourcePid = (uint)Environment.ProcessId
    };
}
```

`tools/PrepareFFmpeg.ps1`:

```ps1
#requires -Version 5.1
[CmdletBinding()]
param([string]$ArchivePath = '', [switch]$Offline)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$Root = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
$Lock = Get-Content (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'ffmpeg.lock.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$Destination = Join-Path $Root 'native/vendor/ffmpeg'
# The marker is written only after a checksum-verified extraction. When it names the pinned archive and the generated
# import libraries exist, the SDK is ready: the archive is not needed (nor downloaded) again.
$Marker = Join-Path $Destination '.hunt-source-sha256'
if ((Test-Path $Marker) -and (Get-Content $Marker -Raw).Trim() -eq $Lock.sha256 -and
    @(Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $Destination 'lib') -Filter '*.lib' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count -ge 5) {
    Write-Host "Verified FFmpeg SDK already prepared ($($Lock.sha256))"
    return
}
$Cache = Join-Path $Root '.cache/downloads'
New-Item $Cache -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
if (!$ArchivePath) { $ArchivePath = Join-Path $Cache $Lock.name }
if (!(Test-Path $ArchivePath)) {
    if ($Offline) { throw "Offline: provide the pinned archive with -ArchivePath. Required SHA256: $($Lock.sha256)" }
    Write-Host "Downloading the pinned FFmpeg shared SDK (build machine only)..."
    [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
    $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Lock.url -OutFile ($ArchivePath + '.download') -UseBasicParsing
    Move-Item ($ArchivePath + '.download') $ArchivePath
}
$Hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $ArchivePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($Hash -ne $Lock.sha256) { throw "FFmpeg checksum mismatch. Refusing to compile or embed untrusted binaries. Expected $($Lock.sha256); got $Hash" }
$Extract = Join-Path $Root ('.cache/ffmpeg-' + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
try {
    Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $ArchivePath -DestinationPath $Extract
    $Sdk = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $Extract -Directory | Where-Object { Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName 'include/libavcodec/avcodec.h') } | Select-Object -First 1
    if (!$Sdk) { throw 'The verified archive does not contain an FFmpeg shared SDK.' }
    if (Test-Path $Destination) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Destination -Recurse -Force }
    New-Item $Destination -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $Sdk.FullName '*') -Destination $Destination -Recurse
    Set-Content (Join-Path $Destination '.hunt-source-sha256') $Hash -Encoding Ascii
} finally {
    if (Test-Path $Extract) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $Extract -Recurse -Force }
}
# BtbN's MinGW import archives are not assumed to work with MSVC. Generate standard x64 .lib
# files from the verified DLL export tables using the user's Visual Studio tools.
$VsWhere = Join-Path ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} 'Microsoft Visual Studio/Installer/vswhere.exe'
if (!(Test-Path $VsWhere)) { throw 'Install Visual Studio 2022 / Build Tools with Desktop development with C++.' }
$Vs = & $VsWhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath
if (!$Vs) { throw 'MSVC x64 tools not found. Install the Desktop development with C++ workload.' }
$Toolset = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $Vs 'VC/Tools/MSVC') -Directory | Sort-Object { [Version]$_.Name } -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
$Bin = Join-Path $Toolset.FullName 'bin/Hostx64/x64'
$Dumpbin = Join-Path $Bin 'dumpbin.exe'
$Lib = Join-Path $Bin 'lib.exe'
New-Item (Join-Path $Destination 'lib') -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null
foreach ($Component in @('avcodec','avformat','avutil','swresample','swscale')) {
    $Dll = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $Destination "bin/$Component-*.dll") | Select-Object -First 1
    if (!$Dll) { throw "Missing runtime DLL: $Component" }
    $Output = & $Dumpbin /nologo /exports $Dll.FullName
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "dumpbin failed for $($Dll.Name)" }
    $Symbols = @($Output | ForEach-Object {
        if ($_ -match '^\s+\d+\s+[0-9A-Fa-f]+\s+[0-9A-Fa-f]+\s+([_A-Za-z][_A-Za-z0-9]*)\s*$') { $Matches[1] }
    })
    if ($Symbols.Count -eq 0) { throw "No exports found in $($Dll.Name)" }
    $Def = Join-Path $Destination "lib/$Component.def"
    @("LIBRARY $($Dll.Name)", 'EXPORTS') + $Symbols | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Def -Encoding Ascii
    & $Lib /nologo /machine:x64 "/def:$Def" "/out:$(Join-Path $Destination "lib/$Component.lib")"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "lib.exe failed for $Component" }
}
Write-Host "Verified FFmpeg SDK prepared at $Destination"

```
